tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so//

༄༅/ / nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la bstod phyag 'bul ba// 1) gar gyi nyams dgu me dpung 'bar ba'i nang*// rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la dus drug gzigs// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu spros med bde chen rnal 'byor pa// sprul pa du mas 'gro ba 'dul bar mdzad// rdo rje 'chang gis dngos su byin gyis brlabs// rje btsun tilli pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rtog ge ngan pa'i dri ma rab sbyangs shing*// lnga brgya ba yi thams cad mkhyen pa mchog /srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus khyad bsad nas// bla ma mchog gi zhabs la spyi bos gtugs// byin rlabs tsam gyis rtogs pa phul du phyin// mchog dang thun mong yid bzhin nor bu brnyes// mnyam pa med pa'i dam pa rin po che/ /rje btsun nā ro pa la phyag 'tshal lo// lus srog phyag dar khrod bzhin dor byas nas// bla ma sman pa lta bu rab tu btsal// gdams ngag bdud rtsi bzhin du 'thung byed pa// rje btsun lho brag pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dka' ba du mas sgrub la nan tan mdzad// don dam brtan pa nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug sprul pa du ma mdzad// rje btsun mi la'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba lta bur spangs// rig 'byung mkhas pa'i slob grwa na lan drar// gtsug gi nor bu lnga brgya'i thams cad mkhyen// bslab gsum rin chen thod bzhin spyi bos bkur// byang chub sems mchog rab sbyangs gzhan don mdzad// jo mos lung bstan kha ba can du byon// dad ldan skye bo nges legs gnyis la bkod// dpal ldan a ti sha la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs las skyes pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs pa// thugs dam zhal gzigs gdul bya'i bsam pa mkhyen// gnas sbyong mthar phyin rtogs pa'i myu gu 'khrungs// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bo gtsug gis blangs// mgo la me shor sgrims pa ji bzhin du// yengs pa med par sgrub la nan tan mdzad// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsang sngags rgyal po mchog gi lam la zhugs// rtags bcu yon tan brgyad sogs mthar phyin nas// gnyis med bde chen thugs kyi dbus su 'khrungs// rtogs pa mchog tu gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod// brtse ba'i ma ma gdul bya rnams la chags// 'jig rten chos brgyad mkha' yi 'ja' ltar rtogs// lung bstan thob cing mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs// brgyud pa mchog ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zab cing rgya che ri khrod dben gnas bsten// spros bral zab zhi 'od gsal mi g.yo bas// mchog gi skye bo thams cad zil gyis gnon// mnyam med mi yi seng ger phyag 'tshal lo// dad dang ldan pa'i skye bo gang dag gis// khyod ni mthong dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus gcod par byed// sman pa'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// gza' bral chu yi snying po 'char ba'i tshe// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i sprin tshogs 'dus dbus nas// sprin bral zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gang ba bzhin// chos sku gnyis med bde chen phyag 'tshal lo// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la 'char ba na// rtogs pa mchog ldan dge 'dun dbus bzhugs nas// gnyis med bdud rtsi char bzhin 'bebs par mdzad// rigs drug dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo// snang ba sna tshogs gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// spros bral nam mkha'i dbus su ro gcig pa// zhi ba rin chen gling du zhugs gyur kyang*// snying rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs// 'dzin pa gnyis spangs rang nyid yal bar dor// rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus bgrod// ltung ba'i rnyog pa ngo bo nyid kyis zhi// chos sku mnyam par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor pa// gsung rab 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs byas nas// mar gyi snying po 'od gsal mthar phyin pas// gzhan don mun sel gsal ba'i mchog tu gyur// lam mchog ston par byed pa'i rin po che// spros pa rab zhi don dam byang chub sems// snying rjes rab brlan kun rdzob smon 'jug gnyis// til dang til mar bzhin du ro gcig pa// zang zing rab spangs mnyam med dge ba'i bshes// gdul bya'i bsam pa ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin// de dang de yi snang ba ston par mdzad// gsung gi brjod pa bral bar gyur na yang*// rnam rig tsam gyis the tshom gcod par mdzad// rtog pa'i mtshan ma sprin dang bral na yang*// mkhyen pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes rin po che// rgyun chad med par chos nyid ngang la bzhugs// sku gsum mngon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// ba spu g.yo zhing dga' ba skyes pa yis// yon tan cha tsam cung zad brjod pa des// zug rngus gdungs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kun// dam pa khyed dang yon tan mnyam par shog

/dbul ba sel ba'i gter chen mi zad pa// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dpal ldan rin po che// 'gro lnga'i dpal du shar ba'i rdo rje 'chang*// bla ma rin po che dang mi 'bral shog /mtsho chen sgrol bar byed pa'i gru dang gzings// ma rnams sgrol ba'i thabs la zhugs gyur cing*// rin chen gling du khrid byed rje btsun dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog /lam stor smag tu zhugs pa'i gsal byed mchog /sku gsum ma dang phrad byed rin po che// skal ldan byang chub gsum la 'dren par byed// rje btsun dam pa khyed dang mi 'bral shog /dam pa khyed dang mi 'bral gyur nas kyang*// skad cig tsam yang mi mnyes med pa dang*// gdams ngag rin chen dga' bzhin gnang byed cing*// mos gus mi 'bral tshul bzhin bsgrub par shog /tha mal med par sgrub pa byas nas kyang*// mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir thob par shog /dbang po'i stobs kyis thob par ma gyur kyang*// rnal 'byor srog gi dbang po 'gag pa'i tshe// rje btsun la sogs rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis// me tog char phab rol mo'i sgra rnams dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan thogs nas kyang*// mkha' spyod gnas su nges par khrid par shog/ // 2) ༄// rigs lnga'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zung 'jug bzhi yi pho brang nas// byin brlab chen po'i 'od phyungs nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas ston mdzad pa'i// brgyud pa'i bla mar phyag 'tshal bstod// mnyam med dam pa rin po che// 'od gsal chen po'i ngang la bzhugs// mtha' brgyad skyon gyis ma gos pa// rje chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dga' ba chen po'i zhing khams na// gsal stong ro gcig ngang la bzhugs// rtog pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo ba'i// rje mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// brtse ba chen po'i zhing khams na// snang stong dbyer med ngang la bzhugs// mtho dman skyon gyis ma gos pa// rje rin chen 'byung ldan phyag 'tshal bstod// byams pa chen po'i zhing khams na// bde stong dbyer med ngang la bzhugs// zag bcas dkri bas mi brdzi ba'i// rje 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// btang snyoms chen po'i zhing khams na// stong nyid snying rje'i ngang la bzhugs// rang don dri mas ma gos pa'i// rje don yod grub par phyag 'tshal bstod// byang sems 'og min zhing khams na// lhun grub bde chen ngang la bzhugs// mnyam rjes chad pa med pa yi// rje rnam par snang mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod// mnyam pa nyid kyi zhing khams na// thugs rje'i chu rgyun mi gcod cing*// blta bas ngoms pa med pa yi// rje sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod//

༈ //nyes pa thams cad rab zad cing*// yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa// 'bras bu thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid ngang las gshegs gyur cing*// chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// bdag cag slob 'bangs 'gro drug la// sngon gyi dam bca' ma bsnyel bar// thugs rje chen po'i sprin bsdus te// bde la zhen pa med pa'i nyams// gsal la 'dzin pa med pa'i don// rgyun chad med pa'i bsam gtan mchog /char pa chen po dbab tu gsol// 'gyur med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// bdag cag rjes zhugs sems can gyi// rnam rtog bde sdug 'khrugs pa kun// mnyam nyid byams pa'i chu bo yis// 'tshe ba thams cad rab zhi ba// bde ba chen por mnyam du gsol// snang med ngang la mnyam gnas kyang*// bdag cag gsol ba 'debs pa yi// gang dang gang gi 'dod pa yi// don rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol// dam pa khyed kyi rtogs pa yis// mtshan ma'i dngos po bshig gyur kyang*// dus gsum gsal bar mkhyen pa yis// sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag rnams// thugs kyis btsir gyis gzung du gsol// rab zhi spros pa rnams zad kyang*// bdag cag bka' yi 'khor 'bangs rnams// dran par gyur pa tsam gyis kyang*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad gsol// bde sdug mnyam par mkhyen na yang*// sdug bsngal zug rngus non pa yi// sems can bde la 'god mdzad cing*// mya ngan zhi bar mdzad du gsol// dus gsum ma lus thams cad du// g.yeng ba'i mtshan ma zhi na yang*// rjes su bsgrub pa'i gang zag rnams// ngo bo nyid kyi rang sems la// g.yeng ba med par bltas nas kyang*// nags khrod dben pa stes dbang gis// 'khrid cing rang dbang bsten mdzad gsol// ma rnams bu la sems pa bzhin// khyed kyi thugs rje chen po yis// bdag cag sems can ma lus pa// sdug bsngal nad las thar mdzad nas// thams cad mkhyen pa thob mdzad gsol// rin po che yi byin rlabs kyis// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyis// gang dang shin tu gang ba dang*// smin dang shin tu smin mdzad gsol// yi dam dkon mchog chos skyong gis// bdag cag sgrub pa byed pa la// bar chad thams cad rab zhi nas// rtogs pa mchog nyid thob nas kyang*// byin rlabs chen po mdzad du gsol// byams pa'i chu bo mi gcod cing*// snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brlan te// byang sems ljon shing rab rgyas nas// sa bcu'i me tog thon gyur te// don gnyis 'bras bu smin mdzad gsol// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang*// chos skyong mkha' 'gro dkar phyogs kyis// bdag cag g.yeng bar gyur pa'i tshe// dben par dbang med 'khrid pa dang*// phyi la chags shing zhen pa'i tshe// rmi lam bzhin du go ba dang*// nang la zhen cing chags pa rnams// 'dod chags bde bar bsgyur mdzad gsol// sdang sems 'byung bar gyur pa na// snying rjer gyur gyis 'gyur ba dang*// mi shes gnyid rmugs byung ba rnams// 'od gsal snang med shes rab tu// mtsho la kha ba bab pa bzhin// ngang du gnas par mdzad du gsol// rdzogs so//

// 3) ༄// bka' brgyud gong ma rnams la phyag mchod gsol 'debs 'gyur med 'od gsal// 'gyur med 'od gsal chos sku bde chen ni// sku gnyis dus gsum rgyal ba'i sprin tshogs kyis// 'gro rnams bde chen sa la 'god par mdzad// bla ma rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis med zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i sku// dpag med sprul pa bye ba mang po yis// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad pa po// rje btsun tilli pa la phyag 'tshal lo// yon tan 'byung gnas bde chen bla ma la// dpag med dka' ba mang pos mnyes byas pas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus brnyes// dpal ldan nā ro pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sems nyid 'od gsal dbyings nas mi g.yo zhing*// gsang sngags yon tan dpag med ston par mdzad// rdo rje theg pas 'gro rnams smin par mdzad// rje btsun lho brag pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyes pa gsum gyis don dam snying po grub// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi// gtsug gi nor bu mnyam med rin po che// rje btsun mi la'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal tshab thugs rje'i dbang phyug ma pham pa// thub pa'i bstan la spyod pa rlabs chen spyad// mi shes mun sel 'jig rten sgron me'i gtso// dpal ldan mar me mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal bas lnga brgya'i dus su lung bstan cing*// sangs rgyas dgongs pa mtha' dag bsgrubs mdzad pa'i// bdag nyid chen po lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin po che// dag pa gnyis ldan dri med chos kyi rje// 'khor 'das bdag po dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// gnyis med bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal mi g.yo bas// gdul bya thams cad smin dang grol mdzad pa// bstan pa rgyas mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis med 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus shar// khams dang bag la nyal dang bsam pa'i tshogs// kun mkhyen skyes rabs gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi yon tan rgya mtsho rnams// khyod la brten nas ma lus thams cad kun// rtsol sgrub med par shugs las smin gyur pa// mi zad gter chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sdig dang sgrib pa'i bud shing ma lus kun// dus mtha'i me bzhin ma lus bsreg par mdzad// bdud bzhi 'khor ba'i dgra rnams 'joms mdzad pa// dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni dad pa'i shugs kyis dran pa'i tshe// zag med bde ba chen po rab rgyas shing*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus zad par byed// byin rlabs rmad du byung la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa mchog

/'od gsal spros dang bral ba'i ngang nyid las// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rten 'brel tshogs// shin tu phra ba'i rgyu 'bras mngon gyur pas// rigs drug 'khor ba'i nad rnams ma lus pa// dbyer med stong dang snying rjes gso bar mdzad// sman pa'i rgyal po khyod la skyabs su mchi// bde chen rgyal po dus gsum 'gyur ba med// mya ngan mi 'da' 'jig rten gsum na bzhugs// rgyun chad med par thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// thub chen khyod la skyo ba yong mi mnga'// brtse ba chen pos kun la bu bzhin gzigs// phongs par gyur na shin tu mi gtong zhing*// gnod par byed la thugs rjes bder 'brel ba// nga 'o zad pas 'khor gsum yongs su dag /brtse chen rmad du byung ba'i gnyen gcig pu// mnyam med bla ma khyod dang mi 'bral shog /dam pa khyod dang mi 'bral gyur nas kyang*// dus gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba'i sems can rnams// zag med bde ba chen po rab rgyas shing*// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog/ // 4) ༄// dpal phag mo gru pa'i skye rabs la bstod pa dus gsum bdag nyid ma// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum bdag nyid bde chen bla ma ni// khyab dang gzugs can ma yin 'gro 'ong med// chos sku rang bzhin lhun grub ngo bo nyid// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu rnam dag bde ba chen po'i sku// smon lam mthar phyin 'gro ba ma lus la// bsam gyis mi khyab sku gsung thugs su shar// mnyam med rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum rang bzhin skye med spros dang bral// ratna tsaraya dus gsum rgyal ba'i gter// 'khor 'das kun gyi mchod pa'i gnas su gyur// sems nyid rang byung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ting 'dzin dpal chen mdzes pa'i grong khyer du// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan mchog mnga' ba// dge ba'i blo gros dge slong chos kyi dpal// 'gro ba 'dren pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i sems can rnams// byams pa chen pos shin tu 'dun mdzad cing*// mi ldog ting nge 'dzin la 'god mdzad pa// brtse chen byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// 'das dus sngon gyi bskal pa grangs med na// drang srong chen po rgyal ba'i skur bstan nas// gling bzhi mi yi bdag po 'khor bcas btul// 'gro ba'i ded dpon chen por phyag 'tshal lo// lam stor 'jig rten gling bar sems can la// rdo rje snying po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar// mi shes mun pa'i tshogs las skyob mdzad pa// skyob pa thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten mgon po shākya'i rgyal po la// zab cing rgya che theg pa'i gleng slong zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa// rgyal po rnam gsum bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// phyi rol rgol ba ngan pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// thub pa'i bstan pa 'jig tu nye ba'i tshe// smra ba ngan pa'i wa rnams 'byer mdzad pa// mtshungs med seng ge'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan birwa pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma lus kun// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel zab mor shar// ma nor thugs su chud la phyag 'tshal lo// bod yul kha ba can gyi sa phyogs 'dir// sna tshogs skye ba'i rnam pa du ma yis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad// 'jig rten sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan phag mo gru yi nags tshal du// skal ldan gdul bya mang po smin mdzad cing*// bsam gyis mi khyab cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// lhun grub 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'i 'od zer gyis// snang srid bde chen chos skur bsgyur mdzad pa// byin rlabs rmad du byung la phyag 'tshal lo// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog u rgyan du// dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro'i sku dang dbyer med pas// 'jig rten dregs byed thams cad 'dul mdzad pa// bde chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs rdul dang bral ba'i zhing khams su// dri med dge slong dkar po'i skur bstan cing*// 'gro rnams skye med sa la 'god mdzad pa// ma skyes spros dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam nyid byang chub snying po'i zhing khams na// rang byung mi bskyod rgyal po sman gyi bla// stobs dang mi 'jigs yon tan kun rdzogs pa// bcom ldan 'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/

/'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong par ma gyur tshe// thugs rje chen pos 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad cing*// mya ngan mi 'da' bde chen chos kyi sku// blo gros dri med rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo// ༈ //khyod ni dri med chos kyi sku// thugs rje smon lam rgyu 'bras kyis/ /'khor ba stong par ma gyur tshe// mi zad sku gsung thugs su shar// sgrib pa rnam gsum dag par mdzad// bsam gyis mi khyab sku gsung la// bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams// kun nas dang bas skyabs su mchi// rje rin po che yi byin rlabs kyis// bdag dang sems can ma lus pa'i// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// dug chen sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras la// bde dang skyid par rnam rlom pa'i// skyabs med sems can thams cad kun// sems gsum bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// sdug bsngal me rlabs zhi mdzad gsol// dran rig 'khor ba'i 'byung khungs la// mthar thug 'bras bur rlom byed cing*// grub mtha' blo yi mdud pa la// sangs rgyas dgongs par 'khrul pa rnams// de nyid rtogs par gyur nas kyang*// dran 'dzin rang sar dag mdzad gsol// bdag 'dzin mun pa'i 'jig rten du// las dang nyon mongs dbang song ba'i// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// 'od gsal rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis// mi shes mun pa bsal nas kyang*// gnyis su med par mdzad du gsol// stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab la// mthar thug 'bras bur rlom byed cing*// las 'bras khyad du gsod pa rnams// gnyis med zung 'jug chen po yis// yul dang yul can gnyis med par// rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur mdzad gsol// nam mkha' lta bu'i sems can rnams// gzhi med rten cing 'brel ba yi// kun rdzob rgyu 'bras sna tshogs kun// stong nyid snying rje ro gcig pa'i// sgyu ma'i lus ngag yid gsum gyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad du gsol// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rnams kun// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pa yi// bde chen chos sku rdzogs nas kyang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs// lhun grub rgyun chad med mdzad gsol/

༈ //rab zhi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor blo las rnam 'das pa// blo mig dag pa'i 'phags pas dpag par mi nus na// blo can 'jig rten gzhan gyis smos kyang ci dgos pa// shin tu zab pa'i bdag nyid rin po che dpal 'dud// sku yi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa yis// rang bzhin dbyer med bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye nas// 'gro ba ma lus smin par mdzad pa'i gnyen gcig pu// mtshungs med dbang phyug khyod kyis 'gro rnams rgyal gyur cig /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams ma lus kun// sems nyid gdod nas spros dang bral zhing ma skyes pas// ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas 'khor la ston mdzad pa'i// lta ba'i mun sel skyob pa'i nyi ma khyod phyag 'tshal// lus dang ngag yid yod na khyod kyi sku gsung thugs// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rnams dang mnyam par mi 'gyur te// rnam gsum rnam par dag pas bde chen ngo bo nyid// lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa khyod ni 'dus ma byas// byang chub zhi ba sems nyid gdod nas rnam dag ni// zag med yon tan dkyil 'khor thams cad rab rgyas shing*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma lus stongs par mdzad nas kyang*// dbyer med bde ba chen po khyod la tha dad med// //

5) ༄// u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la bstod pa// bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// 'jig rten ngam gyur padma'i rgyal po ni// rigs ni u rgyan rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs// u rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs thams cad bcad// bsil ba'i tshal du dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes// 'jig rten khams su gdug pa thams cad btul// kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad// lho nub mtshams su srin po'i kha gnon pa// mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru kaḥ /mnyam med bla ma mchog de dus 'dir dran// // 6) ༄// bstan bcos tsinda ma ṇi'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rtsa ba// oṃ swasti/ tshe 'di'i rnam rtog slu byed gshed ma sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rnams// bdag med ye shes mnyam nyid bde ba chen por bsgyur mdzad cing*// gnyis 'dzin nam mkha'i mdud pa thams cad gcod pa'i gnyen gcig pu// bdud bzhi'i stobs 'joms dpa' bo bla ma dam pa rnams la 'dud// rmongs pa'i byis pa rnams ni nyams dang rtogs pas rnam rlom zhing*// tshe 'di'i nyon mongs rtog pa'i dbang du song nas bsnyon gtam sgrogs// mtha' dag zag pa rnam par rgyas nas zag med ye shes dang*// de yi yon tan ma lus rgyas pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang ga la shes// chom rkun chen po slu byed kha cig dag ni 'di skad ces// kye kye nga la tshe 'di'i nyon mongs rnam rtog mi mnga' zhes// gsang skad mthon pos 'jig rten kun tu grags shing khyab par brjod// rnyed dang bkur sti grags pa bde skyid 'ong du re na yang*// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pas brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms// gzung 'dzin spangs pa'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab de// tshe 'di'i rnam rtog can dang lhan cig gnas par gyur na ni// mun nag nyi ma dang ni lhan cig gnas par gyur pa dang*// rgyal ba rnams dang gong ma'i gsung la skur bar 'gyur// mig gcig 'jig rten mgon po'i gdams ngag nyon// brtse chen des ni nam yang bslu mi srid// phung byed rdzas dang longs spyod sdug bsngal gzhi// lung rigs mi dgos thar ba'i srog gcod pa'i// gshed ma de las bros nas nags su song*// rang la ltos pa med par phan btags cing*// lus srog phye mar byas nas bskyangs gyur kyang*// phan btags lan du gnod pa skyel byed pa'i// za byed gnyen 'dun spongs la nags su song*// rang yul lcags sreg me ltar 'bar gyur cing*// nyon mongs sdug bsngal chags sdang kun gyi gzhi// gnod pa'i gzhir gyur ral gri'i nags tshal 'dra// khe grags mi gtsang ro myags 'dam rdzab tu// mi chos gshin rje'i skyes bu 'dra rnams kyi// dpon du gyur na shin tu mi legs pas// rang la snying brtse yod pa nags su song*// log pa'i slob dpon sgog skya dug sdong 'dra// bsten par gyur na 'jig rten chos kyis gos// btud par gyur na nyon mongs dug gsum 'phel// snying gtad byas na thar pa'i srog gcod pa// bdud kyi rgyal po slob dpon cha byad can// sangs rgyas rnams dang bla mas gsungs pa yi// chos kyi 'brel pa'i bar chad rab spangs nas// gcig pu gnyis su med par nags su song*// kun tu bzang po'i nags tshal dam pa ni// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis shin tu bsngags// sgo gsum mi dge'i tshogs las shin tu dben// dge ba bde ba ma chags zhe sdang dang*// gti mug med pa'i yon tan stobs 'phel ba// rang byung byang chub sems nyid bsgom pa'i gnas// drang srong chen po rnams kyis bzhugs gyur cing*// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs kyis gang*// dpag med bsod nams tshogs las grub pa yi// lha mchog dga' tshal yid 'ong dam pa ni// rtswa dang lo ma nags tshal shin tu mdzes// lo 'bras me tog gis spud ljon shing ni// yid 'ong rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i tshogs rnams kyang*// bsil ba'i grib ma 'dzin cing mthun rkyen sgrub// nags mthongs spang ljongs me tog bkra ba ni// yid la 'thad par byed cing nyams kyang 'phel// bya dang ri dwags mdzes pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// ri bo mchog brgyad nyam nga 'jigs med pas// snyan pa'i sgra 'byin rtsed mo sna tshogs byed// yan lag brgyad ldan bsil ba'i chu rgyun yang*// tshad pa'i gdung ba sel cing nad rnams zhi// gangs ri'i rgyal po dung mdog 'dra ba yang*// nged la rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog yod ces// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun la ngom zhing mdzes// 'khor lo sngon po gnam gyi dbus dag nas// mkha' la spyod pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams// dri med ye shes sprin gyi phreng ba las// shin tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bebs// padma lta bu'i sa gzhi nyams dga' ba// nga las ci dgos longs zhes mthun rkyen sgrub// ngo srung rtsol ba mi dgos phun tshogs pa'i// rgyal bas bsngags pa'i gnas su cis mi sdod// nags khrod der ni drang srong chen po mchog

/rtsa ba lo 'bras gyi nas 'tsho bar bya// go cha chen po bgos pa'i skyes chen gyi// stong dang snying rje rtsa ba ma btang na// sa yi lha mo rnams dang klu chen rnams// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs rnams kyis// rtsa ba lo 'bras me tog nyung ngu la// bcud dang nus pa'i stobs rnams bskyed pa yis// nyung ngus 'tsho zhing bcud len mdangs stobs 'phel// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// dam las mi 'da' bla mas yang yang gsungs// lar chos dang sems su 'dres gyur nas// byams snying rjes rang rgyud brlan gyur na// snang ba rang snang yin pas na// thal tshan chu bo rab med kyang*// rdzing dal gyis 'bab pa'i bdud rtsir gyur// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la ni// zwa tshwa med gsol bas don rnams grub// pha chos rje bla ma rin chen yang*// sha thud gnyis kyi zhen pa bral// zho dar gyi mos pa chung byas nas// lo thug tsam gyi 'tsho ba la// brten nas byang chub bsgrubs par gsungs// lar 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// zas skom rtsol sgrub drag po yis// za 'thung bde ba ci spyad kyang*// thar pa'i bde ba ma myong bas// da res bde chen gyi ro la myang*// khyed byang chub 'dod pa'i dam pa de// rdo rje theg pas bgrod bzhed na// nyon mongs rtog pa'i dug ro de// bslab gsum ma gi'i sbyor ba yis// dug chen rtsad nas ma byang zhing*// smin lam rin chen dbang bzhi yis// sdug bsngal chos su ma bsgyur na// gsang sngags seng ge'i 'o ma yis// dug chen khong du 'phel ba 'am// dug snod bdud rtsis bcag pa ni// dam tshig nyams pa'i snga rtags su// yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs 'byung*// gdon dang rims dang dug sogs kyis// bsad nas rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro// rgyu sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu la// sangs rgyas mthu yang rdugs pas 'jigs// de yi phyir na rnal 'byor pas// dam tshig sdom pa srog bzhin srung*// mthun rkyen 'dzom zhing 'gal rkyen spangs// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa phyogs der// khe grags med pa'i spyil bo dbub// kun la snyoms pa'i zhal zhal bya// chags pa spangs pa'i thab ka der// zhe sdang gdug pa'i me la gzab// gti mug spangs pa'i mal sa der// byams pa chen po'i 'bol stan bting*// bsam gtan yan lag dgus gnas nas// khyed rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po de// mnyam par bzhag par bzhed lags na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog

/tshig tshogs spros pas ma bslad pa// rin chen lta bu'i gdams ngag mchog /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// grub thob gong ma'i phyag bzhed ni// bde chen byang chub sems yin pas// 'gro ba'i don du bskyed par bya// snying nas rgyud la skyes tsam na// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lha sku bsgom// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// gzung 'dzin rtog pa spong ba ni// yi dam lha yi phrin las yin// don gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs par bsgom// brgya la gal te rnal 'byor pa// 'jig rten man ngag zab mo yis// rlung gnad du song ba'i rten 'brel gyis// kha dog gzugs byad gsal na yang*// bdud kyis khyer ba'i gang zag rnams// rtsa ba'i rdo rje slob dpon la// 'khu zhing khyad du gsod pa rnams// yi dam lha yi gzugs bzung nas// rdo rje dmyal bar bsreg par byed// de yi 'khor du gtogs pa dang*// 'brel bar gyur pa thams cad kyang*// thar pa nag po'i 'khor bzhin du// nags la mched pa'i me lce ltar// dkar po'i sa bon thal bar byed// dgongs pa 'dus par gsungs pa dang*// lha 'dod chags skye na yi dwags yin// lha zhe sdang skye na dmyal ba yin// lha gti mug skye na dud 'gro yin// lha dug du song na mi dge ba// de las sdug bsngal 'byung bar gsungs// de bas lha la bya ra gces// dang po las kyi sbyor ba yis// sa brgyad thob par bzhed pa ni// byang chub sems las byung gyur cing*// kun brtags spros pas stong pa yi// sgrib gsum spangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// gnyis med gcig tu gyur pa yis// sa brgyad thob pa mtshar ci che// spyir dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// sa brgyad thob par bzhed pa ni// mdo rgyud rnams kyi rjes 'brangs nas// nyams su bzhes pa'i gdams ngag ni// rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po klu sgrub dang*// dpal ldan tilli nā ro dang*// grub thob brgyud pa gong ma rnams// lam zab bla ma'i mos gus kyis// tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub dang*// gang gi drin gyis bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba yang*// theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun la yang*// dka' ba drag po spyod dus su// de tshe rgyal ba mkha' rdo rje// til gyi gang bu bzhin bkang nas// bsam gtan 'di ni rnam dag min// 'dis ni mthar thug mi thob ste// nam mkha'i ngos ltar dag pa yi// 'od gsal ba la dmigs pa bya// 'od gsal ba la dmigs byas na// rang dga'i gzugs su ston byed ces// byang chub thob pa'i chos bstan pas// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// bdud rnams btul nas rdzogs sangs rgyas// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// rigs kyi bdag pos spyi bor brgyan// rang sems sangs rgyas ston pa yi// bla ma dam pa bkur ba yin// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsungs// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi yon tan rnams// 'di las 'di 'byung dpag med rnams// thams cad bla ma ma gtogs pa// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs// sa dang lam dang sangs rgyas rnams// gzhan nas rnyed pa mi srid cing*// phan dang bde ba'i srog gcig pu// bla ma dam par nges pas na// rtsa ltung dang pos ma phog par// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ltar// spyi bo gtsug tu bkur byas te// byang chub sems kyis mchod nas kyang*// 'dod pa'i don kun gsol ba gdab// snying gi dbus su bzhugs nas kyang*// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi mdun gros dri// longs spyod 'khor lo nyams dga' dang*// mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng du// padma rā ga nyi zla la// skyob mdzad bla ma rin po che// mgon po tshe dpag med pa de// mnyam bzhag chen po'i tshul du bzhugs// a nga'i rnam par chos rnams gsung*// rang yang mnyan cing gzhan rnams kyang*// zab mo'i chos kyis tshim par bya// sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo dang*// dri med ye shes 'khor lo dang*// dpal ldan nag po spyod pa ltar// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas rnams kyang*// bla ma dam pas ston par byed// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kun// chos rje mgon pos ston par mdzad// 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag po mchog

/dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes// bla ma rin chen gsung pas na// dus 'di nas bzung nas sangs rgyas dang*// 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur tshe// dus rnams kun tu mi 'bral zhing*// mchod pa'i tshogs ni ma lus pa// rgyun chad med par mchod nas kyang*// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par bya// bla ma rin chen las byung ba// lam zab mo nyams su len bzhed na// bla ma'i mos gus ma gtogs pa// gzhan nas rnyed par mi 'gyur bar// bka' dang bstan chos thams cad du// dam pa rnams kyis rgya cher bshad// bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas// bla ma chos skur ma go na// rang chos skur rtogs pa kha ta yin// bla ma gzugs skur ma go na// rang yi dam du gsal yang beg pos khyer// bla ma tha mal du skye lags na// rang rtogs pa mtho yang nyams la shor// nyams myong bzang yang gnyid kyis khyer// chos byed ltar 'dug kyang nyon mongs dbang*// btsun po ltar 'dug kyang chos dang bral// pha gi gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nas// snying rje'i rgyal po pha rgyud dang*// lhan skyes kyi rgyal po ma rgyud nas// mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub dang*// gzhi dang lam gyi 'bras bu rnams// bla ma la mos gus ma byas na// 'bras bu 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba// khyed mkhyen pa can gyis ma 'tshal lam// bya bas 'bras bu 'dod pa yi// phyi rol mu stegs kyi dngos grub kyang*// dus gsum du bla ma ma bkur na// srid rtse thob kyang shor lags pas// lhag spyod kyi bsam gtan ma thos sam// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus las// rtogs pa skye bar bzhed lags na// tshe 'di spangs pa'i blo gros dang*// 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras thams cad la// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de// 'dod pa med par go lags na// 'gog pa'i bden pa'i 'bras bu de// rgyud la skye ba'i snod du 'gyur// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho de// ma rig nas bzung rga shi'i bar// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'dis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor ba de// ma rig dang po rgyu 'gags pas// 'du byed la sogs rga shi rnams// rim gyis 'gag par 'gyur bas na// yang rang gi bla ma dam pa la// ma rig rtogs pa'i shes rab can// yang dag don la gnas mthong na// de ltar mthong ba'i slob ma de// rten 'brel lugs las bzlog pa yi// zab mo rtogs pa'i snod du 'gyur// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pas// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag pa med pa'i don mthong nas// de ltar ma rtogs sems can la// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang chub mchog la 'god pa yi// go cha chen po bgos gyur pa// mnyam med rgyal sras dam pa der// bla ma dam pa mthong gyur na// de ltar mthong ba'i slob ma de// theg chen snod du 'gyur ram snyam// bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas// sangs rgyas 'du shes ma skyes na// byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pas kyang*// smon pa'i sems bskyed tsam po yang*// skye 'am mi skye the tshom za// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsungs// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// bdag gi bla ma rin po che// rnam par snang mdzad chen po ni// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes can// sku la zhing khams thams cad snang*// zhing khams kun tu skus khyab cing*// 'bad pa med pa'i ngang tshul gyis// zhing rnams ma lus thams cad du// sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las rnams// zhi khro rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar// sems can smin par mdzad pa yi// 'du shes skyes par gyur pa na// smon 'jug brtan po'i bla ma yin// mos gus bzang po de 'dras kyang*// mthar thug chos sku mi thob ste// thub pa longs spyod rdzogs sku 'di// mi ldog sems dpa' chen po yi// shes bya'i sgrib pa'i snang ba de// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la// 'od gsal rdo rje rnyed pa las// rgyun chad med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i tshe// snang mdzad chen po'i bla ma yang*// yul dang yul can gnyis med par// dbyer med 'od gsal chen por 'gyur// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// rtogs pa skyed pa'i bla ma de// rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs sku yang*// cis kyang yin par mi bzhed de// de yang kye yi rdo rje las// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// don bdag rkyen bsod nams bsags pa yis// bsod nams bsags pa'i kha tshon du// bla ma je mtho gyur pa dang*// gzhan rkyen bla ma dam pa des// rang nyid smin par byed pa yang*// nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ram// sa bon 'bras bu ji bzhin du// rten 'brel zab mos 'grub pas na// mos gus rten 'brel ngo mtshar che// mos gus tshad du skyol lags na// rtogs pa tshad du phyin nas mchi// mos gus tshad du ma phyin par// thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab kyis// brtags shing dpyad pa'i stong nyid kyang*// blos byas stong par bla mas bzhed// nyams dang myong ba'i chos rnams dang*// rgyal ba'i gsung rab zab mo dang*// grub thob gong ma'i mgur rnams dang*// rnal 'byor bzhi yi ye shes kyis/

/sems la bkab pa'i rtogs pa 'di/ /mos gus med pa'i gang zag la// skye ba shin tu sla na yang*// nyon mongs rnam rtog mi spong bas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ga la brgal// spros dang bral ba mi shes pas// spros pa'i mtshan ma ji ltar spong*// skye med 'od gsal ma rtogs par// skye ba'i chu rgyun ji ltar gcod// khe grags sgom gyi yang zong can// rtogs pa'i kha tsho che ba kun// shi na pham por mi mchi 'am// mthar thug mos gus las byung ba// rang byung phyag rgya chen po ni// blo yi yul du ma gyur pas// gzung 'dzin gnyis snang ga la yod// skye med 'od gsal rtogs gyur pas// srid pa'i chu rgyun ngang gis bskams// rang sems rang byung lhun gyis grub// dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa la// mnyam rjes rtog pas ga la bslad// rang byung ye sangs rgyas pa la// yang sangs rgyas nyag gcig ga la 'tshol// dngos med spros dang bral ba la// rtog pa'i sa lam ga la bgrod// chos sku rang la yod pa la// dus ring por gzhan nas ga la 'tshol// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan yang*// sems nyid rtogs las byung gyur na// gdams chung yon tan ga la re// spros bral lhan skyes rtogs lags sam// tshig gi sna mthud ga la 'tshol// gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs pas// bar dor 'od gsal ga la bsgug /sku gsum 'byung gnas ngo bo nyid// rang byung rang la rnyed lags pas// 'bras bu thob tu ga la re// 'khor ba nam mkha' bzhin du rtogs// spong sems kyi rtsol sgrub ga la byed// spyir rang sems rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rang ngang la gnas pa ma gtogs pa// rtsol sgrub byung na nor ba yin// zhe 'dod byung na bdud kyis khyer// sgrib pa gsum po ma lus kyang*// ngang la bzhag pas ngang du grol// nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs dang*// khyad par gti mug las byung ba// sa bdag mdze yi nad rnams kun// phyag rgya chen pos mi 'ded na// skyon dag yon tan bskyed pa yi// chos sku yin pa ku re yin// rtogs ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug de// rtog pa'i sa lam mi brtsi yang*// sa lam shugs kyis bgrod nas mchi// chags sdang gnyis kyi blo gros kyis// spong sems rtsol sgrub mi byed kyang*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rang sar grol// bde chen ngo bo nyid sku la// sku gsum mtshan mar ma grub kyang*// skyon dag yon tan ma lus rdzogs// snying gtam tshig gcig brjod pa de// rang la yod pa'i rang sems dang*// bhu su ku yi spyod 'gros kyis// skad cig tsam yang ma bral dang*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs gyur pa// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// kho bos yon len rtag tu gsungs// des na sems nyid goms par bya// gegs dang bar chad sel ba ni// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi// gegs dang bar chad gsum yin te// gsum po yang ni 'di lta ste// rgyu yi bar chad byang chub sems// byams dang snying rje las byung ba// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po dang*// gser 'gyur rtsi yi mchog lta bu// dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas de// rang gi rgyud la ma skyes par// mtho dman bsam pa gang gis kyang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi thob ste// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pas na// rgyu yi bar chad sel ba ni// phan dang gnod pa'i khyad par las// gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams dang*// bdag dang bdag gi phyogs rnams la// mi mthun gnod pa bsgrub byed cing*// bde dang thar pa'i bar du gcod// gtan gyi bde ba 'phrog byed pa// snying rje bya bar mi 'os pa// gnod par byed pa 'di rnams la// rgyu mtshan rnam pa lnga po yis// tshad med snying rje bskyed par bya// zhag dang zla ba lo rnams su// nan tan chen pos bsgom par bya// sngon gyi rgyal sras dam pa rnams// bskal pa chen po grangs med par// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa kun// skyo ba med pa'i blo gros kyi// snying rje'i shugs las byung ba yin// sgrib pa gsum po spangs nas kyang*// mthar thug byang chub thob pas na// rgyu la nan tan bskyed par bya// bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang*// sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang song zhing*// chos kyi mig dang bral ba rnams// snying rje'i rnam gzhag thos pa yis// snying rje las byung yon tan rnams// rgyud la skye bar 'dod pa dang*// snying rje bsgom pa'i dus su yang*// snying re rje ba'i go yul gyis// snying rje bsgoms par mi 'gro ste// rgyu mtshan rnam pa lnga la sogs// rgyud la skye ba'i thabs rnams ni// zhing dang sa bon chu lud sogs// myu gu skye ba'i thabs bzhin te// myu gu rang ni ma yin ltar// rang gi rgyud la ma skyes pa'i// lo zla mang po thams cad du// snying rje bsgoms pa'i yus po che// snying rje'i rtsa ba med pa la// yon tan lo 'dab gang nas 'ong*// snying rje rgyud la skyes tsam na// gzhan pas rang gces bsam pa yis// nga rang rgyal 'dod ga la 'ong*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rgan gyi// sdug bsngal sel bar 'dod pa yi// bsam pa rang dbang med par skye// de yi dus su bla ma la// sems bskyed pa yi sdom pa thob// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni// sa gzhi 'gyur ba med pa ltar// lus ngag yid gsum thams cad kyis// dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shugs rnams kun// rang nyid grol bar 'dod pa'i blo// skad cig tsam gyis skyes na yang*// de tshe nyan thos theg par ltung*// byang chub sems las ma gtogs pa'i// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nga rgyal phra dog dug rnams kyi// kun slong rgyu yi sa bon las// lam dang 'bras bu thams cad du// bslu ba med par dug tu 'gyur// dug gis rang gzhan thams cad phung*// gegs dang skyon dang bar chad rnams// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// sdug bsngal spong bar 'dod pa yis// byang chub sems la nan tan bskyed// sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la// nan tan bskyed pa tsam gyis kyang*// gegs dang bar chad dag nas mchi// rgyu yi gegs sel bstan pa'o//

༈ //lam gyi gegs sel bstan pa ni// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyis// gegs dang bar chad sel ba ste// bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi ni// phung po'i bdud dang nyon mongs bdud// lha yi bu dang 'chi bdag go// sdug bsngal phung po 'di nyid la// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal gyis// dus rnams rgyun tu gtses gyur cing*// lam la bar du gcod gyur na// lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir// sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid can// sgrib pa gsum po spangs pa der// gsang sngags dbang gi man ngag gis// rgyun chad med par rang nyid bsgom// bskyed rim brtan pa'i yan lag tu// rdo rje bzlas pa rgyun tu bya// man ngag gsum gyi gnad zin na// ring por mi thogs rnal 'byor pas// bskyed pa'i rim pa brtan par 'gyur// sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin las// skyes pa'i sdug bsngal phung po yi// bdud kyi rgyal po ma rungs pa// bcom ldan 'das kyis bcom nas kyang*// sha dang rus pa'i tshogs rnams ni// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad mchog /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs su gang*// mnyam med rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyad// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// rang byung sems nyid dri ma med// mchod rten brgyad kyi tshul du ston// byang chub sems kyi sprin brgyad las// thugs rje chen po'i chu brgyad 'bab// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi// byang chub shing mchog rnam brgyad la// thub pa'i dbang po brgyad byung ste// dga' bo la sogs klu brgyad dang*// brgya byin la sogs lha dang klu// gnod sbyin mi 'am ci rnams kyis// thub pa'i dbang por yongs bskor nas// 'gro ba ma lus smin mdzad par// sdug bsngal phung po gnas gyur pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bskyed pa'i gzhi// nyon mongs gsum po stobs 'phel bas// rang gzhan thams cad brlags gyur pas// lar skyob mdzad thub pa'i dbang po yis// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong grangs med gsungs pa rnams// nyon mongs dug gsum gnyen po yin// nyon mongs gdul bar bya ba'i phyir// thabs mkhas thugs rje can rnams kyi// bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad kyis// rang gzhan nyon mongs 'joms mdzad pa// gnad kyi man ngag gsum po yang*// gang zag rigs las byung ba ste// dam pa rnams la chags sdang med// man ngag dang po bstan pa ni// dpal dang 'od dang gzi brjid can// rigs rus yon tan thams cad kyi// yon tan rgyan gyis rab brgyan pa// skyob mdzad shākya'i dbang po yi// rjes su zhugs pa'i sras rnams kyis// 'jig rten kun gyis smad pa'i gnas// rtsa ba yan lag sdom pa rnams// nyes pa'i skyon dang bral bar bya// 'jig rten mgon pos bcas pa yi// rgyal po'i khrims las gang 'da' ba// shākya'i rigs las nyams pa ste// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis// smad pa'i chad pa dang po phog

/dmyal ba yi dwags byol song gi// sdug bsngal chad pa gnyis pa dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal drag po yis// gtan du btses ba'i nyes pa yis// phung bar gyur na ma legs pas// shākya'i dbang po'i nang khrims las// bdag cag 'gal bar mi bya zhing*// srog la bab kyang bsrung bar bya// snyam pa'i go cha drag po yis// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la// nan tan chen po byas pa yi// nyon mongs gsum gyi dgra choms nas// 'phags pa'i sa la rab tu gnas// dad pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa yis// shākya'i rgyal po'i gdams ngag la// nan tan byas las byung ba ste// tshe 'dir rtog pa'i blo can la// gnad kyi man ngag dang po yin// ༈ //bdag la phan par byed pa'i ma// rang gi srog dang bu yi srog /brje bar phod pa'i gdung sems kyis// rang gi bde dang skyid pa dang*// bza' dang btung ba gang la yang*// kham cig za dang 'thung na yang*// rang gi bu la mi sbyin pa// mi nus pa yi bsam pa can// srog chags srin dang 'dra ba zhig /gsos shing bskyed nas da ltar gyi// bde dang skyid pa 'di dag dang*// 'jig rten 'di dang phyi ma dang*// dus gsum bde ba thams cad kun// bdag la ster ba'i drin can ma// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa la// gdung ba'i shugs kyis byams pa yis// ma yi 'dug lugs bltas pa la// khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer du// skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis// rgyun chad med par gtses gyur cing*// dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*// rigs drug sdug bsngal mi bzad pas// g.yen spyos

g.yen spyos pa ni sdang ba dang*/ sdigs pa/ gshe ba sogs la 'jug skyabs mgon bral ba la// snying rje chen po'i ngu shugs kyis// a ma'i sdug bsngal ma bzod nas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer du// rang dbang med par 'jug pa ni// padma'i mtsho la ngang pa dang*// dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa bzhin// go cha chen po bgos nas kyang*// 'gro ba byang chub mchog la 'god// byang chub sems dpa' chen po des// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i thabs// byang chub sems pa'i sdom pa las// sdom pa'i tshul khrims dri med pa// sems can kun gyi don ched du// byang chub snying por rab tu bzung*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims de// na 'phos gong du stobs 'phel ba// sa dang lam gyi rim pa ste// nyon mongs bdud tshogs rab bcom nas// 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur// gdung ba can gyi gang zag gis// ma yi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas// nyon mongs spangs pa'i lag rjes de// gnad kyi man ngag gnyis pa yin// ༈ //bsags pa rab tu gyur pa yis// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyis// nyon mongs 'joms par byed pa ni// spang bya gnyen po gnyis med de// 'bras bu lam du byed pas na// rgyu yi dus na 'bras bu nyid// las 'phro can gyis rtogs su rung*// dpal tilli pa yi gsang tshig yin// 'bras bu lam du byed pa ni// rin chen dbang gi man ngag gis// nyon mongs ye shes nyid du 'gyur// de dang de yi rang bzhin nyid// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis// rtogs shing mngon du 'gyur ba ste// lhan skyes dri med nam mkha'i dbyings// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas// gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan te rtogs// mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcur yang*// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// de ring nyid du mgon po nga ni 'khrul pa chad// da ni su la'ang mi 'dri zhes// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa dang*// spang bya gnyen po thams cad la// rang bzhin rtag pa yod na ko// skye med rtogs pa mkhas pa rnams// ci yi phyir na mya ngan 'da'// des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// lhan cig skyes pa bdud rtsi'i ro// spang bya gnyen po gnyis med pa'i// sems kyi gshis la goms par bya// bsags pa rab tu gyur pa yi// bla ma mnyes pa'i byin rlabs kyis// gnyis su med pa'i don mthong ba// gsang sngags gnad kyi man ngag ste// gnad kyi man ngag gsum po 'dis// nyon mongs spong ba 'dra na yang*// bsags pa rab 'bring khyad par gyis// dang po 'khor bas skrag nas spong*// spangs pa'i nyan thos nyid du nges// gnyis pa 'gro ba'i don ched du// byang chub sems kyis nyon mongs spangs// sgrib pa spangs pas sangs rgyas thob// gsum pa bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i bag chags rnams// gnyis med rang gi ngang du dag

/nyon mongs dag pa'i lag rjes 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// gsum po 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la// skrag pa skyes pa'i gang zag des// byang chub sems kyi go bgos nas// zab mo lam la zhugs pa'i tshe// phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad 'byung*// de yang gnyis su shes par bya// chen po'i bdud dang chung ngu'i bdud// rnal 'byor nyams su myong bas 'byung*// chung ngur gyur pa'i bdud rnams ni// klu dang rgyal po bsen mo rnams// 'jig rten khams na gnas pa ste// rgya mtsho chu bo lteng ka dang*// chu mig mtsho dang mtshe'u rnams dang*// g.ya' ri gangs ri nags ri dang*// 'brog dang lha khang phug stong dang*// rdzas dang yo byad bang mdzod sogs// nyon mongs can gyi sems can la// gdug pa can gyi lha 'dre rnams// kun tu bzang po'i smon lam ltar// las kyi dbang gis gnas pa yin// 'jig rten log 'dren 'di dag rnams// mthun pa'i rdzas kyis mchod gyur na// mthu mgon sna tshogs byed par 'gyur// chu lha rlung lha la sogs pa// lung du grags pa thams cad kun// don gyis 'di rnams yin par 'dug /nyams len tshad du song ba yis// nyams myong phyogs cig skyes gyur na// yid kyi gzugs can de dag gis// rnal 'byor pa yi sems mthong nas// rang la gnod pa'i bsam pa 'byung*// mthu dang nus pa stobs rnams kyis// rnal 'byor pa la bar du gcod// rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan dag /phyogs bcu kun tu 'khrugs par byed// tshe dang srog gi bar chad kyis// thar pa 'thob la bar du gcod// dmag dang 'thab mo sha gnyer dang*// tshig gam zhig gam gsod byed pa// de kun 'byung po'i rnam par 'gyur// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams de dag gis// bar chad sna tshogs byed pa la// rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pas// gsungs pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*// sngags zlos sngags mdud la sogs pa// man ngag gnad du che ba yin// gzhan yang ston pa bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten khams su byon pa'i tshe// lag na rdo rje la sogs pas// rang rtags srog gi snying po rnams// ji ltar phul ba'i rten 'brel dang*// cho ga zhib mo thams cad kun// phyi rabs rnal 'byor don ched du// 'jig rten mgon pos bzhag pas na// de dag kun kyang mkhas pas bsten// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// bar chad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni// gnod par byed pa de dag gi// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bsams pa las// rang dbang med pa'i snying rje skye// snying rje chen po las byung ba// byang chub sems kyi go cha bgos// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// lus ngag yid gsum dge ba rnams// khong gis gtso bo byas pa yi// sems can bde zhing skyid pa dang*// bde bas sdug bsngal dang bral nas// byang chub 'thob pa'i don du bsngo// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung*// chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// 'gro mgon de yi bka' stsal la// gtang snyoms tsam du bzhag phangs pas// rang la ltos pa med pa'i blos// snying nas nan tan chen po yis// bdag gis smon lam 'di skad btab// bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa yi// dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pas// khyed la sogs pa'i sems can kun// bde dang skyid pa rab rgyas shing*// gnod pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog thob ces// yang dang yang du smon lam btab// bden pa'i stobs kyang 'di ltar brjod// skyabs chen dkon mchog bden pa dang*// rang bzhin rnam par dag pa yi// chos kyi dbyings kyi bden pa dang*// lha dang snying po sngags dang ni// phyag rgya dam tshig bden pa yis// 'byung po ma rungs khyod la sogs// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang*// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig

/sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab spangs nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob gyur cig /rang snying dpang du btsugs pa yi// g.yo sgyu med pa'i bsam pa yis// rtag tu smon lam rgya chen btab// bden pa'i stobs dang smon lam stobs// lhag bsam g.yo dang bral ba'i stobs// bsam gyis mi khyab stobs rnams kyis// smon lam 'grub pa rten 'brel te// phan zhing bde ba skyes gyur nas// gnod pa shugs kyis 'gag gam snyam// dang po'i las can rnal 'byor la// phra mo bdud kyi bar chad la// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bstan pa'o// ༈ //nyams myong chen por gyur ba yi// lhan cig skyes pa'i drod thob na// chen por gyur pa'i bdud rnams kyis// bar du gcod pa gdon mi za// chen por gyur pa gang zhe na// tshangs pa gung lang khyab 'jug dang*// brgya byin dbang phyug chen po rnams// lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor la// bar chad rnam pa sna tshogs byed// 'dod pa'i dbang phyug stobs ldan rnams// 'jig rten mi rnams bskul byas te// 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs kyis// rnal 'byor pa la bar chad byed// gling bzhi legs par brgyan gyur cing*// rin chen sna bdun dbang phyug gtso// thogs med mkha' la 'gro ba'i bla// gling bzhir gnas pa'i sems can rnams// dge ba bcu la 'god pa'i dpal// stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba yi// longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa kun// rnal 'byor pa la sbyin pa yis// thar pa'i bar du gcod par byed// stobs ldan spyi phud stong gi rje// lha dbang mig stong ldan pa po// bde dang skyid pa'i dpal 'bar zhing*// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams la// chags thogs med pa lha yi lha// lha min rab tu pham mdzad pa// thogs pa med pa'i rdo rje can// dbang po nye dbang thams cad kyi// gtsug gi nor bus rab tu blangs// rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang na// che ba'i che thabs thams cad kyis// shin tu che bar gyur pa yi// dbang dang bsod nams rgyal srid rnams// rnal 'byor pa la stob pa yis// thar pa'i bar du gcod par byed// stong gsum mi mjed khams kyi bdag

/tshangs pa'i dbang po gdong bzhi pa// byams dang snying rje'i ting 'dzin gyis// 'gro rnams bde la 'god pa'i dpal// stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams// skad cig cig la shes pa yi// mngon par shes pa'i stobs 'chang ba// tshangs pa'i dbang po'i go 'phang dang*// longs spyod bde skyid ster bas kyang*// thar pa'i bar du gcod par byed// shin tu zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin// bsam gtan snyoms par 'jug pa dang*// byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*// btang snyoms zhi bde bsam gtan dang*// 'jig rten pha rol phyin drug gis// thar pa'i bar du gcod par byed// gzhan yang myong rig ting 'dzin gyis// rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad kyi// thar pa'i bar du gcod pa ste// rang nyid zhi bde 'dod pa'i blos// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bar du gcod// de 'dra'i bsam pa ston pa yi// pha ma mkhan po slob dpon dag /bar du gcod pa'i bdud rnams su// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs// kye ma bar chad bdud rnams kyis// gtan gyi bde ba 'phrog byed cing*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnod pa yis// dus rnams rgyun tu gnod pa yi// dgra bgegs ma rungs 'di dag la// bdag lta ji ltar dga' ba skye// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor pham bzhed na// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// skyob mdzad shākya'i dbang po yis// gnyug ma byams chen ting 'dzin gyis// ma lus bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rnams// bde chen rab tu mchog la bkod// ngas kyang de yi rjes su bslabs// nus pa'i mthar thug birwa pa// lung bstan thob pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon// klu sgrub snying po la sogs pa// grub thob gong ma rnams kyis kyang*// rtogs pa'i ye shes ma gtogs pa// kun rdzob srung ba gang gis kyang*// nang bdud chen po mi thub ces// bu gcig rnal 'byor rjes 'jug la// gces pa'i 'o dod drag po 'bod// gong ma rnams kyi rjes 'brangs nas// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis// bde gsal mi rtog las skyes pa'i// 'jig rten dbang phyug chen po rnams// sde dang dpung bcas gzhom par bya// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs nyid mi 'gyur rdo rje yis// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor bcom pa 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// skye zhing 'chi ba'i bdag po gcig

/mi bzad dbang phyug chen po de// sus kyang thub pa yod med do// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// bdag nyid chen po'i lto bar gnas// khams gsum srid pa gsum gyi bdag /mthong ngam thos sam dran pas kyang*// rang gzhan thams cad brlag par byed// sems can kun gyi tshe srog la// dbang byed 'chi bdag bdud kyi rje// ji ltar byas na 'di las thar// bdag cag lhan cig tshogs pa rnams// gsod pa'i gshed ma 'di nyid kyi// lag nas da rung ma thar na// bdag cag ji ltar dga' bar gnas// mi bzad gshin rje'i lto ba 'dir// rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nam yang thar ba'i dus med na// bdag lta ji ltar dga' ba skye// mthong ngam thos sam dran pas kyang*// rang dbang med pa'i bred shugs kyis// kha nas khrag dron skyug byed pa// gshin rje be con thogs pa yis// bdag nyid rtag tu bcom gyur na// bdag lta dga' ba ga la thob// kye ma mi bzad 'chi bdag las// 'di las skyob par byed pa yi// bdag gi skyabs su su zhig 'gyur// mgon po bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs// thub pa chos kyi sku can de// bdag la skyob pa'i ngang tshul gyis// skyabs chen bla ma dam par snang*// rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid las// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'du shes kyis// bdag dang sems can thams cad kun// 'chi bdag chu srin chen po las// thar par 'dod pa'i blo gros kyis// skyabs chen 'di la rab btud de// bdag dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yi// gces pa'i lus srog thams cad kyis// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchod gyur nas// g.yo sgyu spangs pa'i bsam pa yis// rdo rje 'chang dbang chen po la// snying nas nges par skyabs su song*// de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// dpa' bo khams gsum las rgyal ba// 'jigs byed khams gsum 'jigs mdzad pas// gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje yis// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ma rig pa// mi bzad 'chi bdag gshin rje yi// spyi bor rnam par bsnun nas bsad// 'chi bdag gshin rje bsad pa yis// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// thar nas bde ba chen po'i sku// khams gsum las rgyal chos rjer 'gyur// 'chi bdag gshin rje chen po de// bsad pa'i sha rus phung po ni// 'og min chos kyi pho brang du// rnam par snang mdzad chen por 'gyur// lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid 'dis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// rtsol sgrub med pa'i ngang tshul gyis// bde chen byang chub mchog la 'god// sku yi dkyil 'khor de nyid la// dus gsum sangs rgyas sprin tshogs 'khrigs// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes can// skyob mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon por 'gyur// bla ma dam par mos gus kyis// bdag 'dzin bsad pa'i lag rjes 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// mdor na rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis// sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la// bar du gcod pa rnam pa bzhis// bdag rkyen gzhan rkyen gang yin yang*// byang chub bar du gcod par byed// sdug bsngal phung po bdud chen ni// sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid can// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba der// bsgoms shing brtan pa thob pas 'dag

/chags sdang nyon mongs thams cad kun// sdom pa gsum gyis rim gyis spong*// phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad ni// byang chub sems kyi sbyor bas spong*// mi bzad 'chi bdag gshin rje yang*// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus kyis// 'od gsal thob nas rang sar dag /lam gyi gegs sel bstan nas kyang*// ༈ //'bras bu'i gegs sel bstan pa ni// rgyu yi rten 'brel tshogs pa las// 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa 'byung*// rgyu yi rten 'brel ma tshang na// 'bras bu'i gegs su gyur pas na// 'bras bu'i gegs sel bstan par bya// thub pa sku gsum bdag nyid ni// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu ste// bdag gi rkyen dang gzhan gyi rkyen// gnyis ka'i rkyen las grub pa ste// de yang dang por bdag rkyen ni// ku sā li yi gzhung lugs kyis// 'khor 'das gzung yul thams cad la// mtho dman grub mtha' thams cad du// rtogs mkhan rang gi rig pa ste// dang por rang gi rig pa 'di// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar rtogs// de nyid goms pa'i ngang shugs kyis// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// gnyis kyis bsdus pa thams cad kun// rang gi gshis las mi 'da' ba// spros med lhan cig skyes par rtogs// gnyis med ye shes de nyid ni// mnyam rjes gnyis snang rnam par dag /gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// lhun gyis grub pa nyid du gnas// lhun grub rgyun chad med pa de// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i gshis// thub pa'i bde chen chos sku yin// thams cad chos skur gcig gyur pas// chos sku bdag gi rkyen zhes bya// gzhan gyi rkyen la ltos pa ni// kun rdzob rten 'brel che ba ste// sems can nam mkha' mnyam pa la// snying rje chen po rab skyes nas// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de// byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyis// sa bcu sems can don tu sbyangs// gnyis ka'i rkyen la ltos pa ni// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*// khams gsum sems can ma lus kun// rtogs rgyu gzung 'dzin de nyid la// snying rje'i yul yang de nyid de// rtogs pa'i ye shes na 'phos pas// sbyang gzhi lus ngag yid gsum rnams// sbyangs shing dag pa de bzhin du// lus ngag yid gsum rnam dag pa'i// yon tan bye ba mang po rnams// na 'phos gong du stobs 'phel ba// gzhan rkyen snying rje'i rten 'brel gyis// 'gro ba rab tu smin par mdzad// rtogs pa'i chos nyid 'od gsal gyis// lus ngag yid gsum rab sbyangs nas// shing zad me zad ji bzhin du// chos sku stsol sgrub med par gnas// lus ngag yid gsum rnam dag pas// dag pa mthar phyin yon tan sku// lus nyid rab tu dag pa las// thub pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// dpe byad bzang pos rab spras pa// zhing rnams kun la bzhugs pa'o// ngag rnams sbyangs pa rnam dag pa// dag pa'i yon tan de nyid kyis// thub pa'i gsung gcig yan lag la// sgra skad rgya mtsho rab phye bas// sems can thams cad smin par mdzad// thugs nyid sbyangs pa rnam dag pas// dag pa'i yon tan de nyid ni// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes te// bral ba'i yon tan sum cu gnyis// de ltar thub pa'i sku gsung thugs// sems can don du rab sbyangs pas// sangs rgyas chos sku rnam dag ni// ma lus sems can khams rnams la// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par snang*// chos sku bde ba chen po ni// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtha' las 'das// mtha' bral 'od gsal chen po yis// lus ngag yid gsum rnam dag pa// byang chub sems kyi rgyu byas pas// skye med 'od gsal chos sku de// rang bzhin dbye ba med pa yis// sems can khams rnams thams cad la// sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lor snang*// 'od gsal dbyings la tha dad med// sku gsum rgyu lam 'bras bu yi// gegs dang bar chad bral ba 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// mgon po phag mo gru pa'i dgongs pa dri med pa// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu skyon med 'od gsal ba// mi shes mun sel 'jig rten sgron me gsal byed 'di// bsags pa rab tu gyur pa'i gang zag blo gros can// tshe 'dir ltos pa rab bcad lhag pa'i bsam pa yis// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la yun ring gtugs gyur nas// sgrub ba snying por byed cing dben pa la dga' bas// tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa la// dbang gi rgyal po nor bu rin chen ji lta bar// bla ma dam pa'i gsung 'di nye bar mkho bar gnas// don gyi snying po yi ger bris pas tshig gi brgyud par song gyur na// bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang dam pa rnams la bzod par gsol// bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa dri med pa// 'gro la phan par dgongs pa brtse ba'i bdag nyid can// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir yi ger bkod pa yis/
bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par shog tsinda ma ṇi rin po che 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba rdzogs so// //

7) ༄// bla ma'i bka' bstsal gces pa'i snying po dum khrigs// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yon tan thams cad kyi gter du gyur pa/ 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad kyi dpal dang mgon du gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i bdag por gyur pa/ rje btsun phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin 'di/ rgyu gang las byung na ma rig pa las byung*/ ma rig pa 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin du gnas/ ma rig pa'i rang bzhin du 'khrul pa yin te/ mdor bsdus na/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin zhes bya'o// ma rig pa la gnyis te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs las byung ba las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ rten 'brel lugs las ldog pa de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa'o// ma rig pa rig pa dang*/ shes shing go bar byed pa bla ma yin la/ shes shing go ba la ni sangs rgyas kyi chos zhes bya'o// de yang*/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes// yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs// zhes pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad du ma rig pa sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'dag par byed pa/ lam nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu thams cad du bla ma gcig pus lam bgrod par bzhed do// de yang slob dpon birwa pa'i zhal nas/ rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i dbang*// dbang lam gyi 'khor lor 'khor bar bzhed/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i dbang du byas na yang sems bskyed nyi shu rtsa gnyis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i bla ma la bsten nas thob cing*/ sems bskyed nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyis lam bgrod par bzhed de/ don la sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad du las dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad 'dag cing*/

'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad bla ma la brten nas skye/ de yang*/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs// zhes gsungs so// de yang mdor bsdus na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las sku gsum ye shes rnam pa lnga gcig tu dril ba dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lung chos dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa dang*/ dge 'dun sde gnyis la sogs pa dkon mchog gsum ga bla ma gcig pu yin par bzhed de// de yang dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// zhes pa dang yang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa bsnyen bkur ba las yon tan ma lus pa thams cad skye ste/ bla ma yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las yon tan skye yi/ mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i bla mas yon tan bskyed par mi nus te/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rkos phor la ri mo med na tshwa tshwa la ri mo mi 'byung gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab thams cad du yang bla ma'i mtshan nyid dpag tu med pa bshad pa slob ma'i rgyud la yon tan skye bar bzhed nas gsungs pa yin/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid dpag tu med pa'i don bsdus pa yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas// chos gsum dang ldan pa'i rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi thugs sprul pa// bde chen bla mar phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa chos gsum ldan du bzhed de/ de yang shes rab chen po'i sgo nas chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad khong du chud pas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam sna 'khrid nus pa dang*/ snying rje chen po'i sgo nas ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi khur 'khur bar nus pa dang*/

tshe 'di la ltos pa spu'i rtse mo tsam yang med pa ni bla ma'o gsungs/ yang na sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ngo sprod nus pa gcig pu ste/ de yang gang gi drin gyis bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces pas sems nyid ston pa'i bla ma ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i bla ma rin po che zhes gsung ngo*// de lta bu'i bla ma la bsten par bya ba'i tshul lugs dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ don mos gus drag po gdung ba'i shugs kyis dus dang rnam pa thams cad du shes pa bla ma dam pa dang mi 'bral ba'i blos dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bsnyen bkur byed pa'o// de yang bla ma dam pa de'i mtshan thos nas yul phyogs thag ring po nas mos gus dang gdung ba drag po yod na/ rgyal ba sprul pa'i skus rang rgyud byin gyis rlob cing ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo'am yon tan dpag tu med pa rgyud la skye ste/ dper na byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi mtshan thos nas gdung ba'i sems skyes pa lta bu'o// de ltar rgyang ring po nas mos gus byas pa gcig pus chog pa ma yin te/ rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rgyud rang don dang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi lag rjes yin pas bla ma dam pa bsnyen bkur dgos te/ de yang bla mas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bskyed pa skyes pa ni sa gzhi dang 'dra la/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum de la nye bar 'khor ba'i rdzas dang longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gtong ba ni 'dod chags med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sa bon gruung po dang 'dra ba rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'grub pa'o// de yang dper na byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags la rgyang ring por mos gus byas pas chog par ma bltas nas/

shing rta lnga brgya dang bu mo lnga brgya rgyan gyis brgyan pa yang phul/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod sha dang khrag dang rus pa dang bcas pa ltos pa med par phul bas sa bdun pa man chod kyi mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa lta bu'o// ༈ //kye legs par dgongs dang skyes bu rnams// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// sdug bsngal gting mtha' med pa las// sgrol bar byed pa'i bla ma la// mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis// rgyun chad med par mi gdung ba// bdag gi mgon skyabs su zhig yin// sha dang khrag dang rus pa rnams// bla ma'i phyogs su mi gtong ba// thog med dus nas da yi bar// gces par btsas pa'i lus po rnams// da lta khyod kyi gang na yod// da res rul ba'i phung po 'di// skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// ltos pa med par phul nas kyang*// sangs rgyas gser gyi kha dog sku// mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad kyis// legs par brgyan cing dpal 'bar zhing*// ma lus zhing khams thams cad na// 'gyur ba med par rtag tu bzhugs// sems can ma lus smin mdzad pa// thub pa'i sku dang mi brje bar// rul pa'i phung pos ci zhig bya// rtag tu 'di dang 'grogs sam ci// rdzas dang longs spyod thams cad dang*// nye du g.yog 'khor thams cad kyis// bla ma'i sku gsum rang bzhin la// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kyi// bde skyid yon tan rgya mtsho rnams// phul nas chen por mi byed pa// rdzas dang longs spyod thams cad kyis// rang gzhan kun gyi dug 'phel ba// bu gcig khyed kyis mi sems sam// des na lus srog longs spyod dang*// mchod par 'os pa thams cad kyis// mnyam med bla ma mchod pa yis// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor grub// de ltar rdzas dang longs spyod dang lus dang srog la sogs pa thams cad ltos pa med par dad gus drag pos bla ma la phul/

de yang de tsam gcig pus chog pa ma yin te/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa de la mos gus dang gdung ba drag po'i shugs kyis bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog 'di byas dang*/ 'di byed kyi rtsis 'dings pa med par dus 'di nas bzung nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stongs kyi bar du mi 'bral ba'i go cha yod na/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma de'i thugs kyis zin te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang gcig tu 'dres te/ sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid rdo rje yi rang bzhin du ro gcig par 'gyur te/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du// skyob pa bla ma dam pa dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral te// mnyam nyid dbyer med rdo rje'i sku// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// 'khor 'das thams cad nga yin te// nga yang bla ma dam pa yin// de kun thams cad nam mkha' ste// nam mkha' nyid kyang sa gzhi yin// gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'o// de ltar rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dus gsum gyi bdag nyid de ni bla mas tshor te/ bla mas bgrod par 'gyur ro// de 'gro 'ong med pa'i khyim du phyin// spang blang med pa'i 'bras bu thob// gnyis 'dzin med pa'i kha zas za// bde ba chen po'i btung ba 'thung*// snang med thang la skyo bsangs byed// gnyis med nor la longs spyod cing*// sngon bsags sgyu ma'i longs spyod kyis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i ma rgan rnams// rang gi ngang du 'dren par byed// 'di yi dus su bla ma dang*// gnyis su med par gyur pa yis// bla ma'i zhabs tog tshar ba yin// de ltar bla ma bsten pa'i tshul lugs de dag thams cad kyis mos gus dang gdung shugs drag pos bla ma dam pa la gdungs pas/ bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 'dres pa'i rten 'brel gyis skyon dag cing yon tan rdzogs pa yin la/ mos gus de yang rgyu med pa las mi skye ste/

sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags bsags pa/ bla ma des kyang rgyud smin pa dang grol bar byas pa'i las kyi 'phro de da res 'dir sad pa la mos gus de 'dra ba skye ste/ slob dpon dpal ldan nā ro pa lta bu ni mos gus rab tu gyur pa yin/ dbang po 'bring po blo 'khrid du btub pa man chad la bla ma rin po che'i gdams ngag gis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag cing*/ bdag la mos gus skye bar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab ste/ de ltar byas na mos gus rab tu 'gro ba la tshegs med/ mos gus dang yon tan dus mnyam du skye'o// de lta bu'i mos gus de yang*/ gzhi bzhag tu gyur pa zhig la bya yi/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du chos nyid 'dus ma byas ltar mi 'ong ste/ de yang dang po'i dus tshod du bla ma la mos gus byas pas bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis dang por rang gi nyon mongs pa 'dag pa'i 'go rtsom/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams phra phre'u skyes pa'i dus su/ nang du rang gi nyon mongs kyi srog ci tsam du chad pa de tsam du rang nyid kyi phung po nyon mongs pa las skyes pa de yang 'jig /de la nye bar 'khor ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i lha 'dre thams cad kyis shor thob kyi bsam pa skyes nas bar chad sna tshogs byed/ bla ma dang bla ma'i chos dang rang gi nyams len thams cad la the tshom za ba chos nyid yin/ de yang a mo gha pa sha chen po'i rgyud las/ gang tshe dngos grub 'byung ba'i tshe// de tshe las kyang ldog par 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ chos zab mo nyams su blang ba'i dus su/ lus ngag yid gsum sdug bsngal sna tshogs skye ba chos nyid yin gsungs/ 'di'i dus su bla ma bzang ngan dang*/ gdams ngag che chung gsal ba yin te/ nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rnams// skye ba'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i gzhi// 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen rnams kun// dang po rgyu la ma bltas par// dmu

ma rung pa'i sems 'thom yid dpyod byed pa rnams// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma go bas// sangs rgyas chos las phyi rol nyid// 'di'i dus su gdams ngag dang bya rgyu dpag tu med pa zhig yod kyang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gshis bltas la/ dang po bla ma'i mos gus kyi rkyen gyis nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi stobs 'phel na/ mos gus kyang tshad du skyol/ bla ma yang byin rlabs che ba yin pas/ skyon slong na 'dag pa yin pas rtsa ba'i mos gus la nan tan bskyed/ 'du ba rnam bzhi gang yin yang sman dang*/ mo dang*/ bon dang*/ rtsis la sogs pa ye mi bya/ mos gus rgyun bsring pa gcig pus 'dag go// de la rab 'bring rnam pa gsum// dbang po rab kyi gang zag la// mos gus gdung shugs rgyun chad med// rgyun de bsrings pas skyon las grol// dbang po 'bring gi gang zag rnams// rdo rje mched grogs la sogs las// bla ma'i yon tan thos pa yis// bar chad ngang gis dag nas 'gro// dbang po tha ma'i gang zag gis// sngon 'gro bla ma'i mos gus kyis// mi mthun phyogs kun bslang ba'i tshe// rang la gnod pas blo phrogs nas// bla ma'i mos gus brjed par gyur// de la gso ba'i thabs bstan pa// gong gi mos gus bag chags de// sad par byed pa'i thabs rnams ni// sad par gyur na skyon las grol// snying rje'i rngan gdags gtsigs su che// bar chad mi mthun phyogs rnams la// spyi yi bcos kyi gdams ngag go// de ltar mos gus kyi rnam par gzhag pa de lta bus skyon de lta bu dag na/ gegs sel ba dang bogs thon pa dus gcig tu 'ong ste/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum gyi nyams rang shugs kyis skye/ nyams la brten nas mos gus skye/ mos gus kyis mngon par rtogs pa skye ste/ rtogs pas nyams 'dag ste/ de yang ci tsam du/ nang du nyams dag pa de tsam du nyams la brten pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dang*/

nyams las skyes pa'i lha dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa khams gsum gyi lha 'dre thams cad kyis bar du gcod de/ de la bar chad gsum 'byung*/ bar chad chen po rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dang 'bral snying 'dod pa 'byung ste/ bdud sems la zhugs nas dang por dgon pa la sogs par sgrub pa logs su byed pa'i brod pa skye/ bar du der phyin yang sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen mi 'dzoms/ tha ma yul mtha' 'khob du phyin nas ba glang mang po'i rdzi bo byed de/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin mchog thun mong gnyis kyi 'byung gnas bla ma yin pas/ bla ma dang bral na de dag thams cad dang bral bas so// bar chad 'bring ni rtsa ba'i bla ma la nyon mongs pa rgyu 'bras can gyi rtog pa skye/ des rang gzhan thams cad la gnod pa'i snang ba 'ong*/ rtog pa de 'dra ba byung nas sus kyang ma tshor na yang bla ma'i chos de nyams su myong ba'i dus su/ sngar gyi bla ma nyon mongs pa rgyu 'bras can la chos zhus nas nyams su myong ba'i dus su dug stobs 'phel ba dang dus mtshungs nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du gcod/ sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu don med par 'ong*/ de'i gnad ka yang*/ dkon mchog gsum la log par bltas shing sku gsung thugs dri ma med pa la nyes pa'i skyon btags/ don phan 'dogs pa la gnod pa skyel bar bltas/ mtshams med du song bas lan pa'o// bar chad tha ma ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa 'byung ste/ de gsum gang yin yang phyi nang gi rten 'brel zab mos 'byung ba ma gtogs pa/ bdud ces bya ba gzhan nas 'ong zhing gnod pa ni ma yin no// bar chad de lta bu dag par byed pa la spang bya de gnyen po drag po'i stobs kyis bcom pa tha mal pa'am nyan thos lta bu ni 'bras bu'ang de dang 'dra bar 'byung ba'o// pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa lta bu kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rkyang pas/

bar chad kyi dngos po ma 'gyur bar lam du byed cing*/ bsngo ba dang smon lam de ltar byed pa ni shin tu ring ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o// gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la bar chad gsum po gang byung yang*// bar du gcod pa'i ngo bo de// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid la bstim// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de nyid kyang*// khams gsum bdag por mos pa bskyed// bdag nyid chen po'i gsang gnas su// dbang gi rgyal po bsgom par bya// mtho dman kun gyi de bzhin nyid// dbye ba med pa'i ngang nyid la// rgyun chad med par ngang gis 'gro// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing thams cad kun// bcom par sangs rgyas lta bu yi// bla ma dam pas yang yang gsungs// sngags dang mtshan nyid thams cad du// 'di las ma bshad rnal 'byor pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// 'di las ma gsungs rnal 'byor pa// rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams// 'di las ma g.yos rnal 'byor pa// kha phyir 'brang na kha lta yin// tshig phyir 'brang na 'chad mkhan yin// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag de// rnal 'byor nyams su myong ba yin// nyams rtogs gcig tu gyur pa de// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yin// gnyis med ye shes chen po de// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// 'di 'dra'i don dang ldan pa de// tha snyad tshig phyir 'brang du med// 'di gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// nyams dang ldan pa'i ku sā li// la kha'i bya sgro 'dra ba rnams// tshig gi sna mthud 'tshol ba la// snying gtam tshig tu smras pa lags// de ltar lhun gyis grub pa'i dge sbyor de rgyun chad med par bskyang bar bya ste/ gzhan ma nyams dang bzang rtog gi spros pa dang*/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad kyi sna kha mi bsdu/ lhun grub rgyun chad med pa'i dge sbyor de thabs dran pa yengs pa med pas bsten cing bsgom par bya ste/

ci zhig ltar rang phye rang la gtor nas rang nyid bzang por bsgoms/ bla ma dam pa dang bral sngas/ gcig pu gnyis su med par thabs lam la sogs pa'am spros pa'i brtson 'grus kyis gdung*/ lhun gyi grub pa'i ngang la ngang gis 'gro ma shes na nyams la bsgom du byas/ bzang rtog gi spros pa la yon tan du byas/ bdud kyi phye gtor la dngos grub du byas nas ngan sar lhung ba yang yod/ rang sems rang byung lhun gyis grub// dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa la// nyams dang bzang rtog spros pa yi// sgrib pa'i sprin gyis mi dgab par// byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis// 'gro drug rjes su dran byas nas// sems can smin pa'i go cha dang*// tshad ldan bla ma'i mos gus kyis// rgyun chad med par bsgoms lags na// snang zhing dngos po thams cad kun// dbyer med sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs nas// 'od gsal chen por ro gcig tu// dbyer med lhun grub chen po la// rgyud chad med par ngang gis 'gro// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa// mthar thug 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur// 'di'i dus su gnyis 'dzin gyi sgrib pa bsrabs nas sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu yang mngon du gyur/ rgyu 'bras dang stong nyid dbyer med pas rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel la yang go ba rnyed/ dam tshig ma nyams pas bsam pa'i don 'grub/ snang ba rang sems su song bas dngos po'i 'ur ldang*/ zhen pa gting nas zhi bas rnyed pa dang bkur sti char bzhin du 'bab/ byams pa dang snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can thams cad la mas bu gcig pu mthong ba dang 'dra ba'i sems skye/ bsam pa dag pa'i rten 'brel gyis yi dam dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis lung bstan 'ong zhing*/ byin gyis rlob pa dang sdongs grogs byed/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi mgon du 'gyur zhing*/

byang chub la 'god pa'i mthu yod par 'gyur ro// 'di'i dus su rang yang yid mi ches/ 'di ci tsug yin na snyam pa 'ong*/ gzhan dag na re yang*/ la las ni bdud kyi bar chad yin zer/ la las ni nor sgrub yin zer/ la las ni che ge mo dang mang ge mo yin zer ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ste/ mdor na gang yin rang gi sems la 'dri/ sems la nyon mongs skye zhing des snang ba byin gyis rlob/ nyes pa'i rtsa bar gyur na bdud yin par thag chod/ rang gi bsam pa rnam par dag pas yul byin gyis rlob cing*/ phan pa dang bde ba bskyed na bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ 'di thun mong gi dngos grub dang po yin gsung*/ 'di'i dus su mtho sa che na g.yang sa che/ ngan sar ma lhung ba tsam med/ bdud du ma song ba yang dka'/ gzhan thams cad kyi re sa rang la byed/ rang chags sdang dang mi chos kyi 'dun ma la blo gtad byed/ mi che che bzang bzang la zhe 'dod kyi sun 'byin/ chung chung ngan ngan la mi rigs pa'i chad pas bcad/ 'bring 'bring shar shar la so nam dang khe skyed bcol/ drung na 'dug pa'i nye gnas la nyon mongs pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ chos yin pa skad zer yang chos pas bon du yang ma song*/ dang po sems bskyed kyi rnam gzhag tsam la brten nas g.yeng ba'i stobs bskyed/ g.yeng ba che na rnam gzhag yul sum phyogs na med/ tha ma chos ldan gyi slob mas chos byas pa bas/ bya bzhag gzhan byas na dga' bar 'ong dogs yod/ 'di tsug song na bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bslus/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig kyang nyams/ rang gi srog rtsa bdud la shor bas/ dang po yag par yod pa la/ 'di ci tsug song na/ gzhan dag kyang zer/ skad cig ma gcig la nag hrul gyis 'gro ba la tshegs med gsungs/ 'di'i dus su snga mo nas nyes pa ma byung ba'i gong du yon tan 'di rnams 'byung ba'i rgyu ci yin blta/ 'di'i rgyu bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig ma nyams shing*/
