nyon mongs med mchog 'phags pa rab 'byor la// chos 'dir spobs par gyis gsung byin gyis brlabs// zhu ba zhus shing spros pa rnam par bcad// skyon med legs par shin tu gtan la phab// de yi tshe na mkha' las lha rnams kyis// ca co ga zha'i sgra dag phyungs nas kyang*// lha yi gos dag 'thor zhing 'di skad ces// kye ma 'dzam bu gling 'di dam pa'i chos// chos kyi 'khor lo lan gnyis bskor ro zhes// sgra skad dbyangs su brjod cing dam par byas// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin po ches// rgyas 'bring gsum dang sde tshan drug la sogs// ston pas legs gsung chos kyi 'khor lo 'di// shes rab pha rol phyin pa blo las 'das// 'di ltar sems ni sems ma mchis pa ste// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gsungs pa'i don// nyon mongs gsum dang chos rnams thams cad dang*// ma bral mi ldan bsal bzhag med pa'i don// snying por gsungs pa 'di nyid kho na ste// gzhan rnams phun sum tshogs pa rnam bzhi dang*// zhu dang zhus pa'i lan gyis gtan la phab// spros pa legs par bcad pa bsdus pa'i chos// thub pas lung bstan slob dpon 'phags pa yis// smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal zhes// sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa chen po las// gsungs pa 'di nyid yin zhes bka' stsal gsungs// 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi// rgyal ba sras bcas lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi// phan bde'i gzhir gyur bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la skyabs su mchi'o// thub chen 'gro ba'i bla ma bcom ldan gyis// bla med don gyi snying po rmad byung ba// chos kyi 'khor lo gsum par rnam grags pa// thub pa dus gsum byung ba'i bde gshegs rnams// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag dang yon tan rdzogs// mthar thug 'bras bu de las mi g.yo ba// nges pa'i don gyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'di// rtswa mchog grong khyer chen por legs gsungs pa// mya ngan 'das pa chen por gtan la phabs// de yi bar du mnyan yod lha gnas dang*// gangs can ri bo yangs pa can la sogs// gdul bya sna tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa// 'dul ba'i thabs tshul dpag tu med pa yis// smin cing grol bar mdzad nas gdul bya'i tshogs// sku yi dkyil 'khor de yis mi 'dul zhing*// le lo can rnams brtson 'grus brtsam phyir dang*// 'khor lo gsum pa bskor bar bya ba dang*// rtag par lta ba bzlog par bya phyir dang*// gdul bya dpag med 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar nub med pa bzhin// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs na yang*// gdul bya bsod nams zad pa'i snang ba la// nyi ma nub par gyur pa ji bzhin du// shākya'i rgyal po dgung lo brgyad cu gcig

/bzhes pa'i dus su mya ngan 'da' bar dgongs// rtswa mchog ldan pa'i grong khyer rmad byung ba// stobs ldan gyad rnams stong phrag sum cu gnyis// 'byung ba'i gnas gyur sa la zung gi tshal// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ku sha dang*// legs mthong chen po la sogs bcom ldan 'das// sngon tshe byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i tshe// dpag med spyod pa rlabs chen spyod pa der// thub pa chen po gnas der gshegs par mdzad// stong gsum 'di na gnas pa'i 'khor rnams dang*// dpag med zhing nas lhags par gyur ba dang*// lha klu gnod sbyin srin po mi 'am ci// bya dang ri dwags seng ge bung ba dang*// stong gsum 'di na yod pa'i srog chags kun// bde gshegs byin gyis brlabs kyis drung du lhags// 'od bsrungs ba glang bdag po ma gtogs pa// rgyal ba'i nyan thos rnams kyang drung du lhags// rnam bzhi 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu yis// legs par mchod nas seng ge'i khri bshams te// ston pa de la bzhugs pa'i dus kyi tshe// gtso bor gyur pa thub chen rgyal ba'i sras// byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'od bsrungs dang*// tsun dhe la sogs gzhir mdzad bka' bstsal pa// nga ni do nub nam gyi gung thun la// mya ngan 'da' zhes ston pas gsungs pa dang*// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag phal mo ches// ngu zhing smre sngags 'don dang brgyal bar gyur// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba rgya chen btab// rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang*// mya ngan mi 'da' gnad la babs pa yi// zhu ba rgya mtsho yang dang yang du zhus// de yi tshe na sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// sangs rgyas rnams ni mya ngan mi 'da' ste// dam pa'i chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur zhing*// dge 'dun dkon mchog rgyun chad med ces gsungs// bcom ldan gsung la ngo mtshar ha las nas// 'jam dbyangs 'od bsrungs seng ge sgra la sogs// rgyal ba'i sras po dkon mchog gdung 'dzin pa// mngon shes gzungs dang spobs pa thogs med pas// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho ma lus kun// legs par bzung ba de dag thams cad kyis// dkon mchog gsum po nub par mi 'gyur zhing*// sangs rgyas mya ngan nam yang mi 'da' na// gnas kyi bye brag 'di dang 'di rnams su// 'khor gyi khyad par 'di dang 'di rnams la// dam chos bka' bstsal 'di dang 'di skad gsung*// 'di ni ji ltar lags zhes zhu ba zhus// legs par shin tu gtan la phab pa dang*// legs par shin tu gtan la phab gyur nas// dkon mchog gsum po rtag tu rtag pa la// dga' ba skyes nas bstod pa rgya mtshos bstod// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ci yang mi smrar gyur// de yi tshe na ston pa bcom ldan gyis// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor de la 'di skad ces// nga ni do nub nam gyi gung thun la// mya ngan 'da' ste sang ni khyed rnams kyis// ston pa mi mthong the tshom dri sa med// nga la dris shig nga la dris shig ces// yang dang yang du lan gsum bka' bstsal kyang*// 'jam dbyangs la sogs 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams// sgro 'dogs chod pas ci yang mi smra gyur// shākya seng ge dgyes nas 'di skad gsungs// legs so legs so khyed rnams shin tu legs// nga la khyed kyis sgro 'dogs legs bcad pas// zhu ba zhu rgyu med pa legs zhes gsungs// ji ltar bud shing zad par gyur pa na// me yang shi bar gyur pa ji bzhin du// sku des 'dul ba'i gdul bya zad gyur na// thub pa chen po mya ngan cis mi 'da'// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag dang yon tan gyi// pha rol phyin pas sangs rgyas skyon med cing*// des gsungs chos kyang rgyun chad med pa dang*// chos de nyams su len pa'i dge 'dun yang*// rgyun mi chad par rgyal bas dam bcas pa// de la rgol ba'i dri ba sna tshogs kyis// brgal zhing don 'di gtan la phab pa las// theg pa sna tshogs ston pa'i mdo sde zhes// mi mkhas rmongs pa'i skye bo rnams kyis smra// mdo sde gtan la phab pa zhes smra ba// legs par smras pa yin te ci zhig cig

/gtan la phab pa shes pa dka' bar 'dug /dper na ljon shing rtsa ba bcad nas ni// yal ga phra'u la bstod byed pa ltar// nges pa'i don ston bla med snying po yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba gsum pa la// smod par gyur pa de dag ci 'gyur snyam// 'di la dgongs nas rje btsun mi pham pa// chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan thugs rje can// bstan pa'i bdag po rje btsun byams pa'i mgon// rgyal tshab mchog brnyes chos kyi rgyal po mchog /dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs pa'i mgon po des// theg pa chen po bla ma'i rgyud ces pa// mtshan 'di btags shing don dang ldan pa'i mtshan// dpag med bstod pas bstod cing bkur mdzad pa// rdo rje'i gnas bdun mchog tu bsdus pa 'di// chos kyi 'khor lo gsum pa'i don 'grel du// bcom ldan mgon pos mdzad par gyur 'di dang*// deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar// skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med pa dang*// mi pham mgon la zhu ba zhus pa dang*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stong bar// ma lus 'gro ba sems can thams cad la// chos 'dis rtag tu smin cing grol bar shog /bdag dang ji snyed 'gro ba ma lus kun// chos kyi 'khor lo bla med snying po'i don// bla ma'i rgyud la skyabs su nye bar mchi// thub pas lung bstan 'gro ba'i bla ma rje// snyigs ma'i dus su rmad byung rje btsun pa// 'tsho byed ming can bla ma rje btsun des// nga yi chos 'di theg pa chen po'i rgyud// bla ma 'di nyid yin zhes gsungs pa dang*// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gyur 'gro ba'i mgon// chos kyi rgyal po bla ma rin chen gyis// nga yi chos 'di theg chen rgyud bla ma// 'di nyid yin zhes bka' stsal yang yang gsung*// phyag rgya chen po theg chen bla ma'i rgyud// 'di yi khrid la 'bad pas nan tan byas// 'jig rten mgon las yang dang yang du thos// snying gi pu lur rtag tu bcangs pa las// spu rtse shas tsam nges shes skyes pa des// bdag gzhan kun la phan par re ba 'o// bla med chos kyi 'khor lo gsum po yi// 'dug lugs zur tsam dus 'dir bstan par bya// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang po ni// bden pa bzhi po gsungs pa 'di nyid de// lha yi skad dang klu yi skad dang ni// grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji snyed pa// de snyed skad du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// 'gro ba kun gyi khams rgyud ji snyed par// de snyed chos kyi sgo dang thabs rnams kyis// 'gro ba smin cing grol par byed pa 'di// dang po sems bskyed rgyu 'bras nyid du nges// der 'dus tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu yis// 'bras bu tha dad thob cing chos kyi sgo// bsam mi khyab par 'khor lo de nyid du// rgyas par phye ste dpag tu med par gsungs// rgyal po'i khab tu gsungs pa gnyis pas kyang*// rgyal po'i khab ni rgyal po'i khyim yin te// bzang ngan sna tshogs ci yang 'du ba'i phyir// chos 'di 'khor 'das kun gyi gnas yin te// 'dug lugs bstan pa rgyal po'i khab nyid de// ma rig nas bzung thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes rtogs pa'i phyir// sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid 'byung ba'o// chos kyi 'khor lo phyi ma gsungs pa la// mu stegs rnams kyis dgra bcom thob par gyur// kun tu rgyu ba rab bzang la sogs pa// dpag tu med pas yang dag don chen grub// tsun dhe 'od bsrungs la sogs thub pa'i 'khor// bsam yas rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa yis// 'khor lo gsum gyi nges don gtan la phebs// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba re re yang*// gang zag dbang po tha dad rim pa yis// chos kyi 'khor lo gsum gsum dag tu 'gyur// de ltar 'gyur ba'i gtan tshigs zab mo rnams// 'khor lo de dag nyid la so sor snang*// rim pa gsum po rim gyis nges pa yang*// de dag nyid du nges par mi snang ste// de nyid 'dus pa ta tha sang kra har// 'og min gnas mchog dam pa bla med par// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas nas ni// chos kyi 'khor lo de nyid 'dus par gsungs// rdo rje gdan du rdo rje rnam 'joms dang*// de nyid du ni sangs rgyas phal chen te// ri rab rtse mor chos snang le'u gsungs// mtshe ma'i gnas su mi zad gter bcu gsungs// dga' ldan gnas su rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi// bsngo ba bcu po gsungs par gyur pa dang*// dbang gyur gnas su sa bcu'i mdo gsungs shing*// yum gyi lhums su dpag med 'gro ba rnams// phyir mi ldog sogs rigs can sar bzhag ste// bya rgod phung por 'jam dbyangs lung bstan dang*// gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po'i mdo rnams gsungs// sa la'i zung du rab bzang la sogs pa// gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad la// theg pa gsum po so sor byung gyur na// rim pa 'di zhes bdag cag ji ltar smra// de ltar min yang thub pa'i gsung gis nges// bdag cag mgo bo 'khor zhing phyogs rnams bslad// thub pa'i bka' yang mos phyogs dag tu bzhag

/gzhig long byas na je spun je spun 'gro// sangs rgyas gsung la the tshom som nyi skyes// phu pa byang pa mtha' 'khob bsod nams can// chos la 'khris pa'i sdig med gsung re mad// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// chos kyi rgyal po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// chos kyi bdag po chos kyi rgyal po yis// chos 'di mkhyen gyi bdag 'dra gzhan gyis min// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nas// dung gi tshems bar nas ni skyes chen gyi// ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas 'di skad gsung*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnam gsum 'di// gang zag dbang po'i bye brag gsungs pa yin// cig car ba dang rim gyis pa zhes pa// sems can khams kyi byang chub thob byed pa// rim gyis thob kyi cig car ma yin zhes// yang yang bka' stsal gsung ba 'di re mad// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// 'khor lo gsum po rim gyis bgrod pa dang*// thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs sgam dkyel po che// rku ba'i thabs kyis byang chub sems bskyed nas// dgra bcom rang rgyal sa lnga sa drug pa'i// mngon rtogs rgyud la skyes nas e ma ho// rgyal ba'i sras su bdag cag ma gyur ces// gser la shin tu dga' bar gyur ba'i mi// gser sgrog dam pos bcings pa ji bzhin du// sa gnyis thob nas de la 'dod med cing*// 'gyod pa'i sems gdungs sangs rgyas thob 'dod tshe// rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad ces// dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas thob pa la// gtan du gegs byed ma yin nyan thos sras// gtan gyi gegs su 'gyur zhes gsungs pa dang*// ljon pas pi wang sbrengs pa 'od bsrungs sogs// gar byed gar byed dge sbyong tshul las nyams// rgyal sras rnams kyi de 'dra dpag med pas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i blo skyes pas// dam chos padma dkar po zhes bya bar// nyan thos dge 'dun tshogs la 'di skad gsungs// khyed rnams dgra bcom ma yin zag ma zad// bya ba ma byas byed pa ma byas te// sems bskyed nas ni da gzod sangs rgyas zhes// thub pa chen pos gsungs par gyur pa dang*// dga' ba skyes nas thams cad tshig mthun par// sangs rgyas sras su bdag cag da gyur ces// dbugs ma phyin pa ston pas dbugs dbyung mdzad// shes rab chen po 'phags pa shā ri'i bus// dgra bcom zag pa zad par mnyam pa la// yon tan mi mnyam 'di ci snyam sems pa// ston pa nyid la zhu'o snyam pa 'di// bcom ldan 'das kyis de ring bka' stsal ces// ched du brjod pas yang yang ched du brjod// dgra bcom tshogs rnams de dag thams cad kun// rdzogs pa'i byang chub kun gyi lung bstan thob// kau'u di na ya sogs nyan thos dgra bcom rnams// 'khor lo dang pos smin par mdzad nas kyang*// 'khor lo gnyis pas shin tu smin par mdzad// gsum pas shin tu rab tu smin mdzad par// thub pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum du snang*// 'di yang rgya cher 'jig rten mgon po yis// blo gros 'jug par ji bzhin gsungs pa dang*// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid du rgya cher gsungs// tshig tu nyung la dpag med don rgyas pa// legs par ston pa'i bla ma rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// gnyis pa khyed kyis zhus pa'i don 'di yang*// legs par phye zhing bu la bstan par bya// gzung ba med pas der 'dzin med ces pa// mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par gsungs pa'i don// lugs su 'byung ba rten 'brel skye ba la// dgongs nas gsungs te phan tshun gcig la gcig

/ltos pa mdung khyim lta bu'i rten 'brel du// ston pas legs par gsungs pa 'di yi don// 'phags pa yab sras thogs med sku mched dang*// rgyal sras mkhas pa rnams la mi mthun med// gzung don rtog pa spangs phyir dang*// 'dzin pa mi spong phyir na de// rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam// bcom ldan mi pham mgon pos gsungs pa ste// rten cing 'brel pa lugs las ldog pa yis// phung po lnga la bdag dang bdag gi 'jig tshogs su// lta ba'i ri rtse ye shes rdo rjes bcom// ye shes rdo rje rtogs pa'i don nyid la// ma yengs rgyun chad med par bsgom pa 'di// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' yis// sgom lam thun mong yin pa de yi phyir// ston pas de gsungs de don de yi sras// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras dang*// 'phags pa thogs med sku mched gang la yang*// 'khrul pa mi mnga' 'di la mi mthun med// zhu ba gsum pa legs par zhus pa'i don// nyan thos rnams dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen por rtogs// sdug bsngal de las rang nyid brgal 'dod pas// bsod nams tshogs bsags smon lam btab pa'i mthus// rang nyid nye bar zhi ba'i bsam pa brtan// rigs gsum theg pa chen por nges pas na// dman pa'i blo can nye bar zhi 'dod phyir// byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed mi nus// nye bar zhi ba'i blo gros rab sbyangs pas// nyan thos rnams kyis bden pa rnam pa bzhi// ji bzhin rtogs pas dgra bcom 'bras bu thob// rang sangs rgyas kyis rten 'brel mngon du gyur// rang rgyal byang chub nyid du thub pas gsungs// dang po nyid nas bsam pa rgya che zhing*// theg chen dge ba'i bshes dang phrad gyur pas// rigs gcig theg pa gcig tu nges bstan phyir// de la blo nges yid rab brtan gyur nas// sangs rgyas dag gam byang chub sems dpa' la// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed blangs nas ni// dge ba thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo// bla med theg pa'i rigs su skyes pa des// chu bo gzhol ba'i phyogs su 'bab pa 'am// nyi ma mkha' la 'gro ba ji bzhin du// gong nas gong du shugs kyis 'gro bar 'gyur// tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi lam las 'das gyur na// mthong ba'i lam nyid mngon du 'gyur ba yin// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog la blo brtan nas// bsod nams tshogs kyi thabs chen shugs 'dzin pas// gong nas gong du khyad par 'gro bar 'gyur// sa lnga thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des// bden pa rnam bzhi rtogs par gsungs pa dang*// sa drug thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yis// rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs par 'gyur ba ni// sa bcu'i mdo nas rgya cher rnam par bshad// nyan thos rang rgyal dag dang sems dpa' che// bsam dang sbyor dang 'bras bu mi gcig na// rtogs tshod mthun pa 'thad pa min snyam na// ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu// blon po'i bu dang lo grangs mnyam pa bzhin// bsam sbyor 'bras bus dman par gyur pa 'di// lo grangs mnyam pa lta bu'i rtogs pa la// tha dad byung yang 'gal ba med pa nyid// sa bdun rang rgyal sa las ring du song*// mar me mdzad dpal bcom ldan mgon po las// utpal lnga gtor skye ba med pa yi// chos la bzod pa chen po thob pa yis// sa brgyad byang chub sems dpar gyur pas na// mar me mdzad kyi lung bstan de nyid du// chos la bdag med dus 'dir rtogs pa yis// sangs rgyas der gzod bdag gis zhal mthong gsungs// dag pa'i sa gsum legs par bgrod byas nas// dbang bskur chen po rgyal ba thams cad kyis// legs par dbang bskur rnam par grags gyur pa// pha rol phyin pa'i theg par bshad pa dang*// bya spyod rgyud du cung zhig bstan pa yang*// lus ngag ji ltar dag pa'i rim pa las// dngos grub ji ltar 'byung ba'i rim pa rnams// dbang skur tshul gyis ji ltar 'byung ba las// rgyu med 'bras bu mtho dman tha dad pa// mi 'byung nges phyir ston pas ma gsungs so// dbang bzhi legs par bskur ba ma nges na// sku bzhi thob par 'gyur ba mi srid phyir// zab mo mthar thug gsang sngags dbang bzhi yis// sku bzhi mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir// rgyal sras mchog gis dbang mchog thob par nges// thob nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog 'tshang rgya// ji ltar ri dbang yungs 'brur 'dud pa dang*// ba glang rjes la rgya mtsho chen po bzhin// skyes chen khyed kyis bdag la zhu ba 'di// rigs par gyur pa ma lags na yang 'dir// dad dang gus can thams cad dpang bzhag nas// sngon gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi// rjes su slob par bdag gis dam bcas pa// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la nor bzang gis// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// dpag med dka' bas bla ma bkur ba ltar// deng sang dus su bdag lta cis mi 'bad// thog med dus nas da lta phan chad du// dpag tu med pa'i lus po zhig gyur kyang*// 'di 'dra'i don la lus srog btang rnams bsgrub la cis mi bzod// 'khor bar 'khor tshe skye gnas thams cad du// rga dang na dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang*// rdeg dang gsod dang go rar 'jug pa dang*// gshin rje'i skyes bu brtse ba med thag chad pas bzod byed na// su la gces ka byed cing 'dir mi bzod// snying stobs chen pos de ltar go bgos nas// brtul zhugs drag pos nyams su blang ba'i thabs// gong ma'i rnam thar gsang sngags spyod /bla med theg pa chen po bgrod gcig pu// pha rol phyin pa drug gi brtul zhugs gzung*// 'di 'dra'i zhing la mgo dang rkang lag kyang*// bskal pa dpag tu med par gtong rigs na// bu dang chung ma lus khrims phung po nyid// rgyal bas gsungs pas srog las gces par srungs// kha mi zol 'bum wa mos seng ge'i sgra// bla med theg pas tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyang*// bzod pa'i go cha med la mi snang ste// bzod pa gsum gyi go cha bgo bar bya// brtson dang 'grus pas rang gzhan don kun 'grub// chang dang 'dod yon gnyid kyis non na ko// 'phags pa zag pa med pa'i yon tan rnams// thob pa srid dam bu gcig /gti mug 'dzin pa'i nyes pa chen po las// mkha' la rgyu ba'i bya bzhin ma chags pas// nyes tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu'i bdud las rgyal// nyon mongs gsum gyis rang nyid bdud du 'gro// de phyir khyed kyis bcu dang gsum po yi// chos 'dis ma lus thams cad bsgrub par mdzod// de ltar go cha chen po bgos byas nas// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya mtsho bkur ba dang*// dam chos rgya mtsho khong du chud pa dang*// gti mug nga rgyal dang*// phrag dog la sogs spyod pa mtha' yas kyis// 'gro ba mtha' yas 'dul bar byed pa rnams// dam pa'i skye bo mkhas pa phal cher kun// rin chen gdugs dpes mchil lham 'gebs snyam byed// nyon mongs spyod pas nyon mongs can 'dul kyang*// dul bar gyur nas sbyangs sdom spyod phyir dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas zla 'od gzhon nu'i bkas// zab cing rgya che nyams rtogs rin po che// bla rgyu dang 'bras bu rten cing 'brel 'byung ba// mngon sum gzigs pas 'das dang ma byon dang*// da ltar dus su 'di dang 'di zhes pa/ */lung dang rigs pa man ngag rgya mtsho yis// sbyang sdom brtul zhugs khrims sbyangs pa'i yon tan legs spyod pa// dka' thub dka' spyod yin par ma go ste// tshe 'di da lta nyid du che thabs dang*// bzang thabs skyid thabs chos brgyad sgrub pa'i thabs// rang gzhan kun la mi gnod phan pa'i rgyu// rgyun chad med par chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du// sangs rgyas thob kyi bar du skyid pa'i thabs// sbyangs sdom tshul khrims yin pa nyid du go// lung rig man ngag bla ma dam pa'i gsung*// gong du bstan pa de dag kho nar zad// bdag gis nyams su myong ba 'di lta bu// g.yo sgyu med par bu la bstan par bya// yon tan rgya mtsho tshogs las dben gyur cing*// thos dang bsam pa'i yon dug lngas g.yen spyod dug chen 'thung la dga'// kha chag sna ral skyon gyis ma tshor gnas// dran pa tsam gyi sgyid lugs ga chad

'u thug pa pa'i// dman pa'i skye bo rmongs pa tha shal gyis// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal mthong gsung thos pas// bdag nyid chen pos rtag tu gang gsungs kyang*// thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab 'ching gyur pas// thabs med shes rab nam mkha'i padmo bzhin// rgyu med 'bras bu rigs pa ma yin dang*// dang po thabs dang ldan par gyur pa yis// shes rab mngon par rtogs pa skyes na yang*// phyi nas thabs la nan sgyu tshul 'chos 'jig rten bsam pa yis// byas la byed lo byed par 'gyur los kyang*// thos dang bsam pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho yis// blo mig bye ba'i mkhas pa chen po rnams// 'di yi byed pa bzang zhes bkur par snang*// smra bcad rgyu lto lug na 'bros par nges// bstan pa'i babs mkhyen che ba'i che ba nyid// sgrub pa gtso mdzad ma nor lam zhugs pa// dpal ldan a ti sha yi rjes 'brang ba// chos dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa ni// thub pa'i bstan pa gces par 'dzin pa rnams// 'di yi bstan pa 'jig par mi 'gyur zhes// snying la bu bzhin rtag tu brtse bas dgongs// skyon gyi phung po 'chab par mdzad pa dang*// yon tan phra mos bstod cing spel ba yis// padma rgyas pa lta bur chos brgyad 'phel// nang cha mthong ba'i dus kyis ma rnyings na// da rung 'gribs par mi 'gyur tshul 'chos pa'o// deng sang che zhing bzang ba dpag med rnams// mngon du gyur pa khyed kyis ma gzigs sam// tshul 'chos 'di las 'di tsam 'byung ba la// chang kha nas btsags pa yang 'di 'dra na// chang zhabs nas btsags pa 'di ci 'dra zhes// dpag med 'gro ba rnams kyi mgon gyur pa// skyes bu dam pas gsungs pa 'di re mad// thub pa'i bstan pa srungs shig rgyal ba'i sras// bstan pa 'jig pa'i gnyer ka nged la med// lam 'phrang ma shig chos kyi ag tsar can// tshul 'chos nyams su myong ba'i rnam thar 'di// shan pas srog gcod bu la gdams pa ltar// tshul 'chos khyed la gdams pa ma yin te// tshul 'chos med par sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs zungs// sha chang khams gsos 'di yang ma dgos te// bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho zhes khyod nyid gsungs// gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa lon par nges// srog la bab kyang sbyangs sdom mi gtang ngo*// thub pa chen po bcom ldan chos kyi rjes// gnas brtan chen po 'phags pa nye sde la// khyod kyang mdzes la khyod kyi 'khor rnams mdzes// mdzes pa'i rgyu rkyen gang yin smros zhes gsungs// nye sdes bcom ldan 'das la 'di ltar zhus// rab tu 'byung ba bdag gi drung 'ongs na// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis sgrub nus sam// sgrub par nus na rab tu 'byin pa dang*// mi nus zer na rab tu ma byung bas// bdag gi 'khor rnams shin tu mdzes zhes zhus// thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mdzes gyur na// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun la cis mi mdzes// tshe 'di khe grags 'dod na brtul zhugs spyad// 'jig rten chos brgyad khe grags 'byung ba'i tshul// sa gzhi lta bu yon tan dang po 'o// yon tan gnyis pa 'phags pa nyan thos kyi// dgra bcom la sogs yon tan 'byung ba yang*// sbyangs sdom tshul khrims 'di nyid gzhir gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po mkhas dang dam pa rnams// zhal mthun tshig dang dbyangs su mthun par gsungs// drang srong chen po mi dbang bcom ldan gyis// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rnams// dus gsum kun tu byung ba dpag med pa// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyad pas zhi gnas dang*// lhag mthong yon tan skyes par gyur pa yi// tshul lugs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa rgya chen yang*// ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pas// sangs rgyas bcom ldan spyan chen bla ma dang*// chos dang dge 'dun sde gnyis lhar bcas kyi// 'jig rten thams cad dpang du bzhag byas nas// dang po sems bskyed brtul zhugs 'di ltar bzung*// deng nas ji srid byang chub thob bar du// rnam dag dge slong dag tu ma gyur na// sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lhar bcas 'jig rten thams cad bslus gyur cing*// nam yang byang chub 'thob par mi 'gyur zhing*// nyes tshogs kun gyis ldongs par gyur cig ces// dam bcas smon lam de ltar btab pa dang*// rnam dag dge slong mchog tu gyur nas kyang*// dgon pa ba dang

bas 'di la nges shes skyes// de yang mgon po 'jam dbyangs rtsa rgyud las// tshul khrims 'chal bas sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba ni// yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no// ji ltar ta la'i shing gi mgo bcad pa// skyes zhing 'phel bar gyur pa mi srid ltar// tshul khrims 'chal la gsang sngags 'grub pa yang*// de dang 'dra bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dag tu// bde gshegs bka' 'das ltung bar gang gsungs pa// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa spangs pa yis// gsang sngags sgrub par byed pa 'di yin zhes// mnyam med bla ma de las yang yang thos// tshad mar gyur pa 'phags pa yab sras dang*// gong du smras pa'i thub pa'i rgyal sras rnams// sbyangs sdom bstan pas theg chen gsang sngags kyi// yon tan rgya mtsho mchog dang thun mong gi// dngos grub mtha' yas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob// mang po smras pas su la ci bya ste// sa bcu man chod kun la sgrib pa yod// sgrib pa gnyen po sbyangs dang bsdom pa yi// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa 'di las gzhan pa yi// med cing mi srid nyid du nges pa yin// de ltar gyur na gsang sngags dam pa'i tshig /rang spyod 'dor ba ches zhes grags pa'i don// rig pa brtul zhugs ji ltar spyod pa'i tshul// glang chen myos pa stag dang seng ge bzhon// sbrul gyi ske rags phyag rgya khrid cing 'gro// dpag tu med pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston pa dang*// 'gal lo zer zhing snyam par gyur na yang*// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyad par gyur pa yis// nyon mongs dag pa'i gnyen po'i lag rjes su// ting 'dzin skyes las byung ba ma yin nam// de ltar gyur na 'di la 'gal ba ci// 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa rnam 'phrul ba// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa nyid la yang*// rgyal bas bkag pa med pa nyid du snang*// 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po mo'u 'gal bus// rang gi slob ma dgra bcom khyer ba la// gdug pa gshed ma'i dmag tshogs sprul nas kyang*// sku yi sras gyur bzang po sgra can 'dzin// gling bzhi 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal po la// btsun mo brgyad khri bu pho stong dang bcas// rin chen sna bdun dmag dang bcas pa sprul// yon tan de la nyes pa gleng ba med// sgra gcan bzang po tshul khrims brtul zhugs las// nyams pa ma yin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// dge slong brtul zhugs spyod la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mtha' yas pa// sprul pa sprul nas gzhan gyi don mdzad pa// sbyangs sdom ting 'dzin nyid las byung ba ste// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur 'bum pa las// shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di spyod pa// ngan song gsum du nam yang mi skye gsungs// rgyal ba'i sras po 'phags pa rab 'byor gyis// de ltar gyur na 'di ltar bcom ldan gyis// byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs dpag med las// ngan song gsum du skyes pa mang po gsungs// ngan song gsum du skyes par gyur pa'i tshe// dge ba de dag gang du mchis zhes zhus// ston pas de la 'di skad bka' bstsal pa// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gang du yang*// sus kyang mi nus spyad pa spyod byed pa// phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yi// spyod pa mtha' yas spyod par gsungs pa'i phyir// dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i sems dpa' che// gdul bya dpag med 'dul bar byed pa dang*// zhing rnams rgya mtsho sbyong bar byed pa dang*// spyod pa rgya mtsho spyod par byed pa rnams// dka' thub brtul zhugs rnams las nyams pa med// gsang sngags theg pa spyod pa'i sems dpa' yang*// 'di las gzhan pa yod pa ma yin te// gsang sngags sgor spyod byang chub sems dpa' zhes// rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud du gsungs pas so// de ltar tshul khrims brtul zhugs kyis// de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rnams// ma lus thams cad 'di las 'di 'byung ba// mtshan dang dpe byad rab tu 'bar ba'i sku// tshul khrims bsrungs pa 'di las 'di 'byung zhes// bram ze sen rings zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs// tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// 'phags pa sdud par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// pha rol phyin drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// sa bcu lam lnga yongs su rdzogs pa yis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub rdo rje 'chang gi sku// thob par 'gyur pa gsang sngags rgyud du gsungs// slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten gsungs pa'i don// yon tan gzhi rten bstan pa bzhi pa 'o// dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyad las nges 'byung zhes// bla ma'i gsung sgros bdag gis bris pa las// dge ba gang thob des ni 'gro ba kun// sgrib gsum dag nas byang chub mchog thob shog

/tshogs gnyis rgya mtshos nam yang mi ngoms shing*// bla ma dkon mchog rgya mtsho mnyes byed pa// rgya mtsho lta bu'i slob mas zhus pa lags// bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgya mtsho rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong sgom pa gsal ba dbang phyug gis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 108) ༄// bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam thar sdong po rgyan pa gsal ba dbang phyug la gnang ba// sems kyi de nyid rnam dag nam mkha' la// gnyis med byang chub sems kyi nyi dkyil rgyas// kun tu bzang po 'od zer drwa ba 'gyed// nyes tshogs mun sel bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// smig rgyu'i rgya mtshos ri dwags skom grir shi// thag pa sbrul du bzung bas byis pa bred// ser ba'i 'bru gu rin chen yin snyam 'khrul// bdag tu 'dzin pa yod ma myong bas bslus// bdag 'dzin bral ba brtan pa'i sa gzhi la// snying rje chen po byang sems sa bon btab// dgag sgrub bslab pa'i so nam yur khugs byas// rtse gcig ma yengs dus la bab pa dang*// smon lam rgya chen char zhod snyoms pa yis// dpag med yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// rtsa ba lo ma me tog 'bras bur smin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i yon tan rnams// nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin lhun gyis grub pa dang*// rtsol ba med cing rgyun chad med pa yis// rang gzhan 'tsho ba'i gter chen mi zad pa// tshad ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs pas rnyed// rgyal ba rnams dang de yi sras rnams dang*// tshangs dbang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*// u tum wa ra ltar mdzes mi dbang gi// spyod pa rab spangs gsal ba dbang phyug gis// 'khor 'das ma lus 'tsho ba'i rin chen 'di// bsod nams bsags dang bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed// sems kyi ngo bo rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// chos rnams ma lus bde chen lhan cig skyes// gnyis med byang chub sems su ro gcig pa'i// bde ba chen po rol pas rnam rol nas// spang blang med pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa// bcom ldan 'das 'di mos gus can gyis rnyed// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa nam mkha' yi// mdud pa dam pos 'gro ba bcings gyur nas// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gting mtha' med pa ru// snying brtse med pa gshin rje'i skyes bu yis// brlag par byed pa'i rtsa ba gang yin pa// gcod par byed pa'i mngon rtogs ral gri de// tshad ldan bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed pa yin// sems can khams mang bskyed pa'i pha dang ma// gti mug dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi dang*// sred pa'i rgya mtsho zhe sdang 'khor yug ri// dus mtha'i me ltar bsreg pa dam pa'i chos// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis gang gsungs pa// lugs las 'byung dang ldog pa'i rten 'brel 'di// rgyu 'bras mkhyen cing gzigs par gyur pa yi// zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa'i drin gyis rnyed// kun 'byung sa bon las dang nyon mongs las// 'bras bu sdug bsngal gsum dang phung po lnga// 'khor ba'i 'khor lor thub pa chen po yis// thugs su chud nas bkag pa gnang med cing*// ma chags pa dang zhe sdang gti mug med// thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba yi// 'phags pa'i lam mchog mi g.yo gya nom pa// de las byang chub rnam pa gsum 'byung bas// gnang zhing sgrub pa'i bslab pa rgyal bas gsungs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i gnad dang snying po'i don// bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs pad la// gus pas gtugs shing yun ring bsten pas go// rgyal sras sangs rgyas rigs las byung ba rnams// yab kyi pha phogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis// 'dir bde phyi mar bde zhing rtag tu bde// skye dgu mang po'i bu dang zas nor dang*// rang gi srog bas phangs pa'i dngos po yis// bdag bde sgrub pa'i thabs mchog gang yin pa// mkhas pa rnams kyis bsten par cis mi byed// sems nyid spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba la// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dri mas ma gos pas// khams dang bag la nyal dang bsam pa'i tshogs// byad dang me long dkyil 'khor ji bzhin du// nor 'khrul med par mngon du gyur pa yis// padma'i mtsho la ngang pa ji bzhin du// rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'gro ba'i don du 'jug

/pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel yi dam lha// mthar thug chos sku yon tan phrin las bcas// rang nyid yin par ma rtogs sems can la// nam mkha'i dbang phyug dpa' bos 'gro don byed// mthong dang thos dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// spro zhing dga' ba skye bar gyur pa dang*// 'di yis nam yang bslu bar mi 'gyur zhing*// nyes tshogs phung po'i 'byung khungs ma yin zhes// blo gtad snying bzhag byed pa'i gdul bya la// zab dang rgya che theg pa'i snod yod na// byang chub sems dpas gdul bya smin par byed// pha bzang mes po bzang zhing rigs rgyud btsun// nga bdag bzang zhing sus kyang 'gran med pa// kun gyis bkur ba'i bla ma bdag rlom na// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba dam pa'i chos// bcu dang gsum du yongs su grags gyur pa// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bla na med pa 'dis// rang rgyud smin cing gzhan rgyud grol ba yi// brtul zhugs ci'i phyir 'dzin par mi byed ces// rang gi rang la gzhen skul yang yang 'debs// rigs rus lang tsho yon tan bsnyems pa yis// khad kyis bya long yod pa'i log shes kyis// rgas 'khogs gtugs pa'i lus su byung gyur na// sdom pa rnam gsum rten mchog gzhon lus kyis// nyon mongs bdud dang skye 'jig med pa'i lus// nam zhig thob ces snying la yang yang bskul// bla ma rnams dang dus gsum 'phags pa dang*// bstan pa'i bka' srung dpang du bzhag gyur nas// 'gro ba thams cad smin par dam bcas pa// rang nyid dbang ba'i rdzas dang yo byad dang*// phan bde sgrub pa'i dam chos rin po che// ston pas bu la bzhag pa'i pha nor yang*// 'gro ba gzhan la gtong bar mi nus na// nam mkha' mdzod dang lag na rin po che// dpag bsam shing dang nor bu rin chen ltar// chos dang zang zing phun sum tshogs pa yis// sbyin pa'i dbang phyug chen por ji ltar 'gyur// phyi yi rdzas dang nang gi gnyen 'brel dang*// 'dod chags spyod pa'i yul la 'chums

zhen pa gyur pas// bla ma dkon mchog ya rabs grogs mched la'ang*// 'dzems pa med cing mgo bo bcad gyur kyang*// ngo tsha med par chags zhen 'chums gyur na// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis mi zad gter// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan// dus gsum bde ba'i 'byung gnas tshul khrims la// klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu ji bzhin du// ci yi phyir na 'chums par mi 'gyur ba// bdag lta rab tu byung ba dgos pa ci// zhe sdang 'khrugs pa'i yid kyis ches 'khrugs pas// rang nyid gsod pa'ang dka' ba ma yin na// bla ma pha ma la sogs ci smos pa// mi bzad gdug pa'i sems 'di skyer rung na// rang gzhan mnyam dang rang bas gzhan gces pa'i// thog ma bar dang mtha' mar dge ba yi// tshad med byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// rnam par 'khrugs shing smyos par gyur na ko// gzhan don su yis byas pa su ma byung*// shin tu mi bzad ngar 'dzin dug shing gi// rtsa ba lo ma me tog 'bras bu rnams// dam chos ltar snang chos brgyad chu lud kyis// 'phel bar byas pa'i nga rgyal dug sdong gis// rang gzhan phung bar byed pa'i che thabs 'di// thabs dgus btsal bar byed pa sha thang ba// rang bzhin rtogs pa'i sta re rnon po yis// nga rgyal dug sdong ci'i phyir gcod mi byed// tshogs sam dben pa gang du 'dug kyang rung*// nyon mongs tshogs la 'gran sems brtul zhugs bzung*// rang sems rin chen dri ma yang yang phyi// bslab gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bya// bla ma dam pa rnams dang dkon mchog gsum// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu yi// zhabs 'bring zhabs tog tshul lugs 'di lta bu// brtson 'grus rlung gi shugs ltar khyod kyis bsgrubs// rang gi pha dang ma dang gnyen gyur cing*// dpag med yon tan rgya mtsho bskyed pa yi// bla ma dam pa bla mar 'os gyur cing*// rigs gcig skyabs gcig lta spyod gcig pa yi// dam pa rnams kyi yon tan rgya mtsho la// snying nas mi dga' brjod par mi 'dod cing*// thos par gyur na kha nas khrag skyugs pa// rang gi rgyud la da lta skyer rung na// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// gnyis med byang chub sems su ro gcig cing*// rang las gzhan med byams chen ting 'dzin gyis// phrag dog nyes rtsa ci'i phyir bsreg mi byed// nyes tshogs rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa yi// kha 'dzin zhe 'dzin 'di ltar 'chums gyur na// yon tan gzhi rten bdag med brtul zhugs la// ci yi phyir na bdag cag mi 'bad ces// rang gi sems la dri ba yang yang dris// tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang*// tshe yi tshad ni ci tsam mi shes pas// ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar// thub pa'i dgongs pa tshad ldan bla ma yis// gdams ngag rin chen nyes tshogs skyon bral ba// bu gcig khyod kyis snying gi dbus su chongs// mnyes pa gsum gyis bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrub// bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes par gyur pa dang*// brtul zhugs drag pos sgrub la brtson pa yi// slob mas bskul nas bris par gyur pa yi// dge ba gang yin des ni 'gro ba kun// thub pa'i dgongs pa mchog la rab gzhol te// skyon dag yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs nas// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog

/rje btsun byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa sdong po rgyan pa zhes bya ba/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong gsal ba dbang phyug gis zhus pa rdzogs so// //

109)༄// lam rim rin po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dge bshes dpal dro la gnang ba// spangs dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// de yi dam chos bslab gsum kun tu dge ba'i chos// gang gis nyams su blangs pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dang*// smin cing grol mdzad bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud// thub pa'i gsung la blo gros yangs pas ma grol zhing*// rtogs pa'i shes rab mkha' la nyi dkyil ma rgyas pas// 'di don gsal bar bdag gis nus pa ma yin te// gus pa'i shugs kyis slob ma dam pas skul ba yis// bla ma'i gsung bzhin cung zad tsam zhig 'dir brjod bya// spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par bya// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes gsung pa 'dir ma 'dus pa med gsungs/ de yang bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum yin te/ de yang sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing bya ba ni/ sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi 'dul ba'i sde snod/ bslab pa na lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ dge ba phun sum tshogs par bya ba ni/ sde snod na mdo sde'i sde snod/ bslab pa ni lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul ba ni/ sde snod na mngon pa'i sde snod/ bslab pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa yin la/ de yang rten gyi gang zag gcig gis nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ rim gyis nyams su len pa ma gtogs pa/ yon tan rin po che rgyud la skye ba mi srid gsung ste/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol ba dang*/ zhe sdang dang gti mug 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyir/

sems dang shes rab rnam par grol ba'i chos ston to// zhes gsungs pas/ nyon mongs pa gsum la 'dod cing chags pas ni/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye ba la yang bar du gcod na/ thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa lta ci smos te/ dge slong lhung bzed la chags pas sbrul du skyes nas/ dge slong gi ro dang*/ nags kyi sbrul dang*/ rnam par shes pa dmyal bar bsreg pa'i me gsum dus gcig 'bar ba gzigs nas/ nad pas lhung bzed 'on cig byin cig zer nas sbyin par bya'o// zhes bcas pa mdzad pa lta bu ste/ mdo 'ubs kyis bsdus na/ ston pa'i dgag par bslab pa thams cad ni/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ba'i phyir na/ thog ma dang*/ bar dang*/ tha mar mi dge bas bcas pa'i rten zhes bya ba'i tha snyad yin min med par/ thams cad mkhyen pa dus gsum gzigs pa des/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi nyes pa'i skyon thams cad ni/ rgyu mi dge ba 'di dang 'di las byung bas/ gleng gzhi 'phros pa dang*/ nying 'phros thams cad las/ dge slong khyed kyi de ltar mi bya'o// zhes dgag pa'i bslab par bcas pa las/ ngas ma gnang ngo zhes bdag nyid bya dang byed pa por khas blangs pa ni ma yin te/ stong pa nyid rgyu 'bras kyi skor gsungs pa ni/ sde snod gsum dang*/ sngags dang mtshan nyid thams cad kyi nges pa yin pa'i phyir na/ nyon mongs pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las/ lhung bzed gzhan gyi yin pa 'dod pa mi sbyin pa tsam yang bkag pa ni/ ltung ba sde lnga pas bsdus pa/ nyon mongs pa che 'bring gis bsdus pa'i las yin par dam pa thams cad zhal mthun pa yin pas spang bar bya'o// dgag bya de 'gog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ston pas phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs shing*/ de'i nyes dmigs bcu mi 'byung ba'i phyir bslab pa bcas par gsungs pa dang*/ yang rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa spangs pas 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po mi 'byung zhing*/

sems dang shes rab rnam par grol bar gsungs pa dang*/ bya dang byed pa mang*/ las dang lam la sgrib/ ngan song gsum du skye/ gzhan dag ma dad par 'gyur ba dgag pa'i dgos par gsungs pas/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyi gsung gi rjes su 'brangs pa las/ tshe 'di nyid la byang chub rnam pa gsum mam/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi thob pa'i lam gyi rim pa'i dbang du byas na/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'byung ba gnas yin zhing*/ 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa 'byung ba ni gnas ma yin pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'i gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi stobs su bzhed pas/ 'dir de'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// de yang ji ltar nyams su blang bar bya zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung*/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las rab tu byung nas/ ston pas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du gdams ngag bcu gcig dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar khas blangs shing*/ dam bcas pa 'di che long du bzhag pa dang*/ zhib tu gzhan du shes par bya ba ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du rab tu byung ba'am/ dge slong gi brtul zhugs sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas pas ting nge 'dzin skye/ chung ma 'chang ba dang*/ phru gu spel ba dang*/ zhing gzhi 'dzin pa dang*/ rta phyugs spel ba dang*/ las ngan ci byed kyang ma gnang ba cig kyang med pa 'di nged kyis byar rung ba zhig yin te/ 'on te gong mas bzhed pa'i yon tan ni su la yang mi snang*/ rtogs gnyis cig car yang mi 'jug spang bya dang gnyen po lhan cig tu mi gnas pas/ rang nyid rang nyid la yid mi ches pa kho na'o// skyes chen bdag nyid chen po rnams// nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyis// 'khor ba'i pha rol 'gro ba dang*// yon tan dpag med 'byung bar gsungs// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// cis kyang nges par 'byung ba la// rang la skye ba'i 'dod chags dang*// skye bzhin pa yi zhe sdang dang*// bdag tu 'dzin pas 'khrugs pa'i yid// 'jig tshogs lta ba 'di nyid las// 'byung bar 'dod pa'i blo med na// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la// chags thogs med pa'i shes rab can// gzhan la mang po bshad na yang*// rgya mtsho'i dbus su gzhigs pa'i grus// pha rol dag tu 'gro ba med// nyon mongs gsum gyi rjes 'brangs pa'i// lus ngag yid kyi las rnams kun// mkhas pas spong ba'i brtul zhugs spyad// las dang nyon mongs spangs pa las// 'bras bu rnam smin mi 'byung zhes// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas na// ston pas rjes su 'brang bar bya/

/de ltar so sor thar pa'i sdom pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor rnams bzhis bsrung ba spyi'am/ rab tu byung bas khas blangs shing dam bcas pa ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ sbyang pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs la gnas pas/ sngon gyi 'phags pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis rjes su 'brangs te/ dgon pa'i gnas ri khrod dang gangs khrod la sogs par/ gyi na tsam gyi zas gos la brten nas nyams su blangs bar bya ste/ ci zhig nyams su blang bar bya zhe na/ nyon mongs pa gsum gyis dben pa'i yid/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa zhes yongs su grags pa/ sems ting nge 'dzin la yid g.yo ba med par mnyam par bzhag par bya ste/ bsam gtan gyi sgrib pa rgod pa dang*/ 'gyod pa dang*/ gnyid rmugs dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ 'dod pa la 'dun dang*/ the tshom rnams spang te/ byams pa'am/ snying rje'am/ dga' ba'am/ btang snyoms sam/ bsam gtan bzhi la sogs pa sems gang du 'gro ba zhig la mnyam par bzhag pas/ bsam pa'am ting nge 'dzin de nyid stobs 'phel nas/ dang po ni bsam pa de nyid ji lta ba bzhin du bkol du btub pa 'byung*/ de nas ni rang gi lus kyang de ltar du 'gyur/ de nas ni snang ba'i dngos po yang de ltar du 'gyur te/ 'di la ni sgom yun ring thung gi bye brag lo grangs mang nyung gi rtsi bgrang*/ mo mo btsun gyi sgom chen/ mi kha lce gcod kyi chos pa/ ma nyan pa med pa'i sob sgom gyi mi phan te/ chags pa'i yul rnam pa gsum las/ sems dang shes rab rnam par grol ba/ slob dpon shan ta de ba'i zhal snga nas kyang*// zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes bya ste// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// ces pas nges te/ zad par sngon po la mnyam par bzhag pas/ zad par ram mtha' dag sngon po zhes bya ba/ sngon po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems de gzhan thams cad kyang sngon por mthong ba dang*/

de'i dgongs pa bsgrub pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong ba la sogs pa 'byung ste/ sngon po ni bai ḍūrya la sogs pa yang yin no// gser ni ser po yin/ dung dang dngul dang mu tig ni dkar po yin/ nam mkha' ni thogs pa med pa yin/ sa ni thogs pa dang bcas pa yin/ de thams cad gang la yang mnyam par bzhag pas/ dmigs pa'am ting nge 'dzin gyi shugs yul dang yul can gyi shes pa gnyis med par/ rtse gcig tu yun ring la dar drag par goms par byas pas de kho nar 'gyur te/ thod rgal rnam pa sna tshogs kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pas/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa mngon par shes pa rnam pa lnga mngon du byas nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po byed pa dang*/ mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ gong ma thams cad kyi zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog tu 'gro ba dang*/ pha ma dang nye du dang*/ gnyen 'brel thams cad khong dgod 'chor ba dang*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad re ba skye ba/ sems rtse gcig pa 'di nyid las 'byung zhing*/ 'di yod na ni 'di 'byung*/ 'di med na ni 'di mi 'byung ste/ sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di yod na/ de'i khyad par ram bye brag sngon po dang*/ ser po dang*/ nam mkha' la sa dang*/ sa la nam mkha' bsgoms pas de dang der 'gyur ba ma gtogs pa/ rje btsun ma a lce sgom skyid la zhus pa'i gdams ngag zer lo dang yin lo'i dam chos/ a me khams pa'i yang zong*/ khur gcig dang pang gang gi be'u bum/ 'dres khyer gyi sgom chen rnams kyi lag cha/ chu'i chu bur la nor bu rin po cher 'du shes pa yin pas/ sems rtse gcig la 'bad par bya'o// de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor// rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub// ces gsungs pas shes so// bsam gtan 'di yi gnas dang*/ rgyu dang*/

rkyen dang*/ yan lag gi bye brag bshad pa shin tu mang yang*/ dben pa'i gnas su rtse gcig gi sems gang gis thob bltas la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs lus dang yul la chags pa la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi sgrib pa rnams 'chi ba mi rtag pa la sogs pas bzlog nas bsgoms pas/ dus gsum la 'jug pa'i sems 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa byung ba las/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba'i rgyu lta bu'i bye brag rnam pa sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin yid kyi las des/ 'khor ba'i skye gnas thams cad du skye zhing*/ 'khor bar go ba gal che ste/ 'di ma go na ni phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi bsam gtan la log pa'i lta ba rnam pa sna tshogs pas/ lha tshe ring po la sogs pa lta ba log pas mi khom pa'i gnas ngan song du 'gro ba srid de/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ mngon shes yod kyang log lta'i snod// ces pas/ 'khor bar skye byed kyi rgyu/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa yin la/ ma rig pa gang zhe na/ bdag tu lta ba/ bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di kho na ste/ rtsa ba 'di yod na de'i khyad par gyi chos bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa dang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ mtha' yod pa dang*/ mtha' med pa dang*/ dben pa dang*/ mi dben pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ma zhi ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ mi stong pa la sogs pa lta ba 'di rnams thams cad ni/ phung po lnga la bdag tu bzung ba/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ srid pa thams cad kyi ma rgan/ ma rig pa ma mo chen mo/ phyi rol mu stegs byed yin pas bdag med pa bsgom par bya'o// de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis// bdag med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pas// mu stegs ri dwags ngan 'jigs byed// ces pas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa spong ba la 'bad par bya'o// 'di la spong lugs zad pa'i mtha' med pa zhig bshad kyang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/

'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ sngags dang mtshan nyid thams cad du/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun 'di/ 'phags pa nges par 'byung ba rnams kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul yin pas 'di kho na bsgom par bya ste/ de yang dang por sngon du 'gro ba dran par nye bar bzhag pa bzhi las/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa phyi nang gi lus la brtags pas lus bdag ma yin pa dang*/ tshor ba la brtag pas tshor ba bdag ma yin pa dang*/ sems dang chos la brtag pas nye bar zhi ba'i phyir bdag med pa'am/ bdag tu zhen yul lus dang sems so sor phye ste/ gzhig long byas pas bdag med pa'i shes rab skye ste/ 'di'i don phyin ci ma log pa cig bdag gis gang nas rnyed ces/ bdag nyid kyi mngon par shes pa'i rtsal gyis mthong ba'am/ yi dam gyi lha'am/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas lung bstan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags lung bstan pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang la bla ma brgya rtsa bcu lung bstan pa'am/ jo bo nā ro pa la yi dam gyi lhas slob dpon chen po tilli pa lung bstan pa ltar/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa bsten pas/ yon tan gong ma rgyud la skye ste sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro// de la 'di ni spyi'i don legs par snyan du gsol ba lags so// ༈ //bye brag gi don theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang du byas na/ dang po kho na mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa gcig dang 'phrad dgos te/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi brjod bya bla ma gcig pu yin te/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// zhes pa dang*/ yang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma la ni skyabs su mchi// zhes pas/

bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhig dgos la/ rdo rje de yang*/ gzhogs pa shing gi rdo rje dang*/ brdungs pa lcags kyi rdo rje la sogs pa 'dzin pa la mi zer te/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbyer med pa gcig tu gyur pa la gsung ste/ de ltar yang*/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang btud de// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rgyud du bla ma'i mtshan nyid ji ltar bshad pa/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa zhig btsal nas/ dang po kho na dbang blang bar bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po las kyang*// sngags pas dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar// gang zhig rnal 'byor pa nyid 'dod// mkha' la khu tshur gyis brdeg dang*// smig rgyu'i chu ni 'thung dang mtshungs/ */zhes gsungs pas shes so/ */de yang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa 'di ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo lha de nyid kyi 'khor du gtogs pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ de'i 'khor du gtogs pa tshangs pa dang*/ drag po dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ sgrub pa byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin la sogs pa bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren de rnams dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rim du gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs na ni sdong grogs byed cing ci nus pa'i dngos grub ster la/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs na ni bar du gcod pa byed pas/ rgyu mtshan 'dis dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya ba/ tha na nad kyis zin pa dang*/ 'jigs skyob la yang dbang bskur bar rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyis gsungs pa dang*/ mtshams med pa rnam pa lnga la sogs pa sdig pa mi dge ba dpag tu med pa byas pa la sogs pa dang*/ shi ba'i ro dang rus pa dang*/ rus gcig pa dang*/ bran dang*/ ming gcig pa la yang dbang bskur na/ sdig pa mi dge ba byang nas mtho ris dang thar pa thob par rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du gsungs pa dang*/

rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud du dbang rnam pa bzhi bskur bas/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum po 'di dang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad bral nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mtha' dag thob pa la sogs pa med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras/ tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs chen po/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan rin po che thams cad kyi gter yin par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor du mi 'jug tu mi rung bar gsungs so// de la dbang zhes bya ba'i don gang yin na/ sdig pa'i grogs po zhig la brten na 'dod chags drag po rgyud la skye ste/ 'dod chags kyi dbang du gyur na 'dod chags spyod pa dang 'dra ba'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas snying rje drag po'i dbang gis byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa dang*/ dbang mchog thob pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la brten nas/ dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum gyi nang du zhugs te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byin gyis rlabs pa gsum gyi dbang gis/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs su 'gyur pa 'di ni mi srid pa ma yin te/ srid pa'am de ma yin pa gzhan gang gis kyang de ltar 'gyur du mi btub pa ni shin tu yang nges pa'o// 'o na de ltar dbang thob pa de gcig pus chog gam snyam na/ sa bon gcig pu yod pas mi chog ste/ rkyen chu lud dang*/ dus yongs su 'gyur bas smin pa ltar/ bza' srung gi dam tshig dang*/ nyams su blangs pa'i dus kyi 'gyur bas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob pa mi dka' na/ dus gzhan dag tu lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ dbang bskur ba ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i sa bon grung po/ yon tan rin po che thams cad bskyed par byed pa'i sa gzhi/ gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gro ba'i them skas/

med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras yin pas/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya'o// dbang bskur nas dam tshig bsrung dgos sam mi dgos zhe na/ de rang nyid la 'dri bar bya ste/ mtho ris lha mi'i go 'phang thob pa la/ de skyed byed kyi rgyu las dge ba rnam pa bcu rgyu'am srog tu song dgos sam mi dgos/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sems bskyed pa de sdom pa blangs pa yin nam ma yin/ blangs pa yin na de bsrungs pas de'i 'bras bu thob bam mi thob/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur bas tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum po 'di kun rdzob mi bden zhing brdzun pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs ni bden pa/ mi bslu ba/ rtag pa yin na/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum la sogs par mi ltung ba'i sdom pa 'dzin dgos sam mi dgos ji ltar yin pa dang*/ khas blangs pa dang sdom pa mi shes pa'i rten gyi gang zag 'ba' shang ro drud bdag cag lta bu gang gis gang la tshul dang thabs ji lta bu'i 'gro ldog spu'i rtse mo tsam yang ma mthong ba rnams ni/ smyon pa smyo ba'i gtam kho na sgrogs par zad do// 'dir yang skyes bu dam pa mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can rnams ni/ dang por khas blangs pa nyams 'og tu chud par byed pa yin la/ mkhas pa rnams ni dam bca' la skyon khel lam mi khel zer ba yin la/ gang zag dra ma rnams kyang*/ chad

khas blangs pa dam ma chad kha la glo gtad yod dam med zer ba ltar na/ khas blangs shing dam bcas pa'i sdom pa de srog gi snying po yin pas/ de'i bslab bya mtha' dag kyang tshig de nyid la gnas pa ni/ sdom pa gsum char la de ltar shes par bya zhing*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags la dam tshig sa ma ya 'bum sder bshad pa yang*/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje thob par byed pa la mang ba ma yin te/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ brtson 'grus che la yid thung ba'i// don du gsang sngags theg pa bstan// ces gsungs nges so// de ltar gyur na gsang sngags sbrul shun gur bcug pa dang 'dra/ dbang bskur ba ni mang*/ dam tshig bsrung ba ni nyung*/ ma bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu ni rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro bar bshad na/ gyong chen po ma byas sam snyam na/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la dam tshig sa ma ya 'bum sde bsrung dgos kyang*/ yi ge drug pa lan gcig brjod pas mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa'i sdig pa ni 'byang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug ni rdzogs/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa ni dkyil 'khor du zhugs par 'gyur/ tshangs par mi spyod pa ni tshangs par spyod par 'gyur ba la sogs pa skyon dag cing yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung na/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig gi nang na de dang 'dra ba'i pha spun dod thub/ mnyam hrug ge ba ma mang po yang yod la/ gang de dag gi gdong du blta ba tsam du yang mi nus pa'i lha mang po yod par gsungs pas/ lha de rnams kyis 'khor ba nas 'don pa ma lags sam/ slob dpon ārya de bas/ byi las ne tso bsad pa'i sdig pa gang ga'i lha mos sbyong gsung skad na/ de dang 'dra ba ma lags sam/ de nyid 'go bsgre/ de nyid kyis tshar bcad pas 'brel dgos zer na/ skyabs su song zhing byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ lus phul ba dang*/

smon lam btab pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs gcig tu gyur pa ci rigs tsam zhig yod na/ de yang 'brel pa ma lags sam/ med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags so// de ltar dbang bskur ba'i dam tshig ni/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal snga nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya bsrung nus na/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la yang tshegs med gsung skad pa shin tu mad gsungs/ 'gro ba'i mgon chen po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig bsam pa'i bye brag gis bsgyur bar jo bo chen pos bzhed pa yin gsungs/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mtha' dag gsang sngags kyi sdom pa rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang sdom par gsungs pa yin gsungs/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud nas/ 'di ltar nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag de/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa/ spyod pa thams cad kyi yang rab mthar thug yin gsungs so// de ltar dbang dang dam tshig dang ldan pa des/ bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rnam par grags// rdo rje'i skye mched thams cad ni// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid// sa chu spyan dang ma ma ki// me rlung sgrol ma gos dkar mo// rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum dang*// gsang chen rigs gcig gang bshad pa// thub pa rgyal bas legs bsngags pa'i// dben pa'i dgon pa yid 'ong bar// theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags bsgom// tha mal lus ngag rjes 'brangs nas// nga mi khom zhes mi gsung bar// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs nyid gcig gyur pa// yid dam lha dang mi 'bral zhu// gal po che la lan gsum zhu// gdams ngag be'u bum mang na yang*// rdo rje 'chang gi lung bstan cing*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub brnyes// gling mchog lho yi 'dzam gling 'dir// nyi zla ltar grags rje btsun pa// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyi// chos drug chos bzhir rnam grags pa// grub thob brgyud pa ma chad cing*// mos gus rgyun chad med pa yis// nyams rtogs rgyud la ma chad pas// byin rlabs rgyun chad med pa dang*// thos pas sdig pa zad par byed// mnyan pas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'du// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// nyams su blangs pas 'byung ba yi// rnyed dka'i gdams ngag rin po che// cis kyang nyams su blang bar zhu// rin po che yi zhal snga nas// pha med gdams ngag mang po yis// byin rlabs nyams par 'gyur zhes gsungs// tha snyad chu yi gnyer ma la// brtsi bgrang byas pas mi lang ba// mkhas pa khyed kyis ma khums sam// rang la skyes pa'i nyams rtogs 'di// dben par bsgoms pas 'phel lags pa// rnal 'byor pa yis ma dgongs sam// mtshan ma'i spros pas g.yengs pa la// zhi bar gnas pa'i gnyer med pa// sgom chen khyed kyis go bar mdzod// bla ma yin pa'i gnyer ka yis// tshogs dang dpag dang dus kun tu// kha zad gre ba ral ral tu// rtag tu snying tshig gdams pa rnams// thugs la zhogs la nyams su longs// spyi dang bye brag dam chos kyi// nyams len gnad kyi tshul bstan pa// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// byang chub sems kyi rjes 'brangs pas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyis// byin gyis rlob cing bzod par bzhes// shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong bsod snyoms pa// rin chen zhes bya dpal gyi mtha' can la// thos dang bsam pa'i blo gros rab yangs shing*// dam pa rnams kyi zhabs pad gtsug gis blangs// bla med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis thugs rgyas shing*// bdag la gus pa'i yid can rnal 'byor pa// dge bshes dpal dro ba zhes rnam grags pas// yang dang yang du gsol btab bris pa las// byung ba'i dge ba gang yin de nyid kyis// ston pa'i bstan la legs par gzhol gyur nas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa myur du rgyas par shog

/bslab pa gsum legs par bsdus pa dang*// gsang sngags kyi nyams su blang ba'i rim pa rin po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 110)༄// sdom gsum gsal byed dri med snying po dge slong sding po la gnang ba// stobs bcu ting 'dzin ye shes mche ba can// gang zhig skye ba'i rang bzhin gzeb bral nas// mya ngan 'das pa'i 'brog dgon zhugs gyur pa// ston pa glang po de la mgos phyag 'tshal// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// gshis sam rang bzhin ngang nyid kyis// mi dge ba zhes sde snod gsum// gsungs pa de yi gnyen po yin// cha mnyam pa dang rnam bzhi las// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// bla med rgyud sde man chad dang*// sde snod gsum po kun tu gsungs// mkhas pa rnams kyi de yi don// dgrol bar byed pa'i 'grel pa mdzad// da lta yongs su grags pa la// mi mkhas blun po gti mug can// nyes dang nyes pa med pa yi// rnam gzhag don la rmongs pa rnams// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin gyi// rgyu 'bras ji ltar 'gyur ba dgongs// nyes dang nyes med gsungs pa ni// rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya// gshis kyi nyes pa med pa ni// nyon mongs las dang de yi 'bras// med par gyur pa ma lags sam// de la ston pas gnang bar gsungs// nyon mongs med cing de yi las// rnam smin 'bras bu bde 'byung ba// sgrub pa'i bslab pa ma lags sam// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// 'bras bu rnam smin mi bzad pa// sdug bsngal rgyun par gnas pa la// gang gis spong bar bya ba yi// bsgrub par nus pa ma yin phyir// nyes pa med ces gsungs pa ste// 'chi bar nges pa'i skyes bu la// nam yang phan par mi 'gyur na// shi ba nyes med smra dang mtshungs// nyes pa gtan med yin smra ba// log pa'i 'khrul pa ma lags sam// de ltar min na 'jig rten du// dkon mchog gsum po ma byung na// nyes pa med par 'thad pa dang*// smyos dang sems 'khrugs tshor bas nyen// 'du shes sems pa yod bzhin pa'i// rmi lam nyes pa med gyur na// nyin par gnyid pa bkag pa dang*// srod dang tho rangs mi nyal zhing*// nyal na seng ge nyal thabs dang*// thum 'phras

gnyid srab mo 'du shes don med 'gyur// gal te gnyid la nyes med cing*// de yi khyad par chos la yang*// nyes pa med pa yin na ko// dgra bcom rnam par grol ba yi// 'bras bus su la ci zhig bya// 'bras bus dgra bo ma choms shing*// 'khor ba'i g.yul las ma rgyal na// 'bras bu gang yin dgongs dang kye// nga la btsun po'i dam bca' med// mi ngom cha phyung zhe 'dod med// gal te gshis sam rang bzhin gyis// las dang lam la sgrib pa dang*// bya dang byed pa mang ba dang*// gzhan dag ma dad thob pa dang*// ngan song gsum du mi ltung na// sangs rgyas byung ba don med cing*// dam pa'i chos 'di don med de// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun don med cing*// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan kyang*// thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin zhing*// phywa dang dbang phyug byed por 'gyur// rjes zhugs slob ma phung bar 'gyur// sangs rgyas drang por mi gsung bas// rdzun pos 'jig rten bslus par 'gyur// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin gyi// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi bden phyir// rtag gam yang na chad par 'gyur// gal te gti mug nyes med na// 'gro ba gang zhig 'khor bar 'khyams// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ma 'dres chos// stobs bcu'i spyod yul 'dul ba yis// rgyu dang 'bras bu las rnams la// rmongs par gyur pa'i ma rig dang*// nyon mongs rgyu lam ldog pa yis// 'gog pa'i bden pa thob pa'i tshul// de kho na nyid la ma rmongs pa'i// ma rig pa 'di ji ltar spong*// 'di dang 'thad pa dpag med pas// gzhan la smra ba'i gnyer kha med// bu rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams// mthar thug stobs bcu ma thob bar// lus srog phye mar gyur kyang bla// ston pas gsungs pa'i tshul khrims dang*// skad cig tsam yang ma 'bral cig /'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba thams cad gcig gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis/

/lus kyi tshul khrims rnam dag na// lus kyi ting 'dzin rnam dag thob// lus nyid grol ba'i shes rab thob// ngag dang sems kyang de bzhin te// sems dang shes rab rnam grol ba// ma thob thob pa tshul khrims yin// thob pa brtan pa tshul khrims yin// brtan pa bogs 'don tshul khrims yin// mthar thug sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug tshul khrims yin// nga la nye ba gzhan med pas// bu slob rnams la smra ba yin// snying gtam kha chems 'di las med// sor gcig sor gnyis yan chad dang*// mang po sder longs man chad kyi// slob mas yi ge gang zhus pa// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu dang*// gegs sel bogs 'don rten 'brel rnams// 'di las med do gces se rnams// bsdur la zhu thug mdzod dang mngon// 'di na bag med 'ga' zhig gis// nyon mongs gsum la chags pa'i blos// 'di kun dman pa'i tshul khrims yin// dman pa'i tshul khrims bsrungs pa yis// mthar thug byang chub mi thob ste// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*// 'jug sdom tshul khrims blangs pas chog /snyam pa'i bsam pa skye na yang*// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i sa nas kyang*// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa de// sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin par gsungs// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// dang por byang chub sems bskyed nas// bar du bskal pa dpag med du// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs par byas// tha mar byang chub sangs rgyas pa// stobs bcu stobs la gnas pa yi// thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur zhes grags// brgya la gal te bden srid na// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa 'di// spangs pa'i pha rol phyin lnga 'dis// stobs bcu thob pa rgyu 'bras min// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// gang gis spyad par 'gyur ba des// 'bras bu thar dang thar pa ches// so sor thar pa yin srid na// nyon mongs las dang rnam par smin// gang gis ji ltar spangs pa 'di// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skye dang gnas dang mthar thug gi// rten du ci yi phyir mi 'gyur// rmongs pa khyod la go ba med// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin gyis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal 'byin pa 'di// nged kyis na ning snga nas shes// nged kyi slob dpon che ge mo/ */mang tang tha se rnyog ge mor// 'di skad zer bas 'di skad bshad// de ltar min pa'i so sor thar// gzhan zhig ya gi ma gir spyod// pha gi tshu gi na yang yod// snyam zhing smra ba yod na yang*// ston pa'i 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod du// bdag nyid dang ni gzhan dag gis// ngan song gsum dang 'khor ba'i rgyu// sa dang lam gyi bar chad dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar chad du// ston pas gsungs pa 'di las gzhan// khyod kyi mtshar po yar po ste// lung dang rigs pas mi 'grub cing*// ston pa'i gsung dang 'gal ba'i phyir// mkhas pa su zhi dga' ba skye// 'di yang gzhan la smra ba yi// gnyer kha nga la yod pa min// rang bas gces pa'i bu slob kun// khyed kyi rnam par thar pa gang*// bdag gis ji ltar nyams su blang*// snyam zhing zhu ba'i bu slob la// dbang gi rgyal po rin po che// bye ba khrag khrig 'bum pas kyang*// lhag par gyur pa'i snying tshig 'di// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// rdo rje gsung yin thugs la zhog

/kye ma khyod kyi dam chos 'di// mgo bas gsus pa phyi phyir sra// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// rang nyid khams gsum 'khor ba las// thar bar byed pa nyan thos yin// bdag dang sems can thams cad kun// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal pa yi// nyon mongs 'ching ba las grol byed// gong ma las kyang phyi ma dog /zab cing rgya che gting mtha' med// tshul khrims phung po bsrung mi nus// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// zab pa'i gdams ngag cig gcig yod// don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas phyir// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// dka' thub spyod pa mi zad de// bsgrubs pas 'grub par yong mi 'gyur// 'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing*// bsgrubs pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur// ma dang bu mo chung ma dang*// mna' ma dang ni sgyug mo ma rgan ste// phyag rgya rnam pa lnga pa ni// rnal 'byor pa yis bsten ces grags// chang med pa la dngos grub ci// ye shes kyang ni de bzhin gsung*// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// ya mtshan can zhig dus 'dir byung*// sla 'o gsang sngags theg pa la// dus 'dir bdag gis spyad par bya// snyam pa'i bsam pa skye 'gyur na// legs par dgongs dang skyes bu kun// bsam gzhig mdzod dang mkhas pa kun// rtog dpyod gyis dang shes rab can// mar khrid ma mdzad tshogs dpon kun// blo 'di babs dang gshis la zhogs// thub pa'i gsung rab dpang por byas// bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar blta// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa// slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyis// ji ltar gsungs pa tshad mar bzung*// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa yi// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// mtha' drug rdo rjes rgyas btab pa// mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya grol ba yi// nyon mongs bdud bzhi bcom gyur pa// dpa' bo rdo rje slob dpon gyi// bdag cag bka' dang 'gal mi bya// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor sgo phye zhing*// mtshan mchog dung gi tshems bar nas// ljags kyi dbang po brkyang mdzad de// dpag med tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// khyu mchog seng ge'i 'khor rnams la// nyan thos byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rdo rje theg pa'i rim pa rnams// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gsungs// nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa bas// bsags pa'i stobs kyis blo log pa// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi// ma rgan nyon mongs dbang song zhing*// de yi las kyis 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yi// don du byang chub sems bskyed pas// 'khor ba sgrol bar byed pa'i thabs// bdag nyid brgal nas sgrol ba dang*// grol nas dgrol bar bya ba dang*// dbugs phyin nas ni dbugs dbyung ste// mya ngan 'das nas mya ngan 'da'// de las gzhan pa mi nus par// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod rnams// 'di nyid du ni rnam par gsungs// bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni// mi yi lus kyang mi thob na// bla med byang chub smos ci dgos// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rgan rnams// las dang nyon mongs dbang song ba// bdag gi spong sems 'di tsam dang*// brtul zhugs spyod pa 'di tsam gyis// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kun// byang chub mchog la ji ltar 'god// snyam pa'i bsam sbyor drag po yis// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi// brtul zhugs spyod pa gang yin pas// cha dang dper yang mi bzod pa// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis spyod// lung dang rigs pa thams cad kyis// grub pa mkhas pa rnams kyis dgongs/ */skyes bu dam pas thugs su chud// shes rab can gyis gting nas go// bdag gi slob ma mgo ldog pa// lham nag can la smras pa yin// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che// brtul zhugs spyad pa de 'dras kyang*// bsod nams bsags pa'i blo stobs kyis// rang snying gang bar ma gyur nas// tshe 'dir byang chub sangs rgyas nas// 'gro ba smin par byed pa la// nyon mongs las dang shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing sa bon dang*// bag la nyal dang bcas pa rnams// spong bar bya phyir zhugs pa des// chang 'thung ma sring spyod pa yi// khrel med ngo tsha med pa 'dis// tshe 'dir byang chub ga la thob// bla med thugs stobs de 'dra la// chang dang ma sring spyod pa yi// bya bas rang la ga la mgu// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing ma bsregs par// rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi sku// thob par theg chen gsang sngags kyi// rgyud sde bzhi po gang du yang*// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa med// bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gsungs pas// skur pa gdab par mi bya ste// rdo rje dmyal bar 'tshed par nges// bsags pa rab tu gyur pa yi// snying rje brtson 'grus shugs can gyis// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon las// smin par byed pa dbang bzhi zhu// grol bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis// rgyun chad med par nyams su blang*// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa bzung*// rgyun chad med par nyams blangs pas// sgyogs dang 'khrul 'khor ji bzhin du// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar// the tshom med par myur du phyin// ma smin smin par byed pa yi// gsang sngags dbang gi go ba 'di// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// de gsum dag par 'dzin pa'i blo// dag par byed pa dbang du gsungs// yang na dbang gi sgra don ni// bsgyur ram dbang du byed pa yin// sgyur byed rdo rje slob dpon ni// bla ma rdo rje 'chang cig dgos// jo bo chen po'i rjes 'brangs ba// skyes chen gong mar bzhugs pa rnams// bka' stsal gsungs pa 'di re mad// lus ngag yid gsum 'gyur ba'i dngos// sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje de// nyin mtshan med pa thams cad du// bskyed pa'i rim dang rdzogs pa'i rim// zung du 'jug par nyams su blang*// gcig gi bogs 'don gcig gis bya// rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung*// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa 'di// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// dam tshig 'bum sde sa ma ya// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa 'di// man ngag gnad dang bcas pa yis// rgyud sde bzhi yi dgongs pa'i don// gnad rnams ma lus phyung ba 'dis// gnad rnams ma lus phyungs nas 'dug

/ma lus gnad kyi man ngag 'di// bu snying dang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa// tshe 'dir dngos grub 'dod pa yis// snying gi dbus su bcang bar bya// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// bu gces par bsam kyang khar mi thon// snying khrag kha ru skyugs pa 'dra// nga byin pa las kyang god pa dang*// khyed khyi la ma phan ma byed par// gcig pu dben par nyams su blang*// bcom ldan dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// chos kyi sku dang gzugs kyi sku// dbyer med zung du 'jug pa las// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum du// skad cig tsam yang ma shor ba// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum du// shor na dam tshig nyams gyur te// gal te mkha' 'gro brda yi skad// sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gsung na// mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i gsung*// snying gtam yin gyis sems la zhog /sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid dang*// rgyun chad med par ma bral zhing*// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yid// gti mug ma rig chen po de// spangs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// chags dang sdang ba cis mi spong*// nyon mongs gsum po spangs pa la// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa'i sku// stobs dang mi 'jigs yongs rdzogs pa// gar dgu'i rnam par rol mdzad pa// dus gsum khams gsum ngo bo nyid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i skur// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// de ltar gyur na khyod nyid kyis// ji ltar gong du bstan pa yi// brod pa de rnams ji ltar thal// gsang sngags tshul dang 'gal snyam na// gsang sngags brda yis bshad pa la// blo dman rnams la ci cha yod// thabs mang dka' ba med pa de// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pa// sku gsum rang la yod pa yin// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// bral ba sku gsum sangs rgyas kyis// yul dang yul can gnyis med pa// 'dod pa lnga yis de nyid spyod// phyag rgya lnga po gang bstan pa// dug lnga rnam par dag pa'i brda// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// bde chen ro yi btung ba la// chang zhes rnam par bshad pa dang*// tha mal chang du gang gsungs pa// rje btsun 'khor lo sdom pa yi// sdom pa 'byung bar gsungs pa yang*// kha dog dri ro nus pa rnams// sngags pas med par bya bar gsungs// de bas gzhan pa'i gang gis chang*// 'thungs shing myos par 'gyur ba ni// ngu 'bod chen por skye bar gsungs// 'di ni rdo rje 'chang gi bka'// chang med pa la dngos grub ci// de na yod de de na med// he ru ka dpal rdo rje la// ye shes bdud rtsis ma mchod cing*// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kyi// 'khor lo chen por ma gyur cing*// sngags pa chang gis myos pa ni// ngu 'bod dmyal bar skye bar gsungs// nyams len bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis kyis// thams cad mkhyen par 'gro ba la// dam tshig bsrung bar bstan pa 'di// nyon mongs gsum las bsrungs ba yin// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// tshig ni de yi bka' yin pas// dam tshig nyams par gyur pa de// rdo rje dmyal ba la sogs pa// 'khor ba'i chad pas phog pa yin// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa yi// sdom pa rin chen gsum po 'dis// nyon mongs gsum po spong bar gsung*// 'dir mang smos pas ci zhig bya// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// dam tshig sdom pa gang yin pa// nyon mongs gsum po spong bar mtshungs// las dang nyon mongs spangs pa la// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhes brjod pas// don de gong du brjod pa bas// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa yi// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi// rnam par bzhag pa bstan pa 'di// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i gsung*// zur tsam bdag gis bris pa las// nor 'khrul gyur pa ci mchis pa// bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis// byin gyis rlob cing bzod par bzhes// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab kyis// thub pa'i gsung la nges shes skyes// rdzas dang zhabs tog sgrub pa yi// mnyes pa gsum gyis bla ma la// mnyes par byas pa'i skyes bu yis// bslab pa gsum gyi tshul lugs 'di// yang dang yang du zhus nas bris// 'di bris bsod nams dam pa des// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// nyes tshogs sgrib pa rab spangs nas// sangs rgyas sku gsum thob par shog
/sdom pa gsum gsal bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dge slong sdings po bas zhus pa rdzogs so// //

111) ༄// dug gsum gnyen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len bslab khog chen mo// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du lhun gyis grub cing*/ rgyun chad med par sems can thams cad smin pa dang*/ grol bar mdzad pa'i rje 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// spyir nged rang thams cad skye shi la rang dbang ni ma thob/ mi rtag pa'i srin pos ni bzung*/ 'jig rten pa'i 'di bya ba dang byed pa la zin pa'i dus ni med/ gnyen dang mdza' bar gyur pa rnams kyang ci tsam du btud pa bzhin du/ byis pa 'ja' la bda' ba bzhin du 'bros/ 'dus byas kyi dngos po thams cad chu'i chu bur dang 'dra bar/ cis kyang mi rtag par ni nges/ tshe phyi ma phan chad kyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po la gting mtha' ni ma mchis pa lags pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen po 'jig rten gyi bya ba gtong bar zhu/ de la 'jig rten ni gang*/ bya ba ni gang*/ gtong lugs ni gang*/ btang ba'i phan yon ni gang yin snyam na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'jig rten sna tshogs las las byung*// zhes gsungs pas da ltar gyi rang gi bsam pa 'di la nyon mongs pa skyes/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las byas/ las de'i 'bras bu 'khor ba dang ngan song yin pas/ ngan song du smin pa 'di ni 'khor ba 'jig rten zhes bya'o// bya ba gang zhe na/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po dngos sam brgyud par bskyed pa'i bya ba dang byed pa la ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba zhes bya'o// gtong lugs ni rnam pa gsum ste/ sems can thams cad kyi gshis la nyon mongs pa dug rnam pa gsum yod pa 'di'i gnyen po phyi yul dang nang sems can la chags pa'i gnyen por lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/
