zhe sdang gi gnyen por lhag pa sems sam ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ gti mug gi gnyen por lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gsungs te/ de la kha cig tshul khrims las ting nge 'dzin skye/ ting nge 'dzin las shes rab skye bar gsung pa dang*/ kha cig tu nyon mongs pa gang shas che ba'i gnyen po bsgoms sam go ba skyes pas/ nyon mongs pa de dul nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bslab pa'i gzhi khas blangs nas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa gsha' mar chud nas/ bden pa mthong nas bzod 'byung bar dpag tu med pa gsungs pa yin pas/ cig car ba dang rim gyis 'jug pa gang bden pa dang*/ gang yin pa rtsod par mang yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab kyi gzhi gnyis po 'dir gyur pa lags pas/ de kho na nyid nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'di las gzhan du gyur pa ma mchis kyang*/ bla ma rin po che'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi nyams len cig car du 'jug pa'i man ngag skad cig ma'i bsam pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i de nyid/ gsung rab thams cad kyi nying khu/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes la sbar zin byed pa'i man ngag sems rang grol bas 'khor ba rang grol ba'i tshul lugs ni/ theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa/ theg pa chen pos dang po zhe sdang gi gnyen po byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ phyi yul la chags pa'i gnyen po gzhal yas kyi khang*/ 'byung ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ yul ris dang sa bcad sa rdo dang khang khyim la smon pa med pa'i bzang po bsgom pa dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa'i gnyen por/ bu dang tsha bo nye du dang*/ gnyen 'brel la smon pa med pa dang*/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhi rang gi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ rang gi chung ma la chags pa'i gnyen por/ mi mo nu ma can la smon pa med pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum/

rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la sogs pa la blta ba dang*/ dgod pa dang*/ lag bcangs dang*/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa la sogs pa shes pa ji ltar 'jug pa'i dga' ba dang*/ bde bas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum sras dang bcas pa mchod pa 'di ni/ myur du lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs/ rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i rgyu/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la/ gsung brjod pa dang bral ba'i myong bas/ de kho na nyid ston par byed pa'i rten 'brel/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i 'bras bu nges pa yin pas/ lus lhar bsgom par bya'o// de la bla ma dam pa bsgom pa ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po skem par byed pa'i bskal ba'i me dpung chen po/ ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sel bar byed pa ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen pos/ dngos por 'dzin pa'i blo brag gi ri bo lta bu dang*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa ma gtogs pa gzhan med pas nyin par spyi bor bsgom par bya/ mtshan mo snying gi dbus su bsam gsung*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i mtshams sbyor/ nyon mongs 'khrud par byed pa'i 'khrud shing*/ thar pa'i khang bzang bgrod par byed pa'i them skas/ lam gsum rgyud la bskyed par byed pa'i ma ma/ de nyid ston par byed pa'i ston pa/ bla ma dam pa yin pas mos gus kyi tshad du bskyal bar bya'o// gti mug gi gnyen po yang dag pa'i shes rab don dam pa'i bden pa rgyud la skyes na/ phyi gzung ba'i yul dang nang 'dzin pa'i shes pa nga snyam pa dang*/ nga yi snyam du log par rtog pa smon pa med pa/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa bsgom pa ni/

'di shes nas bsgom mam mi shes nas bsgom/ mi shes kyang bsgom snyam na/ log pa'i shes pa bsgom pa'am/ don spyi bsgom par mi 'gro'am/ log shes don spyi don rang gi mtshan nyid du mi btub par/ khyed rang gi thugs su chud pa yin mod/ don dam pa'i bden pa mthong na mthong lam/ de la goms pa sgom lam yin na yang*/ de dag gi rgyud la mi 'dug snyam na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ lhan cig skyes pa gang skyes pa// lhan cig skyes pa de brjod bya// zhes pas ston pa'i gsung dang ma 'gal ba zhig bsgom pa ma yin du zad mod/ de ji ltar zhe na/ lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ba ni rang nyid lhan cig skyes pa la zer/ rang nyid lhan cig skyes pa de rang gi sems yin mod/ de la lag pa g.yas g.yon ma spos shing ma bcos pa de/ lhan cig skyes pa gang skyes pa// zhes gsungs la/ de nyid la lhan cig skyes pa zer ba yin no// zhes pa'i gsung gis/ lhan cig skyes pa de brjod bya// zhes gsungs so// de'i spros pa gcod pa'i gsung*/ gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// chad pa med par rtag med pa// skye ba med pa 'gag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi zhir bstan pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa 'di la 'gro ba'i mgon po chen po slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dbu ma'i don bstan bcos chen po mdzad pa rnams kyi log par rtog pa spros pa'i mtha' rnam pa brgyad du ma 'dus pa med la/ de dang bral ba'i don de la/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ mnyam med dam pa rin po che// 'od gsal chen po'i ngang la bzhugs// mtha' brgyad skyon gyis ma gos pa// rje chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pas/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par bya'o// dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zab mo thabs la mkhas pa/

sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba byas tshad zad mi shes pa'i gter mdzod/ nag po mi dge ba'i phyogs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i rdo rje/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba 'di gcig pu yin pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba la 'bad par bya ste/ de yang dge ba gang yin pa dang*/ tshul ji ltar bsngo ba dang*/ bsngos pa'i 'bras bu gnas skabs dang mthar thug tu ji ltar 'gyur ba gsum du shes par bya ste/ dang po bsngo rgyu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /ces gsungs pas rang nyid kyis byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ 'dod chags med pa'am/ zhe sdang med pa'am/ gti mug med pa'am/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rang nyid kyis byas pa dang*/ gzhan la byed du bcug pa dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba shes pa la dran tshad bdag gir bya/ snying por bya/ ched du bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'i dus 'dir nag po mi dge ba'i rtsa ba dran par mi bya/ 'dres par mi bya/ dge ba dkar po bzang yag tu byas nas bsngo bar bya ste/ de yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che de'i zhal snga nas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta phan chad kyi bar du/ mi dge ba'i las ji snyed cig byas pa/ sgos bla lhag tu dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pa la 'jig rten gyi sems dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa 'dres na bshags par bya ste/ sdig pa bshags pas mi 'dzad pa mi mchi gsung*/ sdig pa bshags pas sdig pa mi dge ba mi 'dzad pa yin na/ sdig pa rtag pa dang*/ sdig pa sems la gnas par thal ba ma yin pa'i skyon yod pas/ bshags pas 'dag par nges te/

de ltar yang mtshams med pa rnam pa lnga dang*/ sdig pa mi dge ba rgya chen po byas pa thams cad kyang 'gyod pa skyes pas dag pa rgyal po ma skyes dgra lta bu gsungs/ bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ lo stong lon pa'i mun pa 'thug po yang*// sgron me skyes ma thag gis sel ba ltar// 'khor ba'i bag chags rgya chen 'thug po yang*// rang sems rtogs pas skad cig gcig gis zhi// zhes pa dang*/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang*// dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol gyur ba// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi bsten// zhes pa dang*/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig can rnams// skad cig gcig gis nges par bsreg par byed// ces gsungs pa ste/ spang bya dang gnyen po lhan cig tu mi gnas pa'i 'gal ba yin pas/ 'gyod pa skyes pa tsam gyis sdig pa 'dag par nges pas/ skad cig ma'i shes pa de nyid la dag cing dri ma med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dran tshod kyi mtshon nas/ rang nyid dang sems can thams cad kyis/ dus gsum du byas shing bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tshul ji ltar du bsngo na rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya ste/ de ltar yang 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa nas/ byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rtog pa thams cad spang phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nas/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba bya bar gsungs pas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das par ro gcig rang dang gzhan dang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems nyid ma skyes pa phyag rgya chen po gcig tu byas nas bsngo bar bya ba ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces bsngo bar bya'o// bsngo ba'i gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/

'dzad par byed pa'i rgyu rnam pa bzhi la sogs pa gang gis kyang 'dzad par mi nus pa dang*/ dag pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dri ma med pas dkon mchog gsum dang rtag tu mi 'bral ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po ches rang gzhan thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa ste/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya'o// de la 'jig rten gyi bya ba gtong lugs chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad 'di rnams yin/ des sems su mi btub/ bya ba gtong ba la yang mi dgos dgu dgos/ gangs khrod dang ri khrod 'grims dgos/ dka' thub dang sdug bsngal byed dgos snyam na/ de gong ma rnams kyis phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams kyi brtul zhugs su gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor ba dang mya ngan 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bram ze chen po'i don dam pa'i rig pa las kyang phyi rol gyi yul bgrod pas grol ba dang*/ lus gdung bas grol ba dang*/ ngag bzlas brjod kyis grol ba gtan tu mi srid par lung dang rig pas gtan la phab pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ lus ngag gi dka' thub 'ba' zhig ston par byed pa phyi rol mu stegs byed/ sems 'dul ba nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin gsung*/ nyon mongs pa rang gi bsam par 'dug na/ de rgyu 'bras 'jig rten pa yin mod/ nyon mongs pa de nyid ngo shes na de rtogs pa'i shes rab zer/ shes rab skyes pas rnam par grol ba gong ma rnams kyis bzhed pa lags pas/ 'khor 'das lag pa'i lto rgyab yin// sems 'jig rten pa yi bya ba btang*// go ba tsam gyis byar med yin// 'khor 'das lag pa'i lto rgyab 'dra// gong mas gsung ba 'di re mad// 'jig rten bya ba btang thabs so// bya ba'i btang ba'i yon tan ni// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// 'jig rten 'di yi bde skyid dang*// 'jig rten pha rol bde skyid dang*// sa dang lam la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa'i bde skyid dang*// mthar thug rgyal ba'i bde skyid rnams// sems 'dul sangs rgyas bstan pa la// nyams su blangs pa'i lag rjes lags// bya ba btang ba'i 'bras bu'o// ku sā li yi nyams myong 'di// tshig dang tha snyad ma sbyangs pas// mtho dman phog thug mang na yang*// rang gi chos las skyes pa'i bu// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yis// gsol ba btab nas bris pa lags// byung ba'i dge ba rtsa ba 'dis// byang chub dam pa mchog thob shog

/nyams len bslab khog chen po rdzogs so// // 112) ༄// tshogs gnyis rgya che zab par bstan pa yid dbang 'dren pa'i shing rta// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dbyer med bde chen dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs 'chang ba// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la gtsug gis 'dud// sprang po sa mthar 'khyams pa yi// nags dang dgon pa ri dwags ltar// skyid sdug phyogs ris med pa yi// shākya'i dge slong ldom bu la// sngon sbyangs bsags pa'i las 'phro can// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bdag po mchog /stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur pa ltar// 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po'i gsung phrin las// yi ge skur cig gsung ba la// blo gros chen po khyod nyid kyi// mkhan slob sangs rgyas 'dra ba yi// legs bshad gsung dang mi 'gal zhing*// skyob pa shākya'i rgyal po yis// ji ltar gsung pa de bzhin du// skyes bu khyed kyis mdzad par zhu// bdag la gdams pa'i gnyer med kyis// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// rtag tu 'chi ba bsam pa dang*// las su bsags pa bgrang ba dang*// dkon mchog gsum po mchod pa dang*// ngo bo gnyis med bsgom zhes gsungs// cung zad de yi don bshad na// bdag nyid chen po i ko ma// ku re min te 'chi bar 'dug /lung rigs bshad bshud mi 'tshal te// cis kyang mas kyang 'chi bar 'dug /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang*// lha klu gnod sbyin gdug pa can// dbang po lags te 'chi bar 'dug /pha dang ma dang gnyen 'dun dang*// rang la brtse bar gyur pa yi// gong ma de rnams gang du song*// thams cad 'chi bar nges pa la// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// sha dang pags pa rus pa rnams// bdag cag rnams kyis spyod pa gang*// de dag shi ba ma yin nam// cis kyang 'chi bar 'gyur zhe na// zhag gcig sdod pa'i nyal sa 'dir// gtan gyi gnas mal mi yong bar// mkhas pa kun gyis shes pa ltar// gtan gyi so tshis

'tsho thabs bsags pa bgrang*// de la rnam pa gnyis yin te// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis po// pha rol phyin drug dbye ba yis// lnga ni bsod nams tshogs yin te// shes rab ye shes tshogs su gsungs// gnyis po'i rtsa ba byang chub sems// lhag bsam g.yo dang bral ba yis// tshogs gnyis bsags na byang chub thob// de la dang po sbyin pa yang*// zhing dang bsam pa dngos pos bsgrub// 'di ltar sa bon 'debs pa'i zhing*// bzang ngan bdam pa ji bzhin du// zhing ngo bzang ngo rnam gzhag gis// me dang chu dang gangs khrod du// sa bon btab na mi smin ltar// gang la brten dang bdag nyid kyi// lus ngag yid gsum bya byed rnams// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// dam pa rnams la bsten par mdzod// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa nyan thos rang sangs rgyas// dam pa rnams kyis bstan pa yi// tshul khrims dri med rin po che// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// skyes bu chen pos srog bzhin srungs// re rag yod cing ma thub pa// khe nyen len pa'i bzod pa la// thub pas bzod par ma gsungs te// mtho 'am yang na dma' yang rung*// dgra 'am yang na gnyen yang rung*// phyogs ris med pa thams cad la// gnyen bshes bdag las med pa ste// 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig tu// bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do// bdag gi dgra gnyen mthong ba ko// ji ltar rigs par 'gyur snyam nas// gzhan la phan dang bde ba bsgrub// mi rigs gnod pa'i bsam pa yi// go skabs dbye bar mi bya 'o// cung zad gnyen po stobs chung bas// gnod pa'i dgra dang sems can kun// pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel dang*// yi dam lha dang rang gi sems// chos kyi sku dang bla mar bsam// rig pas nges pa skyes gyur na// khro dang gnod pa'i bsam pa ldog /'di la nan tan bya 'o zhes// 'jig rten mgon po bla mas gsungs// sa bcu dbang phyug man chad dang*// khams gsum sems can yan chad kyi// dkar po dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// 'bad dang brtson 'grus brtsams las byung*// dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba la// btang snyoms tsam du mi bzhag par// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams// ji ltar mdzad pa'i rjes bsnyags te// rang gis 'bad pa ma byas na// rang gi bya ba su yis byed// legs par gzigs la soms dang kye// brtson chen shākya'i rgyal po yis// rang byung brtul zhugs ma spyad na// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyis// nyid la phan nam gzhan la phan// bdag cag sems can thams cad kun// brtson chen bcom ldan bka' drin gyis// bde zhing skyid pa ngo mtshar che// nged kyang ston pa'i rjes su bslab// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// rnam par rtog pa mang ba las// sdug bsngal che ba gzhan med gsung*// rnam par rtog pas g.yen spyos pa'i// rgyal po bdag nyid che na yang*// gshed mas mtha' ma bskor snyam pa'i// smyon pa 'o dod 'bod pa sdug

/bla ma rin chen shin tu mad// rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pa// shākya'i rgyal po sras dang bcas// phyags dar khrod kyi gos 'chang zhing*// bsod snyoms zas la brten nas kyang*// nags khrod ri khrod dgon gnas su// rtsa ba 'bras bu lo ma dang*// tha chad nya rgyu gsol na yang*// rnam rtog dgra bo spangs pas skyid// mtho gcig dma' gcig rnam rtog rnams// ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal 'dra// ji ltar bsams pa de ltar dmyal// bsams pa'i thog tu 'bab pa dka'// bsam pa bzhin du byung na yang*// nyes pa thams cad kun gyi gzhi// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// bu gcig thub pa'i gsung bzhin sgrubs// 'di rnams bsod nams tshogs yin te// nyams len lam gyi gnas skabs su// mkhas pa'i thabs su bstan pa yin// mthar thug grub pa'i 'bras bu ni// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku yin// rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad du// thabs mchog 'di dang mi 'bral zhu// thog ma bar dang tha mar yang*// dge zhing skyid par 'gyur ba yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yum gyur shes rab pha rol phyin// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa'i don// rtogs pa'i ye shes nyid yin pas// de rtogs tshogs pa ye shes tshogs// 'di la nan tan chen po yis// bdag nyid chen pos bsgrub par zhu// shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di// gti mug ma rig chen po yi// gnyen po yin par shes par bya// ma rig rnam pa gnyis yin te// rgyu 'bras las la rmongs pa dang*// de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'o// de bzhin nyid la rmongs pa yi// gnyen por thub pas stong nyid bstan// stong nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa ste// sngags kyis myong ba gtso bor ston// tshu rol mthong ba'i gang zag gi// rigs pa gtso bor 'dir mi smra// rtog ge rnams kyi yul min zhes// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs// gnam gyi ya ca sna tshogs dang*// sa yi srel zhi mang po zhig

/gcig tu bsdus pa'i tshogs pa rnams// mkhyen pa'i ye shes spyod yul ba// ko la khya dang ko la ba// chags can mi mo bsten pa las// rang byung don dam lhan skyes skye// ku sā li pa 'di la ston// mkhas pa chen po paṇḍi tas// gcig dang du bral la sogs pa// gtan tshigs chen po rnam pa lngas// shes par bya ba'i yul rnams dang*// shes byed yul can shes pa rnams// sna tshogs tshul gyis gtan la 'bebs// gcig dang du bral la sogs pas// shes bya gtan la phebs pa rnams// ji ltar byas kyang rnam rtog ste// dbab pa'i yul dang 'bebs pa rnams// gtan la phab pa'i shes pa gsum// 'khor gsum yongs su ma dag cing*// 'dzin rtog gsum gyi rang bzhin pas// mkhas pa'i skyes bu thams cad kyis// 'di la blo gtad byed mi nus// rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar phyin pa// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen sogs// ku sā li yi sgom chen pa// bram ze chen po tilli pa// dam pa'i zhabs pad la gtugs pas// don dam shes rab pha rol phyin// gnyis med ye shes rang gi sems// bde ba chen po rtogs pa yis// rang don gzhan don rdzogs pa yin// ku sā li yi rnal 'byor pa// rang gi myong ba gtso bor smra// lung rigs gnyis kyang de la tshang*// rgyal bas gsungs par 'dra na yang*// mtshan nyid pha rol phyin pa la// grangs med gsum gyi dam bca' yod// tshu rol mthong ba'i rigs pa yis// sgro 'dogs phyi nas gcod pa 'di// phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams dang*// so so'i skye bo mkhas pa rnams// dga' bar byed pa'i dam chos te// thar par 'gro ba'i them skas yin// stong pa nyid la dga' ba yi// bag chags bzhag par gyur pa yis// nam zhig don dam rtogs pa yi// rgyur 'gro tsam du 'gyur ba srid// theg pa chen po gsang sngags la// tshe 'dir byang chub thob pa yi// dam bca' sngon du song bas na// rang byung lhan skyes ye shes nyid// da lta nyid du thob pa'i thabs// ku sā li yi gzhung lugs la// brten nas don dam rtogs bzhed na// mnyam med 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// tshe gcig mchog gis sangs rgya ba// tshig dang spros pas ma bslad pa// mar gyi snying po lta bu yi// gdams ngag tshig gsum 'di yin te// rang la yod pa'i rang gi sems// rang byung phyag rgya chen po 'di// rtogs par byed pa thabs kyi mchog

/gsang sngags gdams ngag zab mo dang*// rtogs ldan bla ma dam pa la// mos gus tshad du bskyal ba yi// gdams ngag rnam gsum 'di nyid kyis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par ni// nges par khyed kyi thugs la zhog /de yang kye yi rdo rje las// gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// gsungs pa nyid kyis nges pa yin// de ltar tshogs gnyis lag len 'di// rgyun chad med par nyams len pa// las su bsags pa bgrang ba 'o// de ltar nyams len byas pa yis// dkon mchog gsum po mchod par 'gyur// bla ma dam pa mnyes pa yin// ngo bo gnyis med bsgom pa yi// de yi lag len 'di lta ste// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la bsam nas// bsam gtan yan lag lngar gnas te// nyams su blang bar bya ba 'am// spyod lam gang yang rung ba yis// rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa nyid// nyin par spyi bor bsgom par bya// mtshan mo snying gi dbus su bsam// rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa yi// lung khungs bcas te yang yang gsungs// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// rang sems gshis su gnas pa la// smras dang bsam dang shes pa dang*// tshig dang blo las 'das pa zhog /gtang yang mi btang dgug kyang mi dgug ste// bsam du med pa bsgom du med pa nyid bsgom na// lta sgom rtogs pa ro gcig dbyer mi phyed// spyod lam bzhi la khyad par med// lhun grub sgom la rgyun chad med// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i phyogs ris med// med do med do med pa'ang med// thams cad mnyam nyid bde ba che// bde chen kun bzang rang gi sems// bu rang gi sems dang ma 'bral mdzod// rtag tu mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig ste// rjes thob yul na ma mchis na// de dang gnyis su ma mchis par// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngos// mnyam gzhag rjes thob 'dug gyur na// mnyam gzhag dge ba bsngo ba dang*// rjes la mnyam gzhag rgya yis thob// zung 'jug ro gcig tsam gyur na// tshogs gnyis rgyun chad med pa yin// de ltar tshogs chen gnyis po 'di// dang por bsod nams tshogs yin te// de nas ye shes tshogs su 'grub// phyis ni tshogs gnyis zung 'jug ste// mi slob zung 'jug mthar thug pa// 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang du gsungs// mi rtag khar tshud chu yi chu bur 'dra ba yi// gnas dang mnga' ris gzhi dang rgyal srid yul rnams la// yi dwags lta bur 'jungs par gyur cing mnar ba'i yid// log 'dren bdud tshogs 'di dang nam zhig 'bral bar 'gyur// sems nyid zhi ba spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba la// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa gshin rje'i lto ba na// rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal drag pos g.yen spyos pa// bdag med skye shi med pa'i gnas su nam zhig phyin// zhe sdang mnar sems bskal pa'i me chen rab 'bar bas// dkar po dge ba'i phyogs rnams bsreg par byed pa yi// phung byed gdug pa'i sems dang bral bar gyur nas kyang*// byams dang snying rje bde chen rol mtshor nam zhig phyin// mtho la phrag dog dma' la rngan chen sna tshogs kyi// bya byed dur khrod me mched pa dang 'dra ba yis// nye du dgra gnyen thams cad phung bar 'gyur ba las// re dogs med cing mnyam pa'i sprang por nam zhig 'gyur// nyon mongs stobs rnams 'phel ba'i rang mthong ri 'dra ba// rgyal ba rnams kyi yon tan nyi ma sgrib byed pa// gnyis med ye shes sems kyi rdo rjes bshig nas kyang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan rgya mtsho mthar phyin 'gyur// sngon bsags bsod nams dbang chen gser gyi gzhi 'dra dang*// sangs rgyas byin rlabs nyi ma stong gi 'od zer kyang*// mi shes sgrib pa'i sprin nag srab mos sgrib byed na// nor bzang bzhin du bla ma ji ltar bkur bar 'gyur// snga bsam phyi mno ma byas shing*// lung dang rig pas dben pa yi// snying la yod pa'i gdams ngag rnams// gsung bzhin bdag gis bris pa las// bla ma mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// brtse bar dgongs nas bzod par zhu// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// mtshon nas bdag dang 'gro kun gyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog/

// 113) ༄// tshad ma bzhi yis rjes su 'brangs nas gsung la tshad mar byas pa// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshad ma bzhi yis tshad mar gyur// tshad ma'i skyes bu khyu mchog gi// rjes 'brang gsung la tshad mar byas// a bo a nu a jo dang*// gzhan gyis ci zer mi kha yi// a po'i rjes su ma 'brangs pas// nyams myong tshad ma bag tsam byung*// tshad ma gsum gyis de la bstod// a po yig nag bltas pa dang*// gzhan pas ci zer bshad pa min// bdag gis sdig pa byas pa yis// bdag la sdug bsngal chen po byung*// bdag gis gnyen po bsten pa yis// bdag gi sdug bsngal dag pa yin// bdag la nyams su myong ba yod// de la kha cig 'di skad ces// sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin ni// gnyen pos zad par mi 'gyur zhes// smra ba 'di kun ci zer ang*// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal ni// cis kyang mi 'byung zer ba yang*// rgyu las 'bras bu mi 'byung ba// 'di la nges shes ma skyes lags// las kyi rnam par smin pa kun// zab mo chos kyi 'dag pas na// lto gos zas tsam don gnyer ba// rtag chad gnyis por na 'phos na// bsod nams bsags pa'i che ba yis// blo sna gong mar skyed byung nas// tshe gcig sangs rgyas bzhed pa 'dis// thog med dus nas bsags pa yi// sdig dang sgrib pa 'byang ba yis// sangs rgyas btub pa yin nam snyam// sdig pa byas pa'i 'bras bu yang*// thog med dus nas bsags pa yi// sdig dang sgrib pa thams cad kun// zab mo chos kyi bsdus gyur pa// shig nad na tsha sdug bsngal dang*// mi mthun phyogs rnams rgyal pa yis// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs 'gyur bas// de la 'di dang 'di bya yi// zab pa'i gdams ngag gsungs pa yod// snying gi dkyil dang mchin pa'i drungs// grod pa'i rdzems su btums pas na// da lta a po mkhas sam snyam// mkhas par 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis// mkhas pa rnams kyis mkhas so zhes// phye gtor med par bstod par 'dug

/lung khungs 'ga' zhig drang snyam ste// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// gsang sngags brjod bya thams cad kun// rin chen gsung dang mthun gyur pas// lang lung drangs bas yong ma lang*// 'on kyang cung zad smos pa la// gnas brtan chen po kun dga' bos// 'jim pa'i dan gong ril lu yis// rang rgyal mgo la bsnun pa yis// spyi bor phol mig byung ba de// sman pa'i rgyal pos ma bcos sam// gnas brtan chen po gang bo yis// bran mo'i bu zhes smras pa yi// las kyi sgrib pa rgya chen kun// gnyen po spyod pa'i stobs kyis ni// chung ngus byang bar gsungs pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod du// sangs rgyas phal chen la sogs par// byang chub sems kyis 'byang tshul dang*// 'gyod pa bsal ba la sogs su// rang sems rtogs pas 'byang tshul dang*// nam mkha'i snying po la sogs par// rigs sngags cho gas 'byang tshul dang*// ngan song sbyong rgyud la sogs par// theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// sngags dang phyag rgya lha dag gis// sdig dang sgrib pa 'dag par gsungs// gzungs chog nus pa'i nyams myong yod// khyi sngags sgal sngags byed pa mthong*// seng ge'i nyal thabs bya 'o zhes// chos kyi rgyal po chen po yis// rab tu byung ba rnams la bcas// mgon po mi 'khrugs tshe dpag med// rin chen gtsug gtor shākya'i rgyal// bcom ldan mgon po sangs rgyas rnams// mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang*// reg pa dang ni dran pas kyang*// sdig dang sgrib pa 'byang 'gyur ba// ma mo sman dges mi gsung ste// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pas gsungs// chos rje bla ma rin chen bka'// tshad ma bzhi yi bdag nyid kyi// gdams ngag nyams su blang bar rigs// //

114) ༄// bstan bcos rin chen dbang phyug nam mkha' lding nye gnas grags 'byung gi zhu chos// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyabs gcig 'gro mgon rin po che// pha mi bskyod rgyal po sman gyi lha// rje thugs la thogs shig 'gro ba'i mgon// sems ma bde rtogs pa'i dug tsher gyi// zug rngus sems la zug pa'i tshe// skyabs gzhan med bla ma'i nges shes skyes// byin gyi rlabs kyis bde bar shar// mi nga la mi bde dbang med byung*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon du// skyabs med long bas bong gzhug shor// mgon med re thag chad pa'i tshe// 'ju sa bla ma rin chen rnyed// mi bde ma mchis bde mor gda'// dus gsum sangs rgyas gcig pa'i sku// bla ma yin pa'i nges shes skyes// gang zag yin no snyam na yang*// lung rigs man ngag myong bas grub// nges shes skyes pas blo re bde// mthar thug 'bras bu chos sku de// nyon mongs rnam rtog dngos su gda'// nyes tshogs rtsa ba yin snyam na// mtha' brgyad spros pas stong bas nges// nyams su myong bas 'gyur ba med// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam de// byang chub sems su kho thag chod// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pa'i phyir// gzhan du btsal sa med par go// bsam pa'i rang gzugs blo thag chod// 'gro ba'i bla ma gcig pu ma// dam chos chos sku nyag gcig nyid// dge 'dun bsam pa mthun pas gcig /zhing dang bsam pa gcig dril bas// mi 'grub med de blo re bde// yang cig ku re kyal ka zhu// dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' drin gyis// mi nga bde ba chen po'i chang gis bzi// bzi gtam cal col smra ba la// khyed phyogs ris bka' bkyon mi mdzad zhu// chos kun spros dang bral bar go// rtag chad la sogs grub mtha' la// mi nga la bzang ngan phyogs ris med// mu stegs byed kyang nga dang mthun// bsha' mar gyer na bon yang mkhas// bsam mi khyab la longs spyod pas// yul dang yul can chos rnams la// zab mo gnad kyi man ngag rnams// 'di shes mi shes rtsis gdab chung*// mkhas pa thams cad dga' bar byed// mkhas pas bsten pa de ltar lags// dngos po rdzas la zhen pa spangs// 'khor gsum yongs dag rten 'brel mkhas// khyad du mi gsod 'bras bu blta// kho bo cis kyang phyug por mchi// ka ca gsog skrun ma byas kyang*// nga yi rjes su 'brang ba yi// nye gnas ltogs grir mi 'chi snyam// rin chen pha phogs rgyu 'bras kyi// rten cing 'brel 'byung brtsi tshad che// sdom gsum gnad kyi man ngag mkhas// a po mi btsun dbang med yin// gnad ka rgyu mtshan de dag gis// nga yi slob ma btsun pa yin// gzhan du gyur na slob ma min// stong nyid rtogs shing zhe 'dod med// snying rjes 'gro ba mi gtong bas// rnal 'byor nga la khong khro med// tshig rtsub bam rdeg na rang skyon spong*// drung na gnas pa'i nye gnas kun// mos gus yod na rjes 'brang 'gyur// rko long mdzad na ci bder gshegs// tshad ldan bla ma'i ded dpon bzang*// thabs shes rab gnyis kyi gru rdzings legs// smon lam 'dod phyogs rlung gis bdas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dbang med brgal// lam zab rdo rje theg pa yis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par nges// gdul bya'i khams rnams ji snyed pa// 'dul byed gnad kyi man ngag shes// mi mang ngam yang ni nyung yang rung*// blo gtod na ting 'dzin mi skye re// tshig smras pa nyon dang dge 'dun rnams// mgo bskor nas ngan sar gtong re shi// chos kun shes rab pha rol phyin// gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad du// ma skyes pa la skye ba med// sus kyang ma byas lhun gyis grub// dus ring po gcig gi chos kyi sku// spang bya gnyen pos rtogs pa min// mos gus gyis dang rnal 'byor pa// dpal phag mo gru pa'i rdo rje'i gsung*// zab mo yi ger bris pa la// bla ma mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// thugs rje chen pos brtser dgongs nas// byin gyis rlabs shing bzod par bzhes// mkhas pa'i skye bo ma mnyes na// tshig la rno ste don la rtul// lo gsum sgom la 'gal 'brel gzigs// nyams myong skyes na 'thad nas mchi// dad ldan mos gus che ba dang*// pha rol phyin drug dbang phyug rgyan// dpa' brtan seng ge lta bu yi// grags pa'i 'byung gnas nye gnas kyis// skyo bsangs ched du zhus pa lags// rje btsun byams pa dgyes pa'i chos// zhig po bdud rtsi bla ma'i gsung*// rin chen dbang phyug nam mkha' lding*// bstan bcos 'di yi ming lags so//

// 115) ༄// tshul khrims rin po cher sngags pa dpe re med na 'o re che zhes pa// gnas skabs kyi yon tan/ tshul khrims kyis bde 'gror 'gro zhes pa'i lung la brten nas/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i go ba med kyang*/ sdom pa bsrung ba 'di kun dpe re med de 'o re che/ bram ze'i khye'u skar ma dang*/ ded dpon snying rje chen po'i lung la brten nas/ so sor thar pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sdom pa yin gyi/ sangs rgya ba la gtan mi phan snyam pa yod kyang*/ tshul khrims bsrung ba 'di kun dpe re med de 'o re che/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi sdom pa nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa/ che 'bring ltung ba sde lnga yin par bshad kyang*/ nges shes med pas bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam gzhag mang po bsrungs kyang btub/ ma bsrungs kyang btub snyam pa la/ sdom pa bsrung ba 'di kun dpe re med de 'or re che/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'ju sa dang rten phur/ tshul khrims ma yin pa gzhan mi srid pa'i nges shes yod kyang*/ 'di bas bag drag cig mi byed pa snying re na la ngu re bro/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du spang bya yod pa spong zhing*/ gnyen po yod pa bsten dgos pa'i nges shes yod kyang*/ yul mtha' 'khob kyi rmu rgod rnams dang khyim thab byed cing nyams len mi byed pa 'di snying re na la ngu re bro/ bsam pa bzhi'i sgyur thabs kyi phan pa dang bde ba/ tshul khrims gcig pu las med pa'i nges shes yod cing bla ma dam pa'i bka' stsal gsung yang*/ 'di sdom pa bzhi gang yin gang yin snyam pa'i rtog pa skyes pa 'di snying re na la ngu re bro// // 116) ༄// gces pa'i snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes pa dge slong grags 'byung gi zhu chos// skyes chen gang zhig thugs gnyis dbyer med pas// gdul bya'i khams rnams ma lus ji snyed par// chu snod zla ba bzhin du kun tu snang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bo'i gtsug gis blangs// ltem rkyang med pa'i gus pas mnyes par byas// dge blo cung zad skyes phyir bskul ba yi// yin lugs cung zad dus 'dir bdag gis 'bri// rgya mtsho cher yangs rus sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi lus thob par shin tu rnyed par dka'// dal 'byor rnyed pa de bas shin tu dkon// sdug bsngal rtsa ba nyon mongs dug gsum 'di// gangs khrod nags khrod dgon pa thag ring du// phyin pas nam yang spongs par mi 'gyur zhes// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas 'o dod 'bod// gang du 'dug kyang rang gi nyon mongs spongs// gzhan skyon mig bzhin mi bsrung rang skyon snang*// me long bzhin zhes bla ma dam pas gsung*// snang srid 'di kun chos kyi sku yin te// yon tan phrin las dag dang lhan cig ces// thub mgon rgyal ba rnams dang rin chen gsung*// bu gcig log par ma blta rgyal ba'i sras// log lta can gyis 'phags lam mi thob ces// nyid kyis dam bcas rtag tu yang yang smra// tshig don 'gal bar ma mdzad ag tsar can// lus dang srog sogs gang la'ang ma ltas par// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang ji bzhin du// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi drung du bsdad// nyon mongs zhe sdang yid kyis g.yengs pa'i tshe// bla ma dam pa mnyes par ma gyur cing*// dug gi me tog rdo rje ser ba bzhin// ye shes mthu yis bdag gi log rtog bcom// 'gro ba'i don phyir 'o brgyal chen po yis// phongs par gyur tshe zhabs 'bring zhabs tog byas// khe dang grags pa chos brgyad bsam pa yis// cung zad zhabs tog byas pa'i mthong chos kyis// rgyu dang 'bras bu phan tshun dpag pa'i tshul// dge 'o legs so khyod kyis bzang byas zhes// gdung ba'i shugs kyis 'di skad tshig gis bstod// skyid la lkog snogs byed pa kun gyis rtsom// sdug la lkog rnogs byed pa'i snying rus can// bdag gi bla ma'i nye gnas yin zhes zer// gnyen pos spang bya bcom pa'i yon tan gyis// rgyu las 'bras bu bslu ba med pa'i phyir// brtse bas gnas pa'i yid la dga' bde skyes// bzang po'i grags pa phyogs rnams kun tu rgyas// shākya'i sras kyi dge slong 'jigs med pa// bla ma dam pa'i bu sdug yid 'ong zhing*// srog la mi blta rtag tu mnyes byed pa// dpon mchog des kyang mar khu ldud dam zer// tshul 'chos phra ba'i bya ba 'di 'dra na// nyon mongs khong du gsod pa'i brtul zhugs can// phan bde gzhan la ster bar gyur pa dang*// yang dag lta ba zab pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// de dang mthun pa'i spyad pa spyod byed na// 'bras bu ci 'dra 'byung zhes dga' ba'i shugs// yid la skyes pas bu la bdag gis smras// sngon gyi drang srong chen po brtul zhugs can// shākya'i rgyal po la sogs rgyal ba yis// nyon mongs bdud kyi tshogs las rgyal bar mdzad// bdag cag rnams kyang thub pa'i brtul zhugs bzung*// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma dang*// dpal ldan a ti sha sogs gong ma yis// gzhan skyon ma gzigs yon tan rgya mtshor spyod// bdag cag rnams kyang gong ma'i rjes su 'brang*// don 'di bdag la rag las gzhan dbang min// mgo dang rkang lag dum bur song yang bla// gong ma'i brtul zhugs zungs shig chos kyi bu// gces pa'i snying po dri ma med pa'i dpal// rin chen phreng ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan 'di// nyes tshogs spang phyir bdag gi slob mas zhus// 'gro bas bla med byang chub mchog thob shog

/shākya'i sras kyi dge slong grags pa 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 117) ༄/ phag gru'i rnam thar gsol 'debs byang chub grags la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho gting mtha' med// ro langs ji bzhin rtog pa'i dbang song ba// gnyis med ye shes mthu yis 'jig mdzad pa'i// mnyam med bla ma de la skyabs su mchi// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rtog pas rnam g.yengs shing*// chos brgyad byis pas 'ja' tshon bdas pa yis// ngoms pa ma byung lus sems khur gyis dub// dus 'dir rang sems gso phyir bla ma dran// lha min g.yul gyis rab nyen lha rnams ni// dbang po'i chos bzang dran pas sel ba ltar// sdug bsngal mang pos gzir ba'i bdag 'dzin yid// bla ma dran pas de las skyob par byed// lha na mo ratna gu ru badzra ye/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin po che// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med gcig pa'i sku// dus gsum chos rnams spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rtag pa'i sku// mgon po khyod kyis skye 'jig 'gro 'ong spangs// 'gro ba'i mgon po lhun gyis grub pa nyid// mnyam med bla mas bdag cag ci'i phyir spong*// 'bral med mgon po'i sku la skyabs su mchi// thub pa chen po'i gdul bya sems can rnams// dpag med nam mkha'i khams dang shin tu mnyam// de srid bar du mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med gcig pa'i gsung*// gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis// 'gro ba ma lus thams cad smin mdzad pas// ci yi phyir na bdag cag smin mi mdzad// thub mgon rdo rje'i gsung la skyabs su mchi'o// chos kyi rgyal po mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon// yul dang yul can gnyis med ro gcig pa// lhun gyis grub cing skye 'jig kun dang bral// chos kun nye bar zhi ba'i rang bzhin la// bya dang byed pa'i spros pa mi mnga' bas// rtsol ba med par 'gro kun smin par mdzad// dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'i rig pa 'dis// bde gshegs khyod la rtsod pa yong mi mnga'// mgon po de yi zhing ni bsam mi khyab// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam zhing dpag med du// rin chen sna tshogs rgyu las legs grub cing*// dpag bsam shing dang gos kyi shing dag dang*// zhing gi rgyan rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pas// phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan rdzogs byed cing*// byang chub mchog la 'god par gyur pa 'di// rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung phyir shin tu nges// nyid las mi gzhan dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs// kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i mdzod 'dzin pas// nyes tshogs sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg mdzad cing*// 'khor ba'i bde skyid ma lus ji yod dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba zag med kyis// sems can rgya mtsho smin mdzad gnyen gyur pa// khyod sras rnams la bde dang legs 'byung ba// byams pa'i rgyud la 'bras bu 'di 'byung rigs// nga 'o nga rgyal zad par gyur pa dang*// tshad med thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyis// bdud dang bar chad bgegs dang log 'dren rnams// btang snyoms mi mnga' dus las mi 'da' bar// rab zhi khros pa'i hūm̐ sgra rab sgrogs pas// gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul bar mdzad la sogs// zhi rgyas dbang gi smin par mdzad pa yis// dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad la dub pa med// ji ltar nam mkha'i padmo rab rgyas pa// mo gsham bu yis sprul pa mchod pa ltar// gdod nas nye bar zhi ba'i byang chub ni// gdod nas nye bar zhi ba'i sems can gyis// ma skyes spros dang bral ba'i tshogs gnyis kyis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mdzad pa 'di// dngos dang dngos med gang yin skyes chen kun// rdo rje'i gsung 'di rtogs ldan rnams kyis go// dpal ldan phag mo gru pas bskyangs pa'i bu// nyid dang dbyer med rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// bsags pa mthar phyin skyes chen rgyal ba'i sras// bla ma mchog la rab gus dam tshig can// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad pa// nye bar gnas pa'i slob ma dam pa rnams// bla med dkon mchog de dang mi 'bral bas// srid dang zhi ba 'di las dbugs kyang phyin// glang chen rab myos ri brtsegs 'dra ba la// rin chen rgyan gyis legs par rab brgyan pa// khur gyis non cing lci bar mi 'gyur te// nyam nga med par shin tu brjid par snang*// 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa lta spyod zung 'brel ba// phra ba'i rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung ba// go bar gyur la stong nyid log na med// nam mkha' rab yangs mtha' dbus bral ba la// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrib pa med pa yis// mig ldan skyes bus so so'i bya ba bsgrub// de dag bsam pa rdzogs pa nyi ma'i mthu// kun bzang yangs pa dpal ldan chos kyi rje// lus can kun dang dbyer med gcig gyur pa// byang chub sems nyid dbye ba med pa'i skus// ma lus smin par byed pa bla ma'i mthu// ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po rab zab cing*// rgya che yangs par gyur pa de nyid ni// srog chags 'byung po mang po'i gnas yin zhing*// dpag med rin chen kun gyi 'byung khungs ltar// zab cing rgya che sku gsum dbyer med pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rje rin chen yang*// phan dang bde ba kun gyi gnas yin zhing*// yon tan ma lus kun gyi 'byung khungs yin// ji ltar bskal ba'i me chen rab 'bar bas// sa dang rgya mtsho ri bo mchog rnams kyang*// rab tu mched cing 'bar bar gyur nas kyang*// thal ba'i lhag ma tsam yang ma lus byed// tshad ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs gyur cing*// mos gus mchog ldan slob ma dam pa yi// 'jig rten chos brgyad nyon mongs sgrib pa'i tshogs// bla ma dam pas thams cad 'joms par byed// grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pas// gong ma'i phyag rjes khyu mchog rnam gsum gyis// rnam dag zhing du skye ba ma yin zhes// dge bcu spyad pa'i rten 'brel go bar mdzod// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i rigs las byung*// bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrub byed pa// shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong ri khrod pas// zab cing rgya che 'gro la phan phyir zhus// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba dam pa des// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pas// 'jig rten gsum mgon mnyam med rin po che// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i sku thob shog

/'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i rnam par thar pa/ zhum pa dang yid skyo ba sel bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs gyis bla ma dam pa mnyes pa'i go cha bgos pa sgom pa byang chub grags kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// //

118) ༄// nyams len mi phyed rdo rje'i gsang tshig byang chub grags pa'i zhu chos// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// sku gsung thugs la rab gus pas// rtse gcig sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong ma lus thams cad kun// dus gsum rgyal bas gang gsungs pa// rdo rje'i tshig gis mdor bsdus nas// rgyas par bshad kyis rgyal ba'i sras// nye gnas rnams kyis nyan par gyis// tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog 'dod pas// mnyan nas nyams su blang bar bya// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bka'// kye ma kye ho ngo mtshar che// e ma kye ho ngo mtshar che// re dga' re skyid ngo mtshar che// lta ba rnam dag lha sgom zhing*// sgom pa rnam dag sngags kyang bzla// spyod pa rnam dag bya byed sgrub// 'bras bu rnam dag ro gcig pa// de gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras rnams dang*// 'jig rten ngam gyur padma dang*// brtul zhugs grub pa'i nyams len 'dis// rgyal sras khyed dang gzhan rnams dang*// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis// mchog gi dngos grub thob par shog /mi phyed rdo rje'i gsang tshig 'di// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rigs las byung*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ldom bu pa// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod du// ri dwags stag dang seng ge ltar// nyam nga med par rgyu ba yi// bu gcig byang chub grags pa yis// tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog 'dod pa'i// rnal 'byor rnams kyi don du zhus// mi phyed rdo rje'i gsang tshig rdzogs so// // 119) ༄// ston pa'i gsung la gces par 'dzin pa mi thub rdo rje dar gzhon la gnang ba// gnyis med thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' lta bu las// thugs rje chen po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rab gsal bas// mtho dman phyogs ris med pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kun// smin mdzad bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la// bdag 'dzin rnam rtog glo bur ba// ma rig mun pa'i sprin tshogs gtibs// rtog pa'i sprin gyi kha dog la// bzang ngan sna tshogs cir yang 'khrul// 'khrul pa'i bag chags sna tshogs 'di// bag la nyal ba ldang ba'i dus// rnam pa gnyis su gnas pa 'di// mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya// de la ldang lugs dang po ni// chags dang sdang ba'i yul la sogs// nang gi bag chags gang che yi// phyi rol rkyen gyis sad par byed// de la ston pa bcom ldan gyis// rkyen gyis yongs su bsgyur zhes gsungs// nyon mongs rnam rtog de nyid kyi// rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag yid// bzang ngan 'bring gsum gang byas rnams// gong ma'i rtog pa'i rang lus la// bde sdug sna tshogs rnams su 'gyur// dga' dang mi dga' chags sdang gi// sna tshogs rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// khams gsum 'khor ba sna tshogs su// mu mtha' med par 'khor ba 'di// bsam pa rnam rtog 'khor ba las// gzhan pa yod ma mi srid pas// mgon po dpal chen rdzogs sangs rgyas// bcom ldan shākya seng ge yis// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// mgon pos de skad gsungs pas na// 'khor ba rang gi rnam rtog yin// rnam rtog rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rtogs pa'i skad cig de nyid la// 'khor ba chos sku bde chen du// skad cig gcig gis 'gyur ba la// dus ring po gcig gis kha g.yos la// kho thag re ltos chod la thong*// nyon mongs rnam rtog bag la nyal// rkyen gyis ldang ba'i tshul lugs 'dis// rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i 'khor lugs su// ji ltar 'khor ba bstan pa'o// gnyis pa de las ldog pa'i don// ldang ba'i tshul lugs bstan pa ni// sangs rgyas rnams dang sems can gyi// sems nyid rang bzhin rnam dag 'di// lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// che chung bzang ngan ma mchis par// thams cad kun la mnyam par gnas// de ltar yin yang ma rtogs pa'i// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ji bzhin du// bzang ngan phyogs ris ma mchis par// de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje 'jug

/sangs rgyas thugs rjes 'jug pa'i tshul// yul dang gnyis su med pa yis// ji ltar ga bur tsan dan la// nyi ma'i 'od zer phog pa'i tshe// dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldang bas// 'phags pa mnyes shing sems can tshim// de ltar ma chags zhe sdang med// gti mug med pa'i dri mchog gis// 'phags pa thams cad mchod pa dang*// sems can thams cad dga' skyed kyis// tshim par gyur pa ngo mtshar che// nyi ma phyogs ris med pa dang*// spos mchog bsam pa med pa las// dri mchog bzang po 'byung ba 'di// rigs kyis yin pa nyid du nges// ji ltar lcong bu chol po utpal ser po tho re ba la// nyi mas gdungs par gyur pa'i tshe// de la de yi dri 'byung zhing*// dri gzhan 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba// de bzhin 'phags pa'i 'od zer gyis// bsags pa 'bring po'i khams rgyud la// bskul bar gyur pa de 'dra ba// 'di 'ang rigs kyis nges pa yin// ji ltar khyi ro rul pa la// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phog pa'i tshe// mi gtsang dri nga mnam dri bro ba pa yis// thams cad skyug log mi gtsang bas// nad dang gnod pa 'byung ba dang*// 'gro ba mang pos mi 'dod pa// de ltar 'phags pa'i thugs rje'i 'od// nyon mongs gsum gyi rigs can dang*// khyad par zhe sdang rigs can la// gong ma'i byin rlabs bzhugs pa'i tshe// shi 'bras 'byung ba'i tshul lugs 'di// mkhas pa rnams kyis thugs la zungs// dam pa rnams kyis zhe la zhogs// gcig pur sdod pa'i rnal 'byor pas// bla ma mchog la rab btud de// mgo rtsa ma log dam chos gcig /nyams su blangs par gyur pa na// bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems// gnyis med gcig tu 'dres pa'i tshe// rdo rje slob dpon bla ma ste// gal te zhe sdang gnyen por yang*// 'gyur ram mi 'gyur brtag par bya// gal te gnyen po yin srid na// blon po chen po'i grogs po bzhin// 'di yis nga la ngan pa zhig

/cis kyang byed du 'ong snyam pa'i// the tshom bsam pa skye bar 'gyur// rgya la gal te rnal 'byor pa// log rtog de yi rjes 'brangs pa// khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis// lha rten btud pa lta bu dang*// gzhan yang gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung*// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag la// nan tan chen pos bsgoms pa dang*// bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs gyur na// 'dir mang smos pas ci bya ste// gnyen pos spang bya bcom pa yi// rim pa ji ltar yod pa bzhin// 'byung ba nyid du the tshom med// skrod dang 'ching dang gnod pa dang*// smyo dang brgyal dang 'bog pa dang*// gsod dang bsreg dang thal ba dang*// rus pa'i rnam pa rjes med pa// rim par dbye ba mang po rnams// rnal 'byor pa la 'byung bar 'gyur// a ho de tshe dpa' bo rnams// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// brtse chen ma ma la sogs pa// khams gsum sems can rjes su gzung*// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la// ltos pa med par phyad rtag par kyis gtang*// chags pa med pa nyid du bya// ku sā li yi tshogs gsog 'di// gnad du zab pas gnad du bskyal// man ngag 'di yi rjes 'brang nas// a nan ta bar mtshams med pa yi sbyor ba yis// ku re kyal ka ma mchis par// ring po'i dus la mi ltos par// gces pa bcu yi man ngag ltar// nyams su blangs pa'i dus nyid du// sbrul gyi pags pa brjes pa bzhin// shan shun bye brag phyed par nges// rgya la gal te rnal 'byor pa// rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i ri khrod pa// phar ngan bur ngan mes por ngan// gdams ngag med pa'i long ba dang*// nga dang ngar 'dzin nyon mongs kyi// dbang song 'jig rten 'di pa rnams// nga bdag 'jig rten so tshis rnams// nyams par dogs pa'i bsam pa yis// de yi rjes su 'brangs pa la// rang gi lam dang bral ba dang*// gong ma'i byin rlabs rgyun chad pas// skyabs mgon dpung gnyen kun dang bral// rang gi bden pa'i nus pa shi// gdug pa'i 'dre chen nyal ba yi// mig tu shing bu sug sug byas// 'di la mkha' 'gro'i gtam rgyud yod// tshe 'di'i che thabs sgrub long med// gdug pa'i lha 'dre gtum po yis// sha khrag rus pa hab thob byed// de bas lam la nan tan bya// rang nyid nyams len bstan pa'o// gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa yi// slob ma skyong bar 'dod pa'am// rang la yon tan 'byung 'dod na// gtam col tho co'i rjes 'brangs nas// snod dang gang zag ma brtags par// slob ma mang 'dod che 'dod kyi// log rtog rmongs pa tha chad rnams// ma smin sems can tha chad la// zab pa'i gdams ngag bstan gyur na// nyon mongs dug gsum stobs 'phel nas// gong du bstan pa ji bzhin du// phung bar 'gyur bas dang po 'dir// slob ma'i rgyud rnams sbyang bar bya// 'chi ba mi rtag bsgom pa dang*// rgyu 'bras chos la nan tan bskyed// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// ji bzhin rgyud la skyes pa dang*// smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur nas// grol bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs sbyang*// 'di la 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi// rim pa lnga yi gdams ngag 'di// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyi// ji bzhin nyams myong skyes pa yis// dgongs pa mthar thug 'di yin te// de yi rjes su bslab par bya// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung*// spyir ni rim gyis ma gtogs pa// cig car srid pa ma yin dang*// nyon mongs gsum gyis rang rgyud bsregs// 'od kyis gzhan rgyud bsreg pa dang*// bsam pa sa bon grung po las// 'bras bu rnam smin 'byung ba'i phyir// bsam pa sbyang bar bya ba la// nan tan chen pos bka' stsal gsung*// bsam pa sbyangs pa'i slob ma la// zab pa'i gdams ngag bstan pa'i tshe// ga bur tsan dan dri bzhin du// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas nyid kyang mi dka' na// dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos// rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas// las dang skal par ldan pa la// bdud bzhi dgra yis tshugs par dka'// dngos po gsal bar gsungs pa dang*// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu// slob dpon slob ma brtag pa dang*// sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams// 'di las med pa nyid du go// des na rjes 'jug slob ma la// gzhan don 'dod pa 'byung srid na// rang bzhin tho co ma byed par// slob ma'i snod brtag rgyud sbyangs nas// gdams ngag dam pa bstan par bya// de ltar byas na rang nyid dang*// rang gi 'khor du gtogs pa rnams// tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel// bkra shis bde skyid phun sum tshogs// slob ma gcig las med na yang*// stong tsho gsum pas mi dga' re// mang po grangs kyis ci zhig bya// 'phags pa nye sde'i 'khor bzhin du// mdzes pa mdzes pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// nga yi bla ma rin chen la// stag lung thang pa gcig pus chog

/slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub la// bzhi zhes grags kyang mang po lags// slob ma khyi ro rul pa yi// nyon mongs dri ngan mnam po yis// rang gzhan phung bar byed pa yi// sbyang thabs gegs sel bstan pa'o// yang cig rab gnas gzungs chog dang*// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /gsang sngags phrin las zab mo yis// rang gzhan smin par 'dod pa rnams// rab gnas gcig pu nyid mtshon nas// thams cad khong du chud par bya// rab gnas byed pa'i gang zag gis// rab gnas bya ba'i bsam pa dang*// gsang sngags phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir// bsnyen pa tshad du bskyal ba ni// bla ma rin chen yang yang gsung*// theg chen gsang sngags rgyud rnams su// bsnyen pa med pa'i las sbyor gyis// tshe 'dir dngos grub mi 'grub cing*// sdug bsngal nyes pas gtses pa dang*// sha za srin pos zos nas kyang*// mnar med dmyal bar 'gro bar gsungs// des na grangs dang mtshan ma yi// bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin tshad du bskyal// gsang sngags bzlas pa bya ba'i thabs// dbang bskur mchog gi rgyud chen du// 'jam dbyangs shes rab chen po pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig la// gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// bsgyings pa chen po cher bsgyings shing*// gsang sngags myur du 'grub pa'i thabs// nan tan chen pos bka' stsal pa// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid// gcig yin gcig tu shes pa yis// gcig tu byas na myur du 'grub// ston pa rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// nan tan chen por gsungs pa 'di// shi phod gces pas nyams su longs// sangs rgyas brdzun tshig mi gsung ba// bu gcig gces pas nyams su longs// de ltar bsnyen pa thems pa yis// sgrub pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul// rab gnas gzungs chog la sogs pa// 'di 'dra'i las sbyor dgos dogs yod// gsang sngags las sbyor byed pa la// sgrub pa sngon du 'gro bas na// sgrub pa gong gi bzlas pa bzhin// gnad du bskyal ba'i dus tshod du// rang gi las sbyor byed pa dang*// rab gnas zhu ba byung ba'i tshe// gsang sngags phrin las brtsam par bya// rtags dang mtshan ma ngan gyur na// bsnyen sgrub gnad du ma song bas// sngar bshad khyi ro rul pa yi// nyes pa'i dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir// nga 'bus sgrub chung gcig cig nas// rdo rje gzhon nu'i rigs 'dzin rnams// srid pa rdo rje grub mdzod cing*// srid pa rdo rje phur ba'i lha// ye shes khro bor grub par mdzod// bzang po zhig gis de skad gsungs// med kyang rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// phyi snod nang bcud snang srid kun// rang gi lhag pa'i lha nyid dam// nye bar mkho zhing 'jebs

yid du 'ong ba pa'i lha// rnam pa sna tshogs nyid du sgrub// 'di ltar bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas// khyi ro rul pa'i dri ngan rnams// tsan dan ga bur dri mchog tu// 'gyur ba nyid du the tshom med// 'di la dgongs nas he rus kas// bla med theg pa'i rgyud rnams su// khyi ro rul pa de nyid la// sgron ma bdud rtsir gang gsungs pa// rgyud tshod rim pas phye ba yin// thabs dang stobs dang shes rab dang*// dam tshig man ngag med pa yi// tho co pho rgod nor tshol rnams// mig nas lcags phye 'thul na yang*// mkhas bdo btsun bdo bzang bdo la// zhal shangs ldog pa gan na yod// phung 'drer song ba mang po mthong*// lar bdag kyang mkhas pa ma lags te// grogs kyang blo dang mi ldan pa// mthong ba lba can sngo 'khru lags// sgrub pa gnad du skyol ba'i mis// las la sbyor ba'i man ngag rnams// so sor man ngag ji bzhin du// nyams su blangs pas gcig tu mchi// bkra shis bde legs thams cad 'ong*// bsnyen sgrub bya lugs tha dad kyang*// sgrub pa 'di ltar smon pa 'di// kha sna ldog pa 'phangs pas na// nan tan chen por smras pa yin// yang cig bla ma rje btsun pa// nga 'dra nyon mongs zhe sdang can// dpe med sgom chen bzang po zhig /gcig gam yang na mang yang rung*// yul phyogs 'khrugs pa slongs pa yi// zhe sdang can la chags pa 'am// chags dang rjes su 'brel pa yi// lus ngag yid gsum bya byed la// las zhes ston pas gsungs pa yin// sred len gnyis kyi mtshams sbyar ba// zhe sdang rang la 'phos nas 'ong*// 'di yi dus su snying rus kyis// goms pa gang che'i dam chos kyis// gnad du bsnun nas bzlog pa'am// yang na ston pa bla ma yis// gnas dang grogs dang rdzas rnams dang*// bsam ngan nyes pa'i dri ma yi// grib rnams spang bar gang gsungs pa// 'brel ba'i thabs la nan tan bskyed// yang na ston pa bla ma yis// mdo rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab cing*// man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// thabs dang shes rab sbyor bas bzlog

/yang na skyob pa 'gro ba'i mgon// skyob pa bde gshegs mi 'khrugs pa// rang dang sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs zhe sdang la sogs pa'i// nyes pa sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir// thugs bskyed byang chub sangs rgyas pa// dran pa tsam gyis zhe sdang tshogs// rnam dag byang chub sangs rgya ba// mgon po bla ma de bzhin gshegs// snying gi dbus su bsgom par bya// bsgom par mi bya goms par bya// goms par mi bya nges par bya// le lo ku re kyal ka dang*// rnam gzhag tsam por ma song na// chags dang sred len las byung ba// rkyen las skyes pa'i zhe sdang rnams// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// bcom ldan 'das kyis bcom nas mchi// yang cig rang la ku re zhu// 'brug lo dpyid zla 'bring po yi// nyi shu gsum gyi tho rangs las// rang la nye zhing brtse ba la// nges par dgra yi 'du shes skyes// gsod gcod 'dod pa'i bsam pa byung*// 'thad pa byed pa gcig kyang med// nga la 'di byung yus kyis brnangs// mtshams las 'das na smyo smyo 'dra// dus der tshogs dpon phye gtor 'goms// e ma bla ma rje btsun pa// 'gro ba'i mig rten 'dren pa khyod// 'di ltar ma mdzad 'di ltar mdzod// rtsa na 'khor ba'i nye gnas dang*// gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma dang*// ston pa'i dkon mchog dge 'dun gyis// gnod pa byed pa'i nges pa med// sgrin pos spyad cing mkhas na yang*// gnod pa byed dam mi byed la// the tshom som nyi tsam du mdzod// snyam pa'i zhal ta byas pa las// gsol ba tshig gsum 'debs pa yi// go skabs bag tsam byung ba las// snga ma nga bden yus dang bral// phyi ma khong bden nges pa skyes// 'khor la byams dang snying rjes brlan// bu la gdams ngag ston snying 'dod// mtshan mo nam langs ma khom pa'i// tsab tsab tung tung phan sems skyes// ji tsam 'grang cig zos pa dang*// bsam pa de yang mi gda' ste// tha mal chen por phyal gyis thal// lar gyi bu gcig gces se kun// nga yi 'di 'drar ma zad kyis// khyed kyang 'di 'dra yong dogs yod// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// mtho dman gang dang 'grogs na yang*// cis kyang gnod pa byed nges su// bsam par mi bya bka' stsal gsungs// nyes tshogs nyon mongs rnam rtog ni// sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas// gnyen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gdams ngag mang po gsungs pa rnams// ngan rtog gnyen po bzang rtog yin// ston pa'i dam chos rin chen yin// thabs la mkhas pa'i zhags pa yin// thugs rjes 'dren pa'i lcags kyu yin// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa yin// don gyis mi rtag bslu ba yin// mkho ba'i dus su nyams len bya// phal cher bde chen dbyings su nyal// sems nyid lhan skyes 'dus ma byas// 'dus ma byas la 'pho 'gyur med// rtag cing 'pho 'gyur med pa yi// rang rig de la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu yi// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid dang*// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// rnam par bzhag pa grangs mang yang*// de dag gzhi lam 'bras bu yi// gegs dang bar chad sel ba'i tshul// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// bla ma dam pa'i gsung dag la// lus dang srog ltar gces par byed// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun mtsho bzhin du// ston pa'i gsung la gces 'dzin pa// shākya'i dge sbyong dar gzhon gyis// kun la phan pa'i don du zhus// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i byin rlabs las byung ba/
gzhan gyi mi thub pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong dar ma gzhon nus legs par zhus pa rdzogs so// //

120) ༄// bya ba'i rim pa rin chen snying po dge sbyong dar ma rin chen gyi zhu chos// skyes chen gang zhig bskal pa bsam yas su// dka' ba rnam pa sna tshogs rab spyad pas// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la gus pas 'dud// 'dus byas mi rtag blo gtad med pa la// 'khrul pas blo gtad spang zhing ma 'khrul pa'i// phan bde spel phyir rtag pa bde ba'i chos// rin chen snying po bdag gis 'bri bar bya// e ma rang nyid rang la yid ches mi skye na// su zhig gzhan la yid ches skye bar 'gyur// rang gi rang la blo gtod mi phod na// su zhig gzhan la blo gtod phod du re// rtog pa snga phyi mthun pa mi srid na// mtho dman gang dang bdag cag mthun par byed// sdig sdug gtam gyis bsdus pa'i tshe 'dis kyang*// 'gro ba'i mi la ma phan mi stongs te// khyod kyi nye drung bla ma nga yin zhing*// srog la ma bltas rtag tu 'bad na yang*// zhe 'dod cig gam phra ma tshig gcig gis// 'bral zhing spong ba khyod kyis ma shes sam// thub pas gsungs pa'i dam chos rin chen la// g.yo sgyu med par nyams len byas gyur na// bstan pa mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan los kyang ste// dgra rnams gnyen du 'gyur zhes bla mas gsungs// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa'i lus ngag gis// cir snang rgyal bar shar ba'i yi dam la// pha rol phyin drug mdzes pa'i me tog gis// mchod pa'i brtul bzhugs chod cig rang gi bu// nor zas srog dang longs spyod yul rnams kyi// padma'i lcug mas sems nyid glang po che// bcings par gyur na shin tu ma legs pas// ji ltar byas kyang btub pa'i brtul zhugs spyod// 'das dang ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu yi// rgyal ba sras bcas bla med dkon mchog gsum// ma lus kun dang mnyam par rang nyid kyi// lus ngag yid gsum dge ba rlabs che ba// nam mkha' ltar yangs gting mtha' med pa rnams// lhun gyis grub pa 'grub pa'i dus tshod 'dir// lus dang srog la mi snyan brjod pa yis// go cha chung zhing sgyid lug mi bya ste// srog la mi blta brtul zhugs chen po yis// bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs tog bsgrub// dpag med don chen bsgrub par byed pa la// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dug gsum dang*// bya dang bya ba ma yin mi shes spang*// rang la gzhan gyis rdzas dang yo byad kyi// dngos po che 'am yang na chung yang rung*// legs par byas sam yang na ma byas pa// 'dod pa'i rjes su nam yang 'brang mi bya// gsod dang gcod dang rdeg dang mtshon gyis 'debs// tshig ngan rgya mtsho gshe dang skur la sogs// rang la nyes pa sna tshogs bsgrub na yang*// khro ba med cing des pas bya ba bsgrub// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi bya ba rnams// byang chub sems sogs rang gi dge sbyor gyis// legs par sgrubs la rtag tu dran pas gzung*// kun bzang bsngo ba 'di la 'bad par mdzod// bya dang bya ba ma yin sna tshogs las// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul bas// 'dir bde phyi mar bde zhing bder 'dod na// thams cad mkhyen pa'i rjes su 'jug par bya// 'jig rten gsum mgon bla ma'i zhal snga nas// mkhyen pa'i ye shes gsung rab yin zhes gsungs// gsung rab rnams dang de yi don ston pa// chos ldan dam pa spyi bos rtag tu bkur// rgya mtsho chen po chu gter yin pa bzhin// dam pa rnams kyang yon tan kun gyi gter// dam pa bsten pas rang nyid dam par 'gyur// grogs ngan bsten par ma byed rgyal ba'i sras// dad pa med cing chos la sdang ba dang*// nyon mongs dug rgyas gshed ma lta bu yi// go chod blo gtad snying bzhag byed na yang*// dug sbrul khros pa lta bur phung bar 'gyur// mtho dman sna tshogs las la 'jug pa'i tshe// slob dpon gsung dang brtse ba'i gsung yin yang*// legs par brtag nas dpyad cing ma byas na// rang nyid phyogs dang bcas pa phung 'gyur bas// brtag dpyad legs par byas nas bya ba bsgrub// rgyal po gtum po rnams dang 'dra ba yin// brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs kyi// sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlob mi mdzad// khams gsum sems can thams cad bsad pa bas// dran pa nyams par 'gyur pa sdig pa che// 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das pa las// bya ba thams cad dran pas bsgrub par nges// legs par brtag nas bya ba byed pa ni// nga yi sras zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung*// 'dir mang smos pas dgos pa ci yod de// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa ni// kun mkhyen nyid yin zhe 'dod med pa'i phyir// des gsungs tshig la nan tan chen po yis// legs par brtags nas 'bad pas nyams su blangs// tshad mar gyur pa sangs rgyas nyid yin te// de yi gsung la gces spras chen po bya// bya dang bya ba ma yin shes pa ni// dgag dang sgrub pa'i bslab par sangs rgyas gsungs// ji ltar yin pa khyod kyis bsgrub par mdzod// dad pas bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmo la// yun ring bsten cing gtugs par gyur pa yis// tshogs gnyis rgya chen bsags par gyur pa yi// shākya'i dge sbyong dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis// mnyes par byas nas chos 'di zhus pa yin// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin des// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kun// mnyam med bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par shog

/bya ba nyams su blang ba'i rim pa rin chen snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmo spyi bos blangs shing yun ring du mnyes par byas pa/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 121) ༄// zab pa dang rgya che'i gdams pa dbyer med byang chub sems zhes bya ba// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can la// byams pa snying rje byang chub sems// snying nas rgyud la bskyed pa dang*// bskyed pa skyes par gyur pa yis// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// byang chub sems dang dbyer med par// sems can khams rnams ma lus pa// bde zhing sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob byed pa// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos// rgya che ba zhes grags pa yin// de nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// rang sems rdo rje 'dus ma byas// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// blo yis dpag par ma nus pas// shin tu zab ces bya ba yin// zab dang rgya che'i gdams ngag 'di// khyed kyis nyams su blang bar zhu// ji ltar bya ba'i 'dun ma rnams// zab dang rgya che'i chos la 'dri// chos dang mthun pa'i 'dun ma de// ji ltar byas kyang bde mor mchi// khyed kyi rin chen gser phye de// bdag la shin tu thugs la btags// rdzogs so// // 122) ༄// thag chod gsum gyi gdams ngag dge bshes shes rab grags la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ sems nyid 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// mtha' brgyad nyes pa'i skyon bral ba// 'khor 'das kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// bla ma rin chen dpal la 'dud// rang gzhan thams cad kyi don nor bu rin po che/ dbang gi rgyal po lta bur 'byung bar 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag rnams kyis/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi 'bab sa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed thams cad kyi grol sa/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems mthar phyin par byed pa'i bdag po/

sems nyid rang byung chen po cir mi mdzad/ lhun gyis grub pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal po chen po 'di'i bka' las spu'i rtse mo tsam zhig 'das kyang*/ thog mar bar dang tha mar mi dge ba 'khor ba'i chad pas 'phog par snang ste/ khyed kyis 'gro ba thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa yang 'di yod na yod/ med na med/ g.yag shi breng chad kyi bsam pa drag po gcig pu gcig la shes pa 'chums pas bsgrub par mi bya ste/ de byas na rgyal po la 'khus pa'i bya ba rlabs po che 'bangs phra mos mi 'grub dang 'dra bar 'grub mi srid pa dang*/ yid chad pa dang*/ sgyid lug pa dang*/ sems zhum pa dang*/ brtson 'grus gtong ba dang*/ phyir ldog par 'gyur bas thams cad kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i ngang du gnyis su med par rnam par grol bar rgyun chad med par goms par bya ba dang po'i blo bcad/ thag chod dang po'o// 'gro ba la phan pa dang bde bar byed pa de yang*/ chos rin po che kho nas yin gyi/ chos ma yin pa ma yin pas/ sbyor ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa lan gcig blangs pa dang*/ dge bsnyen sna gcig tsam dang*/ yi ge drug pa tshar gcig tsam dang*/ bcu chos gsum chos kyi man ngag gi gnad se gol gtogs pa tsam re res nyams su blangs shing*/ de la dga' ba dang*/ spro ba dang*/ rjes su 'jug par byed pa/ gcig pu gcig gi bsod nams kyang*/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i sems can thams cad dus gcig tu 'chi ba'i srog las thar ba byas pa bas/ bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char yang mi phod par/ khong du chud par bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'phags pa rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/ thang gcig bsam gtan thun bzhugs na// khams gsum gang ba'i sems can la// srog byin bas ni 'di don che// zhes gsungs pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don chos rin po ches grol ba dang smin pa bya'o// de yang mthil du bya ba ni/

sgrub pa snying por byed pa rnams kyi chos dus las mi 'da' ba dang*/ phyi shol med pa dang*/ rjes su chags pa dang*/ khong khro bas zil gyis ma non par snying dang 'dra bar bskyang bar bya zhing*/ gzhan zhor la shugs 'byung du shes par bya ba ni/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ gzhan phan zhen med snying rje 'di// thabs kyi mchog tu btsir gyis zungs// zhes gsungs pa ni nges pa'o// thag chod gnyis pa'o// gsum pa'i thag chod ni/ yul ris dang rgyal khams gar 'dug kyang yul de na kha smras dang*/ 'thab mo dang 'khrugs pa chen po med pa'i yul mi srid pas/ tshan gcig yun ring po nas sdug pa phongs pa dang*/ zhen par gyur pas sdum par 'dod/ tshan gcig rgyal la byung su song bas da gzod pham par dgos pas sdum par 'dod/ kha cig rang pham por gyur nas slob dpon rin po che la bar g.yon dang sdum zhus nas/ sdum 'og der phung cig ci tsug tu 'grub snyam pa'i bsam pas sdum zhu/ kha cig shi bar gyur kyang nga sdum mi byed/ pham gyong nga la che bas 'di'i blo phugs cig brtag la/ sdum byed pa 'dra na sa kha 'dir mi gnas par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pas sdum zhu ba 'ong*/ de'i dus su pho tshod med pa'i rten gyi gang zag kha cig gis/ da yod glags cig che bar 'dug sdum 'di bya dgos snyam nas/ lus ngag yid gsum/ zas snying nor gsum/ khrel sdig gtam gsum/ g.yo sgyu zol gsum/ thabs blo shes gsum gyis/ 'bad pa sna tshogs byas kyang*/ sngon rgyu phyin ci log tu bsags pa'i las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus kyang bya ba'i thabs spu sa le'i 'dab ma tsam yang mi rnyed pa la/ nged kyis prad prad mang po byas pas phan pa ma yin te/ rang nyid gcig pu gnyis su med par dben pa'i gnas su sku mtshams dam por bcad nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems// chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag dang*// rigs sngags gsang sngags snying po dang*// phyag rgya bden pa'i byin rlabs 'dis// snang ba dbang du bsgyur ba 'di// snang ba rang sems rten 'brel gyis// bslu ba med pa ngo mtshar che// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po rnams// so so rang la myong ba yod// chos kyi rgyal po sa yi bdag

/mi dbang ngam shod bzhugs pa rnams// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// gnas dus las kyis ma bskal ba// gdan sa rin po che yi bdag /bu slob rnams kyi yab dang yum// 'khrugs pa shes pa ma bzod pas// lus srog grwa pa zas nor dang*// bde skyid gang la'ang ma bltas nas// yun ring 'bad pa spyad pa bas// sgam po yang dgon zangs zlum du// sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i tshe// grong pas bsdus pa'i phye phud kyi// lha bshos gcig po cig phul nas// char phobs tshig gcig smras pa yis// mu ge sa tshig byung ba la// mkha' las char gyi rgyun bab pas// bkra shis lo legs chen po byung*// gzhan yang bde legs bsam mi khyab// 'di la ngo mtshar chen po skyes// 'gag dang nya ga mi spong ba'i// khyed kyi brtul zhugs spyad par bya'o// sngon gyi drang srong chen po rnams// thabs dang shes rab rjes 'brangs nas// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i thabs// nged rang dbus na yod pa yi// rgyus pa'i sne mo phag ze ltar// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen gyis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i thabs// 'di la bsal bzhag gang yang med// mang drug gnyis po ma bsdums na// de yi 'dug sa nad ka ti// med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// ra lnga med pa'i 'brog rkyang dang*// pho tshod nyams rtogs med pa yi// 'gro ba skyong ba ga la srid// drung na gnas pa'i nye gnas rnams// skyes chen gces shing brtse ba'i phyir// bskul nas bris pa'i yi ge 'di// dgyes su re nas bris pa lags// 'di las byung ba'i dge ba 'dis// ji snyed ma lus sems can kun// thabs dang shes rab zab mo yis// bla med byang chub mchog thog shog /thag chod gsum gyi gdams ngag /rdo rje phur pa ki li ki li ya zhes bya ba rdzogs so// dge bshes shes rab grags la gnang ba// // 123) ༄// bka' dang nyams myong gcig tu gyur pa 'dan ma shes rab 'od la springs pa//

dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dngos gyur cing*// 'phags pa rnams dang lhar bcas 'jig rten gyis// zhabs kyi ze'u 'brur gtsug gis gtugs gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa rgyal gyur cig /phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang 'byor rgyal po yis// 'khor dang 'bangs la ji ltar bkas phab pa// nus mthu chung yang gsung bzhin bsgrub par byed// de bzhin 'dir yang khyed kyi gsung bzhin bgyi// thos dang bsam pas dben pa blo chung ba// rmongs pa bdag la 'jig rten mgon po yis// legs par gdams shing khrid du mdzad pa'i chos// byang chub sems dang yi dam bla ma dang*// phyag rgya chen po rjes la bsngo bar bcas// rdo rje'i gsung 'dis gdams par gyur pa las// gzhan pa'i dam chos bdag la ma mchis te// skyes chen khyed nyid dbang du gyur pa lags// ji ltar gsung ba 'di bzhin nyams su blang*// bla ma mchog la sangs rgyas 'du shes skyes// mtho dman gzhan gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par// rtse gcig sems kyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar byas// dam pa'i gsung la nyams myong bag tsam skyes// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid chos rnams la// mkhas pa thams cad thogs pa med par smra// nyams su myong dang rtogs pa'i 'gro ldog la// rnal 'byor pa yis 'di las 'di byung shes// ku sā li yi gsang tshig gsan par zhu// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// rang sems gcig pu yin zhes bla mas gsungs// dper na zhe sdang drag po skyes pa'i yid// 'khrugs pas lus ngag ji ltar 'gyur ba ltar// snying rje'i yid kyis lus sems 'gyur ba'i tshe// nang gi rten 'brel sems dang sems 'byung dang*// phyi rol rten 'brel rang las gzhan pa dang*// gsang ba'i rten 'brel rang gi lus po 'di// snying rje chen po gcig tu gyur nas mchi// de yi dus su snying rje de nyid las// gzhan pa med pa'i rten 'brel de nyid kyis// zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs ci rigs dang*// zhe sdang las skyes bsam ngan blo gros can// gnas dang dus kyi bskal nas ldog par 'gyur// 'di las bskyed pa'i nad dang sdug bsngal dang*// gzhan yang nyes pa mang po ldog 'gyur ba// lo stong lon pa'i mun pa mthug po yang*// sgron me skyes ma thag pas sel ba ltar// gnas dang dus kyis bskal nas lhan cig tu// mi gnas nges par bdag gi myong bas grub// snying rje de nas skyes pa'i tshangs dbang dang*// brgya byin 'jig rten mgon po bzhi la sogs// snying rje las skyes skyes bu gang yin rnams// lus dang grib ma lta bur gnas gyur nas// zhe sdang las skyes 'joms par gyur pa 'di// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ma lags sam// bral dang rnam par smin dang rgyu mthun dag

/dbang gi 'bras bur rnam par grags pa yi// 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi por gang gsungs pa// mthong chos 'bras bu can du smin par nges// a ma ma ma ma gcig lha rje ma// nam mkha' dang mnyam sems can ma lus kun// bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// byang chub mchog la bdag gis 'god pa yi// lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo dang bral ba 'di// gang gi rgyud la skyes par gyur pa yang*// snying rje zhe sdang dpe dang mtshungs par nges// yi dam lha dang bla ma dam pa yang*// rnam par dag pa'i 'gres dang 'dra 'am snyam// 'das pa ma yin ma 'ongs pa 'ang min// mthon po ma yin dma' bo dag kyang min// bzang po ma yin ngan pa ma yin pa'i// da lta'i shes pa rig rig tur tur 'di// ma brtag ma dpyad bsam mno spangs pa yi// thabs la mkhas pa bsten par byas pa yis// mtha' gnyis mtha' brgyad spros pas dben gyur pa// ma rig nas bzung rga shi'i bar du ni// rang rig shes pa ci'i phyir spros bral min// ston pa'i bka' dang bla ma dam pa'i gsungs// rnal 'byor pa yi nyams myong gcig gyur na// snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa// thams cad chos sku bde chen ci'i phyir min// nyams myong rtogs pa gcig tu gyur pa yi// nges pa'i shes pa snying la zug gyur pas// 'khor ba ma mthong mya ngan 'das ma mthong*// thams cad ma mthong nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// ma mthong snyam pa'i blo yang ma mthong ba// ma lus kun mthong e ma phyag rgya che// 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs pa'i chos 'di go// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba mthar thug gi// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsungs pa kun// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bas blo re bde// 'di yang gong du ji ltar zhus pa bzhin// gnas dang dus kyis ji ltar bskal ba dang*// phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel 'grigs pa'i tshul// 'bras bu bzhi dang bcas par gyur pa yi// tshul lugs 'di dag skyes chen khyed kyis dgongs// gzhan du rtsa rlung thig le mngon shes dang*// rdzu 'phrul rtags dang mtshan ma mtho dman kun// bdag la med pas nga la 'bri rgyu med// bde chen rgyal ba'i gsung dang bla ma'i bka'// rang gi nyams myong gcig tu gyur pa yi// dam pa'i chos 'di 'bri bar mi 'os kyang*// skyes chen khyed kyi gsung bzhin bris pa lags// ston pa'i gsung la blo gros rab yangs pa// shes rab spyan gyis gzigs pa rgya che zhing*// nyi bzhin snang bar gyur dang 'brug sgra bzhin// phyogs su grags pas khyab pa'i bshes gnyen la// snyan du gsol bas thugs mnyes mdzad par zhu// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag
/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /'dan ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab 'od la springs pa'o// //

124) ༄// sku'i rim gro bya lugs lo gsum du mtshams dam por chod ces pa/ oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ skye ba dang*/ rga ba dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i sku rdo rje 'chang chen po rdo rje'i rgyal po chen po la/ bdag dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// nges par skyabs su mchi'o// bdag cag sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por lhung ba thams cad/ 'chi ba med pa'i gnas su phyin par mdzad du gsol/ bdag sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i ched du/ tshogs pa bskyangs shing 'gro ba la ci phan bsgrub pa yin pa la/ sngon las ngan pa byas pa'i rnam par smin pa dang*/ da ltar gyi bsam pa ngan pa'i dbang du song bas/ spyod pa mtho dman du gyur pa'i stobs kyis de sngon yang bar du gcod pa chen po byung zhing*/ da yang bar du gcod pa 'ong bar 'dug pas/ sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong na// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes pas nyes pa bshags shing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten du/ bdag gi lus longs spyod/ 'khor g.yog 'bangs/ dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad/ 'phags pa dang sems cad thams cad la 'bul gyis/ thugs brtse bar dgongs la bzhes su gsol lo// lar a pho rang gi lugs kyi/ a ru ra'i gcig thang gis ma phan na/ ba ru ra'i skyob kyis mi phan/ dge 'dun spyi'i dge sbyor gyi tshugs dang grabs med na mtho dman tsab tsub mang po byas kyang*/ ltar snang*/ bslu brid/ rang gis rang mgo bskor ba yin pas/ dge 'dun thams cad kyis rang snying dpang por tshugs/

lus srog thed la yal bar thong*/ lto gos gyong la bskur/ nyin mtshan med par dge sbyor la 'bad par zhu/ lar mos gus can bla ma dam pas zin na ci byed tshogs gnyis ma gtogs pa rnyed mi srid/ bsod zad nyon mongs pa'i tsag ram can gar bsdad kyang sdig sdug gi khur khyog tshad rnyed nas 'ongs dogs yod pas/ nyin mtshan med par rang rgyud la blta zhing sbyang bar bya ba gal che/ spyir nga dang khyed rang rnams thams cad kyi rim gro dang bya phyogs/ 'phral dang phugs thams cad du bzang ba/ bu mir skyes na pha la spyang khu bskon pa dang 'dra bar/ nga'i rim gro gsha' mar byed na lo gsar tshun chad tshogs sogs kyi grabs shoms byas nas/ lo gsar phan chad du mtshams bcad sum stong yan chad cig lo gsum du mtshams dam por chod la sku'i rim gro dge sbyor la nan tan du mdzad par zhu/ de rnams kyis brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma rdo rje 'chang chen po rnams kyi thugs dgongs la gnad du bsnun nas/ nga ma shi ba dang*/ bla ma gong rnams kyi mi rabs ma chad pa dang*/ glang sna ma hol ba cig dang*/ rang gi don chen po grub pa gcig dang*/ go chu rug tu ci 'ong gcig mdzad par zhu/ lar thams cad kyis nga'i bar chad 'di rnams ma sol gyi bar du/ kha smras dang kha mchu mi tshol zhu/ mi ltogs phag phag tu ltogs sgur byed du chug ngan rgyags mo ngom dang phyar phyungs byed pa/ nor rdzas dang*/ rang skyong ma nus pa rnams kyi nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gi glud du nga'i srog dang dge 'dun gtong ma nus pa yin pas/ 'dir skung du 'jug par zhu/ chos nyid rang bzhin dag pa na// dbyer med ngo bo nyid mnyam yang*// bdag 'dzin 'khrul pas brtags pa yis// 'chi dang bar du gcod pa yi// 'jigs pa chen po byung ba las// bskyab par bya phyir bsod nams dang*// ye shes tshogs ni gang bsags pas// bdag dang sems can thams cad kun// skye dang rga dang na ba dang*// 'chi dang bar du gcod pa yi// mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sdug bsngal las// thams cad thar bar gyur nas kyang*// skye shi med pa'i gnas thob shog
