/mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par shog /nyams su len par thams cad kyi// phyi nang bar chad med par shog /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// phyi nang bar chad bral nas kyang*// chos dang mthun par gnas pa dang*// sgrub pa tshul bzhin byed pa rnams// bar chad med par 'grub par shog/ // 125)༄// rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gi bkod pa'i thugs bskyed kyi smon lam// chos kun gdod nas spros dang bral zhing 'gyur ba med// gang gis thugs su chud nas 'gro ba smin pa'i phyir// thugs rje chen pos rang gzhan skyon dag yon tan rdzogs// mi bskyod rgyal por rnam grags bla ma mchog la 'dud// mnyam med bla mas dang por thugs bskyed pa// shākya seng ge'i gsung gi rjes 'brangs nas// mi 'khrugs zhing bkod ji ltar bstan pa yi// smon lam rgya chen ji ltar btab pa las// rjes su 'brangs bas nyams su blang phyir 'bri// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan chen la// byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pas// btsun pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// bdag ni byang chub sems dpa' yi// bslab pa ji ltar bcas pa la// slob par 'tshal zhes zhus pa las// dge slong byang chub sems dpa' yi// bslab pa ji ltar bcas pa la// deng sang bslab par shin tu dka'// ci'i phyir zhe na sems dpa' yis// sems can kun la mi 'khrugs cing*// gnod sems bskyed pa min phyir ro// ston pas gsungs pa'i rjes thogs la// byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pas// btsun pa bcom ldan bdag gis deng*// slan chad 'di ltar g.yo sgyu dang*// bden dang gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i// tshig gis bla med byang chub tu// sems ni bskyed cing 'dud pa dang*// yongs su bsngo bar bgyi lags so// sems bskyed rin chen 'di skyed de// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob bar// gal te sems can 'ga' tsam la// khro dang gnod sems 'khrugs pa dang*// ldan pa'i sems ni skyes gyur na// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bslus gyur cig

/de dang mtshungs par thams cad la// ji lta ba bzhin sbyar bar bya// gom pa 'dor ba re re la// thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems bral na// nyan thos rang rgyal sems bskyed de// 'dod pa'i 'dod chags sems skyes nas// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// rnam par 'tshe ba gnyid dang rmugs// rgod dang 'gyod par blta ba dang*// the tshom dag dang ldan pa yi// sems ni bskyed par gyur pa na// srog gcod ma byin len pa dang*// mi tshangs spyod dang rdzun du smra// phra ma ngag rtsub kyal ba smra// brnab sems gnod sems log lta dang*// ldan pa'i sems bskyed gyur pa na// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus par gyur// ji skad smras bzhin ma bgyis na// gom pa 'dor ba re tsam la// sangs rgyas yid la byed pa yi// kun mkhyen sems ni ma bskyed na// gal te tshe rabs thams cad du// rab tu byung bar ma gyur na// mngon par rab tu byung nas kyang*// dgon pa pa dang bsod snyoms dang*// phyag dar khrod pa stan gcig pa// zas phyis mi len ji snyed len// dur khrod pa dang bla gab med// tsog pu pa dang gzhi ji bzhin// chos gos gsum pa phying ba pa// 'dod pa chung dang chog shes pa// chos 'dod pa dang chos la dga'// chos la gus dang chos la rton// chos ston par ni ma gyur na// bslab dang sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// yo byad bsnyungs pa'i yi dam dag /blangs te gnas par ma gyur na// gal te tshe rabs tshe rabs su// rab tu byung bar gyur nas kyang*// dam chos ston par ma gyur ram// spobs pa chags pa med pa dang*// spobs pa tshad med ma gyur na// 'greng dang mchis dang 'chag pa yi// spyod lam gsum po ma gtogs pa// gal te nyal bar gyur pa na// gal te sems can 'ga' tsam la// rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba dang*// grong pa'i chos dang ldan pa yi// bud med dag dang ldan pa 'am// de las gzhan smra brjod pa dang*// gzhan la gnod cing spa bkong dang*// ldan pa'i sems can bskyed gyur na// gal te bud med dag la 'dir// mi rtag sdug bsngal ston pa dang*// bdag med pa 'am gzhan dag gi// chos ni ston par gyur pa na// yan lag la sogs kha dog la// bzang po'i mtshan mar bzung nas kyang*// so yi phreng ba ston gyur tam// rgod dam lag pa g.yob bgyid na// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus gyur cig

/chos ni ston par gyur pa na// lag pa bsgyur zhing chos ston na// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes 'brang ba// skra dang kha spu bregs pa la// snod du gyur pa'i gang zag gam// snod du ma gyur mi 'ong ste// ston pa'i chos gos ngur smrig dang*// gon pa mthong na de dag la// ston pa'i 'du shes ma bskyed dam// mchod rten 'du shes ma bskyed na// byang chub sems dpa' gzhan mthong na// ston pa'i 'du shes ma bskyed na// chos 'chad pa na chos ston la// 'dug ste nyan par ma gyur na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs par// 'di las gzhan pa'i dge sbyong dang*// bram ze lha gzhan phyag bgyis na// 'di la sbyin pa sbyin par bya// 'di la sbyin par mi bya zhes// sems can rnams la tha dad du// bya ba'i 'du shes bskyed gyur na// 'di la yon dbul 'di la mi dbul zhes// de 'dra'i 'du shes skyes gyur na// bdag gis thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems// bskyed pa rin chen 'di bskyed de// bla na med pa'i byang chub tu// bsngos shing yongs su bsngos pa la// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu// sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yang*// gal te 'di la dam chos kyi// sbyin pa sbyin par bgyi ba ni// 'di la sbyin par mi bya zhes// de lta bu yi sems bskyed na// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bslus gyur cig /gal te dgum pa'i sems can dag /la la khrid de mchis mthong na// yongs su thar bar bya ba'i phyir// bdag lus yongs su ma btang na// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus gyur cig /sangs rgyas dpang dang tshad mar 'jog /de yang ring por mi thogs par// lhar bcas 'jig rten tshad mar 'gyur// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to// gal te dge slong dge slong ma// dge bsnyen dge bsnyen ma rnams la// ltung ba'i nyes pa byung mthong na// khyed la ltung ba 'di byung zhes// ltung ba glengs par gyur pa na// bdag nyid rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu// sangs rgyas thob pa'i zhing de na// thams cad rnam pa thams cad du// nyan thos rnams kyi ltung ba'i sgra// mi grags mi 'byung de ltar bsgrub// zhing de yongs su dag pa dang*// yon tan yongs su rdzogs par bsgrub// gal te rmi lam tsam du yang*// khu ba phyung bar gyur pa na// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus gyur cig

/de ltar brtul zhugs spyad pa yis// sangs rgyas zhing der rgyal ba'i sras// nyes pa kun dang bral ba dang*// yon tan thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur// // 126) ༄// rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs bskyed smon lam seng ge'i nga ro// skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje// dang po byang chub thugs bskyed pa// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nam mkha' yis// seng ge'i nga ro tshig 'di brjod// 'khor ba'i mtha' ma med pa yi// sngon gyi mtha' ma ji srid pa// de srid sems can phan don du// spyod pa dpag yas spyad par bya// 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan snga 'dir// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de// 'gro ba thams cad sgrol gnyer te// dbul zhing 'phongs las bsgrol bar bya// de ring phan chad gal te yang*// bdag gis 'dod chags sems bskyed na// phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus par gyur// byang chub nam zhig thob bar du// tha ba'i khong khro'i sems dang gnod sems dang*// phrag dog dang ni ser sna yang*// de ring phan chad mi bya 'o// tshangs pa'i spyod pa bdag gis spyad// sdig pa'i 'dod pa yongs su btang*// tshul khrims sdom dang des pa la// sangs rgyas rjes su bslab par bya// bdag ni byang chub rings tshul du// 'tshang rgyar mos shing spro ba med// phyi mthar thug gi bar du yang*// sems can gcig phyir spyad par bya// tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// sangs rgyas zhing ni sbyang bar bya// phyogs rnams bcu po thams cad du// bdag gi ming ni thos par bya// bdag gis bdag la lung bstan te// sangs rgyas 'gyur bar dogs pa med// bdag gis lhag bsam rnam par dag /bdag dpang 'di na 'dren pa rnams// lus dang ngag gi las rnams kyang*// rnam pa kun tu bdag gis sbyang*// yid kyi las kyang sbyang bar bya// mi dge'i las ni spyad mi bya// ma 'ongs dus na sangs rgya ste// 'jig rten mgon du 'gyur zhe na// bden pa des ni sa 'di yang*// rnam pa drug tu g.yos gyur cig/

// 127) ༄// phar phyin drug gi gdams ngag rnam gsum gyi nyams len// gdams ngag rnam pa gsum ni/ lus mnyam par bzhag pa med na/ dmigs pa dang bcos thams cad don med du 'gyur bas/ lus rnam par bzhag pa sgrub pa'i man ngag rigs tha dad pa shes pas/ yon tan myur du bskyed bar byed pa'i man ngag thams cad kyi rtsa ba yi ge gsum/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i man ngag gi gnad/ sems can thams cad rang gi srog tu song bas/ rang la ltos pa med pas gsog 'jog la 'bad pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i dus dang tshod shes pa dang*/ sbyin pas don ji tsam 'grub blta ba'o// ston pas gsungs pa'i tshul khrims la nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum spong ba'i gnad du go ba dang*/ lta sgom gyi grogs su 'gyur ba dang*/ sgrib pa rnam pa gsum gyi byang tshul dang gsum mo// bzod par bya ba'i thabs gsum ni/ rgyu mtshan shes pas bzod par bya ba dang*/ yon tan shes pas bzod par bya ba dang*/ rang bzhin shes nas bzod pa bya ba gsum mo// brtson 'grus gsum ni/ rtsol ba'i brtson 'grus dang*/ ma yengs pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ mi bsgom pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum mo// 'khor ba sna tshogs kyi dmigs pa dang*/ rgyud byin gyis rlob pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ lhag pa'i lha'i dmigs pa'o// kun rdzob shes pa'i shes pa dang*/ don dam shes pa'i shes pa dang*/ zung 'jug shes pas rang gzhan thams cad smin par byed pa ni shes rab bo// nyes pa thams cad rnam spangs shing*// yon tan kun gyi pha rol phyin// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa yis// smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa'i skyon// nyi shu gsungs pa 'di re mad// lhan cig tshogs pa 'di rnams la// rtogs dang nyams su myong ba la/ /cung zad drag pa nga yin yang*// gces spras nyams len ma byung na// bdag pas drag pa su zhig la// bshad pas nyams su len par byed// bsgoms pas gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob// ku re min nam bden srid na// glen pa nyams len snying por gyis//

// 128) ༄// sems las gzhan pa'i rten 'brel ma rnyed zhes pa// nam mkha' 'dra zhing rdul bral gzugs bzang 'chang*// shes rab sras po lus dang mtshan mi mnga'// yon tan rgya mtsho rab zab thugs rje can// mtshungs med phyag ni bdag gi spyi bor zhog /rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ rten 'brel dang sems mi gcig yul dang dbang po la brten nas skyes pa'i rnam par shes pa sems yin gsungs pa la/ mgon po byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ rnam gsum rnam gsum snang ba can// gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid do// zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan dbang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba thams cad der 'dus par gsungs pa dang*/ yang mdo las/ gnas don lus kyi rnam par ni// mi yi rnam par shes pa snang*// zhes gsung pas/ dbang po lnga yul lnga/ snod kyi 'jig rten du snang ba thams cad sems su gsal bas/ sems las gzhan pa'i rten 'brel ma rnyed/ de dag gi don legs par gsung du gsol/ 'di khyed gsung ba shin tu mad de/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas sems kyi rdo rje bstod pa las kyang*/ sems ni 'gro ba lnga po yin// bde dang sdug bsngal mtshan nyid dag /sems las ma gtogs cung zad med// ces gsungs pas/ sa bcu'i mdo las kyang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis po 'di dag ni sems gcig pu ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad sems so zhes gsungs pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab/ dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams myong ni 'di las med par nges te/ nga'i log rtog la/ rnam par shes pa 'grub pa'i rgyu tshogs pa ni rten 'brel rnam par shes pa nam grub pa'i dus su/ rnam par shes pa'am sems zhes ming 'dogs snyam ste/ 'di log rtog 'ba' zhig tu zad pas/ ngas kyang gsang*/ khyed kyis kyang gsang bar zhu'o// //

129) ༄// sems 'dul gcig pu yin par bstan pa rang sems rdo rje zhes pa// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// zhi ba chags bral rang gi sems// rang sems rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba rnams kyi gdung brgyud 'dzin// g.yo med lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi// dri ngad phyogs bcur ldang ba yis// dam pa rnams kyi yid tshim byed// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// zhe sdang gdug pa'i me dpung gsod// thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab kyis/ /rang gzhan dgra gnyen stong par rtogs/ /bla ma rje btsun dam pa yis// blo phugs 'dun gros zhus pa'i don// rang gzhan skyid sdug thams cad kun// rang gis byas pa'i lag rjes yin// su la dga' la su la sdang*// las ngan sbyangs shing tshogs gnyis bsags// dkar dmar sna tshogs snang ba 'di// sems kyis bris pa'i 'ja' tshon yin/ */byis pas 'ja' tshon mi bda' bar// 'gyur med sems nyid rdo rje bsgom// stong nyid rgyu 'bras lta kham de// ne tso'i rdo rje gcod pa ltar// 'gag dang nya ga mi spang bar// dgos pa'i dus su nan tan mdzod// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// rang sems 'dul ba gcig pu yin// 'khor 'das nye du gnyen 'brel rnams// dmag mus mi dmigs chags sdang ga la bskyed// bde 'cham yul ka'i dgon par yang*// zhag gsum sdod pa'i rang dbang med// 'dug tshis bsam pa skyes pa yis// khams gsum ru la mi g.yeng 'tshal// tshe gcig bskyangs pa'i slob ma dang*// rtag tu bsgrubs pa'i dam chos dang*// gsol ba 'debs pa'i dkon mchog dang*// bral na snying tshim des ci bya// nyes tshogs bde sdug gang byung la// snyi rje chen po'i skam pas gzung*// stong nyid rdo rje tho bas brdung*// bde chen rta 'chag steng kar bskyal// nyon mongs shi ba'i ro 'di mdzes// nyin mtshan med par thugs dam mdzod// nga yi bu chung sman pa rnams// shi chad med par gso bar zhu// sman pa sos pa'i dus tshod du// dgra bo'i bla mchod byas pas chog/

// 130) ༄// nyes skyon spong bar gdams pa nam gzhug chad pa ma tshor ram zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma thugs rje chung na/ snod ldan gyi slob mar gdams ngag mi ster/ slob dpon shes rab chung na/ yon tan rgyud la bskyed pa'i nus pa mi 'byung*/ phra ma mchu snyung la dgyes na/ 'khor mthun mi srid/ zhen yul rnam pa gnyis la chags na/ rang dbang med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi khur rang thog tu 'ong*/ zhwa nag po mgo la gon na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod par 'gyur nges/ chos skyong gi gdan bsngo ma thos na/ yul phyogs su 'khrugs pa 'byung*/ bla bo long gtam 'phros gtam la dga' drags na/ dgos pa'i chos dang don rus mi thon/ srod dang tho rangs la mi nyal ba'i sbyor bas gnyid ma bcag na/ lus ma sbyangs pas ngal dub kyi mthar ltung*/ yon tan che rab yod kyang gces ka'i nyag nyog mang na/ mig yod rgyus shes dang 'khrugs pa 'chor/ ston pa'i gsung dang 'gal na/ tshe 'di phyir sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho thob/ nyams su len pa gding ba'i bcas pa dang 'gal na/ grib kyi nyes pa gsum gyi phog ci byed la rang lugs kyi gzhung ma tshugs nas mi'i kha la nyan drags na/ khyi chu gtor la brgyugs pa dang 'dra bar 'ong*/ 'khor g.yog la 'tshams pa'i las ma bcol na/ gces lo cal col gyi gtam mang na/ mis 'phya rang sdug tu mchi/ mkhas pa gong ma dang bsten sa la gros ma byas na/ rang shes legs kyang gting bye nas 'gro/ legs par brtags nas ma byas na/ krog po thal thung can sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor nyal/ dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ma ldan na/ shes rab rnam pa gsum dang*/ yon tan gang yang rgyud la skye mi srid/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum gyi gnad med na/ gsang sngags 'grub tu mi rung*/ mtshams dam por ma bcad na/ grib ma'i bar chad 'ong*/ phrin las dang bstun nas gnas mal ma bshams na/ rtsa ba'i rnam par shes pa skyer mi 'dod/ rdo rje gsum gyi gnad ma shes na/

bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung*/ bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang bral na/ sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa'i lo 'bras dang 'dra/ dbang po lnga yul la dga' drags na/ tshe thung*/ nad mang*/ yon tan skye mi srid/ phu kha ba'i gangs la bltas bltas nas/ nam gzhug chad pa ma tshor ro// // 131) ༄// dkar po'i dge ba srog ltar srung ba srog rang gis bsrung ba// thub pa chen po 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur pas// de la bar du gcod par 'gyur bar dam bcas pa// de la bar du gcod par mi 'gyur zhes// sus kyang rgol zhing rtsod par mi nus na// 'dul ba rgya mtshor ston pas gang gsungs pa'i// bar du gcod par 'gyur ba'i nyes ltung la// da rung 'dzem pa'i bsam pa ma skyes na// stobs dang mi 'jigs yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs// e ma bdag gis nam zhig thob par 'gyur// bdag gi bsam pas rgyu las 'bras bu'i tshul// ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo ji bzhin du// byas pa dran pas sad nas smin snyam na// bdag gis byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu ni// byas shing bsags pa sngon du song ba ste// ri bo rdib pa'i 'og tu song ba ltar// dran bsam med par rang dbang med par 'byung*// las kyi tshul ni 'di ltar zab gyur na// mkhas pa ci'i phyir nags su gnas mi byed// dkar po'i dge ba rnams kyi srog gyur pa// dam pa rnams sam sems can gang la yang*// gus pa spangs pa'i lus ngag yid kyi las// che bar gyur tam yang na phra yang rung*// srog rtsar khab kyi rtse mos btsugs gyur kyang*// mi 'tsho 'chi bar gyur pa ji bzhin du// rang srog rang gis bsrung ba gces gyur ces// rang la snying brtse yod pa'i mi rnams kyis// rang gis rang la ci'i phyir 'debs mi byed// // 132) ༄// tshogs gnyis rdzogs thabs he badzra zhes pa gzhon nu tshul khrims la gnang ba// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mgon gyur bla ma rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi ze'u 'brur gtsug gis 'dud// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yis// shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa// spros med ri khrod rnal 'byor pas// dgongs pa sgrub pa'i slob ma la// gtan gyi srog srid btsal lugs bstan// mi rtag 'chi ba rjes dran pas// 'jig rten bya dang byed pa la// snying por mi blta mos gus can// 'jig rten 'di yi sdig pa dang*// 'jig rten pha rol rnam smin la// nyes par mthong bas spang par bya// bla ma dkon mchog don ched du// sdig pa byas pa'i mi rnams kyang*// 'di dang 'jig rten pha rol tu// bla ma dkon mchog gang gis kyang*// skyob par 'gyur ba ma mthong ste// 'di yis nyes pa 'di byas pas// nga dang 'brel ba med do zhes// 'o dod 'bod par nges pa ste// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan kyang*// lha sbyin nga dang 'brel med gsungs// bcas pa drug sde rnams la mang*// nyer sbas ston pa'i sras yin gsungs// spyod lam gzob dang dam pa kun// nyon mongs ma bsten rnal 'byor pa// bag dang ldan na rab byung yin// gzhan gyi nyes pa bzod na yang*// rje la ngan smras byed pa la// nga la bzod pa'i thabs med de// rin chen mgo la ya zer kyang*// rgya mtsho'i gling la zer bar soms// gang la gnod na bde 'brel ba'i// bla ma mchog dang 'brel pa la// dga' ba chen po yang yang bskyed// bcu gsum po la nan tan bya// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dngos grub blang*// khyed kyi mgo la ya zer na// thog med dus nas da yi bar// phung khrol rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gyi// mgo la rdeg pa'i mthu bo che// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i yi dam lhar// nges pa'i shes pa chen po bskyed// skyabs su mchi'o gsol ba 'debs// bcos ma med pa'i mos gus bya// mngon mtshan rgya mtsho'i gting tu sba// nyams myong ri khrod dgon par skyong*// spyod pa mi mthun phyogs dang bsre// mnga' bdag rgyal po dngos grub mgon// khams gsum dbang du bsdus so zer// ti ser bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bdag po rgyal ba dga' nas mchi// dgongs shig dgongs shig rnal 'byor pa// rem zhig rem zhig dpa' bo kun// rgyugs shig rgyugs shig 'gag la rgyugs// zungs shig zungs shig dgra bo zungs// mos gus can gyi slob ma rnams// bla ma'i ched du sdig mi byed// khal thang brgya dang sum brgyas kyang*// nged rang spad kyi mgo mi khyogs// pha la bu skyes gyad kyi rigs// rje btsun sgra bsgyur lo tsā la// mi la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// zhabs tog byas pa'i phyi rjes snyogs// dus ngan tha ma'i srog chags rnams// 'grogs pa mi sla dka' ba ste// byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin byed pa// srog la ltos pa med pa yi// rgyal sras 'jigs med seng ge mchog

/ma pham rdo rje dbang phyug gis// rgyal ba'i gdung rgyud mi gcod pa// skyes chen tshogs kyi dpon rnams dang*// de yi sras su gang gyur pas// lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// spyad pa spyod pa'i yi ge 'di// tshig gi 'brel pa chung na yang*// don gyi 'thad pa rdo rje 'dra// shākya'i rigs las byung gyur cing*// sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang du len// ri khrod 'grims pa'i brtul zhugs can// gnyis med glang chen spyod pa yis// bla ma'i zhabs tog byed pa yi// dge sbyong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis// sna tshogs las dang bya ba yis// bla ma dam pa mnyes byas nas// tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs// kun la phan pa'i don du zhus// he badzra rdzogs so// // 133) ༄// theg gsum nyams len gnad kyi don kun 'grub par bstan pa// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyabs gcig bla ma dkon mchog la// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// tshad med snying rje skyes pa yis// rang las gzhan gces bsam pa yis// 'gro ba rjes su gzung 'dod na// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la// bla med dkon mchog gsum po las// skyob pa'i skyabs gzhan mi srid pas// gsum pos rjes su gzung bar bya// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yis// dngos grub rnam gsum la gnas pas// sangs rgyas skyob pa'i skyabs chen gyis// phrin las rnam bzhis bsgrub par bya// byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa yis// bden drang gnyis la rab gnas te// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i tshul// bsdu dngos bzhi yis smin byas te// snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes med gsungs// rab tu byung ba gang yin pas// dge 'dun mthun pa'i bya ba yis// thams cad mi 'grub gang yang med// dge 'dun mthun pa bde ba ste// mthun pa rnams kyi dka' thub bde// gang dang gang du gnas pa yi// dge 'dun rnams dang mthun pa yis// don kun 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs brtan pa dang*/

*/gzhi ji bzhin gyis thams cad 'grub// // 134) ༄// zab mo gnad kyi phreng ba klong thang pa dge bshes be ri'i zhus chos// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig nyes tshogs rab spangs te// yon tan kun gyi rang bzhin chos kyi sku// 'gro ba ma lus smin par mdzad pa'i gnyen// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// dam pa de yi zhabs rdul spyi bo yis// gus par blangs pa'i dge slong shākya'i sras// ri khrod dgon par brtul zhugs spyod pa yi// rnal 'byor pa la gsol ba btab phyir 'bri// spyir bdag cag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por gnas pa rnams kyi 'dug lugs ni/ mi rtag pa'i srin pos spyi bo nas ni bzung*/ skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo chen po bzhi las ni ma brgal/ shes rab don dam pa'i bden pa mthong ba'i mig ni med/ thabs thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer bgrod pa'i rkang pa ni chag 'khor ba dang ngan song las skyob par byed pa'i skyabs jo bo dkon mchog gsum dang ni bral/ ji ltar byas kyang phan pa dang bde ba'i skal pa med par gyur pa yin pas/ deng sang phun sum tshogs pa'i dus 'dir rang gi lus dang srog la ltos pa med par brtson 'grus dang brtul zhugs kyi stobs gcad du med pa'i shugs kyis/ skye ba gtan gyi so nam/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad kyi bde skyid/ bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par bya'o// rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che de tshul ji ltar sgrub snyam na/ lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo sgyu med pas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ yon tan thams cad bskyed par byed pa'i sa gzhi lta bu tshul khrims rin po che la pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rang nyid kyis bgyis pa dang*/ gzhan la bgyid du stsal pa dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis dus gsum du byas shing bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang bar byas shing*/

zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas byas shing bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ltos pa dang 'khris pa med par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba bya ste/ de ltar zhing dang bsam pa dang dngos po rnam pa gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gnad ma 'chugs pas/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang skyid pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ma skyes pa skye ba dang*/ skyes pa 'phel ba dang*/ 'phel zhing rdzogs pa nyams pa med pa'i chos nyid khong du chud par byas nas/ rin chen dbang phyug ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// gzhan yang nged rang pha spad kyi snying gtam tshig gcig man ngag gi gnad zab mo/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ chos la blo nges pa 'ba' zhig yin/ gzhan gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa med gsung*/ slob dpon bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas/ nges pa'i byin rlabs dbang du byas gsungs pas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang thun mong gi dngos grub bya ba byed pa mtho dman 'bring gsum ci dang ci byed pa thams cad ma grub pa grub pa dang*/ grub pa brtan pa dang*/ brtan pa gong nas gong du 'phar pa dang*/ 'phar nas nyams pa med par rtag pa zhing gi gnad dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su song zhing bslab bya dang ma bral bas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs rgya chen pos bdag nyid byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo ba med pas/ byang chub kyi sems rang gi rgyud la skyes pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gcig tu gyur pa'i byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ rang nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po yi dam gyi lha nyid du nges pas/ yi dam gyi lhas byin gyis rlabs dang*/ de nyid kyi sngags dang phyag rgya dang dam tshig dang 'bral ba med pa'i rigs sngags dang gsang sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs dang*/

rang nyid 'khor 'das/ 'khor 'das rang nyid/ sems nyid phyag rgya chen por gdod nas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa la rang nyid 'gyur 'dod kyang gshis kyis 'gyur du ma btub pa/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i byin gyis rlabs dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang drag po'i phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed ces gsungs pa'i don 'khrul 'khor man ngag gi gnad kyis byin gyis rlabs dang*/ byin gyis rlabs 'di rnams thams cad kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi don lhun gyis grub la rgyun mi chad pas de kho na la nan tan shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu/ lar chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kun// rang sems gcig pu ma gtogs pa// dus gsum rgyal bas ma rnyed pas// bsam pa ngan pa thams cad spang*// bsam pa bzang po thams cad bskyed// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas// dbang po sgo rnams bsrung ba las// rgyal bas bgrod pa'i lam gzhan med// des na bag dang ldan pa gces// thabs mkhas shes rab zab mo yis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa yang*// mi nag gdug pa'i sa phyogs su// mkhas pa bas kyang mkhas pa dgos// gnas gcig ther zug sdod pa yang*// kha cig dga' ba skye na yang*// de la zlog pa yod srid pas// brtags nas bag dang ldan par bya// sa phyogs 'di na 'di yod ces// bsam rtog tshig gi rjes mi 'brang*// mthun pa'i gnas dang yul rnams su// rang gzhan don kun bsgrub pa yi// yun ring gnas la 'gal ba med// su dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lha// gang du 'dug kyang gzhal med khang*// dgra gnyen thams cad mnyam por mdzod// rang gzhan thams cad gcig tu bsres// 'byung po kun la byams pa'i yid// brtse bas thams cad bskyang bar bya// bcu chos gsum chos man ngag 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi gter// bya dang byed pa thams cad la// skyes chen khyed kyis nyams su blang*// zab dang rgya che'i gdams ngag kun// bdag la lus pa ma mchis par// thams cad snyan du gsol zin pas// dus 'dir 'bri rgyu ma mchis kyang*// dar ma dbang phyug nan che bas// ji ltar gsungs bzhin bsgrubs pa yi// yi ger bris pa 'di lags so// bris pa'i dge ba gang yin des// 'gro ba byang chub thob par shog
/zab mo gnad kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba klong thang pa dge bshes be ris zhus pa rdzogs so// //

135) ༄// bla med theg pa'i gnad bsdus dge bshes chen po bla brang pa la gnang ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis 'dud// bla ma de yis zhal snga nas// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang dang yang du gsung ba gang*// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang*// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po'i gnad// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// 'di las dam pa'i chos gzhan med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob bar// nyams su longs shig bka' stsal gsungs// dang por byang chub sems kyi gnad// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa yi// bgegs dang bar du gcod pa la// snying rje chen po yang yang bsgom// de yang 'di ltar nyams su blang*// shin tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su// sku mtshams bcad cing bya brel spang*// lus sems g.yeng ba med par bya// gnod par byed pa de rnams la// rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// snying rje bsgom zhing goms pa las// g.yo sgyu med pa'i snying rje skyes// de nas 'gro ba kun la bsgom// gsha' mar snying rje skyes pa'i tshe// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// sdug bsngal kun dang bral ba dang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob bar// lus ngag yid gsum dge la bkol// ma shi bar dang sang gi bar// lus ngag yid gsum dge la bkol// snyam du sems la dam bca' bya// brtul zhugs chen pos de ltar bsgrub// rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms te// gsal la dang ba 'ja' tshon ltar// snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom// de la bsam pa 'jug gyur na// mi skyo'i bar du nan tan bskyed// de nas mgon po rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa de// bdag cag slob 'bangs thams cad kyi// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs byed pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa yin// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ltar// dpyid kyi thig ler gsungs pa bzhin// he ru ka dang phag mo yi// gnas su rgyun chad med par bsgom// he ru kas ni gdug pa 'joms// rje btsun mkha' 'gros phan bde yi// yon tan mtha' yas ster bar mdzad// gzhung tshogs mang po'i rjes 'brangs nas// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas rnams dang*// zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang ni// tshan dho nye ba'i tshan dho dang*// dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod dang*// sangs rgyas lnga yi pho brang du// sgom par 'dod lugs mang yod kyang*// dpa' bo thams cad he ru kaḥ

/mkha' 'gro rigs ni sum cu bdun// kun kyang phag mo'i rigs las skyes// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas na// gnyis po 'di las ma gtogs pa// khyed kyis gzhan du ma bsgom mdzod// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gdug pa rnams// khros pas phung bar 'gyur du 'ong*// he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma'i// yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyis// khyed la sbyin par the tshom med// gsang sngags thabs kyis yon tan kun// rang la byin gyis rlob pa yi// bla ma rin chen bde legs mdzad// rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// nyin mtshan med par nyams su blang*// mos gus gdung shugs ma gcad dang*// kho bo'i bla ma rin chen gyi// byin rlabs khyed kyis shes nas mchi// da mthar thug phyag rgya chen po'i gnad// rje btsun de yi zhal snga nas// rang sems rang byung lhun gyis grub// dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa la// mnyam rjes rtogs pas ma slad cig /bye brag smra ba'i grub mthar ltung*// 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs pas na// gsungs pa de yi rjes su 'brangs// rang sems rang byung lhun gyis grub// 'das pa'i dus su byas pa med// da ltar dus su dbri ba med// ma 'ongs pa na bsnan pa med// ma byas dbri bsnan med pa yi// rang sems 'gyur med sgom du med// sgom rgyu byung na nor ba yin// lhun gyis grub pa ma bcos pa// dge ba'i bshes kyis shes par mdzod// skyes bu dam pas rtogs par mdzod// rang las gzhan tu ma re mdzod// rtogs ma rtogs gnyis las ma gtogs pa// 'bras bu thob dang ma thob med// mnyam med bla ma dam pas gsung*// yi ger bkod par mi rigs kyang*// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen gyi// bdag po yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// thos bsam sgom gsum nor gyis phyug /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnams// mkhan po chen po bla brang bas// dad cing gus pas gsol btab nas// bris pa'i bsod nams gang yin des// thams cad rdo rje 'dzin par shog

/dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba bya ba'i lugs// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /rdo rje rgyal mtshan mchog gis bsngo ba las// gsungs pa de yi rjes su 'brang bar mdzod// bla na med pa'i theg pa'i gnad bsdus pa zhal gyi gdams pa rin po che zhes bgyi ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bla brang pas zhus pa rdzogs so// // 136) ༄// byang chub sems gnyis nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag ye shes rtsegs la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la lus gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sems dang bas skyabs su mchi'o// spyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byed pa la/ byang chub kyi sems ma gtogs pa gang gis kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi thob ste/ med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras nges pa lags/ byang chub kyi sems la rnam pa gnyis te/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems nyams su blang ba'i dbang du byas na/ rlabs po che yi dge ba'i rtsa ba byed pa'i dus sam/ snga thun dang po la zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung ste nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ snyam du dus ring thung rnam pa gsum byin gyis rlabs nas/ lag len du lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsam pa de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs nas bya ba 'am/

yang na nangs par ram/ dal ba'i dus su byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba des mtshon nas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis/ dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya ba ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems/ thabs mkhas pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad bsgrub par byed pa'i gter chen po yin pas/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems de nyams su blang bar bya'o// de la don dam pa byang chub kyi sems ji ltar nyams su blang snyam na/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems de ni/ kun rdzob de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba de kho na nyid yin te/ de ltar yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ spros pa rab zhi don dam byang chub sems// snying rjes rab brlan kun rdzob smon 'jug gnyis// til dang til mar bzhin du ro gcig pa// zhes gsungs pas/ tha dad med par shes par bya ba ni/ dngos po thams cad rdul cha'am/ rdul cha'i dbye bas phye na stong pa nyid du bsgom pa'i lugs yod kyang*/ bla ma rin po che'i bzhed pas/ bla ma dam pa'i mos gus 'ba' zhig gis rtogs par bzhed de/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal dgyes pa rdo rje nas/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang*/ gong gi bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas/ smra bsam brjod med kyi don rtog ge ba rnams kyi yul ma yin pa spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang shar du 'char nas sems nyid kyi ngo bo rgyun chad med par bzhed/

de ji ltar nyams su blang na/ dang po stan bde ba'i steng du skyil mo krung legs par bca'/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnas par byas nas/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa spyi bo'am snying gar bsgom/ de nas shes pa ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag yod par mi gzung rtag lta yin// med par mi bsgom chad lta yin// 'dzin med mi bsgom blos byas yin// so ma ma bcos lhug par bzhag /gsol ba btab cing goms pa las// rang gzhan snang srid 'khor 'das kun// sems gcig lhun grub gcig tu mchi// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis dang bral// 'bras bu spangs thob re dogs bral// nga bdag gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral// bral dang ma bral rlom sems med// lhun grub ngo bo nyid kyi sku// rgyun chad med par rang nyid 'gyur// rjes sam yang na skabs skabs su// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// bsngo ba'i bsngo lugs 'di lta ste// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o// rin po che yi gdams ngag 'di// skye bu dam pas bskul gyur pas// bris las byung ba'i dge ba des// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /bla ma rin po che dpal ldan 'bri gung pa la sgom pa ye shes rtsegs kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 137) ༄// sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i gdams ngag skyid shod pa dkon mchog 'od la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs yon tan kun gyi sku// nyes tshogs dri ma'i skyon gyis ma gos pa// bla ma mchog gi zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// na rga 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gting la thug /tshe 'di skad cig glog dang ba mo 'dra// 'dus byas g.yo ba'i rang bzhin rtag pa med// 'jig rten chos brgyad bslu ba'i ri dwags bzhin// 'dod yon grags snyan nam mkha'i 'ja' dang mtshungs// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa nas// sgrol byed gzings ni tshul khrims rin chen yin// 'das dang ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu yi// rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes pa tshul khrims yin// thub pa drang srong rnams dang lhar bcas kyi// 'jig rten smin grol dga' ba tshul khrims yin// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa yi// gdung brgyud 'dzin cing mdzes pa tshul khrims yin// dus gsum 'phags pas bstod pa tshul khrims yin// rang gi lus dang srog 'di yal kyang bla'i// tshul khrims mchog 'di khyod kyis gces par srungs// 'khor dang zas nor phun sum tshogs pa yis// rang nyid chen por gyur pa'i 'gyings pa yis// dam pa rnams dang bla ma mi smod cing*// zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs nas mchod cing bkur// sems nyid lhan skyes smra bsam brjod las 'das// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i spros pas rnam dben pa// chags sdang nyon mongs grib mas ma gos pa// rgyun chad med par khyod kyis goms par mdzod// rang don zhe 'dod dri mas ma gos par// rang bas gzhan gces sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzhung*// bsdu dngos bzhi dang tshul khrims rnam dag dang*// stong dang snying rjes 'gro ba smin par mdzod// mthu chung man chung gdams chung mang po yis// re zhing ltos pa'i slob ma bslu na ko// mtho dman gzhan gyi blo gtad ga la byed// thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba yi// snying po pha rol phyin pa drug gis skyongs// khyod nyid chos dang mthun pa'i ri khrod du// sgrub pa snying por byed ces bdag gis khums// dad pas zhus pa'i gdams ngag 'di dag rnams// thugs la zhog la nyams su blang bar zhu// dam pa rnams dang bla ma dam pa'i gsung*// dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i dam pa de// drung ngam rgyang na bzhugs kyang bla ma dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams shin tu mnyes// ji ltar bya ba'i lan du bstan pa'o// skyid shod pa dkon mchog 'od la gdams pa'o// rdzogs so// ling mug kha gang dar dkar kha gang dang*// gser gyi chun po 'dra ba'i skud pa dang*// dkon pa'i rin chen gser rnams bskur ba kun// rdo rje seng ges bdag gi lag tu thon// yig rten dbu zhu bskur bas gsol bar zhu//

// 138) ༄// zhal ta tshig gsum gyi yi ge mdo smad pa shes rab 'od la gdams pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo dbyer med pa// mnyam med bla ma dam pa rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis legs btud nas// rgyun chad med par phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// shākya'i dge slong ri khrod pa// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bsod snyoms pas// rang gi chos las byung ba'i bu// dam pa khyed la zhu lags na// tshe 'di skad cig glog dang 'dra// mi rtag 'dod pa'i long med pas// 'jig rten bya byed sna tshogs kyis// rang gis rang mgo mi bskor bar// skye ba gtan gyi so nam mchog /dam pa'i chos la nan tan mdzod// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// thub pa drang srong chen po yis// mkhyen cing thugs su chud pa dang*// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyur pa// bkag pa gshis sam ye bkag pa// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// 'dul ba'i sde snod ces grags pas// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa 'di// rang gi srog pas gces par srungs// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// stobs bcu dri med tshul khrims yin// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshul khrims yin// 'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal las// skyob pa'i skyabs gcig tshul khrims yin// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma yi// zhabs tog bsnyen bkur tshul khrims yin// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis// bstod cing bkur ba tshul khrims yin// shin tu phra ba'i phra ba 'ang*// rang snying dpang du btsugs pa yi// dri med tshul khrims bsrung bar bya// byang chub rnam pa gsum nyid dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po yang*// sgyogs dang 'phrul 'khor ji bzhin tu// mthar thug gnas su phyin byed na// gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal// de bas nan tan chen pos 'bad// 'di ltar tshul khrims rin chen dang*// dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba rnams// ri khrod dgon par bsten pas 'phel/ */sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyad pas grub// 'jig rten chos brgyad khe grags dang*// phun sum tshogs pa'i zas nor dang*// 'khor 'das yon tan gang yin pa// bral dang rnam par smin pa yi// yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus kun// ri khrod dgon pa bsten pas 'grub// grub thob brtul zhugs spyod pa yi// bla ma rje btsun gong ma dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// nags khrod ri khrod dben gnas su// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad cing*// kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob// bu gcig ri khrod dgon par sdod// yi dwags sprang po grong myug ma// 'dod chags chags pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// 'bad rtsol rtsol sgrub drag po yis// grong khyer mang po bskor na yang*// khe spogs ji snyed gzigs par bas// des na rtsa ba lo ma dang*// me tog 'bras bu gyi na la// brten nas khyod kyis byang chub sgrub// snying nas byang chub sgrub dus su// chos can chod nyid gang gis kyang*// bya byed nyams su len dus su// de nyid chos su ma go nas// gcig pur sdod la re na yang*// rnam par rtog pa mtho dman gyi// dpung tshogs mang pos bskor nas mchi// bcu dang gsum zhes grags pa yi// dam pa'i chos kyis nyams su longs// nyams len gnad kyis thabs med na// ci byas spros pa'i gag tshud yin// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu gyur pa'i rten 'brel 'dis// ci byas rgyal ba thams cad kyi// thabs kyi rgyal po khyod kyis sgrubs// shes rab stong nyid 'dus ma byas// 'od gsal stong nyid spros bral de// thun gyi tshod la 'di ltar bsgom// kha ta bya rgyu nga la med// gcig pu ri khrod dgon par bsdad// brtson 'grus chen po'i shugs dag gis// nyin mtshan med par bsgom pa na// rgyal bas bsngags pa'i skyil krung gi// gal te gnad dang bral gyur na// nyon mong rtogs pas g.yengs ba 'am// shes pa skyo zhing mi dga' ba'i// dus su gnad du bsnun gyur na// ro stod gzer zhing mgo bo 'khor// snying mi dga' zhing tshig pa za// smyo 'bog snying rlung can du 'gro// gal te bu dang slob ma la// 'di 'dra'i gnod pa byung srid na// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi// zhabs kyi gdan du gyur pa yi// ri rab lhun po'i zhabs drung du// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'byung po mnan// lhan skyes gdams ngag zab mo yi// gcig shos lugs las bzlog par bya// gnyis po nyams len gang la yang*// dhū ti phra zhing gsal la gces// zhal ta tshig gsum yi ge 'di// gsol ba btab nas bris pa las// byung ba'i dge ba gang yin des// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog// mdo smad pa shes rab 'od la'o//

139) ༄// snying gtam tshig gcig gi man ngag co za dge slong la gdams pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med dam pa rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs la gus pas 'dud// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mgon skyabs bla na med pa yi// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// shākya'i dge slong ldom bu pa// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs 'dzin pa yi// ri khrod dgon par gnas pa la// rang gi rigs las byung ba yi// dge slong bsod nams shākya yis// zhu don gsol ba btab pa la// snying gtam tshig gcig smras pa'i don// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// rgyal ba rnams kyi dam chos 'di// sus kyang ma byas shes bya'i babs// 'gro ba kun gyi 'dug lugs yin// bu sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che// rang gi 'dug lugs sems la zhog /snga ma'i bsam pa bzang po las// da ltar skyes pa'i lus 'di byung*// las mar khu lta bu zad tsam na// lus mar me lta bu 'jig nas mchi// ring por sdod pa'i long med pas// bu sdod pa'i so tshis mi mdzad zhu// sems 'jigs shing skrag pas nyen pa'i tshe// skyabs gtan bde'i gnas su ma phyin na// las ji ltar byas kyang ku re yin// gnas ri khrod kyi dgon par bzhugs par zhu// ri khrod dgon par gnas bcas nas// blo tshol khro la zhugs na rdzun po yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// lam tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa de// bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen yin// rtsa ba byang chub sems nyid la// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan rnam pa lnga// bsod nams tshogs su thub pas gsungs// bu rang snying dpang du tshugs mdzod la// bsod nams tshogs la nan tan zhu// nyams myong med pa'i kha ta can// rang la snying brtse med pa rnams// sha dang chang gi longs spyod dang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po la// nyes pa'i skyon du mi blta ba// ngo mtshar legs pa'i yon tan zhes// dpa' bo 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// phag mo gru pas mi gsung bas// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar// ltos pa med par bsam gtan bya// de ltar ye shes tshogs chen ni// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa de// 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag nyid sku// yod med spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa'i dbyings// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis med kyang*// nags khrod ri khrod gangs khrod du// gong ma rnams kyi rjes bsnyags nas// sbyangs pa'i yon tan brtul zhugs kyis// rnal 'byor pa yis nyams su blang*// 'jig rten spros pa'i bya ba yis// 'khor ba'i bde 'bras gang yin pa// ra yi o srong tshil yin pas// thar pa'i bde ba bsgrub po zhes// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gsung*// bu thugs la zhogs dang rnal 'byor pa// snying gtam tshig gcig man ngag 'di// gsol ba btab nas bris pa yis// dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub shog

/rdzogs so// // 140) ༄// ting 'dzin rgyal po bsgom pas rang gzhan kun skyid ces pa// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dam pa'i chos 'di// dge dang mi dge gshis sam babs su yod pa// don gyi snying po rang gi mtshan nyid dge ba// mi chos 'dun ma thub pa'i dgongs pa spangs nas// don spyi blo yi yul du byas nas 'dun pa'i// 'bad pa drag pos rtags tsam 'dzin pa ngas bsgrubs// 'bad pa drag ste chu la bsrubs pa 'dra bar// dub cing 'tsher te lcags kyi sran ma mur 'dra// bstan pa nub khar rtags tsam 'dzin pa 'ong zer// yin pa spangs nas min pa bsgrub pa 'di yin// thub pa'i bstan pa nam yang nub par mi 'gyur// kun la gshis su yod pa'i dge ba 'di yin// rtags tsam ma 'dzin dam pa'i chos la khyod 'bungs// ngang pa'i skyes ba'i rabs las rgyal po'i bsnyun 'dri// khyod kyi chos kyi sku la bar chad med dam// rnam par dkar ba bsdus pa chos kyi sku yin// rin chen gsung gis ci byas rang nyid snang gsung*// g.yo rgyu med pa'i drang po rang la yid gces// legs par bsam pa'i dam bca' brtan po med na// phyi nang 'tsho ba mang zhing ltogs pa'i zas 'dra// ting 'dzin rgyal po bsgom pas rang gzhan kun skyid// // 141) ༄// gshis kyi dge ba 'di la khyod kyis 'bungs zhes chos la chos su mi shes pa// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dam pa'i chos// dge dang mi dge mtshan nyid 'dzin pa 'di// rang la yod pa'i bsam sbyor 'di nyid yin// tshig gi zer mchu bzung nas dad pa yi// don spyi blo yis bsgoms pas ngal zhing dub// don med rtags tsam 'dzin pas nga re bslus// don med phung bar 'ong ngo bu slob rnams// gshis nyid dge ba 'di la khyod kyis 'bungs// ri khrod dgon par bsdad pas rna ba 'on// 'jur bus bcings pa glod na rang sems grol// byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// ri dwags smig rgyu bsnyogs pas skom grir shi// rtags tsam 'dzin pa bdud kyi sde yin zhes// dam pa gong mas gsung ba 'di re mad// chos sgor zhugs nas tha ma da lta'i bar// chos la chos su bdag gis ma shes pa// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// bla ma yi dam bla med dkon mchog gis// bdag gi nyes pa'i dri ma sbyang du gsol//

// 142) ༄// byang chub sems dpa' rnams bla ma'i gsung bzhin sgrub par nges pa// oṃ swasti/ shes bya'i gshis la mi gnas pa'i// 'jigs 'jigs bye ba brgya byas kyang*// 'thad cing myong ba med pa'i phyir// gang yang mgu bar 'gyur mi srid// gnas brtan chen po shwa ri'i bu// lus rten bar chad med pa yi// rgyal sras seṅge 'jigs med la// bu longs gsungs pas yon tan rdzogs// bskal pa grangs med mang por yang*// mgo dang rkang lag gtong pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrub par nges// brgya la gal te ston pa yi// mi mnyes skyon pa'i gsung byung na// srog chad re thag chad pa'i phyir// phan med gnod pa ci'i phyir bsgrub// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kun// bsdu dngos bzhi yi spyod pa yis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa las// dam chos gzhan med mkhas pas gsung*// // 143) ༄// rje nā ro'i gdams ngag mi la'i thugs la shar ba rung rgang par springs pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// 'das pa'i dus su sngon byung ba'i// sangs rgyas grangs med mnyes mdzad cing*// bsod nams tshogs chen rab bsags pas// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// lnga brgya'i tha mar rmad byung ba// 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin// bslab gsum rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mchod cing bkur bar gyur pa'i gnas// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud// thugs kyi dpal be'u rab bkang nas// skal ldan mang po smin par mdzad// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes mchog

/gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis// bag chags sgrib pa zad par mdzad// rje btsun mi la'i zhal snga nas// rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen dang*// bod kyi mi la rnal 'byor gnyis// 'od gsal gyi ngang du gcig tu 'dres// dpal nā ro paṇa chen gyi gdams ngag de// bdag mi la ras pa'i thugs la shar// rdo rje'i mgur du bka' stsal gsungs// bdag ri khrod 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor pa// sprang po dbus na yod pa dang*// khams na yod pa'i dge ba'i bshes// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu 'dres// 'phags pa ka tā ya na la// yul mthar gnas pa'i gro zhun skyes// 'phags pa rna ba bye ba ris// dgra bcom 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe// mkhan po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// bdag gis chos sku'i zhal mthong yang*// da rung gzugs sku ma mthong bas// ston pa nyid dang mjal don du// gsol ba btab pa ji lta bar// sngon gyi thugs dgongs mnga' ba la// le lo phyi bshol ma mdzad par// ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin du mdzad// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /yig rten du dbu zhu gcig 'bul zhing mchis// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rung rgang pa la springs pa'o// // 144) ༄// mi tshe chos la bskyal ba 'phan yul brtson 'grus dpal 'od la springs pa// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// brtul zhugs grub pa thams cad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// spangs shing skyabs dang bral ba yi// bdag cag mgon skyabs med pa rnams// thugs rje chen pos ma bzod nas// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa// shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa la// sprang po bdag gi rjes zhugs nas// snying nas rab tu byung ba kun// ku re kyal ka ma mchis par// byang chub bsgrub pa yin par go// lus dang srog la ma bltas par// khyed cag 'ba' zhig bskyangs pa la// tshe gcig bskyangs pa'i drin lan du// sha chang 'dod yon spyod do zhes// thos pas yi chad la gam nas// zhe sdang tshig ngan ngag tu shor// shi na rung ste snyam pa byung*// chos la srung ma med dam ci// da rung gson por 'jog pa de// ci tsug yin nam snyam pa byung*// gshin rje'i dong khar gtong snying 'dod// drag po gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor gyi// sbyor ba dkar nag bya 'am snyam// 'on kyang 'di dang phyi ma gnyis// med pa'i sbyor ba ngas kyang 'grub// 'byams yig shog bu btang pas chog

/snyam nas shog bu btang ba de// chu tshol brtag pa tsam du zad// 'on kyang bu la nyes med pas// sprin dkar dag pa bzhin du dkar// nam mkhar zla ba dri med bzhin// nyes pa med pa mtha' nas dag /nyes med rgyan kha lha yis bzung*// bka' brgyud rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs// yon bdag grogs kyis che gzhi phye// bu la mi tshangs kha med byung*// dag go tshangs so shin tu dga'// nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pa// de las dga' ba yod dam med// khyod rang dpang por gyur pa yin// bu la tshangs pa'i rgya ma sbyin// mi shes 'khrul pa'i dbang song bas// khyod la smras pa'i sku yus su// ri khrod nags khrod gangs khrod gsum// khyod la dgon pa 'bul zhing mchis// dad zas bsod snyoms ting 'dzin zas// 'tsho ba zas kyi skal bar byin// gnyug ma ye shes rang drod dang*// gtum mo'i drod dang gos kyi drod// khyed la na bza'i skal bar 'bul// rnam shes rlung gi rta pho dang*// bla med theg pa'i glang chen dang*// zung 'jug yangs pa'i shing rta gsum// bu la bzhon pa'i skal bar 'bul// dpal phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar dang*// sems gnyis 'dres pa'i rin chen dang*// rgyal ba'i gter mdzod bslab pa gsum// bu la nor gyi skal bar 'bul// dbu skra phyag zhabs sen mo dang*// gsol ba 'debs pa'i zhabs rjes gsum// mi 'bral rten gyi skal bar 'bul// ji ltar gsungs shing dam bcas pa'i// rtag tu dam par bzhugs par zhu// mi tshe chos la skyel bar zhu// mtha' sgab bzang po mdzad par zhu// bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par zhu// rdzogs so// // 145) ༄// dge slong blo gros rin chen dang dge bshes rgon chen pa gnyis la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi ze'u 'brur gtsug gis 'dud// 'jig rten mgon po de nyid kyi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// shākya'i dge slong ri khrod pas// rang gi rigs las skyes pa yi// bu la gdams pa'i man ngag 'bri// gting mtha' med par 'khor ba yi// rgya mtsho mu mtha' med pa la// 'jigs shing skrag pa'i bsam pa yis// ston pa'i bstan la rab tu byung*// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs dka' thub spyad// yun ring mi sdod 'chi ba dang*// ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*// 'gro la phan pa sgrub pa dang*// gong ma'i gdung rgyud 'tshob pa dang*// tshul khrims sbyangs pa'i yon tan la// pad mo la ni chu bzhin du// ltem rkyang med par nan tan mdzod// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa la// mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung zhing*// nga tsam med pa'i nga rgyal dang*// rlom sems dug sdong 'phel na ko// mtho ris thar pa'i srog gcod pa// bdag 'dzin mnga' thang rgyas pa yi// tshul 'chos des ko ci bya ste// nyon mongs gsum gyi rjes 'brangs pa'i// lus kyi las dang ngag gi las// yid kyi las dang gsum spangs pas// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// lhun gyis grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin// rtsol sgrub med par skye ba 'di// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa las// lhag pa ting 'dzin bslab pa 'di// skye bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' dag dang*// bka' brgyud grub thob gong ma yi// gdams ngag yin no thugs la zhog

/sems dul spros pa zhi ba yi// lhan skyes sems nyid rin po che// bde gsal mi rtog nyams myong gi// nyes pa'i sprin dang ma bral na// gnyis med ye shes nyi ma yi// dkyil 'khor snang bar mi nus pas// gnyug ma rang sems bsgom pa dang*// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus kyis// 'gyur med lhan skyes ye shes 'di// gsal bar mdzod cig dge ba'i bshes// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// sgrub pa byas ba'i 'bras bu de// rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa grub// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa yi// sems can rnams la smin gyur cig /thugs bskyed rgyu las byung ba yi// phun tshogs 'bras bu ngo mtshar che// khyed kyi bslab gsum rin chen la// rgyal bas smin par mdzad pa'i sras// las can mang po tshogs pa la// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi// rjes su 'brangs pa'i nye gnas dang*// bu slob sde pa yon bdag gi// mi chos 'dun ma zab mo yi// kye kye rjes su ma 'brang bar// rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang*// kha lan khur sha yod pa dang*// dma' ba sprang po yin kyang rung*// skyes dang gnas dang mdzes pa yi// bar chad gsum dang bral pa rnams// thabs dang shes rab zab mo yi// khyed kyis rab tu 'byung ba dang*// las can smin par mdzad par rigs// ma brtags cal col mtho dman rnams// bla ma'i rnam thar yin snyam nas// khyi gzhug bcad pa'i rab byung gis// rang nyid ngan sar ltung ba dang*// thub pa'i bstan la gnod pa dang*// tha mal 'jig rten ma dad na// tha mal 'jig rten smin pa'i thabs// ji ltar 'ong ba legs par som// 'jig rten kha na ma tho ba// de phyir khyed kyis bsrung bar bya// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dge ba dus gsum bsags pa rnams// sems can kun la btang ba dang*// de bsrung dag dang spel ba'i thabs// khyed rang nyid kyis dpag med bshad// 'on kyang da res phyag len mdzad// sbrang mas 'bad de rtsi bsags kyang*// sbrang rtsi gzhan gyis spyod par zad// bu lon skyed 'phel thabs rnams kyis// ka ca mang po bsags na yang*// gsog mkhan gces su nye gnas kyi// sha chang kha las mi phyid pas// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yis// rten cing 'brel pa ma 'chugs par// khyed kyis sbyin pa ran par gtang*// de ltar bdag gis sbyin pa 'dis// gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*// bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen sdom pa dang*// dge slong dge tshul sdom pa dang*// theg chen byang chub sems dang yang*// gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa// ji ltar bdag gis 'khod gyur cig

/las su bsags pa yang yang bgrang*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam bzhi yis// sems can smin pa ma gtogs pa// gzhan gyi byang chub sangs rgyas pa// thos sam mthong ngam rnal 'byor pa// bslab pa gsum sogs bya lugs 'di// mi chos yin nam lha dam zhes// khyod kyi thugs la skyes gyur na// ci bya rang gi sems la dris// tshe 'di 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis// nga bzang khyod bzang 'dod na de// 'jig rten 'di pa kho nar zad// rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// thar bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis// dge ba dpag med byas pa yis// nyan thos rang rgyal ma gtogs pa// rgyu 'bras log par 'gyur mi srid// byang sems g.yo sgyu med pa yis// byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// de las gzhan du mi srid pa// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med par nges// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// spros med sems kyi ngo bor gcig /gzung dang 'dzin pa med gyur pa// nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i dpes// byed med rtsol ba mi mnga' yang*// sngon gyi thugs rje'i smon lam gyi// mkha' la nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can gyi// mi shes mun pa sel ba 'di// chos kyi sku yi yon tan dang*// phrin las yin zhes gsungs pa de// kun rdzob don dam mtha' gnyis su// myong ba med pa'i mkhas pa rnams// tshu rol mthong ba'i skye bo yis// tshu rol mthong ba rnams la bshad// chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa// gnyis med rtogs pa rnams kyis go// mdor na rgyu lam 'bras bu'i tshul// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// ji ltar bshad pa de bzhin du// lhag bsam g.yo sgyu med pa yis// nyin mtshan med par nyams su blangs// khyed kyis 'gro ba smin pa dang*// grol bar mdzad pa'i brtul zhugs spyad// dge slong blo gros rin chen dang*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam gnyis kyis// yang yang gsol ba btab nas bris// de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog
/rdzogs so// yig rten du phyag phreng gcig dang*// dbu zhu gcig /a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba gcig dang gsum 'bul zhing mchis// //

146) ༄// nged spun la byin gyis rlobs zhes pa bkra shis seng ge'i zhu chos// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// 'phongs na thugs rjes mi gtong ba// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs la thogs// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'jig rten zang zing sna tshogs kyis// lus sems dub cing skyo ba skyes// gsol ba 'debs so thugs la thogs// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lnga brgya'i dus kyi sems can la// phan btags lan tu gnod pa skyel// gsol ba 'debs so thugs la thogs// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// nyon mongs rnam rtog rjes 'brangs pa'i// 'jig rten las dang bya byed kyis// rang gzhan don rnams mi 'grub pas// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'jig rten spros pa bcad nas kyang*// gong ma rnams kyis rjes 'brangs te// ri khrod dgon par mchi bar zhu// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// cis kyang thugs la 'dogs par zhu// gsol 'debs zhu 'bul yig rten du// chab dar dmar po yugs gcig 'bul// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// // 147) ༄// dga' bde skyid pa'i dam chos bkra shis seng ge'i zhus lan// oṃ swasti/ skyob pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun zhes// gsungs pas rang gi bla ma la// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes byed cing*// bzod pa'i brtul bzhugs go bgos nas// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// ston pa'i rjes su slob byed cing*// rang gi srog la mi blta ba// khyod kyis zhus pa'i zhu tshig rnams// shin tu bden zhing yus lags te// nged kyi pa pha bcom ldan 'das// sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal po 'dis// snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rnams// phan btags lan du gnod skyel zhing*// bzang byas lan du ngan rnams byed// dmu rgod mi bsrun gdug pa can// gdul bar dka' ba'i nyes dus 'di// dran pas thugs rjes ma bzod de// keng shu'i 'dab ltar snying 'dar zhing*// gdong la mchi ma'i rgyun 'dzag pas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// dpang du bzhag nas smon lam btab// deng sang dus 'dir sangs rgyas pa// ston pa de yi rgyal sras rnams// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// mgu bar dka' zhes bstod pa yis// legs par bstod pa rgyal ba'i sras// rkyen ngan nyes spyod de tshod kyis// zhum zhing yi mug skyes gyur na// ston pa'i sras su ji ltar 'gyur// pha la bu skyes rdzun po yin// gnyis med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// sus smras sus thos gang gis gang*// sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// tshe gcig mchog gi sangs rgya ba// mtho dman bag chags sna tshogs kun// gsang sngags sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yis// ngo mtshar ltad mo blta ba ni// lnga brgya'i dus kyi ngan can yin// rgyal sras yab kyi pha phogs spyod// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// rdo rje gdan dang dpal gyi ri// u rgyan ri bo ta la dang*// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod dang*// mngon dga'i zhing dang bde ba can// e ma bzod pa'i yul 'di dang*// sbyin dang tshul khrims brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab rdzogs pa'i yul// 'di 'dra gang du rnyed pa 'gyur// legs par soms dang pha yi bu// thog med dus nas da yi bar// bkur bsti zhabs 'bring zhabs tog dang*// snyan tshig me tog phreng ba yis// bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgyal po 'di// mnyes su re nas 'bad na yang*// 'bad pas co ga'i 'gyur bzhin du// phyi phyir je thu je thur song*// da res mya ngan 'das pa'i gtso// rang sems rang byung bcom ldan 'das// bag chags dri ma sbyong byed pa// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyan thogs nas// mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs// rgyal po rgyan dang gdan bcas pa// thub pa chen po'i brtul zhugs kyis// dus 'dir mnyes par mi byed re// swo re dga' re skyid nga re dga'// bdag 'dzin spangs pa'i mi re skyid// srog la mi blta ba 'di bde// so nam chos la byed pa skyid// dga' bde skyid pa'i dam chos 'di// pha bzang bu yi zhe gdengs yin// bu mos gus can gyi thugs la zhog

/bkra shis seng ges zhus pa'i lan rdzogs so// // 148) ༄// thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa bstan pa rgyas byed ces pa// ston pas thams cad mkhyen pa mnyes pa'i gnas// ma ga dha dang byang chub shing drung dang*// nye bar gyur pa rgyal bas lung bstan pa// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi gnas gnyis po// bsags pa'i las can skyes bu ya rab rnams// rdzas dang yo byad gsog la mi dga' ste// dam pa rnams la bkur bstis bkur gyur pas// dam pa bsod snyoms dag gis brel ba med// rgya mtsho chen po lan tshwa'i ro gcig ltar// kun kyang log par lta bas ma gos te// thams cad dkon mchog mchod pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin// nyams len byed la bsod snyoms brel ba med// rang nyid za dang brgyan par mi nus shing*// bu dang chung ma dag la'ang de lta min// bslab gsum brtul zhugs rgyan gyis mdzes pa la// bkur bsti byed pas bsod snyoms brel ba med// gangs ri'i rtse la nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du// thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la// de dang mthun pa'i bkur bstis mchod gyur pas// yon tan ldan pa bsod snyoms kyis mi brel// sngon gyi dus na ston pas rgyud sbyangs pas// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po'i rten 'brel mkhas// shes rab zab mo blo gros bzang po yis// zhing la mkhas pas bsod snyoms brel ba med// ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu// legs par bskyangs pas rgyal por gyur pa bzhin// ston pa'i sras rnams legs par bskyangs gyur pas// chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas nyid la 'god// rgyal ba sras kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas te// yon bdag gzugs kyis thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin// dpag med yon tan can dang mi 'bral zhing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog/ // 149) ༄// sku gzugs 'bri bar thub pa'i bka' bzhin tshad dang ldan dgos pa// oṃ swasti/

dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// chos sku bde ba chen po ni// sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan pa// rnam par smin pa'i yon tan yin// bral ba'i yon tan mtshon pa ni// stobs bcu glang po che yi gdan// seng ge mi 'jigs bzhi yin te// chags pa med pa padma'i gdan// thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan// tshad med thugs rje ri dwags yin// chu srin ma 'dres mtshon pa yin// bya khyung srung ba med par bshad// ston pa'i yon tan 'di dag la// 'jig rten phal ba'i kha skad du// rgyan sna bzhi zhes yongs su grags// gang zhig 'di dang mi ldan pa'i// thub pa'i sku gzugs 'bri ba ni// yon tan med pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam// de yi phyir na thub pa yi// gang gis sku gzugs 'bri ba yis// bkur bsti phun sum tshogs pa yis// thub pas gsungs pa'i bka' bzhin du// tshad dang rgyan dang ldan par bya// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad du// yon tan phun sum tshogs par 'gyur// rdzogs so// // 150) ༄// skyabs 'gro dang so thar byang sems bcas kyi sdom pa 'bog chog dang bslab bya// na mo ratna gu ru/ rgyal ba rnams kyi bstan pa kun gyi babs// 'gro ba'i bde skyid sgrub pa'i rten 'brel mchog /skyes bu rnams kyi bsam pa rmad byung ba// sdom pa rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa don du gnyer ba'i skyes bu dag gis/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa blang bar 'dod na/ ngan song dang 'khor ba me'i 'obs bzhin du bsams la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa dang ldan pa stan mthon po la bzhugs/ dkon mchog la mchod pa bshams/ bla ma la yon phul/ thal mo sbyar/ tsog pur bsdad nas rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog

chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum gyi bar du bya'o// skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ dpag tu med kyang mdor bsdus na brgyad de/ nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud pa'i phan yon dang*/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad zad cing bsrab par 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po 'phel ba dang*/ shi nas ngan song dang ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba'i phan yon dang*/ lam khyad par du 'phags pa rgyud la skye ba'i phan yon dang*/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phan yon dang rnam pa brgyad do// phan yon de rnams thob pa la bslab bya 'di rnams la slob dgos te/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas lha gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal/ chos la skyabs su song bas sems can la 'tshe ba spang*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas mi mu stegs can mi bsten pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten tshad dang ldan pa yan chad la gus pa bsgrub pa dang*/ srog dang bya dga'i ched du yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa mi gtong ba dang*/ dgos ched khyad par can byung na yang thabs gzhan mi btsal ba dang*/ dus dang dus kyi mchod pa la bslab pa dang*/ phyogs gar 'gro ba de'i lha la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ spel zhing sbyang ba la bslab pa'o// ༈ //bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ni/ dkon mchog gi rten la phyag dang mchod pa byas nas/ nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa brtan pos/ byang chub kyi sems yang dang yang du gsos btab nas skyes pa'i dus su/ ba 'jo ba'i tshul du bsdad nas rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog

/chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ slob dpon gyis bsnyen gnas su bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon gyis thabs yin no// slob mas legs so bya/ sdom pa'i rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyid do// yan lag dang po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// gzhan yang sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ma byin pa len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang bcos pa'i chang*/ bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu gar dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ rgyan kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan chen po dang*/ mal stan mthon po dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spangs te/ phyi dro'i kha zas las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la/ ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ brdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu dang gar dang*/ rol mo dang*/ rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan chen po dang*/ mal stan mthon po dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spangs te phyi dro'i kha zas las slar ldog par bgyi'o// yan lag brgyad po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// thabs yin no// legs so// phan yon ni de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid yon tan gyi bstan pa la/

bram ze'i khye'u gnyis kyis bsrungs pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis gnod sbyin lnga la rang gi sha byin nas/ khyed kyis nga la dga' bar shes gyis nas// srog gcod dug bzhin rnam par spang bar gyis// gzhan gyi chung ma dag la bsten pa dang*// gzhan gyi yo byad dag la brlam pa dang*// ku re'i ched du rdzun du smra ba spongs// chang gi btung ba phyi dro'i kha zas rnams// nya stong dus bzhi la ni rtag tu srungs// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar byas pas lnga sde bzang por gyur pa dang*/ byams pa lung bstan pa nyid las/ bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang*// de bzhin zla phyed tshes brgyad dang*// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad bsrung na// nga yi bstan pa lhags par 'gyur// ces pa la sogs pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyang rgya cher bshad par bya'o// ༈ //dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa ni/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen nam/ yongs rdzogs sam/ sna gcig bsrung ba'am/ sna 'ga' bsrung ba'i dge snyen gyi sdom pa gang len kyang*/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par byas nas so so'i rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ slob dpon gyis so so gang gang len pa'i dge bsnyen de dang der gzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum bya/ thabs yin no// legs so bya/ de nas bslab bya brjod pa ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyid do// yan lag dang po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// gzhan yang 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang*/ bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ ma byin pa len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang dang*/ bag med pa'i gnas spang te/ bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog par bgyid do// yan lag lnga po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// thabs yin no// legs so bya/ yongs rdzogs dang sna gcig bsrung ba dang*/ sna 'ga' bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen ni/ so so gang bsrung ba de rjes zlos bya ba'o// phan yon ni/ dge bsnyen chen po li tsā byi dri ma med par grags pas/ jo bo byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs la sogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi 'khor dge slong dge 'dun dang bcas pa zil gyi mnan pa dang*/ slob dpon tsan tra go mi dang*/ dge bshes ston pa la sogs pa ste/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gsha' ma shig yod na btsun po'i go yang des chod/ mtho ris dang thar pa yang des thob gsung ngo*// ༈ //byang chub kyi sems rin po che ni/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi bde skyid zad pa med pa'i gter chen po yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed par bya ste/ de skye bar byed pa'i rgyu ni bzhi ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can byas pa dang*/

tshad med pa bzhis blo sbyangs pa dang*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed pa dang bzhi las smon pa skye bar bzhed la/ de yang jo bos rgyu dang po las skye bar bzhed pas/ kun bzang spyod las gsungs pa yi// mchod pa rnam bdun dag kyang bya// zhes pa'i don bsgoms nas/ stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bsngo ba byas nas slob ma'i blo bcos par bya ste/ 'jig rten 'dir yun ring po mi sdod/ 'chi dgos/ 'chi ba'i rkyen du ma gyur pa ni gang yang med/ shi nas med par mi 'gro/ nyon mongs dug gsum gyis mi dge ba bcu spyad na ngan song gsum du skye/ dge ba bcu la brten nas lha dang mir skyes kyang*/ brel phongs dang ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pas/ rigs drug gar skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin/ de yang rang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa ltar sems can thams cad kyis a ma ma byas pa med pa la/ ma 'di rnams kyang sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*/ sdug bsngal ba 'di rnams thar pa'i thabs sangs rgyas min pa gzhan med/ sangs rgya ba la sems bskyed dgos pa yin byas pa la blo bcos so// de nas bla ma de sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa bsam/ sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bzhag nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs rin po che bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ me tog 'thor/ sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes gsha' mar bzhag

bar 'dir yan lag bdun pa rdzogs par byas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas la ston par bya/ theg pa chen po'i chos la lam du bya/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la lam gyi grogs bya snyam du sems la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i khyad par can gyi rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog don dam pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum bya/ me tog 'thor/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bzhag phan yon ni/ khyad par gyi skyabs su 'gro ba byas nas/ theg pa chen po par tshud pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'i rten du gyur pa dang*/ skyes bu khyad par can de lha dang bcas pa'i mchod pa'i gnas su gyur cing*/ rang nyid tshogs gsog pa dang*/ sdig pa zad pa dang*/ myur du byang chub thob pa lta a cang ches te/ gzhan yang tshogs gsog pa dang*/ sdig pa zad pa dang*/ ngan song las skyob pa dang*/ myur du byang chub thob par byed pa'i phan yon no// bslab bya ni thun mong ba dang mthun no// thun mong ba'i yul gsum ni/ chos sku las dang nyon mongs pa dang bral tsam gyi 'gog pa'i bden pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa/ sprul pa'i sku stag dang ri bong la sogs/ chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ dge 'dun gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong yan chad/ skyes bu zung bzhi dang*/ khyad par ba'i yul gsum ni/ sangs rgyas chos sku 'ba' zhig la 'dod pa la/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig ste// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir// tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug yin// zhes pas so// chos ni rtogs pa'i chos so// dge 'dun dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun/

dus snying po byang chub kyi bar ro// ched du bya ba sems can gyi don du skyabs su 'gro ba'o// 'dir sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes lan gsum bya'o// tshad med pa bzhi la blo sbyang ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can 'di rnams ma yin ang snyam du bsgom/ 'o na ma 'di rnams kyis ngan skyugs thams cad ni kha yis phyags/ gsher ba ni bor/ skam pa ni blangs/ rgya mtsho tsam gyi nu zho ni bsnun/ ri rab tsam gyi bza' rgyu ni byin/ lho sprin tsam gyi gos ni bskon pa'i ma 'di rnams drin re che ang snyam du bsam/ da 'o na drin la lan gyis slan dgos snyam du bsam/ ga re ma 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan na dga' ba la/ rigs drug na sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las med pas/ snying re rje ang snyam du bsam/ 'o na ma 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i don du/ sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du bsams la/ yang bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes lan gsum bya'o// gong gi rten sprul pa dang bla ma la mchod pa bdun po rdzogs par bya'o// zhabs la dngos sam yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ slob dpon gyis bdag byang chub sems dpar bzung du gsol/ lan gsum bya zhing me tog 'thor ro// yang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i don du sems bskyed blang snyam du dung nge bsam nas/ rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/

sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs rin po che bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ ma grol ba rnams bsgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya'o// me tog 'thor/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dung dung pa lan gsum bya'o// de nas yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig rdzogs par bya'o// sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag la dga' ston gyis tshim par bya'o// phan yon dang bslab bya ni/ sems bskyed pa ni sa gzhi dang 'dra ste/ sa gzhi ni rin po che'i 'byung khungs lo thog la sogs pa 'bras bu thams cad bskyed pa dang 'dra bar/ yon tan rin po che thams cad bskyed par byed pa'o// nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ste/ dri ma rnam pa gsum phyis nas dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas phyag byas/ smon lam rnam par dag pa'i gsol ba btab na/ yid la ci bsam pa thams cad 'grub bo// thong gshol dang 'dra ste/ sems tha rgod lta bu 'di zhi ba dang 'bol bar byed do// nyi ma dang 'dra ste/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel zhing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad gsal bar byed do// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ste/ bkres pa dang skom pa sel lo// ljon shing dang 'dra ste/ 'khor ba'i tshad pa thams cad sel bar byed do// dmag dpon dang 'dra ste/ theg pa dman pa la sogs pa'i g.yul ngo thams cad sel bar byed do// zam pa dang 'dra ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i gling du phyin par byed do// bslab bya lnga ni/
