// 325) ༄// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde legs kun gyi gzhi gyur 'dul bar shin tu gces dgos pa// mtho dman nyes pa mang po yis// thams cad mi bder gyur pa na// 'gram dang nye 'gram ji bzhin du// legs par brtags nas bya 'o zhes// de yang thub pa chen pos gsungs// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba des shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa thams cad mngon du gyur pas/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung bar mkhyen cing thugs su chud nas/ las rnams bskal pa brgya yang ni// chud mi za ba tshogs dang dus// rnyed na lus can rnams kyi ni// 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid// ces gsungs pas/ shes bya'i gshis las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa'i 'bras bu bde ba dang sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba/ rang nyid kyis byas shing bsags pa rang nyid kyis so sor myong bar 'gyur ba las/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi la sogs pa gzhan la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur bas/ mtsho chen po ma dros par bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu sngon gyi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa dang*/ 'phags pa gyad bu nor/ sngon khye'u bden smra zhes bya bar gyur ba'i dus su/ mas ma g.yar mo la skur ba btab pa'i tshe gzhi mgo cog pas phye ba de'i rnam par smin pas lo brgya phrag mang po dang*/ lo stong phrag mang por sems can dmyal bar skyes nas las de'i lhag mas tshe rabs lnga brgyar gzhi med pa'i skur ba byung zhing tha mar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa chen po/ nyan thos chen po mchog brgyad kyi mal cha dang stan bsko ba rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa gyad bu nor du gyur kyang*/ mdza' bo dang sa la skyes kyis gzhi med par pham pa dang*/ bag tsam la brten pham pa la sogs pa'i skur ba mang po byung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pas de la bslab par bcas shing thub pa'i 'khor du gtogs pa rnams la rgya cher rnam par grags pa dang*/

pham pa dang lhag ma nyes ltung chen po lta zhog gi/ chu bo gang gā'i 'gram du bcom ldan 'das la/ nya dang rus sbal la sogs pa'i srog chags lnga brgya bskor ba byas pa las 'di dag dud 'gror 'gro ba'i rgyu ci lags zhus pas/ 'di dag sngon thub pa 'od bsrungs kyi bstan pa la/ bslab pa'i gzhi phran tshegs phran tshegs dag nyams pas/ dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes pa la sogs pa lung sman gyi gzhir gsungs pa dang*/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho rgya mtsho'i 'gram du nye tshe ba'i sems can dmyal pa mang po mthong ba dang*/ srog chags thag pa 'dra ba dang*/ gtun 'dra ba dang*/ phyags ma 'dra ba la sogs pa mthong ba rnams bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas/ dge 'dun gyi phyags ma la snabs dang mchil ma bskus pa la sogs pa'i rnam par smin par gsungs pas snabs dang mchil lud bskus pa la sogs pa phran tshegs nyes ltung tsam du yang bcas pa med pa'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang de 'dra na/ skye ba bcad pas e la'i 'dab tu skyes pa lta mos kyang ci dgos pa la skye ba gcod pa ni bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa yin pas ngan song gi nyes pa mi bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' khyad du bsad pas skyes pa yin snyam na/ las mi dge ba che 'bring gsum las 'bras bu sdug bsngal che 'bring gsum 'byung bar gsungs pa shin tu phra ba zhig khyad tu bsad na yang ci ga dkon mchog gsum khyad tu bsad par ma gyur grang*/ de ltar gyur na dkon mchog gsum la brten pas nyes pa cher song bzhag pas chog snyam na yang*/ skyabs dkon mchog spangs pa'i thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde ba lta 'ong ba cang srid dam/ yang 'ga' re legs par bsrung*/ 'ga' re mi thub par 'dug ci 'dod red snyam na yang las 'dres ma gong dang 'dra ste/ de la rang rang shes pa ma gtogs pa sus kyang de la ci zhig bya/ rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams kyis 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che la/

ltung bar rigs mthun pa so so nas bcas pa'i dgos pa spyi dang*/ bye brag rnam pa gnyis te/ spyi ni/ ngas 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol bar bya ba'i phyir chos bstan pa la khyod kyis ci'i phyir mi mdzes pa de lta bu byas par gyur zhes rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' bstsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs nas/ 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ dge 'dun bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ dge 'dun legs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ dge 'dun bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ gnong mi bkur ba'i gang zag rnams tshar bcad par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ ngo tsha shes pa rnams bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mngon par ma dad pa rnams mngon par dad par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mngon par dad pa rnams phyir zhing dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ tshe 'di'i zag pa rnams bsdam par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ tshe rabs phyi ma rnams bzlog par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nga'i tshangs par spyod pa skye bo mang po la phan pa yangs par 'gyur ba lha dang mi'i bar dag la yang dag par bstan pa yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ba'o// zhes pa spyi'i dgos pa gsungs pa dang*/ bye brag gi dgos pa ni/ dge slong rab tu byung ba mang po chos gos mang po 'chang ba dang*/ stan bzang po mang po dang*/ srin bal gyi stan 'ba' zhig nyams su len pas lung 'bogs pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kha ton byed pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang yid la bya ba dang*/ sems kyi zhi gnas gtong bar byed ces/ smad par byed/ 'phya bar byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed nas gso dka' ba dang*/ dgang dka' ba dang*/ 'dod pa che ba dang*/ chog mi shes pa smad cing*/ gso sla ba dang*/ dgang sla ba dang*/ 'dod pa chung ba dang*/

chog shes pa dang*/ phri ba dang*/ yo byad bsnyungs pa dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*/ mdzes pa dang*/ tshod shes pa nyid kyi bsngags pa brjod nas bcas pa ste/ de yang shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan la sogs pa shākya lnga brgya rab tu byung ba las/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti chen po byung nas bden pa ma mthong bas/ smad na dbral dka' bar dgongs nas gdul ba la mkhas pa bla na med pa yin pas/ zla ba gsum nang du yang dag 'jog la bzhag nas su dang yang mi 'phrad pa las/ tshe dang ldan pa nye sde dang mjal bas/ nye sde gang gis khyod mdzes pa dang 'khor mdzes pa dang ldan par gyur/ btsun pa bdag gi drung du rab tu 'byung 'dod pa zhig 'ongs na de la sbyangs pa'i yon tan rnams gnas par gyis shig ces brjod cing bsngags pa yang brjod par byed do// gal te de ltar bgyi'o zhes mchi na de rab tu 'byin par bgyid do// gal te bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal ba dang*/ gnas la zhugs pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kha 'don dang*/ yid la bgyi ba la zhugs pa zhig mchi na/ de la tshur dgon pa dang*/ bsod snyoms pa dang*/ chos gos gsum pa dang*/ phyag dar khrod pa dang*/ shing drung pa tshol cig ces mchi zhing shing drung ba nyid kyi bsngags pa yang brjod par bgyid do// gal te de ltar bgyi'o zhes mchi na de la yid la bgyi bar gsol bar bgyid/ de btsun pa gang gis bdag mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa dang ldan pa'i rgyu ni de lags/ rkyen ni de lags so// zhes pa dang*/ legs so zhes pa gnang nas sbyangs pa'i yon tan de dag gi bsngags pa mi brjod pa ni nga'i bsngags pa mi brjod cing brjod pa ni nga'i bsngags pa brjod do// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ nye sde ngas dge slong dgon pa la dgon pa'i yongs su spang ba sbyin par bya ste/ dge slong dgon pa la de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir ltar 'gro ba'i dus ma yin pa med do// dge slong bsod snyoms pa dang*/

rnyed pas chog pa'i bsod snyoms pa dang*/ zas phyis mi len pa dang*/ stan gcig pa dang*/ chos gos gsum pa dang*/ phying ba pa dang*/ phyag dar khrod pa dang*/ shing drung pa dang*/ dur khrod pa dang*/ tsog bu pa dang*/ bla gab med pa dang*/ gzhi ji bzhin pa rnams la spang ba sbyin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir 'gro ba'i dus ma yin pa med do zhes gsungs pas/ shākya rnams kyi yo byad spangs nas chos gos gsum par byas nas bden pa mthong bas bar chad/ mdor na lhag pa'i yo byad tsam gyis bar chad du 'gyur ba dang*/ der yang ma zad de 'jig rten gyi mngon par shes pa lnga'i bar chad du yang g.yang gzhi dang*/ shing shun dang*/ dbyug gu dang ril pa la sogs pa lhag pa'i yo byad kyi bar du gcod par ston pa lkug phye'i skyes rabs su gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang ltung ba so so'i bye brag dge slong don nyung ba rnams dang*/ khyim pa dang mu stegs can rnams kyis 'di la nyes dmigs 'di dang 'di dag yod ces rnam par smad pa de nyid rgyur mdzad nas bkag pa ni bye brag gi dgag bya rnams te/ de yang ston pa thams cad mkhyen pas bde ba dang legs pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa 'dul ba'i sde snod 'di shin tu gces pa dang*/ chos dang 'dul ba ma yin pa'i skyon gyi mi nub par bya ba'i phyir/ gnas 'di dang 'di zhes bya bar/ ston pa tshul 'di ltar bzhugs pa'i dus su dge slong 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba la nyes ltung 'di dag byung ba las spyi bye brag gi dgag dgos gsungs nas 'di ltar mi bya ste/ byas na nyes pa dang ltung bar gsungs pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa chen po la sogs pa rnams la 'di ltar gnang ba'i rgyu mtshan gtan tshigs dang bcas pa gsungs so// de dag kyang mdor bsdus nas bsam pa nyon mongs pa gang yin pa ni nyon mongs pa'o// des kun nas bslang nas lus ngag gi bya ba mthar thug pa ni ltung ba ste las so// las des 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ngan song gsum du ltung ba'o// nyes pa dang ltung ba spangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyis byas pa ni dge ba'o// las dge ba des gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu lha dang mi'i bde ba dang*/
mthar thug byang chub rnam pa gsum don du gang gnyer ba de thob par shes par bya'o// //

326) ༄// 'dul ba'i bslab bya gsal ba'i me long*// dang por byang chub sems bskyed nas// bskal ba chen po grangs med gsum// thub pas pha rol phyin pa la// ji ltar spyad par gyur pa yis// byang chub ji ltar brnyes pa dang*// thub pa'i nyan thos chen po rnams// smon lam ji ltar btab pa yis// 'bras bu ji ltar byung ba dang*// lha sbyin byas pa mi gzo bas// rdzu 'phrul stobs las nyams nas kyang*// ston pas sngon gyi tshe rabs su// byas pa mi gzo la sogs pa// blun zhing rmongs par bstan pa dang*// mi dge ba yi bshes gnyen la// ma skyes dgra yis bsten pa yis// mtshams med lnga la sogs pa yi// nyes pa rnams kyis gos pa dang*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yis// nyes pa'i skyon dang bral ba rnams// dge 'dun dbyen gyi gzhi rnams su// shin tu rgyas par bshad pa dang*// mdor na dkar nag las rnams kyis// rgyu las 'bras bu bstan nas kyang*// des na dge slong khyed kyis kyang*// byas pa gzo bar bya ba dang*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*// sdig pa'i grogs po spang ba dang*// nag po'i las rnams spang ba dang*// dkar po'i las rnams thams cad la// khyed kyis bslab par bya'o zhes// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bka' bstsal pa// thub pa'i 'dul ba'i sde snod las// lhag pa'i tshul khrims bslab pa la// nan tan chen pos bslab pa yis// 'bras bu byang chub thob par bya// ༈ //na mo ratna gu ru// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi// bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang*// las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te// tshogs shing dus la bab pa na// lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin// zhes gsungs nas 'bras bu bde ba dang sdug bsngal da ltar smin pa rnams kyi rgyu 'di ni 'di yin zhes gsungs nas/ yang rjes la dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu gnag

gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi yang gcig tu dkar/ 'dres ma rnams kyi yang 'dres ma'o// dge slong dag de ltar bas na las gcig tu gnag pa dang 'dres ma rnams spangs te/ las gcig tu dkar ba dag kho na la brtsal 'bad bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis bslab par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de la nag po nag po gang zhe na/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gsum bsam pa nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag gi bya ba mthar thug pa la las zhes bya ste/ las dang nyon mongs pa de de las bzlog pa/ de'i gnyen por 'gro ba'i thabs ma bsten na 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur te/ de yang chen pos dmyal ba/ 'bring gis yi dwags/ chung ngus dud 'gro'i skye gnas 'bras bu shin tu gnag pa 'byung ste/ de yang shes bya'i babs la sngon 'jig rten chags pa'i dus su/ 'od gsal gyi lha 'dzam bu'i gling du lhung bas/ bdud rtsi sa zhag mdzub mo thor thos lce la myangs pa'i ro'i sred pa la chags pas/ de nyid kyis mir gyur pa la sogs pa gsungs pa dang*/ dge slong lhung bzed la chags pas me gsum dus gcig 'bar ba la sogs pa 'dod pa la bsten pas ni mi dge ba cung zad kyang mi byed pa med do// zhes gsungs pa dang 'dra bar ltung ba sde lnga nyon mongs pa che 'bring rnam pa gsum gyi las 'bras bu yang de ltar 'gyur bar las dang 'bras bu rnam pa gzhag pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes can/ thams cad mkhyen pa kho nas mkhyen pa'i lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che'o// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon bsnyen par rdzogs pa bcu byung ba las/ 'dir mkhan po dang slob dpon 'os pa dang*/ dge 'dun mthun pas gsol ba dang gzhi'i las mi g.yo ba bsnyen par rdzogs par byas pa las bar chad gsum las/ skye ba'i bar chad klur sprul pa dang*/ pha ma bsad pa'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa la lus 'dis yon tan gong ma skye ba la bar du gcod par gsungs pa dang*/

gnas pa la bar du gcod pa yang bran dgra bcom pa thob pa dang*/ dge tshul gnyis kyis bsam pa na 'phos pas mthar dgra bcom pa la sogs pa yang shes par bya ba dang*/ mdzes pa ni mdzes pa'i bar chad nyid du gsungs pa'o// gzhan yang yul mtha' 'khob kyi gro bzhin skyes kyis nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba'i rgyu 'bras zhib par gsungs pas go bar byas la mkhas pas rab tu dbyung bar bya'o// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// btsun mo gsum la sogs pa yi// bud med drug khri spangs nas ni// dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu la// thub pa khyim nas rab tu byung*// lo drug dka' ba spyad nas ni// dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga la// byang chub snying por bzhugs nas ni// ji srid zag med ma thob par// de srid dkyil krung bshig mi bya// de yis ji srid zag med pa// ma brnyes dkyil krung 'jig mi mdzad// mgon po byang chub sangs rgyas nas// wā rā ṇa sīr gshegs nas kyang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe// lnga pa dang ni nye lnga dang*// mtho ba lnga bcu rab tu byung*// ral pa can gyi tshang gshegs nas// bzang sde'i tshogs ni drug cu byung*// sde 'dong grong du gshegs nas kyang*// bu mo dga' mo dga' stobs gnyis// bden pa dag la rab tu bzhag /lteng rgyas gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// ral pa can stong rab tu phyung*// ga ya mgo yi mchod rten du// dge slong stong po de dag la// cho 'phrul gsum gyi gdams ngag gis// mya ngan 'das la rab tu bkod// ltang 'brang tshal seb gshegs nas kyang*// rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang*// lha yi tshogs rnams brgyad khri dang*// ma ga dha yi bram ze dang*// khyim bdag 'bum phrag du ma rnams// lhan cig bden pa dag la bkod// 'o ma'i tshal du gshegs nas kyang*// shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal bu// bram ze stong rings rab tu phyung*// de yi tshe na dge slong rnams// bsnyen pa tshur shog gis rdzogs pas// 'ga' zhig rab tu 'byung 'dod nas// ring po'i lam nas 'ongs pa las// bar ma dor ni rgyun chad cing*// shi bar gyur ba'i gnas skabs rnams// dge slong rnams kyi gsol ba dang*// thub pa thugs rje chen po yis// ring po lam nas 'ongs pa rnams// dal bar gzigs nas dge 'dun la// bsnyen par rdzogs par gnang bar mdzad// der yang de dag ma bsdams pas// mkhan po dang ni slob dpon la// rab tu 'byung ba nyid du gnang*// slob dpon rnam pa lnga nyid de// dge tshul gsang ste las kyi dang*// gnas dang klog pa'i slob dpon no// mkhan po gnyis te gang zhe na// rab tu 'byin par byed pa dang*// bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'o//

// 327) ༄// bcom ldan 'das ko'u sham bi dbyangs ldan gyi kun dga' ra bar zhes pa// bcom ldan 'das ko'u sham bi dbyangs ldan gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so// de yi dus su gdug pa dang*// gtum zhing pha rol gnon pa yi// dge slong sde snod gsum pa gnyis// phyogs dang bcas pas phan tshun du// mthun par mi smra'i brtul zhugs kyis// yangs pa can dang ko'u sham bir// phyogs bzung rtsod pa byed pa las// ston pa thugs rje chen po yis// phan tshun dge 'dun mi mthun zhing*// 'thab dang rtsod pa skye 'gyur na// ltung ba la sogs mi 'dod pa// gleng gzhi dran par mi bya 'o// de skad gsungs kyang ma btub nas// gso sbyong byed par gyur pa yang*// gso sbyong ma yin par byed nas// 'thab dang rtsod par byed pa yis// dge 'dun las rnams 'khrugs pa dang*// tha dad du ni gnas par gyur// tha dad rnam pa gnyis yin te// rang nyid rtsod pa'i sar song dang*// gnas nas dbyung bar byas pa 'o// mthun par gnas pa gnyis yin te// rang nyid mthun par gnas pa dang*// tshogs kyis mthun par bzhag pa 'o// de ltar gsungs kyang ma btub nas// phan tshun brdeg la zhugs pa dang*// khyim gyi nang du zhugs pa'i tshe// phan tshun brdeg par mi 'gyur ba'i// bstan la bar chad bya 'o gsungs// yang bka' bstsal pa/ tshig mi mthun la phyogs mnyam yang*// 'di gtso min zhes sems byed pa// dge 'dun dbye bar gyur na ko// de la sogs pa gsungs gyur kyang*// dge slong rnams kyis 'di skad ces// bde gshegs chos kyi rje lags te// bdag cag tshig ngan mi bzod ces// smras pa'i don la ma dgyes nas// de tshe rgyal ba mkha' la gshegs// chos rje thub pa chen po yis// bcu gnyis lo yi grangs snyed du// 'thab rtsod byed la btang snyoms mdzod// ko'u sham bi yi khyim bdag rnams// bcom ldan 'das dang ma mjal ba'i// nyes pa'i le lan bsam pa yis// dge slong rnams la mi smra zhing*// bsod snyoms bcad pas de rnams kyang*// ston pa'i drung du mnyan yod lhags// de tshe dge slong kun dga' bos// ji ltar bya ba zhus pa dang*// lag brdas gnas mal tha ma zhig

/bstan par bya ba ma gtogs par// mi smra phebs par mi smra zhing*// mi blta rnam par mi blta 'o// bdag cag rgas na ci yi phyir// gnas mal tha ma sbyin zhe na// tshul dang spyod pa log bsgrubs pas// ston pa'i thugs ma dgyes pa yis// khyed cag dge sbyong yin nam smros// go'u tam mi la stan dang ni// khyim bdag bsod snyoms byin pa las// gzhan du bya ba gong du 'dra// de ltar byas pas dge slong rnams// chos bzhin mthun pa'i blo skyes pas// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa// gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong gis// dge 'dun rnams la dbyung bar gsol// gsol ba dang ni las byas pas// dge 'dun mthun par bya ba ste// mthun pa byin pa'i dge 'dun dang*// mthun par las rnams bya ba ste// mi mthun byed na 'gal tshabs can// bkra shis mthun pa'i gso sbyong la// mi bde ba la gso sbyong la// gzhan du byed na 'gal tshabs can// // 328) ༄// sku gsum rang bzhin la skur ba btab na rang phung bar 'gyur zhes pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ chos kun mnyam nyid gdod nas rang bzhin rnam par dag pa thugs chud pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug de ni tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag po yin// skyes mchog de yi drung du gnas pa rnams kyang shin tu dag par 'gyur ba ste// ma dag yod pa mi srid yod par yang ni mi mthong na// 'khrul pa nying 'khrul can khyod 'gro rnams sku gsum rang bzhin la// nyes pa'i skur ba mang po btab pas rang gzhan phung bar gyur pas na// dpe med rin po che khyod rang nyid rtag tu bsrung bar rigs pa yin// khyod la 'jig rten mgon pos snang ba sems dang de nyid ma bstan tam// // 329) ༄// zab gsang rtogs par 'dod na rtsa ba'i bla mar nges shes skye dgos par bstan pa// dad pa log ltar ma song ba/ bsod nams bdud du ma song ba/ tshogs gsog phung 'drer ma song ba/ sgrub pa 'dre sgrub tu ma song ba/

byas tshad sdug bsngal du ma song ba zhig dgos/ sku nam mkha' rang bzhin yang mi 'dod la/ zhing khams thams cad du gdul bya la cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa/ gsung brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin yang mi 'dor la/ zhing khams thams cad du dbyangs kyis go bar mdzad pa/ thugs spros pa thams cad dang bral yang*/ dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa mkhyen pa ni sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'o// gsang ba zab mo rtogs 'dod na// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de// sangs rgyas kyi nges shes skyes na go// go ba brjod du med par gnas// // 330) ༄// tug gis thug pa'i dus su bcu chos dang sum chos gar song ngam zhes shrī phug pa la gnang ba// dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo bla ma rin chen dang*// des gsungs dam chos 'dod chags bral ba'i rin chen dang*// thub pa'i dge 'dun dul zhing nyer zhi rin chen dang*// rin chen dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan rin po ches/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po la gdams pa/ bdag nyams myong can yin/ phag mo gru'i gdan sa spyan lam du gzigs pa de la/ da 'di na phar la mi thon/ sdug par 'dug snyam pa'i bsam rkyang des nga'i lag pa bud/ mi de tsam zhig shi ba nyid la thugs rgyus mnga'/ bdag 'chi nges pa'i nad ma rungs pa mang du byung ba la/ dge 'dun la sku'i rim gro bcol bas tshegs med par phan par byung*/ phan par 'dug myong bas grub/ khyed kyi bka' shog bstod pa dang bcas pa de la phra ma khyer dogs pa'i bka' bkyon de la bdag shin tu 'jigs par byung*/ 'ga'i dus ngan chen po de dang thug pa dge 'dun grongs pa 'di ma lan na rung ste snyam pa'i bsam pa byung*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas da lta phan chad du 'khor rnams kyi nang du yo byad phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel gyi gang zag re re 'ong*/ dper na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la/

bu 'khor btsun mo rin po che mang yang*/ nor gyi dgos pa khyim bdag rin po ches bsgrub pa yin/ rje sgam po pa'i zhabs tog sgrub byed gdod mtha' bar gsum du/ bla ma chen po dpal gnas nang pa 'di yin par 'dug de la ngas kyang rtog pa cung zad skyes pa'i dus su yang nor la bor ral chen po 'byung bar 'dug khyed kyi nor la bor ral byung ba yang bdag gi zhabs tog tu yab sras gnyis la 'gran sems dang rnam par rtog pa byung ba ni cang srid dam/ sngon khyed nyid kyi zhal nas/ dred mo gcig sha za ba mthong bas rkang pa brgyad pa'i bstod pa byas shing phar ded gsung*/ de la dgos pa ci yod byas pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs zer/ de'i tshod la de ltar gyur na dred mo dang*/ dgra dang gnod pa byed mkhan rnams dpal he ru kar byas nas de la bstod pa ma yin nam/ tug gis thug pa'i dus su bcu chos dang sum chos zab mo de gar song ang*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyob mdzad mi gcig chos kyi rje// mgon po dpal ldan rin po che// de yi gcig shos de 'dra na// gzhan gyi gcig shos ci 'dra ang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// bar chad bdud kyi tshogs la sogs// lha dang bla ma gnyis med pa// snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*// bcud kyi sems can yi dam lha// mgon po phag mo gru pas gsung*// kwa re dga' re skyid tho le rgyal// bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba'i gnas// mi zad lhun grub gter chen 'di// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// 'gro bas byang chub mchog thob shog /mgon po de la phyag 'tshal lo// shrī ri phug pa// // 331) ༄// tshul khrims rin po che la gces spras srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ba shākya'i zhu chos// oṃ swasti/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sdug bsngal chu srin 'dzin khris gang ba las// thabs dang shes rab mchog gi gru yis pha rol sgrol mdzad pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos rje phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs la spyi bos gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// thub pa'i bstan la gces spras mdzad gyur cing*// gong ma'i rjes bslab 'gro ba smin mdzad pa'i// gces pa'i bu yis bdag la zhus pa 'dir// gong ma'i gsung sgros cung zad bri bar bya// spyir bdag cag thams cad kyi 'dug lugs mi'i lus 'di thob kyang*/

thob par ni dka'/ blo gtad ni med/ 'jig par ni sla/ chu'i chu bur dang khyad par med par 'dug pas/ tshe 'di'i che thabs dang*/ bzang thabs dang*/ nga 'o dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ chos brgyad sna tshogs bsgrub par mi bya ste/ bsgrubs kyang 'grub par yang dka'/ rgya la gal te grub kyang nyes pa sna tshogs bskyed par byed pa ma gtogs pa/ phan pa dang bde ba 'byung ba mi srid pas 'jig rten pha rol gyi don bsam par bya'o// de la 'jig rten pha rol gyi don dang*/ tshe 'di'i don dang*/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad kyi so nams lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che 'di ma gtogs pa mi srid de/ de ltar yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu kun gyi sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pas/ tshul khrims rin po che 'di dag gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad kyi yon tan thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i rten yin la/ ngan song gsum las thar bar byed pa yang tshul khrims/ mtho ris lha dang mi'i go 'phang thob par byed pa yang tshul khrims/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po thob par byed pa yang tshul khrims/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob pa yang tshul khrims/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po sa nas sar 'phar zhing*/ sa bcu rgyun gyi mtha' ma la gnas shing dbang bskur ba thob par byed pa yang tshul khrims/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad thob pa yang tshul khrims 'ba' zhig tu gsungs pas/ tshul khrims rin po che la nan tan dang gces spras shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu 'tshal/

'o na de ltar gyur na tshul khrims gcig pu bsrungs pa la/ mtho dman gyi rim pa de tsam du 'gyur ba de ci yin snyam na/ so so'i zhe 'dod kyi bsam pa so so gang 'dod pa'i tshul khrims bsrungs pas 'bras bu de thob par 'gyur gyi/ tshu rol mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i shes rab kyis ni rgyud ma sbyangs/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa dang yang ma phrad/ bka' dang bstan bcos rgya mtsho chen po lta bu la shes rab kyi mig dang bral ba'i rten gyi gang zag kha cig mi dge ba rnam pa bcu spong ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ nyan thos ngan pa 'ba' zhig gi chos yin te/ theg pa chen po'am gsang sngags gang gi yang chos 'di ma yin zhes log par zhugs pa/ lta ba log pa/ lam log pa/ spyod pa log pa rnams kyis snying po phyin ci log pa 'di 'dor zhing nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ chos ma yin pa mtha' dag nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag de dag gi rjes su 'brang bar mi bya zhing tshig tsam yang mnyan par mi bya'o// de yang 'dir theg pa chen po gsang sngags rang gzhung gi dbang du byas na/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po las/ tshul khrims 'chal la sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba ni// yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no// zhes pa dang*/ yang rgyud chen po de nyid las/ ji ltar shing ta la'i mgo bcad na skyer mi rung ba dang 'dra bar/ tshul khrims 'chal bas sngags bsgrub pa yang de dang 'dra bar gsungs pa dang*/ yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las kyang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ni mi dge ba bcu spong ba 'di nyid yin no// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad nas kyang*// dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin// zhes pa'i don bla ma rdo rje slob dpon las dang po thob pa'i bslab pa'i gnas bcu 'di spangs la de'i rjes la gzhan gcig bya'o bya ba ma yin te/

'di rten du bzhag nas dgyes pa rdo rje bslab ces pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ ltung ba gnyis pa bde gshegs bka' 'das kyi ltung ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang bral ba yin te/ shan 'dra ba phyogs su bsdu la sogs pa ni phyogs snga mar mdzad pa dang*/ gsang sgo yal bar mi dor ces pa'i don yang mi dge ba rnam pa bcu spong pa 'di nyid gzhir gyur pa dang*/ mdor na rang nyid ngang du 'dug cing dge ba bcu rgyun spyad na/ sangs rgyas bar chad kun dang rnam par bral ba yin// zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa rang gis nges la/ 'dir bdag nyid chen po de nyid mya ngan 'da' kha na dug gi sngags rno ba nyams myong dang bcas pa yod pa la sman rta chang zhig gtong bar zhus pas/ 'di srog gi phyir yang mi rung zhes nyid kyi sku srog yal bar btang nas chang sun gcig kyang ma gsol ba 'di ni bdag cag thams cad kyi mngon du gyur cing grags pa yin pas/ tshul khrims rin po che rang gi srog dang bsdos la nan tan chen pos nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'o na theg pa chen po dang theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gcig tu bzhed pa/ nyan thos pa dang 'jig rten pa dang 'dra'am snyam na ma yin te/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rjes su 'brangs nas tshul khrims bsrungs pas/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims gzhir bzhag nas/ sems can don byed dang*/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dbyer med du gyur pas/ dus ci 'os gcig na sangs rgya zhing*/ gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi rang bzhin du gnas nas tshul khrims bsrungs pas na/ sgyogs dang 'khrul 'khor ji bzhin du/ tshe 'di'am bar do'am myur bar sangs rgyas par gsungs pa yin te/ chu gcig pu la 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsir sbyor ba yang chu yin/ ja dang chang du sbyor ba yang chu yin/

gzhan dang gzhan dag du btung ba'i bya ba byed pa yang chu yin pa dang 'dra ste/ zhi ba 'dod pa rnams gong nas gong du 'phags par 'gyur zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas stobs bcu'i spyod yul du gyur pa thob nas/ tshul khrims nyams pa med pas tshul khrims rin po che 'di 'ba' zhig la nan tan dang gces spras shin tu che bar nyams su blang bar bya'o// yang thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi don phyin ci ma log pa'i dgongs pa/ sems can dmyal ba 'di dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dmyal bar rtag pa zhig yin nam/ 'on te thar pa'i gnas skabs kyang yod snyam du bsam par bya'o// rtag pa ni mi srid de/ 'dus byas g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gang la yang rtag pa med// ces pa dang*/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa zhes de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi bkas bcad pas/ dmyal ba yang 'dus byas yin pas mi rtag pa yin mod/ de ltar mi rtag nas mtho ris lha dang mi'i go 'phang thob pa'am/ yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas su na 'phar bar byed pa 'di gang gis byed snyam du bsam par bya'o// de yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'od zer gyi bskul yang rung*/ rang gi blo stobs kyis rang rgyud la skyes kyang rung ste/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sam/ zhe sdang ngam/ gti mug pa gang yang rung ba zhig spangs pas/ de las skyes pa'i ma chags pa'am/ zhe sdang med pa'am/ gti mug med pa rnam pa gsum gang rung gis/ dmyal ba nas gong du thon pa ma gtogs pa mi srid pas/ 'di'i skabs su tshul khrims rin po che 'di la so sor thar pa zhes ming 'dogs pa lags pas/ ngan song las thar bar byed pa yang tshul khrims gzhan gong du snyan du gsol ba dang 'dra bar/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan dang bde skyid thams cad bskyed par byed pa tshul khrims rin po che 'ba' zhig yin la/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/

shes rab rnam par grol ba dang*/ zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral bas sems dang shes rab rnam par grol ba dang*/ gti mug 'dod chags dang bral bas sems dang shes rab rnam par grol bar gsungs pa dang*/ yang chags pa'i bsam pa brnab sems kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las mi dge bas yi dwags la sogs pa dang*/ gnod sems gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las mi dge bas dmyal ba la sogs pa dang*/ log par lta ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las mi dge bas dud 'gro la sogs pa'i skye gnas gsum mam/ che 'bring chung gsum gyi dbye ba la sogs pas ngan song gsum la che 'bring chung gsum ji lta ba bzhin du 'byung zhing*/ mtho ris su skyes kyang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po nga la nus/ brgya byin gsad snyam pa'i bsam pa gcig gis 'dzam bu gling du lhung zhing mar sar gyi gong bu bzhin du zhu ba dang*/ mdor na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sa nas sar 'phar ba'i bar du gcod pa yang a cang che ste/ tshul khrims rnam par dag cing mthar ma thug na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mi thob la sangs rgyas pa'i bar du gcod par yang 'gyur na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ skyes bu chen po khyod kyis byang chub kyi sems sam theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor la gnas par byas nas/ tshul khrims rin po che la gces spras dang nan tan shin tu che bar byas te/ srog gi phyir yang btang bar mi bya'o// yang thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che bsrung ba yang 'di nyid yin te/ de ltar yang 'das ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad/ nyams len lhag pa tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab rnam pa gsum las gzhan med de/ de ltar yang nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las mi dge ba spangs pa las/

lhag pa ting nge 'dzin skye la/ ting nge 'dzin de las/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor// rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub// ces pas/ ting nge 'dzin las lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dus gsum la chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i ye shes/ rig pa gsum man chad thob par gsungs pa yin pas/ khyed nyid kyi thugs rgyud la ji ltar du bzhugs pa'i tshul khrims rin po che de dang*/ de las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ de las byung ba'i shes rab mngon par rtogs pa gsum po de ni bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum yin pas de la nan tan dang gces spras shin tu che bar mdzad pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa yang 'dis 'grub/ 'khor ba dang ngan song sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las kyang 'dis grol/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan dpag tu med pa thams cad kyang 'di las skye ba yin pas/ khyed kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di/ nan tan shin tu che bar bsrung bar zhu ba dang*/ gzhan yang rang la gnod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs su gyur pa thams cad la byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang bzod pa'i stobs chen po la gnas nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar chad du mi 'gro ba'i kha smras skyid sdug mtho dman thams cad la khong ji ltar 'dod pa'i rjes su btang ba dang*/ rdzas dang yo byad zang zing ci rigs pas rjes su bsdu ba dang*/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum la ci rigs par dgongs par bya yi/ mi rigs pa'i gnod pa sna tshogs kyis gnod par ni mi bya zhing bzod par ni bya ste/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ snying rjer ldan pa grong khyer 'jug pa na// bzod pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// bzod pa'i stobs kyis mi yi seng ge rnams// lhag pa nyid ces bzod pa'i stobs sgra sgrogs// zhes gsungs pas/

bzod pa'i stobs la nan tan che bar 'bad par bya ba dang*/ skyid sdug mtho dman nyes pa ji ltar byung yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi stobs la gnas nas bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi shugs kyis/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che gsum la mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod cing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyal ba'i yum dang*/ 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i rgyun bya zhing tshul khrims dang ldan pas bklag par bya ba dang*/ khyad par du rang la gnod pa sgrub cing*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs rgya chen pos gnod pa cher byung na 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog rgyun du bya zhing mchod pa dang gsol ba rgya chen po byas pas gnod pa thams cad rang shugs kyis zhi ba dang*/ yang na rgyal bar 'gyur ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi bka' yin te the tshom med do// a ye a ye i mo snying gtam cig /bzlas na zhe la e 'jog ang*// zhe la bzhag na dga' ba la// lag len byas na gsal bar mchi// deng sang dus kyi dge bshes rnams// sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu yi// mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*// mkhyen pa'i stobs dang nyams myong stobs// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bla ma dang*// 'jig rten gsum mgon ston pa yi// rjes su 'brang bar byed pa dang*// mchod cing gsol ba mi 'debs par// dman pa'i nang na dman pa nyid// nyon mongs rtog pas dkrugs pa yi// 'khor dang g.yog dang yang g.yog dang*// mi chos log par zhugs pa dang*// rmongs pas rang nyid phung rnams la// blo gtad snying bzhag byas nas kyang*// de dag ci gsung bka' bzhin du// mi chos 'dun ma dmag dang dmu// rdzas dang yo byad ci yod rnams// nyon mongs gsum gyi dbang du gtong*// ngan song gsum gyi rgyu 'bras sgrub// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi// nyes tshogs phyin ci log bsgrubs pas// mtho bar 'gyur ba mi srid de// nyams su len par byed pa rnams// de rnams pas kyang ngan par 'gyur// de nas je ngan je ngan du// ngan pa'i chu yis khyer nas kyang*// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i gting du 'gro// deng sang dus kyi dge bshes kyi// thugs dgongs mdzad spyod ma lags sam// kye ho dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa// sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod rnams// ston pa'i gsung dang mthun par mdzod// khyed la gzhen bskul mi 'tshal kyang*// nyid kyi bka' bstsal zhu don rnams// bdag gi nye gnas rgyal ba'i sras// mnyes pa gsum gyis bla ma yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs byed pa// shākyas yang yang zhus pa las// bris pa'i dge ba gang yin des// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog
/rdzogs so// //

332) ༄// sems nyid rtogs par mos gus tshad du bskyal ba las gzhan bya thabs med par bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi padmor rab btud nas// ji ltar gsungs pa'i don 'dir bri/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i zhal snga nas/ yi ge zhig skur gsungs pa'i ngos nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rab thams cad kyi snying po/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa cig dang mjal nas/ de la mos gus tshad du bskyal ba ma gtogs pa gzhan med par gsungs te/ de ltar yang dpal sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs padmor 'dud// ces pa dang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes bcom ldan dgyes mdzad nas gsungs pas/ khyed nyid kyi bla ma dam pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ nged rin po che'i bu slob du gyur pa thams cad kyi spyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po cher bzhugs shing*/ bdag nyid kyi yang bla mar gyur cing gsol ba rgyun chad med par 'debs pa'i rten du gyur pa/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stongs kyi bar du/ bdag nyid chen po de dag gi g.yog tu gyur cing skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar smon lam btab pa rin po che smra ba dang*/ rin po che sgos lung ba rnam pa/ khyed rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam par bzhugs par 'dug khong rnam pa las kyang rang gi sems kyi de kho na nyid mngon par rtogs pa mi skye ba ni gtan mi srid/ sems kyi de kho na nyid de las ma gtogs pa mthar thug pa'i dam pa'i chos/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis btsal yang rnyed par mi srid cing*/

der ma 'dus pa yang med par bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyal ba'i yum rgyas par/ rnam par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid shes na/ chos thams cad kyi mdo dang rgyas pa shes par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa de'i don/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu yin gsung pa'i don/ thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi brjod bya de las gzhan ma mchis par/ bdag nyid chen po khyed kyi thugs la gzhag par bya'o// de gong nas gong du bogs 'don pa dang*/ gegs sel ba rnam pa gnyis yin te/ sems nyid rang bzhin rnam dag ni// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun// sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig la// bdud dang bgegs dang bar chod ces// rmongs pa log par gang rtog pa// yod rtog rjes su 'brang mi bya// stong pa nyid kyis stong nyid la// bar du gcod par mi byed ces// bcom ldan rgyal ba'i yum du gsungs// rtag tu goms pa'i man ngag yin// zab pa'i gegs sel bstan pa'o// gnad kyi bogs 'don bstan pa ni// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// gong du bstan pa'i bla ma la// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen nyid// sku gsum lhun gyis grub par blta// nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa na// rdo rje 'chang chen nyid du 'gyur// des na bla ma dam pa la// mnyes pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// mnyes par bya zhing mchod pas mchod// mnyes pa bsdus nas rnam gsum ste// sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes pa ni// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab ces// pha rol phyin drug bstan pa 'di// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// brjod bya mthar thug snying po yin// rtogs pa skyes pa'i rnal 'byor la// 'di las gzhan pa'i bya rgyu med// byar med chen po skad pa de// rang snying dpang du btsugs pa yin// dam pa'i chos bzhin byed pa ni// byar med chen po'i rnal 'byor yin// chos dang mthun na zhabs tog yin// longs spyod g.yo ba thams cad kyis// mchod par byed pa smos ci dgos// 'di ltar nyams su blangs gyur na// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*// tshe 'dir thob pa ma dka' na// gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal// skyes chen khyed kyis thugs la zhog

/'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /rdzogs so// // 333) ༄// dge bshes bsam gtan pa'i spyan sngar gsungs pa dkar po bsam grub zhes pa// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma rin po ches/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bsam gtan pa'i spyan sngar zhu ba/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'dun ma thams cad byang chub kyi sems la 'dri ba ma gtogs pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la yang mi mnga'/ sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la yang mi mnga' bar nges so// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyu bzang po des lam bzang po bgrod nas 'bras bu bzang po sangs rgyas pa'i phyir ro// yang de la don mthong rnam par shes// de yi khyad par sems las byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ don mthong ba byang chub kyi sems/ de yi khyad par gyi chos lus kyi las dang ngag gi las dang yid kyi las tshan po ches mthong chos su myur du 'byung ba'am/ skye ba 'di la 'gyur la skyes nas myong 'gyur tshe phyi ma la myong ba dang*/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur skye ba mang po la myong ba gsum du gsungs kyang*/ sems bkol ba las su rung ba/ rnal 'byor pa rnams ni sems bskyed pa tsam gyis 'grub ces pa gtan tshigs dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas/ khyed rang nyid kyi sems la 'dri zhing sems kyi dbang bsgyur ba lags par ni thugs su chud pa las/ nga la drir ci yod/ lung dang rigs pa'i nyams myong gis// gtan la phab pa'i dam chos 'di// gong ma rnams kyis nyams su blangs// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don chen grub// bslu ba med pa thugs la zhog /rgya la gal te rnal 'byor pas// yag yag thang thang 'dra ba yi// tshe 'di 'dun mas byas pa rnams// mi dge sdig pa'i bsam pa yis// byas pa'i dge ba 'dod pa ni// me phung nang gi padma bzhin// 'grub par 'gyur pa srid ma yin// ji ltar 'o ma zangs gang du// sran ma tsam gyi dug gis kyang*// thams cad ma rungs gyur ba ni// bdag gi nyams su myong bas grub// kwa a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// log pa'i rtog pas nga re bslus// 'khrul pa'i shes pa yi re mug

/snyam pa'i bsam pa yang yang 'byung*// rang la yi mug ga yang chad// dkar po bsam pa sgrub dus su// log rtog can gyi lus ngag yid// sdig pa'i grogs por gyur pa la// sku mtshams bcad cing thag bcad nas// dkar po'i bsam pa bsgrub par bya// dge sems stobs can skye ba'i tshe// dam bca' chen po'i stobs kyis bsgrub// byang chub chen por yang yang bsngo// rlabs po che yi bya ba rnams// kha gtam tshig tu ma shor bar// rgya mtsho'i gting du gsang la bya// thams cad 'grub par the tshom med// gsang ba phyag rgya chen po yi// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /'bul ba bya ba dang*/ 'bul ba blang ba dang*/ bya ba mtha' dag gi gros 'dun lags so// spos kyi rim pa la sogs pa// shugs las byung na dngos grub yin// tung tung byed na ltogs 'gong yin// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyis// sems la gnod pa'i las bcol nas// rang gzhan sdug tu 'jug pa ni// rigs pa ma yin skyes chen khyed// // 334) ༄// bu gcig ri khrod dben pa bsten zhes pa brtul zhugs 'jigs med rdo rje// oṃ swasti/ mgon po dus gsum bdag nyid 'gyur ba med// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs 'gro ba'i mgon// chos rgyal bla ma rin chen mchog nyid kyi// zhabs kyi padmor rtag tu gtsug gis 'dud// mi chos 'brel pa zab mor gyur// lha chos chos la skyes pa'i bu// dad cing gus pa'i gdung shugs kyis// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// lus dang srog la ma bltas par// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// zab dang rgya che dam chos la// nyams myong rtogs pa skyes pa khyed// ji ltar gsungs pa 'di re mad// khyed nyid mi 'chi gdeng thob cing*// skye rga na 'chi sdug bsngal med// a pha a ma nye du dang*// gnyen 'brel thams cad skyong yang dgos// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar yang*// khas blangs dam bcas ku re yin// ba glang mang po'i sa phyogs su// 'bu skad mi 'chad di ri ri// mi skad mi bzlo khyi skad zug

/dgos pa mi byed mi dgos sgrub// su yis khyod la ci bcol nas// smre sngags mang po bya ba kun// shes na da rung mi spong ba// glen pa rang snying mi rje 'am// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa'i// snying po don gyi gdams ngag gis// ri khrod nags khrod gangs khrod du// rang rgyud smin par mi byed pa// a log pa'i shes pa yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pas nga re bslus// kha sbyang sna sbyang dam chos kyi// rang mgo rang gis bskor ba 'di// e ma rang snying mi rje 'am// 'jig rten bya bzhag spros pa kun// khyed pas ngas kyang ma grub cing*// grub kyang dgos pa med pa la// log pa'i mngon zhen sna tshogs kyis// zhen par ma byed ri khrod bsten// bsod snyoms zas dang phyag dar khrod// gang du gnas kyang gzhal yas khang*// su dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lha// sgrub pa snying por mdzad par zhu// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba kun// lta ba rtogs pa'i gdeng yod kyang*// spyod pa brtul zhugs zab mo yis// rang gzhan don kun grub par gsung*// rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas// spyod pa glang po thabs su gces// bka' bstsal gsungs pa 'di re mad// kha ta nyams myong cung zad kyis// grong chog byed pa yi re mug /bu gcig ri khrod dben pa bsten// bsod snyoms kham gang gar yang rnyed// phyag dar khrod kyi gos ni bde// rtsa ba lo ma me tog dang*// 'bras bu rtag tu gnas tsa na// 'dod pa med kyang dbang med du// nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad skye// ku re min na de ltar mdzod// ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis// mun pa sel ba ji bzhin du// nyams rtogs 'od zer drwa ba yis// gdul bya'i padmo kha 'byed cing*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// gdud rgyud 'tshob par byed na de// gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam yin// gzhan du byas pa don med pa// skyes chen khyed kyi thugs la zhog

/zhus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog/ // 335) ༄// sgro skur dang bral ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes shākya'i dge bsnyen 'phan po la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che la lus gus pas phyag 'tshal/ sems dang bas skyabs su 'chi'o// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po bla ma rin po che de nyid kyi bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ dge 'dun gyi sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu/ 'gran gyi do zla thams cad dang bral ba/ 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che mnga' bdag dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi bdag po/ dge 'dun cham phu ba sde ma lag dang bcas pa/ dpon g.yog dang bcas pa/ phyogs ris dang bcas pa thams cad/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i sras dam par bzhugs pa lags/ de ltar gyur pa'i dbang gis rin po che'i bu slob nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bur gyur pa/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa 'jig rten du byung ba bdag cag gi bla ma dam par gyur pa rje btsun rin po che smar pa dang*/ stag lung thang pa dang*/ mchog tu gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po rnams dang*/ nga 'bu 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ dus rnam pa thams cad du thugs la btags shing spyan rgyang gis btsas gces srung pas/ bdag cag ri khrod kyi ldom bu ba/ che ba'i yon tan ni med/ zas bsod snyoms/ gos phyag dar khrod/ gnas ri khrod dang phag phug na yod pa rnams la spyan ras kyi gzigs pas/ dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la shar bas ngar snabs kyang 'od 'tsher ba ltar/ 'gro ba mtho dman 'ga' zhig la cung zad phan par snang ba 'di yang*/ khyed nyid kyis spyan ras kyis gzigs shing thugs la btags pas de ltar gyur pa lags so// de bdag 'khor dang bcas pa shin tu thugs la btags/

phyag yang bzang*/ slad kyis don zhu ba/ mi lus rin po che 'di thob par ni shin tu dka'/ 'jig par ni sla/ 'khor ba ni gting mtha' med/ mi lus thob pa yang rgya mtsho cher yangs gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa 'dra bar gsungs pas/ chos rin po che nyams su blang pa la gces spras shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu/ 'o na de ltar yin mod kyi/ chos de gang yin snyam na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ grub pa thob cing brtul zhugs spyod pa rnams kyi nyams len/ bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis bsgrub pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis gsog pa las gzhan med par gsungs/ de las bsod nams kyi tshogs ni gang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni gang zhe na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa pha rol phyin pa lnga ni bsod nams kyi tshogs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs su gsungs/ yar zhing dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang bla ma la pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lngas mchod cing nyams su blangs pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin zhes kyang gsungs/ lam nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na bla ma dam pa zhing dag ste/ de mnyes par byas pas tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug par gsungs te/ mdor na/ sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab// dam pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bsam mi khyab// bsam mi khyab la dad byas na// rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab// ces gsungs pa'i don lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ spyi babs dang 'dug lugs/ sgro 'dogs skur ba med pa'i mtshan nyid 'di bsam zhing khong du chud par byed pa gal che/ de la zhing rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang dge 'dun rnam pa gsum yin te/ sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu de nyid la brten nas/ dkon mchog gsum de nyid ma gtogs pa gzhan med par khong du chud par bya ba dang*/ bla ma dam pa yang de nyid dang gnyis su med cing*/

de nyid na bzhugs pa bsnyen bkur bar bya ba zhing rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid khong du chud par bya'o// dngos po rnam par dag pa ni/ khyed rang nyid kyi lus dang longs spyod/ kha rje dang dbang thang bde legs ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma dam pa'i phyogs ma gtogs pa gzhan du spu'i rtse mo tsam yang mi 'gro zhing 'gro ba'i gnas med pa ni dngos po rnam par dag pa'o// zhing dang dngos po shin tu rnam par dag kyang*/ bsam pa shin tu rnam par dag pa 'di la bka' nan shin tu che bar gda' ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa ma gtogs pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad/ 'khor ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sems ni skad cig tsam yang skyer mi rung zhes nan tan shin tu che bar gsungs pa lags pas/ khyed yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pas zin pas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'ba' zhig gis mdzad pa thams cad nyams su blang ba shin tu gal che/ de ltar dge 'dun gyi sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi rang bzhin de nyid la brten pas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byed pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ ci byed 'gro ba la phan pa dang bde ba 'grub par 'dug pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ so sor thar pa ris bdun nam brgyad kyi sdom pa nyams su len pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa de dang*/ de nyams su len pa la bzod pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ nyams su len zhing rtsol ba dang brtson 'grus rtsom pa brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ 'di thams cad sems rtse gcig pa ma gtogs pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi 'grub pas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa shes pa dang*/

pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lnga byang chub kyi sems rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa shes pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs zung du 'jug pa de nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba ma gtogs pa mi srid pas skyon med pa dang*/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad khyed nyid ji ltar bzhugs pa de nyid la ma tshang pa med par shes par bya zhing blo thag gcod par bya'o// 'o na de ltar yin na yin pas chog mod/ khyed kyi ngo dga' dang phye gtor ci dgos de kun med pa'i chos cig khyod la 'ong du re ba yin mod snyam na/ de ni de ltar ma yin te/ de nyid la ji ltar yod pa de nyid ngo ma shes na 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba ma rig pa zhes de la zer ba yin/ de shes na shes rab ces zer ba yin/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas// khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa yang shes rab stong pa nyid la zer ba yin/ dkon mchog gsum la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la zer ba min snyam na/ de ltar yang sa bcu'i mdo nas/ sa drug la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs su 'byung ba dang ldog pa rnam pa gnyis shes pa la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gsungs pa dang*/ byang chub kyi snying por rten 'brel thugs su chud pas sangs rgyas pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pas shes pa dang*/ 'di thams cad dbyer med pa mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas thabs bor rgyu/ shes rab btsal rgyu gzhan du mi srid de gnyis med pa'i phyir ro// thabs dang shes rab gnyis lta a cang yang ches te/ yang*/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes pa dang*/

gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// zhes gsungs pas de ltar go na/ rlabs po che'i mdzad pa rlabs po che'i tshogs sogs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu la ma bsten par mi mchi ste/ dper na slob dpon chen po shanta de ba bhu su ku'i spyod pas/ lkug pa dang glen pa lta bus nyams su len pa'i dus su chos kyi gtam tshig gcig kyang mi smra na/ tha mal pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pa yin te/ rin po che zhal snga nas slob dpon de nyid slob dpon bo dhi sa twa zhes bya ba slob dpon de nyid yin te/ bod la lan gsum du byon nas/ chos 'khor chen po dpal gyi bsam yas ni bzhengs/ bod la btsun pa 'ong ngam mi 'ong ba blta ba'i ched du sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung nas/ dus da ltar mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams su thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa lta bu yin pas/ mdor bsdus na tshogs gnyis zung du chud par bya ba las bsgrub rgyu gzhan med/ 'o na sgom zhes bya ba/ zhi zhi po'am/ gnas gnas po'am/ legs legs po zhig gzhan na yod pa ma yin te/ de nyid la sgom zhes ming 'dogs pa lags/ sgom de yang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi bsdus pa'i chos/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos/ chos de dag thams cad rang rig pa la rang la yod bzhin pa 'di yin/ de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur ba de bsgom rgyu ma lags/ go rgyu yin/ de go na/ bdag ni mnyam par bzhag ce'am langs zhes rlom sems med// ci'i phyir zhe na chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes phyir// zhes gsungs pa yin pas de nyid la goms par bya'o// de yang phyag rgya chen po ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i thabs 'di nyid de/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ting nge 'dzin rgyal po nas/

ngas ni ting 'dzin rgyal po 'di yi phyir// rgyal po'i khab kyi shar phyogs 'di nyid du// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i thabs de nyid du shes par bya'o// nyams su myong ba ji ltar skyong ba'i thabs ni/ 'gro ba dang*/ 'chag pa dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ 'dug pa dang*/ spyod lam rnam bzhir dus rnam pa thams cad du yengs pa med par skyid sdug mthon dman thams cad gnyis med thug phrad du nyams su blangs pas/ chu thams cad rgya mtsho chen por phyin na lan tshwa'i ror gcig tu 'gyur ba bzhin du 'ong ba yin pas yengs pa med par nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag nam 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa dang*/ rdzas yo byad longs spyod dang gnyen 'dun thams cad bla ma dam pa dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phul nas dang po kho nar ma chags par bya/ de'i rjes la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga'i steng du seng ge khri chen po zhig gi steng du sna tshogs padma/ de'i steng du nyi ma/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du/ glo gtod thub pa yid ches pa'i bla ma yod na de bsgom/ de med na 'das ma byon dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad/ rang nyid kyi rigs kyi bdag po rigs rnam lnga gang rung gcig gam bstan pa'i bdag po 'di nyid du mos la spyi bor bsgom/ de nas snying ga'am gsang gnas la sogs pa nas rang gi shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ bla ma sangs rgyas de'i thugs kar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du shad kyi thal nas bsgoms pa la lugs cig yin/ yang na rang gi sems bla ma sangs rgyas de nyid yin pas/

sems gzhan du lus pa med/ de nyid la dran pa rtse gcig tu ma yengs pa ni rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba'i man ngag de la ma yengs pas bla ma dam pa'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang rang gi shes pa gcig tu 'dres nas/ sems nyid gnyug ma rgyun tu goms pa de dang dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// rang gi sems nyid 'od gsal dang*// shi ka bar do 'od gsal gnyis// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa 'di// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen nas// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa'i// gnad kyi snying po gcig pu yin// tug gis thug pa'i dus tshod du// a pha a ma a zhang dang*// mtho dman kun gyis mi stongs pas// nyams su blang ba shin tu gces// bdag gi bla ma rin po che// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// nyid dang dbyer med gdan sa gnyis// g.yog po bdag dang bcas pa la// mchod pa chen pos mchod pa 'di// thugs la btags so bdag gi bu// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sras// thub pa chen po'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i shākya'i sras kyi dge bsnyen 'phan po la/ snying tshig ngag gi gdams ngag sgro skur dang bral ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bgyi ba bskur ba lags pas phan par gyur cig bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig/ //

336) ༄// mkha' 'gro gdam mam phung 'dre 'dod ces tsā ri dang ti si'i sgom chen rnams la gsungs pa// khyed tsā rir bzhugs pa'i sgom chen rnams// dur khrod rngam pa'i sgra sgrogs su// mkha' 'gro gdam mam phung 'dre 'dod// dug lnga nyon mongs gang skyes kyang*// rlag 'dre phung 'dre chen po yin// nyon mongs rnam rtog ma skyes pa// mkha' 'gro zhes ni bya ba yin// zhe sdang skyes pa med pa de// rdo rje mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// 'dod chags skyes pa med pa de// padma mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// gti mug skyes pa med pa de// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// nga rgyal skyes pa med pa de// rin chen mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// phrag dog skyes pa med pa de// las kyi mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// ma skyes skye med mkha' 'gro dang*// rgyun chad med par mi 'bral zhu// nged kyi pa pha rin po che// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// nyon mongs spyod pa'i 'gro sa la// dben pa yin zhes mi gsungs lags// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog la// sgrub pa yin zhes mi gsung lags// bu go'am shes sam dgos se kun// ༈ //yang ti se ba rnams la 'di skad ces bya ba ste/ khyed ti ser bzhugs pa'i sgom chen rnams// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas chen der// mkha' 'gro gdam bam phung 'dre 'dod// dug lnga nyon mongs gang skyes kyang*// rlag 'dre phung 'dre chen po yin// nyon mongs rnam rtog ma skyes pa// mkha' 'gro zhes ni bya ba yin// zhe sdang skyes pa med pa de// rdo rje mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// 'dod chags skyes pa med pa de// padma mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// gti mug skyes pa med pa de// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// nga rgyal skyes pa med pa de// rin chen mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// phrag dog skyes pa med pa de// las kyi mkha' 'gro bya ba yin// ma skyes skye med mkha' 'gro dang*// rgyun chad med par mi 'bral zhu// nged kyi pa pha rin po che// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// nyon mongs spyod pa'i 'gro sa la// dben pa yin zhes mi gsungs lags// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog la// sgrub pa yin zhes mi gsung lags// bu go'am shes sam dgos se kun// bu go'am shes sam dgos se kun//

// 337) ༄// sems skye med 'od gsal chen po de dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bla ma zhes pa// kwa a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// lo dgu bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rang la skyes pa'i bu gcig pu// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes mdzad pa// da rung yab sras zhal ma 'tsho// de bden nam brdzun nam ji ltar lags// med kyang ku re bgyis pa yin// pha brtson 'grus chen po chos kyi rjes// bu tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la// a pha a ma phyogs ris kyi// nga bzang khyod bzang ga la khom// brgyud pa rin chen chos kyi gter// sems gnyis med 'od gsal chen po de// dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma yin// bu khyed kyi snying la rtag tu bzhugs// 'bral ba med pa ngo mtshar che// ngo shes sam mi shes zer ba de// shes pa ci byed ma shes ci// shes dang ma shes lo rgyus kyis// su zhig 'tshangs la su zhig phung*// rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas// re dga' re skyid tho le rgyal// don chen thob pas yang rgyal yin// de yi thog tu 'brug slag pags rtsag gon// // 338) ༄// mi rtog pa skye tshul lho pa char 'bebs la mdzad pa// oṃ swasti/ skyob pa 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ting nge 'dzin rgyal po nas/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// zhes pa'i don rnam par mi rtog pa/ sems nyid 'od gsal ba chos sku phyag rgya chen po las rnam par mi rtog pa skye ba'i tshul rnam pa gsum ste/ byas pa dang ma byas pa dang gzhi bzhag tu yod pa rnam pa gsum ste/ de la byas pa'i rnam par rtog pa spang bya dang gnyen po rnam pa gnyis kyi tshul du gnas pa la/ sdig pa mi dge ba nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum dgra bo yin pas/ zhe sdang ba bskyed pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/

tshul de dang 'dra bar log par lta ba dang*/ chags pa dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ mdor bsdus na ched du bskyed pa'i rtog pa ngan pa thams cad spang bar bya ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ lha bskyed pa'i rim pa la sogs pa ma skyes pa bskyed cing gong nas gong du goms par bya bar gsungs ste/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun las/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi 'di kho na ste/ sdig to mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa spang ba dang*/ dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya ba dang bzhi ston pas gsungs pa dang*/ gnyis pa rnam par rtog pa lung ma bstan zhes bya ba bzung bas mi zin/ bkag pas mi khegs/ char cig dang nyar cig rang dbang med par skye ba lags te/ 'di la bcom ldan 'das rje btsun chen po mi la'i zhal snga nas/ nyid bka' rdzogs pa chen po ba yin pa la/ rje btsun lho brag pa'i zhabs drung du byon nas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad zab mo rnams kyis/ rang dbang med pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pas/ rtog pa de 'gag par gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ yang dag la khyad par med kyang*/ rnam rtog la khyad du snang*/ de ltar rtogs pa med pa'i gang zag phyi rabs rnams// tshig tsam don du khyer nas rang bslu gzhan bslu 'dra// zhes gsungs pas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa/ rtsa rlung thig le gsum gyi man ngag gi gnad kyis phra rags kyi rnam par rtog pa bcom par gsungs pa lags/ gsum pa gzhi bzhag gi rnam par rtogs pa/ nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yod ma myong ba la phyin ci log tu 'khrul pa yin la/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ dper na dogs pa'i 'du shes kyis ni dug langs pa// dug de khong du song ba med kyang brgyal bar 'gyur// de bzhin byis pa bdag dang bdag gir khas len pa// bdag der 'du shes yang dag mi rtag skyes zhing 'chi// zhes gsungs pa/

'khor ba'i rtsa ba gzhi bzhag gi rnam par rtog pa 'di dang gsum du thugs su chud par bya ste/ de la dang po ni rgyu dang 'bras bu dgag pa'i bslab pa dang*/ bsgrub pa'i bslab pa gnyis kyis ngan par lam du btang ba dang*/ bzang po goms par bya'o// gnyis pa lung ma bstan gyi rnam rtog zang zing mtho dman rnam pa sna tshogs ni/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rtsa rlung gi gnad zab mos rang shugs kyis 'gag par bya'o// gzhi bzhag gi rnam pa rtog pa dang nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nyes pa ni/ sems nyid 'od gsal ba chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po bsgrub par bya'o// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu'i dus gsum thams cad kyi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis// gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad du// rang don gzhan don thams cad grub// bu rang la skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa// sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku dang*// 'bral ba med par nyams su longs// 'jig rten mgon po chos kyi rjes// bka' rgya mdzad nas gang gsungs pa// chos lnga'i man ngag gtsigs su che// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod du// dgon pa dben pa thams cad du// thugs dam nan tan mdzad par zhu// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa phyogs su// rdzas dang yo byad ched du btsal// sgrub pa btang snyoms chen por bzhag /'bad pa bzhes kyi khrag mthong bzhin// 'bad pa chen pos bsgrubs pa des// bla ma dus gsum rgyal ba kun// mnyes par bshad pa ma mchis pas// rtse gcig thugs dam nyams su blang*// de yang rje btsun zhal snga nas// shugs las byung na dngos grub yin// tung tung byed na ltogs 'gong yin// bka' bstsal gsungs pa 'di re bden// de phyir thugs dam gcig pu mdzad// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog// lho pa char 'bebs la mdzad pa'o// // 339) ༄// stong dang mi stong kun las 'das pa rdo rje gcig pu zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// ma lus gcig tu gyur pa rdo rje 'chang*// mtshungs med dbang phyug phag mo gru pa yis// dus rnam rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog

/'jig rten mgon po de yi thugs kyi sras// bsags pa mthar thug mnyam med dge ba'i bshes// yon tan rgya mtsho rab yangs skyes chen gyis// dad cing gus pas bka' stsal gsungs pa'i don// stong dang mi stong kun las rnam 'das pa// rdo rje gcig pu rin chen dgongs pa mchog /gsang ba'i snying po snyan du gsol ba las// thugs la dgongs nas mnyes pa thugs la btags// khyed kyi snyan pa'i 'brug sgra bstod pa yis// sangs rgyas bstod pas bla ma bstod pa dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur glegs bam phul// na bza' rin chen sku la gsol ba dang*// bdud rtsi bcud mchog zhal zas drangs pa rnams// thugs kyi dgongs bzhin thugs dgongs rdzogs par bgyis// gsungs don bdag gi dam chos rnams kyi lung*// gcig pu de ltar rnams kyang a cang ches// 'jig rten gsum mgon chos rje bla ma las// rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus thams cad dang*// de don dgrol bar mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang*// grub thob rnams kyi gdams ngag rin po che// ma lus kun gyi lung rnams bdag la gnang*// gong ma'i lung rnams ma lus 'di dag kyang*// khyed la sbyin gyis dga' mgur spyad par mdzad// ji ltar gsung bzhin zhabs rjes bskur ba lags// gsang ba'i zhus tshig bka' bstsal de yi don// dam bca' 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje nyid// thos bsam sgom pas sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bco brgyad 'dus nas tshogs 'khor byas nas kyang*// zhu ba zhus pas smras pa rdo rje'i gsung*// yod 'dzin med 'dzin mtha' las rnam 'das pas// sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg pa'i ye shes ni// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi yon tan ma lus pas// sangs rgyas sras bcas 'gro kun nye bar 'tsho// tshig 'di smras pas kun kyang mgu bar 'gyur// stong par 'dzin pa'i lta bas rnam dben pa// sems nyid rdo rje 'di yis mngon du 'gyur// // 340)

༄// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag bdag dbang po rnon po'i rigs su skyes zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ bdag dbang po rnon po'i rigs su skyes// thag ring po cig nas bla ma bsnyags// thugs brtse bar dgongs nas gdams ngag gnang*// 'bad pa drag pos nyams su blangs// ri khrod dgon par gcig 'dug byas// bde sdug mtho dman char bzhin bab// nyams su myong bas rang rgyud tshims// ma yi nu zho rgyas na yang*// bu yi kha bu dka' mor gda'// dpon slob tshogs pa mi ldan pa// rgyal bas bdud kyi las su gsungs// na so rgas shing shi kha 'dir// slob ma gcig yod na dga' ba la// dga' blta dga' ste mi gda' na// 'on kyang snying dang 'dra ba yi// zab pa'i gdams ngag zab mo 'di// nam mkha'i rlung la bskur ba yin// rim gyis pa dang cig car ba// 'gro ba'i don la sems gzhol na// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// a ma'i nges shes skyes ma skyes// snying rje chen po skyes ma skyes// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla ma la// byang sems brtan po bskyed ma bskyed// 'di dang phyi ma dus gsum du// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kyi// so nam dam chos yin ma yin// snying nas yang yang bsam par bya// nges shes skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pas// snying nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad na// rang bas gzhan gces brtul zhugs kyis// bsdu dngos bzhi yis gzhan don brtsam// de la dang po sbyin pa ni// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams// snyan pa'i tshig dang bcas pa yis// gdul bya'i skye bo 'dun par bya// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// bla ma rje btsun 'bri gung pa// bod mi zad gtso bo'i thor cog can// zab pa'i gdams ngag dmigs pa 'di// ka rang gi yul tu phyin tsam na// bstan pa'i gzhir gyur yul dbus su// bstan pa'i bdag po chen po rnams// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// 'phrin las rnam bzhis bsrungs pa ltar// nag po gnam rdang 'khrigs pa'i sar// mtho dman mdzad pa ma mchis shing*// gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg bya spong ba'i bstan pa de// thub pa'i dgongs pa yin mod kyang*// blo kha phyogs par dka' ba des// bla ma rje btsun chen po de// rang gi yul tu byon pa'i tshe// rje btsun byon pa'i sna len du// la kha'i ltang bu mi 'dur ram// dbus sa ser cig tu yun ring bzhugs// mchin pa khrag can mi gsol lam// grod pa glo can mi mur ram// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// pha phogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan la// phyi la gcu 'phras mi rdeg gam// ma sru yon bdag mo rnams kyi// bu chung pang skor mi mdzad dam// grong chog mdzad pa'i phyag mtshan du// dril bu yu chag mi bsnams sam// kha mngar 'khril ba'i bdud rtsi la// zhal btsugs rna ba mi snyol lam// skyes chen 'di dag ma mdzad na// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag cig

/snying la yod pa khyod la gdams// // 341) ༄// gdan sa nyams dmas su gyur skabs mdzad pa'i bca' yig/ gdan sa med pa dang*/ stag lung thang pa grongs pa dang*/ slob ma la re ba ltar ma byung bas shes pa'i ltag chag tshogs skyong ba'i bsam pa ma byung*/ na so rgas pas nus pa yang zad/ da ni phan tshun gcig tu 'gro ba'am/ mtshams dam pa zhig byas la bsdad snyam pa yin/ de la khyed rnams kyis rgyags khye rgyags khye gsungs pa la/ rgyags la 'gyed rgyu/ nged yang dkon pas bskungs pa med/ na ning gzhe ning gnyis su mu ge byung*/ ngo cig mug shul du thal/ ngas za rgyu bzang po zos/ 'og ma rnams kyis phal cher sngo'i tsha ba la brten/ shi bsris sdug bsris byas pas ro ma byung tsam lags/ da khyed rnams kyis rgyags khye zer bas/ gsung ba bzhin du bsgrub pas/ zho gsum yan chad yod pa rnams kyis rgyags mi len pa dang*/ de man chad pa rnams rgyags len pa dang*/ lha dang yi ge mi 'bri bar dge sbyor la nan tan cher byed pa dang*/ snga ma'i bca' khrims ji lta ba bzhin du thog tu 'jog pa dang*/ bud med la glu len pa dang*/ tshong pa la rnying phrin snyog pa dang*/ yul mi kha nyen rnams kyis thog tu btsan po 'jing 'gril byas nas/ bu lon rnying phrin mi 'ded pa dang*/ ji ltar 'ong ba bags kyis snyogs pa dang*/ yod pa kun yang rgas shi dom ring mang po ma 'dzug yod tshad zos pa'i rjes la shan phyed/ za rgyu rnyed nas 'ong*/ bla mar chos zhus nas sgro 'dogs nam chod pa'i dus su 'dir mi bzhugs par phan tshun du bzhud pa dang*/ de la sogs pa legs pa mtha' dag khyed rnams kyis bsgrub par zhu/ mi ma tshan tshan snga ma kho na bzhin du rgyan byas nas/ tshan gang sngar byas na ni tshan gcig kyang 'gyed rgyu mi 'ong nas mchi/ tshan re re la nang gi rgyan byas nas brgya brgya'i re mo cig byas na dga'am yang snyam pas/ bgres po rnams kyi bka' gros mdzad par zhu/
chad 'di rnams las 'gal na/ nga yang ci bde byed pa yin// //

342) ༄// la chu'i ser tshos byed thabs dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i phan yon bstan pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po ches/ thugs rje dang mkhyen pa ldan pa de'i zhal snga nas/ bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ ci gsungs bka' bzhin du bsgrub pa rnams kyis chos 'di ltar mdzad par zhu/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che rab tu byung ba la rag las/ rab tu byung ba chos gos ngur smrig la rag las/ ngur smrig sgrub par byed pa'i tshos dpag tu med pa cig yul mtha' 'khob na yang yod kyang*/ nor bu rin po che 'og na yod pa dmus long gi mi mthong ba dang 'dra ba/ mtha' 'khob kyi mis mi shes pa yin/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i slob ma nyan thos nye gnas shin tu mkhas pa yin gsung bas khyed kyis nga'i tshig 'di gces spras su nyams su blang bar zhu/ de yang bod dbus gtsang gi mthil/ yul dbus/ g.yo ru dang dbu ru 'di'i tshos thams cad de rang na yod pa lags pas/ tshos de rnams 'di na ji ltar bsgrub pa dang 'dra bar mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ de la bod dbus kyi chu rtsa zhes yongs su grags pa'i tshos de ni/ khams na la chu'i rtsa ba yin te chu rtsa'i tshos dbus kyi dang 'dra bar 'ong ba yin/ sbogs bya ba de yang chu'i lo ma sa la mar bstan pa'i ngos de dmar por 'ong ba de yin/ lo ma yar bstan pa la chu dang 'dra/ lo ma rgyab dmar du long ba yang yod zer/ de la dang po rung ba byed pa'i dus/ lo ma dang sngo bu'i nus pa thams cad rtsa ba la mar thim pa/ ston zla tha chung sa cung zad ma 'khyags pa'i dus der rung ba legs par byas nas/ de'i shun pa nag po legs par bzhar/ phyir mi bkab bar ldum chod du khrims bur byas la bskam/ de'i sbogs de sbogs tshos byed na/ thug skyur bya/ nas bzang ba yos ser ba tsam du byas pa khrag khrom du btags la/ de tsha bar bskol ba'i nang du phabs ngan yang rung ste nyis 'gyur du ma tshig tsam du drod mtho bar byas la/

gos log mang pos btums/ zhag gsum tsam du bzhag pas/ skyur shin tu skyur bar 'ong ba de legs par btsags bcud nas btsags pa'i khu ba dang sbogs legs par brdungs pa'am/ shin tu zhib par rang thags pa btags pa'i phye ma skyur dang lhan du sbyar nas skya bas nan tan shin tu che bar bskrugs la/ sbogs la ska sla skyo tsha tsam bya/ chu rtsa de bas gar yang rung*/ chu yang yang du bsnan zhing yun ring du bskol/ de nas legs par phyar ba'am/ skye'am/ ras sam/ shas rtsing pa legs par bkrus nas dri ma med pa'i nang du/ 'og tu rdza'am zangs dri ma med pa mnyam par bzhag nas/ dang po btsag bar du bcang*/ tha mar bcud nas khu ba thon legs pa'i dwangs ma de/ gzod me che bar gtang la bskol/ de la me tog ser chil gyis byung ba cung zad ma khol ba'i nang du/ ras sam snam bu'am 'tshod rgyu gang yin de bcug nas 'og tu me cher btang*/ rgyun chad med par dkrugs/ phyar btso/ de nas lag pas btsir la tshos legs par 'jen zhing tshos pa'i dus su ber ka dri ma med pa gnyis la dkris shing yar then/ ber ka dri ma med pa gnyis kyis tshos kyi khu ba thems su bcug nas mar then pas/ tshos khu gron du mi 'gro/ de yang tshos khu dang po de'i nang du/ gces se bsod nams can gyi gos 'tshed pa yin/ de'i 'og ma de'i nang du chu bsnan nas bar pa'i 'tshed pa yin/ de'i rting la lan gnyis btsir ba'i tshos shal tha ma'i nang du/ snam thung dang*/ gos dri ma dang*/ rnam par ma dag pa kha bsgyur ba tsam byed pa gsum lags so// dus tshod nyi ma shin tu tsha ba la/ 'tshod rgyu'i snam gos shin tu tsha bar byas pa tshos khu'i nang du bcug pas/ tshos 'dzin zhing kha gsal ba lags/ de nas nyi ma la yun ring po bskam/ snam bu phyi nang ngo shes par byas la nyi ma la cung zad bzhag nas/ ma skams pa'i rlon pa bsdus nas thag pa'am rdang dri ma med pa la bkal nas grib skyabs su byas pas mdog shin tu gsal bar 'ong ba lags pas sbogs tshos dang*/

chu'i tshos dbus gtsang na ji ltar byed pa 'di rnams yul der dar ci thub gzigs par zhu/ de la dang po khyed rang gi na bza' mdzad/ de nas thams cad kyi na bza' byas na yul khams thams cad kyi gos ser po rtsol sgrub med par gyur nas/ rab tu byung ba thams cad la phan pa lags pas/ khyed kyis 'di dar ci thub blta bar zhu/ thug skyur 'di la phye mang du dgos par 'dug las dka' ba 'ong ba la sla bar 'ong ba'i thabs dang po'i thug skyur gyi rtsigs ma legs par bcud nas bzhag pa de dang*/ thug skyur rang gi ru ma phor gang yas chad dang*/ thug skyur gyi nyag nyog lhag lhog thams cad gze ma'am/ phu ru'am/ rdza'i snod legs pa'i nang du log dang phyogs thams cad phub ma zhib ma la sogs pas shin tu dro bar byas pa'i nang du gzhug de'i nang du chu tshan khol ma blugs la de'i nang du phye btab cing phabs ngan yang rung ste/ ci mang du btab nas yang chu tshan blugs te dkrugs nas kha legs par bcad cing btums nas zhag mang du bzhag pas khas mi tshugs pa tsam skyur por 'ong*/ de'i dngas ma dang sbogs pa sres nas bskol ba snga ma dang 'dra/ yang phyi ma'i snyigs ma'i nang du sngar ji ltar bstan pa dang 'dra bar rgyun chad med par byas na/ tshos rgyun chad med pa'i khu ba 'ong ba lags par gda' bas de ltar yang mdzad par zhu/ zhag mang por bzhag na yang je skyur du 'gro ba ma gtogs pa nyes pa ma mchis pa lags par gda'/ sbogs skya thal du mi 'gro bar non cung zad che bar 'dod na/ btsod cung zad gtong bar 'dug zha phyal thabs 'di/ yul dbus kyi 'di 'go khyim dang tha ma 'dzom pa bstan pa rin po che'i bka' rtags su 'dug pas/ 'di'i bya thabs dang bzo yang rjes su 'brangs nas mdzad par zhu dang 'dis kyang bstan pa dang dge 'dun la phan tu re ba yin/ dar cher 'ong du re ba yin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig bcom ldan 'das kyis/

lha dang mi rnams la mdo sde dang ma sde dang ma mo bzhag go// klu rnams la ni mdo sde'o// 'dul ba ni zab pa zab par snang ba mthong bar dka' ba/ khong du chud par dka' ba/ dgongs pa mnga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang mthun pa yin na/ dge slong rnams kyis 'dul ba zab pa nyid nas dgongs pa mnga' nyid dang*/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang mthun pa nyid yin pas 'don par mi spro'o// 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bstan pa'i yan lag gang zhig yongs su nyams pa de'i bsngags pa lhag par brjod par mdzad pa yin pas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' bstsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i gang zag la phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'khor bzhi mdun du bdar ba yin/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa gzhan la rag ma las pa yin/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nang gi mdzod srung ba yin/ dge sbyong dang bram ze gzhan rnams kyi spyi bo la 'dug pa yin/ dam pa'i chos gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bslab pa'i ched kyi phyir skye bo mang po la phan pa dang*/ skye bo mang po la bde bar bzhugs pa yin no// mig ni gzugs la chags pa yis// lus dang ngag dang sems bsgribs nas// bsam gtan bzhi dang bral ba rnams// 'khor bar shin tu bsten pa 'gyur// rdzun gyi tshig ni gsungs pa na// lha rnams de nas dong ba dang*// zhal yang mnam dri nga ba par gyur nas su// mtho ris las kyang nyams par 'gyur// gang zhig chos bzhin 'dri ba la// chos ma yin pa ston byed na// chu na rgyu ba'i nya bzhin du// de ni lce ma mchis par 'gyur// gang zhig chos bzhin 'dri ba la// chos ma yin pa ston byed na// der ni skyes pa min skye zhing*// der ni skyes par skye mi 'gyur// gang zhig chos bzhin 'dri ba la// chos ma yin pa ston byed na// lhas ni dus su char mi 'bebs// der ni dus ma yin par 'bab// gang zhig chos bzhin 'dri ba la// chos ma yin pa ston byed na// sbrul bzhin du ni skye bo de yi// lce gnyis dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa ni/

gzhan gyi sems bsrung ba dang bcas pa yin la/ nyan thos bsrung ba med pa dang*/ dug cha bsrung ba bcos su yod pa dang*/ bcos su med pa dang*/ bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga spyod kyang byang chub kyi sems mi gtong*/ bslab pa ma gtugs pa kho nar gsungs pa dang*/ zhus pa 'brel ba bul zhing kha na ma tho ba che ba gnyis ni nyes pas ma yin par smos zhig gsungs pa dang*/ de'i rgyu mtshan nye bar 'khor yang theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpas ni srid pa gcig gis nyon mongs pa thams cad zad par mi bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pa rnams kyi nyon mongs pa dag ni rim gyis zad par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes gsungs pas/ bslab pa ring du rjes su zhugs pa yin la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa rnams bslab pa ni mthar chags yin no zhes gsungs so// 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs ldan pa yi// sems ni 'khor ba yin par kun tu brjod// nyon mongs rnam grol shes dang zla 'dra ba'i// srid pa rgya mtsho'i mthar song yongs su sgrub// gzugs ni 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang ldan// de ni bdag min bdag kyang gzugs ma yin// gzugs la bdag med bdag la gzugs med de// gzugs ni ston pa'i phung po bzhir yang rigs par bgyi// gang zhig skyes bu dag cing nyon mongs med// rab tu sdang med mi la khro byed pa'i// byis pa de la sdig pa phyir 'gro ste// rdzing rnams phyogs su rdul rnams gtor ba bzhin// gang zhig nyes med chad pas gcod// sdang ba min la rab sdang ba// gnas gzhan gang yang rung ba bcu// myur du thob par kho nar 'gyur// // 343)༄// lam gyi rnam gzhag bstan pa bstan bcos glang chen rol pa/ oṃ swasti/ na mo ratna gu ru/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos/
