dge ba'i bshes gnyen des bstan par bya ba'i chos dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ thabs dang shes rab rnam pa gnyis su 'dus te/ de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ thabs dang shes rab rkang gnyis gshog pa brkyang*// gar 'dod sar phyin bde ba'i gnas thob 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de la kun rdzob kyi bden pa lus ngag yid gsum/ shes rab don dam pa'i bden pa de'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ de gnyis dbyer med zung du 'jug pa dang po rtogs pa rgyu/ bar du goms pa lam/ mtha' ma mthar thug pa 'bras bu'o// de yang dang po nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ dngos po mtshan ma la mngon par zhen pa rnams kyi dbang du bya ste/ stong pa nyid kyi don 'ba' zhig bstan pas/ dngos po la mngon par zhen pa dang bral/ stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa'i gang zag la thabs kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bogs 'don te/ stong pa nyid dga' 'dod chags blo// zhes pa dang*/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thongs// zhes pas so// de la nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ yul dang bsam pa dngos po gsum gyis nyams su len te/ de la yul ni rnam pa gnyis te/ dman pa'i yul snying rje ba ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor bying ba rnams dmigs pa'i yul du byas nas/ bka' drin dran pa'i tshul gyis jo bo dkon mchog gsum dang*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi dgongs pa sgrub par byed pa/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba yab rgyal po'i srid 'tsho zhing*/ khrims kyi rgyal po'i yul khams skyong bar byed pa lta bu ni 'phags pa'i zhing gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa sgrub pa dmigs pa'i yul du bya'o// yul de gnyis la brten nas bsam pa la go cha bgo ba ni/ ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub rin po che la 'god pa'i go cha dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs sgrub par byed pa rang nyid sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i go cha dang*/

rang gzhan thams cad sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i rgyu nges pa/ chos dkon mchog la legs par gnas pa'i go cha dang*/ rang nyid gang las skyes pa'i rigs kyi rgyud de 'dzin par byed pa/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing dgongs pa sgrub pa'i go cha dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bdag rang gi rgyud ma smin pa smin par mdzad cing*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che la 'god par mdzad pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong gi bar du mi 'bral zhing*/ skyob par mdzad pa'i mgon chen po de'i rnam par thar pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing dgongs pa sgrub par byed pa'i go chas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dag par bkol bar bya ste/ lus kyi bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gong ma'i rjes su 'brang ba ni lus dge ba'o// ngag gi bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gong ma'i rjes su 'brang ba ni ngag dge ba'o// bsam par bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gong ma'i rjes su 'jug pa ni yid dge ba'o// de ltar thabs de dag gi rnam par bshad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ thub pa'i dbang po sku gsum bdag nyid can// de rjes zhugs pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ste// stong nyid snying rje las byung dam pa yi// dkon mchog yon tan dpag med rgya mtsho dang*// rigs su gyur pa brgyud pa'i bla ma ste// smin par mdzad pa mgon po bdag gi yab// ces pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas// sgom spros bcas kyis byang chub 'dod pa ni// shar du 'gro bar 'dod pa la// nub tu phyin pa dag dang mtshungs// zhes pa ni/ dbang po rab kyi rten gyi gang zag bsags pa rab tu gyur pas bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las dbang bzhi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid de bsgoms pas/ stong nyid de'i rang gi ngang du gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa yang dag pa ma yin par go bas nyon mongs pa mgo mnan/

bsam pa'i shes rab kyis dgongs pa mthar phyin/ bsgom pa'i shes rab kyis nyon mongs pa rtsa nas 'don pa'i dbang du byas nas sgom 'byung ngo*// chos nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes des/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas/ 'khor bar skye bar byed pa'i rgyu/ nyon mongs pa spangs pas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mthar phyin/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa/ 'khor ba dang myang ngan las 'das pa/ rang dang gzhan/ ji snyed gnyis su 'dug pa thams cad/ rang gi bsam pa ma gtogs pa gzhan med par rtogs pas/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa khong tu chud/ sems de nyid gdod ma nas skye 'gag dang bral bar rtogs pas shes rab kyi bslab pa nyams su myong*/ chos nyid bden pa'i rten 'brel gyis tshogs pa ma tshang pa med pa khong du chud pa/ yang dag pa'i don dang gnyis su med par sbyor bas sbyor ba'i lam/ chos thams cad skye 'gag spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar mthong bas mthong ba'i lam/ mthong lam de'i rgyun goms par byed pas bsgom pa'i lam/ goms pa'i stobs kyis gong nas gong du 'phar zhing*/ skyon las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad kyang goms pa'i shugs de nyid kyis spong*/ spangs pa'i yon tan gzung 'dzin 'jig pa la rten pa'i khams brgya la sogs pa dpag tu med pa g.yo zhing*/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stongs par byed pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad skye 'gag med pa sems nyid kyi gshis su bdag nyid gcig pu'i 'od zer gyis smin par mdzad pa dang*/ skye ba med pa'i 'od zer de nyid la 'dod chags can rnams kyis lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che zhes khong du chud nas/ 'dod chags spang pa'i phyir tshul khrims la nan tan byed pa dang*/ zhe sdang can rnams kyis lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa zhes khong du chud nas/ mdo sde'i sde snod la nan tan tu byed pa dang*/ gti mug can rnams kyis lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa zhes mngon pa'i sde snod la slob pa dang*/

de rnams kyi don nyams su len pa'i stobs kyi dbang du byas na/ ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas rang gzhan thams cad 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan la longs spyod pas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sems can gyi don byed cing*/ ci bde dang ci skyid dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa smin par byed pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i don khong du chud pas yul sna tshogs mthong bar gyur ba dbyer med pa'i don phyin ci ma log pa ston par byed pa bla ma lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa'i zhal blta bar nus pa dang*/ chos thams cad skye ba med par khong du chud pas/ spobs pa zad mi shes pas sgra gcig gis thams cad la go bar nus pa dang*/ chos nyid don dam pa las gyur pa'i chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi don dpag tu med pa khong du chud pa dang*/ de la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa de dag chos nyid don dam pa las byung zhing*/ chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa goms pa'i stobs kyis/ gong nas gong du 'pho ba la/ sa nas sar 'phar zhing sa'i yon tan dang ldan pa zhes bya ste/ de ltar skyon thams cad spangs pa dang*/ yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i ngo bo chos kyi sku mthar phyin pa ni mthar phyin pa'i lam zhes bya ste/ mdor na skye ba med pa'i don la 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan mtha' dag 'byung ba kho na'o// shes rab don dam pa de'i rnam par bshad pa mdor bsdus nas tshigs su bcad pa/ bla ma las byung mkhas pa'i stong pa nyid// rgyal ba'i yum gyur smra bsam brjod 'das 'di// 'khor 'das kun gyi bde skyid 'byung gnas te// nyon mongs gnyen por gyur pa bstan pa'i chos// nyon mongs gnyen por gyur pa rtogs pa'i chos// rtogs pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrub pa tshogs kyi lam// rtogs pa nyid du sbyor ba sbyor ba'i lam// bden pa mthong ba mthong ba'i lam yin te// bden pa'i don la goms pa bsgom pa'i lam// yon tan dpag tu med pa skye med goms las byung*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa'i ngo bo nyid// spang bya gnyen po rnam dag chos sku ni// dbyer med spros dang bral ba'i ngo bo nyid du gnas// dbyer med zung du 'jug pa ni// shes rab stong pa nyid kyang thabs// lus dang ngag yid rnam pa gsum la gnas// lus ngag yid kyi rang bzhin yang*// stong pa nyid du lhun gyis grub// dbyer med pa'i don ma mthong bar thabs dang shes rab phyogs la zhen yang*/

bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ thabs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba shes rab kyis bogs 'don/ shes rab kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thabs kyis bogs 'don dgos gsungs pa dang*/ gnas lugs dbyer med par gnas pa blo phyogs rer phyin ci log tu bsgrubs pas/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi yon tan gyi 'byung gnas zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin la gnas par bya'o// de la zung du 'jug pa ni/ thabs dngos po dang mtshan ma la shes rab stong pa nyid kyis rgyas 'debs pa dngos po yod par blta ba dang*/ stong pa nyid med par blta ba dang*/ blta mkhan gyi shes pa la rtog pa ma chud pas rmongs pa rnams kyi zung 'jug dang*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis rigs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad snang tsam mi 'gag pa/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa thabs kyi rang bzhin de rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gnas/ rigs pa'i shes rab kyis khong du chud pas shes rab kyi ngo bo/ de gnyis dbyer med pa mkhas pa rnams kyi zung 'jug sgom chen rnams kyi zung 'jug ni bla ma dam pa gcig gi gdams ngag la brten nas bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa nyams su blangs pas lus la bde ba skye ste/ de stong pa dang zung du 'jug pas bde stong zung 'jug dang*/ yul snang stong zung 'jug dang*/ shes pa rig stong zung 'jug la sogs par tshig yul du ma gyur pa/ rang nyid nyams su myong ba dbang dang byin rlabs kyis nyams su myong ba de rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi zung 'jug go// bla ma rin po che ni zung 'jug rnam pa gnyis su bzhed de/ de la dang po 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad rang gi sems gdod nas skye ba med par rtogs pa gzhir bzhag nas/ rtogs pa'i don ngam ngam shugs kyis goms pa'i stobs kyis bag chags kyi sa bon dag pa'i shugs kyis myong ba rang rig pa blo'i yul du gyur pa/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad dang dbyer med par gyur pa slob pa'i zung 'jug dang*/

mtho ris byung tshor bag chags kyi sa bon mtha' dag gnyis su med pa'i shugs kyis spangs nas/ sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa phyag rgya chen po lhun gyis grub pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa ni mi slob pa'i zung 'jug go// blo gros phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig gis/ yod mtha' med mtha' dmigs pa'i yul du byas pa'i zung 'jug dang*// kun rdzob sna tshogs rigs pas stong par brtags pa'i zung 'jug dang*// bden pa ma mthong 'jig rten zhi gnas zung 'jug rnams// shin tu ngo mtshar 'jig rten zung 'jug ste// mkhas pa rnams kyis 'di la yid brtan byar mi rung*// zung 'jug 'ga' zhig gnyis med blo las 'das// sems nyid rang byung 'od gsal mi g.yo bas// 'khor ba'i bag chags sna tshogs rab bcom nas// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor bsgyur ba mdzes// sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku bde chen gyis// bdud bzhi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bcom mdzad cing*// rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i yon tan rab rgyas pa// rtsol sgrub med par lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang phyug ni// mi slob zung 'jug rnam dag mthar phyin sku// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i zung 'jug de dag gis// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kyis// rnam dag zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i gnas thob shog /bstan bcos glang chen rol pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //

344) ༄// rnyed dka'i dal rten dang de chos dang 'phrad pa shin tu dka' ba ge god klur gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang jo bo lha bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams kyis/ yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad du/ bkra shis pa dang bde legs pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pas rgyas par gyur cig shin tu rgyas par gyur cig shin tu rab tu rgyas par gyur cig bla ma rin po ches/ spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po gting mtha' med par gyur pa yin pa las/ tshe snga ma phan chad du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer sprin gseb kyi glog lta bus bskul bas/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi blo gros shin tu phra ba'i phra ba zhig sad pa las/ de'i rjes su mthun pa'i grogs dang bshes su gyur pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du 'bral du ma btub pas/ phan pa dang bde ba je cher sgrubs shing grub pa las mi'i lus thob pa/ gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal gyi mgrin pa chud pa ltar shin tu dka' bar gyur pa yin la/ de bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags shing dka' ba ni/ chos byed pa'i rigs su skye ba shin tu rnyed par dka' ba yin pa las/ khyed yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i bdag po/ stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po lta bu/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyabs dang gnas dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa/ bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi gdung rgyud mi gcod pa/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa/ de'i mthu chen po mnga' zhing bstan pa'i mnga' bdag yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po nyi ma dang*/ zla ba lta bur gyur pa'i bdag po/

rang nyid kyi yab bcom ldan 'das rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje lta bu'i sras su 'khrungs shing yab bdag nyid chen po de'i sras su gyur pa/ bka' tshul bzhin du bsgrub par mdzad pa'i yon bdag ge god klu la gdams pa/ yon bdag nyid kyi yab gong du ji ltar smos pa'i bdag nyid chen po de lta bu yin pas/ yab bdag nyid chen po de'i bka' ni/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis gcod par nus pa'am/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams dang*/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis kyang*/ bka' gcog par bya ba ma yin na/ yab bdag nyid chen po de lta bu'i sras nyid kyis ni gsung bzhin du shin tu yang bsgrub par rigs pas/ yab chos kyi rgyal po de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gson nam 'das kyang rung ste/ log par lta ba rnams kyi ming shid ces grags pa de la/ khyed kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'ba' zhig tu mdzad cing*/ sta yu la khrag ma dmar ba bzhed par gda' bas/ yab kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung phan pa bde ba thams cad kyi gzhi/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma dus dang rnam pa thams cad kyi bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i gnas/ chos rin po che 'ba' zhig tu mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar// mi lus thob pa shin tu dka'// dal dang 'byor ba rnyed dka' zhing*// mi rtag 'jigs su rung ba yi// srin po snying rje med pa yis// rnam par gtse bar 'gyur ba'i phyir// bu gcig skyes bu chen po yis// yab kyis ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin// khyed kyis thugs la bzhag nas kyang*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// ji ltar zla ba nya ba bzhin// kun gyi snying du sdug pa dang*// mdzes shing gsal bar gyur pa dang*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur mdzod// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po bla ma rin po ches// rang gi sras dang 'dra ba yon bdag ge god klu la legs par gdams pa'i yi ge rdzogs so// yig rten srungs dar dar yug kha the'u ma nyams pa dmar po yug gcig 'bul zhing mchis//

// 345) ༄// dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig mi dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig ces pa// tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pas/ tshul khrims ni thams cad mkhyen pa stobs bcu dang ldan pa'i rjes su 'brang ste/ de yang gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi stobs/ dge ba mi dge bar 'gyur ba gnas med/ mi dge ba dge bar 'gyur ba gnas med pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la mi dge ba rnam pa bdun gnang zhes grags pa ni/ de nyid byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod du legs par gsungs pa'i gnad/ srog gcod pa ni zhing dang bsam pa dang dngos po rnam pa gsum gyis bde bar 'gro ba 'pho ba'i gnad/ zhing byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed la/ bsam pa chags pa'i stobs kyis dngos po chags pa skye med du rtogs nas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa lta bu dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa yul de dang lhan cig du gnas pas chags pa thams cad rnam par spong ba byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi bla ma bcom ma ba lha'i bshes gnyen lta bu dang*/ rdzun du smras pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don nyams su myong bar byas nas mi mthong smras pa drang srong chen po me dang*/ rgyal po sde ma pham pa/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyi lus snga ma kho na bzhin du gyur pa dang*/ ma byin pa blangs pas phan pa dang bde ba rgya chen por 'gyur ba/ sprang pos khur ba phrogs nas rang sangs rgyas la phul bas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan lta bur gyur pa rnams la ni/ gzhi dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ mthar thug thams cad du nyes pa med pa tsam du bzhed kyang*/ yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'byung bas thams cad mkhas pa dang shes rab zab mo'i rjes su 'brang ste/ de ltar yang*/ lha mo dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig

/mi dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig /ces pa dang*/ bram ze'i khye'u khyi dkar po'i rkyen gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la dad pa dang*// ma dad pa'i gnas skabs skad cig ma gzhir bzhag pa las/ las rgyu dang 'bras bu mtha' dag thams cad de nyid du bstan pa las rnam par 'byed par gsungs pas/ 'di thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag 'bri gung pa'i ma lags te/ ston pa'i gsung nyid kyis nges so// de ltar ma gyur na sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam pa gsum spong ba yang mi 'thad/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom nas sangs rgyas pa yang mi 'thad de/ ston pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// // 346) ༄// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa zhes spang pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ri khrod pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gdams pa/ khyed nga la bsten yun ring zhing mnyes pa thams cad kyis mnyes par byas pas/ ji ltar zhus pa'i gdams ngag 'di rnams gong du nas kyang nyams su myong ba dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa dang bcas nas khyed rang la yod pa yin mod kyi/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// stong nyid snying rje zhes bya ba// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa yin// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa dang*// bya dang byed pa thams cad kun// 'di las gzhan med rnal 'byor pa// nyams su longs shig rang gi bu// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyi sku// bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa yin// 'di las gzhan na bla ma med// 'gro 'ong med pa'i de nyid la// su zhig su yi drung du 'ong*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gang dga' nyid// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog

/byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// don du ma shes kha lta can// snying re rje yi snying rje'i yul// snying re rje ba de rnams kun// e ma ji ltar gyur zhig gu// byang sems dbyer med las byung ba// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// shin tu rnam par dag pa kun// yi ge dag dang mthun par yang*// thams cad so so phyag tu thengs// dbu zhu ril ba maṇḍal gsum// bskur nas mchis pas yig rten lags// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog /spang pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gdams pa// // 347) ༄// bu lhun gyis grub pa'i rang sems bsgom zhes pa bla ma lho pa char 'bebs la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ chos kun gdod nas rnam dag nam mkha' la// kun tu bzang po nyi ma rab gsal bas// mi shes mun pa'i rang sems snang mdzad pa// mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// chos kyi rje 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin po che de'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang myang ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin gsung*/ de'i don cung zhig snyan du gsol na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis snang ba thams cad chos kyi sku spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing gdod nas zhi bar thugs su chud/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos thams cad nye bar zhi yang*/ rang gzhan gyi don byang chub kyi sems rin po ches/ thams cad kun tu bzang po rnam par rol pa'i sprin phung du thugs su chud cing rol par mdzad/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad rang gi sems phyin ci log tu 'khrul pas nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings su 'jug pa dang*/ sems can dmyal ba rnams ni mthong tshad thams cad la zhe sdang gi sems tshig pa za ba'i me chen po bsam pa'i rang gzugs de nyid kyis sregs pa dang*/ sdug bsngal bar gyur pa dang*/ yi dwags chags pa'i rang gzugs/ dud 'gro glen pa'i rang gzugs/ lha ma yin 'thab pa dang rtsod pa'i rang gzugs/

lha dang mi rnams bsam pa bzang ngan/ las bzang ngan du bsags pa'i bsam pa'i rang gzugs lags/ thub pa mgon po chos kyi rje// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// snang srid rang gzhan ma lus kun// rab kyis chos skur mthong ba dang*// 'bring gis rang sems yi dam lha// thams cad rang gi a mar mthong*// mthong lugs gsum po ma gtogs pa// ji ltar nam mkha'i padmo la// rmi lam bung bas 'jib pa dang*// rang snang 'khrul pa'i skra shad kyis// gcad par dka' ba'i zhags pa 'dis// sangs rgyas yon tan rang sems 'di// 'ching zhing gcod par mi byed na// rnam grol sa la gnas par dka'// ji ltar sbrang bu'i chu ngan gyis// sa steng bangs par mi 'gyur ltar// nyon mongs dag las 'byung ba yi// chos brgyad bsnyen bkur phra mos kyang*// rang gzhan smin par mi 'gyur pas// bu lhun gyis grub pa'i rang sems bsgom// gnyis med ngang la bzhugs par zhu// sems bskyed bsngo ba nan tan mdzod// rdzogs so// bla ma lho pa char 'bebs la gnang ba'o// // 348) ༄// rgyud tshod dang mthun pa'i chos bshad dgos par sgo glad ma la gdams pa// zhi ba rang bzhin dbyings las mi g.yo mnyam pa nyid// brtse ba'i bdag nyid zhe 'dod 'dzin bral ba// chos dang chos nyid dbyer med zung du 'jug /dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yab sras rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud// dpal chen de la mi chos lha chos gnyis med de// kha snying tha dad g.yo sgyu sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan mgo skor mi mdzad 'gro mgon rin po che// skyabs chen dam pa khyod dang mi 'bral shog /brtse sems dang ma bral/ rgyab gtam ma byed/ rgyud tshod dang mthun pa'i chos shod/ mi'i seng ge cod pan can/ seng ge yang thog 'khrugs la 'bar/ de 'dra ba yi sku khams de/ 'di 'dra gcig gi sing por thal/ sgo glad ma la'o// // 349) ༄// gdan sa phag mo grur gdan sa'i khur mi theg par zhu ba'i phrin skur//

oṃ swasti/ spyir bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgos bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// mkhan slob gnyis kyi zhabs la 'dud// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun dang*// chen po gong ma'i dge 'dun la// mchid tshig zhu tshig ya zung zhu lags na// skyon med yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru// sprul sku rtsod pa med gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gnas// rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams su// shin tu dkon zhing rnyed dka' ba// rang byung rten gyis yongs su gang*// lcang lo can gyi pho brang ltar// byin rlabs rgya chen 'byung ba'i gnas// u rgyan grong khyer chen po ltar// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros yongs su gang*// byang chub chen po'i shing drung ltar// skyes chen yab sras gong ma rnams// 'od gsal thugs su chud pa'i gnas// dpa' bo me tog zla mdzes kyis// nags tshal kun tu bzang po ltar// ngo mtshar rmad du byung gyur cing*// skyon med yon tan rab rdzogs par// 'jig rten mgon po'i rgyal tshab tu// dbang bskur mnga' gsol mdzad nas kyang*// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don bsgrub pa// mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun thams cad kyis// shin tu thugs la btags mod kyi// zhabs tog bya ba'i nus pa med// khyed la gces ka tshol ba min// blo thag snying nas chod pa yin// ku re kyal ka mi gsung zhu// dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// skyob pa phag mo gru pa la// bu chen gsum gyis dbu mdzad pa'i// mkhas btsun seng ge mchog 'dra zhing*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// gtsug gi nor bu rin po che// mnyam pa med pas sa steng gang*// rmongs pa tha shal bdag 'dra la// gdan sar sdod pa'i gnyer kha med// mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// dam pa gong ma khyed rnams kyis// ku re kyal ka mi gsung zhu// chos rgyal mnyam med rin po ches// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// gnyer med kho re chung ba yi// ldom bu dman pa bdag nyid la// sems sgom bka' bstsal gsungs pa las// gdan sar sdod cig ma gsungs pas// skyabs gnas bla ma dam pa yi// bka' dang 'gal bar ma phod pas// gdan sar sdod pa'i rngo ma thog

/mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// skyes chen gong ma khyed rnams kyis// ku re kyal kha mi gsung zhu// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yis// rang gzhan brje bar ma nus shing*// 'du 'dzi g.yeng bas dub pa yis// ri dwags lta bu'i ngang tshul gyis// ri khrod dgon par mos pa skyes// bya bsam gyi khur dang bral ba la// mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// dam pa gong ma khyed rnams dang*// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun gyis// 'jig rten mgon po'i rgyal tshab tu// dbang bskur mnga' gsol mdzad pa las// thugs la 'dogs thabs gzhan med kyang*// rmongs pa yon tan chung ba dang*// chos rgyal gdan sa 'dzin pa ni// tha chung bu la ma babs pas// chen po babs la mkhas pa rnams// nam yang thugs su chud lags kyang*// ku re kyal ka gsungs pa la// gong nas yi mug mchi ma shor// gong ma rnams kyi bka' bstsal de// rin chen gser bas lci lags kyang*// nyams chung bdag gis ma khyag pas// mkhan slob gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// gong ma rnams la bzod par gsol// rdzogs so// //

350) ༄// dam tshig ldan zhing phyag rgya chen po la ma yengs par bsgom par gces pa// shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong kun// bag med spyod pa ma byed par// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// dam tshig la sogs sdom pa rnams// srog la bab kyang mi btang bsrung*// rin chen bla ma spyi bor bsgom// mos gus mchod pas rgyun du mchod// lus ni lha yi sku nyid dang*// mi 'bral dran pa 'dun pa bsten// snang stong zung 'jug lha sku dang*// grags stong zung 'jug bzlas pa rnams// rtag tu ma yengs 'bad 'bungs thon// don gyis bla ma'i dgongs pa blang*// phyag rgya che la ma yengs bya// ma yengs bsgom pa shin tu gces// // 351) ༄// sdom gsum byang sems kyi spyod pa las 'bras bu rgyal ba'i sku gsum mdzes pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la mar bsgom pa ni thabs yin/ de la byams pa skyes pa ni byams pa'o// ma de rnams 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bsam pas snying rje ba ni snying rje'o// snying rje bas bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ byang chub thob par 'dod pa ni smon pa'o// de dam bca' dang cho gas bskyed pa ni smon pa byang chub kyi sems so// de'i ched du sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol ba ni dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims so// des sems can don byed pas ni sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so// sems can don du lus ngag yid gsum mi dge bar sdom pa ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims so// byang chub sems mchog bla med rmad byung bas// lus ngag yid gsum tshul khrims rin po che// sdom gsum byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa las// 'bras bu rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sku gsum mdzes// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong par ma gyur tshe// 'gro rnams bde la 'god la skyabs su mchi//

// 352) ༄// gdan sa phag mo gru la tshigs lhugs kyi sgo nas bsngags pa// sems nyid spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sku/ yon tan rin po che thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong par ma gyur gyi bar du sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid/ bla ma rin po ches 'gro ba thams cad rgyal bar gyur cig 'gro ba'i mgon po de'i gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru zhes bya ba/ rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi shing drung ltar spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas/ 'og min gyi pho brang ltar theg pa chen po'i chos zab pa dang rgya che ba thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ u rgyan gyi grong khyer chen po ltar dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas gang ba/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri ltar grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpag tu med pa'i bzhugs gnas/ byang chub sems dpa' me tog zla mdzes kyi nags tshal kun tu bzang po ltar/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po sgom pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad dang ldan pa/ bya skad snyan pa'i tshogs dang*/ shing dang*/ rtsa dang*/ me tog gi rigs dpag tu med pas shin tu mdzes pa/ shing ljon pa lo ma dang 'bras bu me tog gis spud pa/ bsil ba'i grib ma 'dzin cing tshad pa las skyob pa'i phreng ba can/ gcan gzan dang*/ ri dwags dang srogs chags rnams rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyis byin gyis brlabs pas 'tshe ba med cing skyid par gnas pa/ rang byung gi rten dang khyad par du 'phags pa mang po bzhugs pa'i gnas su/ 'bangs kyi tha ma ldom bu dge slong rin chen dpal gyis/ bla ma dam pa nyid las byung ba'i me tog phra mo shin tu dad pa'i shugs kyis/ skyob mdzad bla ma dam pa dang*/ de'i rjes su slob pa'i dge 'dun bzhugs pa la// phra ba'i me tog phra bar gyur na yang*// bzod pa'i rang bzhin rnams la bzod par gsol// de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med gang bsags pas// bla ma rin chen mchog dang de yi sras rnams dang*// dus rnams rtag tu nam yang mi 'bral zhing*// 'gro rnams byang chub mchog la 'god par shog/

// 353) ༄// lta sgom spyod 'bras gzhan nas btsal mi dgos pa'i tshigs bcad dgu pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rnam rtog 'di// ye shes yin par da gzod shes// lta ba logs nas btsal mi dgos// tha mal shes pa yengs med 'di// sgom pa yin par da gzod shes// nyams myong gzhan nas btsal mi dgos// 'bral ma myong gi rang sems 'di// sangs rgyas yin par da gzod shes// 'bras bu gzhan nas btsal mi dgos// // 354) ༄// rang rgyud tha rgod dul na rin chen mchog tu 'gyur zhes pa// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal mi g.yo bas// las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams// dag par byed cing yon tan rdzogs mdzad pa// rang byung bla ma rin po che dpal 'dud// spyir las kyi sgrib pa mi dang*/ mi khyod rang la nye bar 'khor ba'i chos brgyad po 'di kho na bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis spang bar byed pa yin nam min/ de yin na rang nyid 'jig rten dug gi sdong por byas nas gzhan gyi dug sel bar nus sam/ khyod la mi na re phan par 'dug zer ba de cis phan par 'dug soms dang*/ brlag rgyu chos brgyad po de min nam/ de spong bar byed na zha ngon khyod zhag 'ga' thab ka ngo bsrung dang*/ rnyed pas rnyed pa tshol/ yar dang nga bzang mang po ma bsgrub par/ en gcig khyod rang 'gro dgos pa de 'dra bar yang gyis la/ lus ngag yid gsum de'i phyogs su ma shor ba gal che ste/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gi zhal nas kyang*/ 'jig rten spyod pa ci yang ngas ni ma shes so gsungs/ lus ngag yid gsum brje ba yin// khong rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dam pa rnams// 'jig rten chos brgyad sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan gyi mgo skor mi byed pa// khyod thugs rje chung ngam mi chos glen// kwa chos la sems pa'i dam pa rnams// tha mal mi gtsang bum pa 'di// 'ja' lus rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du// log gis bsgyur nas ci tsug mchi// nyon mongs log pa'i smra brjod 'di// gsang sngags su bsgyur na mi dga' 'am// gzung 'dzin log pa'i rnam rtog 'di// 'od gsal du bgyis kyang ngo ma tsha// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bde skyid rnams// stong nyid snying rje ma gtogs pa// gzhan nas 'byung ba mi srid ces// thub dbang bla mas mi gsung ngam// tshu rol mthong ba'i rmongs pa rnams// ma rig mun pa'i rgya mtsho ru// las nyon chu srin lto ba nas// thar pa med cing sdug bsngal ba// snying rje'i nang na snying rje ste// 'di la smon pa su zhig skye// gzhan lam sna 'dren pa'i rje btsun dam pa khyod// thugs la mi chos bag chags yod pa gzhan rkyen gyis// bslang bas khyod gnyis gzhan gyi mar khrid ded dpon byed// de tshe khyod nyid lus ngag yid gsum ji ltar gces// gang tshe khyod ni stong dang snying rje zung 'jug pa'i// 'od kyis gnas gsum gsal bar byed cing phan pa bskyed// dug ni gnod pa yin no khyed kyis sems la zhog

/thar pa'i lam sna shor bas 'jig rten chos kyis bslus// dmyal bar mngon phyogs gshin rje'i gzugs can 'jigs su rung*// skyob pa med pa de rnams skyob pa byed na ko// rang nyid de yi dbang du song na ji ltar skyabs su 'gyur// de phyir phan pa bskyed na 'khrul 'khor chos la dug sdong rnams dang spyod pa ma bstun cig bla ma dam pa rnams bdag gi lus yongs su bzhes su gsol/ bla ma dam pa rnams bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa bskyed du gsol/ bla ma'i mgo brdung mi bya/ 'dre nyal ba'i mig tu shing bu ma bsug rang thog tu khyi mi rbad/ rang bsod nams bsags pa dang*/ sgom la 'bad na 'dre la lus byin pas chog 'dre rnam rtog yin pas lus byin na 'dod mkhan med/ dad can brtson 'grus ldan pas dam chos nyams len pa/ zla ba yar ngo lta bur gong nas gong du 'phel/ dam pa'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs la bzhugs par gyur pa na/ rang rgyud tha rgod dul na rin chen mchog tu 'gyur// // 355) ༄// nyams rtogs 'bar ba'i thol glu sgom chen gyi bgro gleng*// ratna na mo/ bdag med bdag tu 'dzin pa 'dis// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams// stong pa gzugs su byung ba yis// bsam gyis mi khyab sdug bsngal myong*// da sdug bsngal de las thar 'dod na// bsdam du med pa'i sdom pa blang*// bskyed du med pa'i sems bskyed bya// bsgom du med pa'i phyag rgya bsgom// bgrod du med pa'i sa lam bgrod// thob rgyu med pa'i sku gsum thob// bcings pa med pa'i sems can rnams// rang gi ngang du grol bar bya// chad dang sgrub pa 'thad tshig gsum// med kyang ku re byas pa yin// lan grangs mang bas nyams kyang dga'// dngos po med pas yi yang mug /bla ma slob ma dam chos gsum// med kyang ku re byas pa yin// gzhan gyis glengs na nyams kyang dga'// dngos su med pas yi yang mug

/bdag med gzhan med yul med gsum// med kyang ku re byas pa yin// kun gyi rtsol ba nyams yang dga'// byung ba med pas yi yang mug /char la 'khang ra btang bas bab lo// yang mkhas par gsol ba gcig gis// sgom chen gcig bgro gleng gis ma thub nas/ sgom chen na re/ chos 'di la mkhas pa'i brgyud pa yin// thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang*// tilli nā ro paṇḍi ta// kun bzang sgra sgyur lho brag pa// shes rab mthar phyin ras chen sku// bstan 'dzin zla 'od gzhon nur gyur// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa sogs// lung rigs man ngag nyams rtogs rnams// gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa yin// rmongs pa khyod la ci cha yod// 'ba' shang khyod rang kha rog sdod// zer lo// // 356) ༄// gdul bya'i rigs can tha dad la 'dul thabs tha dad kyis bstan par gdams pa// ji ltar gti mug las skyes pa// rta dang glang po la sogs pa// rigs kyi bye brag shes pa yis// 'dul thabs bye brag so sor bstan// log dang ma log ma nges pa'i// gdul bya rigs can tha dad la// 'dul ba'i bye brag tha dad pa// mkhas pa rnams kyi bsten par byed// sgom chen phyogs bcur gshegs pa rnams// nga 'bu gang la mnyes snyam na// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab la// sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad gyur na// nga 'bu shin tu mnyes pa lags// sdod tshis mi bya 'gro tshis bya// rang mgo ma 'khor tsam re mdzod// bu gcig pha ltar brtse ba'i bdag nyid can// phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin dge 'dun rnams// yon tan che yang mi ngoms rgya mtsho bzhin// yon tan mchog gis gang bar 'dod pa yis// brtse ba'i thugs kyis yang dang yang du spyod// mi shes blo can ma rangs gyur na yang*// kye ma skyes bu dam pa ngo mtshar zhes// 'jig rten 'di na su zhig mgu mi byed// 'jig rten mgon pos gsung pa yin// mkhas pa rang gi sems la dris// lar sems kyi gnas lugs ma go na// kun rdzob bde skyid thabs rnams kun// me yi nang du bsil ba tshol// bu snying gtam tshig gcig 'chad pa de// tshe la long med kyi dus tshod 'dir// log sred tshig gi gdams ngag la// 'dod pa'i bsam pa rab bcad de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog

/bde dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas gtso// gser g.ya' dang bral ba lta bu yi// rang sems spros med rdo rje bsgom// bu log sred can gyi gang zag dang*// rang gi lta spyod mi bstun zhing*// mtho dman gyi gdams ngag sna tshogs kun// rtog pa'i sna kha yin pas na// mthar thug gi 'bras bur ma bsams par// 'gyur med lhun grub 'dus ma byas// bde chen rdo rje rang sems bsgom// bla ma bsten cing gus pa'i phan yon ni// 'jig rten gyi kha na ma tho ba gang yang mi 'byung ba dang*/ yon tan dang bde skyid thams cad zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel ba dang*/ sdig pa thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad ma bsgrubs kyang 'grub pa dang*/ tshe phyi mar byang chub sems dpa'i bla ma gcig dang mjal ba dang*/ bla ma dam pas zin pa'i gang zag de ngan song du nam yang mi skye ba la sogs te rgyas par ni dpal 'byung ba'i rnam thar la sogs par shes par bya'o// mdor na phan yon mtha' med do// ma bsten cing ma gus pa'i nyes dmigs de las bzlog pa'o// gnas skabs dang mthar thug sgrub pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'o// // 257) ༄// dwags lha sgam po'i gdan sa dang brgyud 'dzin rnams la bsngags brjod kyi phrin yig/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dwags lha sgam po'i dgon pa nas// dpal dwags po rin chen la gsol ba 'debs// khong bla ma chen po gnas nang ba'i// lam sna 'di sgam por bsgyur du gsol// nged phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun yang*// khyed rje btsun pa la gsol ba 'debs// sgam po mi nub rgyal mtshan rtser// khyed bla ma rin chen bzhugs par zhu// nged phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun yang*// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// ma lus mtha' dag sgrub pa 'di// khyed bla ma chen po'i zhabs tog yin// dwags po rin chen gyi rgyud 'dzin rnams// khyed rje btsun pa la gsol ba 'debs// gdan sa dwags lha sgam po yi// bdag po rang gi khyim du byon// da yod bzhud snyam yang mi bgyid do// bzhud kyang zhabs la mi 'ju re// cis kyang thag chod bgyis pa lags// sgam po'i ri la bzhugs nas kyang*// gdan sa skyong ba'i dge 'dun rnams// mos gus dang gdung sems drag po yis// phyogs su blta blta mig kyang brdol// rgyug 'dur byas byas rkang pa zad// sna len gra bsham byed byed nas// phugs sris ci yod thang de thal// khong gi ji ltar bsam pa rnams// don med ma mdzad 'byon par zhu// ji ltar bzhed pa'i thugs dgongs rnams// mtha' dag thams cad bsgrub lags pas// sgam po'i re thag ma bcad cig

/lar byas pas mi phan grogs se kun// bla ma rje btsun dbu se yin// 'dzam gling yongs su grags pa yin// dpal nā ro'i gdung rgyud 'dzin pa lags// dgon pa dwags lha sgam po yin// dwags po rin chen gyi gdan sa yin// grub gnas gong na med pa lags// gnas dang rnal 'byor 'dzom pa lags// 'di la dga' ba byung re shi// kha tsam yin na rang la sdig /dwags po chen po'i rgyud 'dzin rnams// dga' bar soms dang rnal 'byor pa// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa lags// ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// de las lhag pa gda' lags sam// // 358) ༄// zad pa bzhi yi dam chos kyis 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal rab tu zad pa// na mo gu ru/ rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma la// chos sku'i nges shes ma skyes na// mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i lta kham yang*// rang dang gong mas khrel bar zad// bde dang sdug bsngal gang snang ba// rang sems yin par ma rtogs na// rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur pa yang*// rje la kha slob byas par zad// spyod lam dus skabs thams cad du// rgyun chad med par ma rtogs na// mnyam rjes med pa'i kha lta yang*// rang la rang phye gtor bar zad// bslab gsum bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// dug gsum zhi bar ma nus na// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa yang*// gong ma'i tshig sgrub yin par zad// zad pa bzhi yi dam chos 'dis// 'gro drug sdug bsngal rab zad nas// bde chen thar pa thob par shog /bde chen thar pa thob par shog /bde chen thar pa thob par shog /gdung 'tshob bus ni pha la mngon lkog med// bran mo kha gsag che yang lkog mi thub// bya zhu can gyi chos ni sa le 'od// ye shes tshul khrims bu ni tshong dpon yin// skyid du re ba'i phru gu rnams// sdug tu bcug pa mthol lo bshags// rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams// gzhan du bzung ba mthol lo bshags// tshig 'jam mkhas pa'i bsngags pa la// tshig rtsub smras pa mthol lo bshags// rang la ltos 'jog byas pa rnams// re thag bcad pa mthol lo bshags// bsam pa gcig tu ma nges pa// gnyis phung byas pa mthol lo bshags// ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las// gti mug dbang gis byis pa rmongs pas na// de dag stong pa zhi ba'i chos mi 'dod// su dag stong pa zhi la dga' ba ni// de dag rgyal ba'i chos 'di bzung ba yin// yang*/

chos nyid du yang mi dbang thams cad ltos// phyogs bcu 'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs dang*// rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa kun snang ste// chos nyid kyi ni sangs rgyas mngon gsum bzhugs/ /chos rnams thams cad stong par shes par gyis// //

359) ༄// kha che'i paṇa chen shākya shrī'i spyan sngar phul ba'i springs yig/ oṃ swasti/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen paṇḍi ta chen po shākya'i shrī'i spyan sngar/ shākya'i sras kyi dge slong bsod snyoms pa rin chen dpal gyis zhu ba/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'jig tu nye ba'i dus la bab pas/ bstan pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs stobs 'phel bas/ dkar po phyogs kyi yul dang phyogs dang ris thams cad bcom pas thugs ngal bar gyur pa dang*/ bgrod dka' zhing rtsub pa'i shul ring po nas byon pa'i stobs kyi sku ngal bar gyur pa dang*/ skad rigs mi gcig pa'i nyes pas phan tshun gyi ngag brjod pa go bar dka' bar gyur pas gsung ngal ba dang*/ cung zad dub par gyur kyang thub pas lung bstan pa byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i gnas/ theg pa chen po'i rigs can sha stag gis gang ba/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang tshul khrims kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa la/ spyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po che ltar 'du shes shing*/ dad pa dang gus pa'i shugs rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs ltar g.yo ba'i phyogs 'dir byon pa ni/ paṇḍi ta chen po rang gi gnas pa khyim du bu byon pa lta bu lags shing*/ bod khams thams cad skal ba dang ldan pa lags la/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa thams cad kyang lus sems dga' bdes rgyas shing*/ nyid kyi thugs la btags pa la bdag kyang glo ba dga' zhing mchis/ slad kyi don zhu ba/ spyir bod kyi rgyal khams 'di rgya gar gi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i spyod yul lags so// paṇḍi ta dang grub thob dang*/ yon tan can dpag tu med pa byon nas tshul khrims rin po che brtul zhugs 'dzin pa nyung bas phan rlabs po che ma thog pa lags/ de yang sngon slob dpon bo dhi sa twa zhes bgyi ba byung*/ de nas skabs su paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba byung*/

da ltar bod kyi rgyal khams 'di dge slong de gnyis kyis tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs gcig pu la brten pa lags/ da khyed kyis rgya gar na ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs de mdzad pas/ bod thams cad kyi mig rten du gyur pa lags/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang tshul khrims byon pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byon pa lags pas/ de la dga' ba dang dad pa dang*/ gus pa'i shugs kyis/ yul mtha' 'khob yin yang ko lpags ni nged kyang mi gon/ thul gog spu yod pa'i zla gam dang sha can lpags tshags dang phyam tse zla gam ni nams kyang mi gsol ba'i rang bzhin/ gos na bza' ther ba dang gru bzhi/ thub pas legs par bsngags shing 'os pa/ dge sbyong gi tshul dang mthun pa/ tshul khrims nyams pa dang cho ga nyams pa sngags mi 'chags pa'i phyam tse dang sha 'gag ma lags pa/ chos dang mthun pa'i na bza' phrug cig la/ ling pong dar srab 'gu che'i snam sbyar gcig dang*/ pong 'gu che rdo rje gsang lam ma'i thang ba gcig dang*/ li khri gcig nyi ma ris kyi sham thab gcig dang*/ phyi tse'u si/ nang ha pu/ bar srin rtel rna gcug pa'i 'phyar bu gcig dang*/ ling rin po che'i ri mo can gyi rngul gzan gcig dang*/ lnga 'bul zhing mchis pa/ nga'i nye gnas gcig la bskur nas mchis pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ na bza' phyag dar khrod kyi tshem bu 'di dag cis kyang sku la gsol bar zhu 'tshal/ gser srang gang mchis pa 'di/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lo tsā bas zhal zas dgyes pa gcig tu legs par bsgrubs nas/ bdag gi bsod snyoms 'di zhal du 'du ba zhig mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ bdag gi nye gnas sgom pa dar gzhon gyis chab tsha zi po la srang lnga dang thud legs pa du ma zhig bskur nas mchis/ dgyes par gda' na da rung yang bskur rgyu mchis pa lags/ bod la kha zas legs pa mi 'dug gsung skad pas tig ta mang du 'dren par zhu/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po lo tsā ba la/ nang dar ser po kha the'u ma nyams pa gcig dang*/ dmar po kha the'u ma nyams pa gcig dang*/ srugs kha the'u ma nyams pa gcig dang gsum 'bul zhing mchis/ ji ltar sha chang 'dod yon gyi// ro yis rnam par myos pa yi// skye bos 'jig rten gang gyur cing*// gsang sngags theg chen yin smra yang*// mig ldan dga' zhing gus pa byed pa med// tsha sgo'i thang 'dra bod yul 'dir// u dum wa ra 'di byung ba// mkhas pa chen po lo tsā bas// snying dang mig bzhin btsa' bar zhu// nam mkha' mdzod dang rin chen bzhin// // 360) ༄// nag shod mkhan po la gdams pa'i gsang gtam chen mo bka' phrin// rje mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mi kho bo rang gi 'dug lugs de// khyed rang nyid la cha yod mod// sngon bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// sog g.yag la se bo man chad du// lus srog la bab kyang mi 'gro bar// dbus gtsang rig pa'i 'byung gnas su// ri khrod gangs khrod 'grims par bsams// de tshe 'di log pa'i blo gros kyis// 'jig rten chos brgyad bsam pa yis// khams su rnyed bkur ga la tshol// mi kho bo rang gi gser 'bum ni// rigs skyon dang bral ba'i mthing shog la// gser sbyangs pa bla ma'i gdams ngag de// mos gus shugs kyis sems la bris// smra bsam brjod med kyi ngo bor rtogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum// shes rab pha rol phyin pa de// bla ma'i drin gyis rang la rnyed// nga rang yang yon bdag cig yin nam snyam// che 'dod bzang 'dod kyi log rtog gis// ched du tshol na rang la sdig /shugs la byung na khab skud kyang*// dga' dang gus pas len pa yin// chen po'i rdzas gzhan smos ci dgos// lar cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba yi// sems sku gsum dbyer med ma gtogs pa// tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i skyabs gzhan med// rnam rtog 'ja' tshon ri mo yis// rmongs pa'i byis pa bslu bar byed// chos brgyad smig rgyu'i rgya mtsho la// tshe 'di log par bslus pa yi// byis pa rmongs pa'i ri dwags rnams// 'khrul pas skom drir 'chi ba yin// de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed// skyob pa skyabs chen rang sems bsgoms// rang sems bsgom pa ma gtogs pa// bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs gzhan med// gsang gtam chen mo'i bka' 'phrin gyi// yang lan gsang gtam chen mo 'di// skyes bu dam pa'i thugs la zhog

/rdzogs so// nags shod mkhan po la// // 361) ༄// 'du shes bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas man ngag/ gu ru dam pa na mo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ dpal rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi man ngag grub thob thams cad kyi thugs kyi nying khu/ tilli pa'i dgongs pa/ birwa pa'i gsang rgyu/ nyams su blang ba'i man ngag la/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes/ gdams ngag la nor bu rin po che lta bu'i 'du shes/ rang nyid la khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pas nad pa lta bu'i 'du shes/ chos la bdud rtsi lta bu'i 'du shes bskyed/ snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bo la/ be'u bum rang yang mi bstan par bya ste rang nyid kyis sgrub par bya'o// // 362) ༄// zhen pa gtong ba'i brtul bzhugs skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar bya ba'i gdams pa// 'di ltar dbang phyug 'khor los bsgyur// byams pa chen po'i zhags pa yis// skye dgu thams cad bzung nas kyang*// bsod nams bsags pa'i mthu stobs kyis// 'gro ba bde la 'god pa ni// zhe 'dod med pa'i brtul bzhugs kyis// thams cad grub par gyur pa yin// phan dang bsod nams stobs yod kyang*// gnas kyi zhen pa phra mo yis// phra ba'i mi chos 'dun ma yang*// 'grub par gyur ba mi srid na// bla med byang chub smos ci dgos// des na bde skyid 'dod pa rnams// zhen pa gtong ba'i brtul bzhugs dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi bya// chos rje bla ma'i zhal snga nas// sems gsum la sogs rten 'brel dang*// dus gsum rten 'brel 'bras bu ni// khams gsum pa yi rten 'brel dang*// bslab gsum yon tan 'brel ba ni// sa bon gang btub ston dang mtshungs// de bas byams dang snying rje sogs// sems gsum rgyal ba'i khang bzang mchog /thams cad kun gyi zhing sa bzhin// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten yin// dkar nag las kyi rgyu lam 'bras// gang du 'gyur med 'bras bu spyod// babs kyi rten 'brel gnad du che// 'gyur med 'od gsal dri ma med// lhun grub bde ba chen po'i sku// sngon gyi thugs rje smon lam gyis// nged kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// 'gro drug kun gyi dpal du shar// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung gnas gtso// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen ni// tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin// brgyud pa gong ma'i rjes 'brangs pa// tshogs gnyis mig dang bral ba ni// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs pa dka'// rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa mchog

/dpal ldan tilli zhes bya ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po ni// snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rnams// tshad med thugs rje chen po yis// rjes su bzung ba'i snang ba yin// gsang sngags gnad kyi man ngag gis// log par ltung ba'i sems can rnams// thugs rje chen pos bzung byas pa'i// sgrub pa dkyus su ma chod na// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// 'gran zla med pa'i chen po khyed// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyis// ku sā li yi rnal 'byor pa// che thabs spangs pa'i tilli la// bcu gnyis bar du bsten byas te// dka' ba rnam pa bcu gnyis kyis// bla ma mnyes par byas pa las// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob// gong ma'i rjes 'jug rnal 'byor pa// che thabs nga rgyal rab spang nas// lus dang srog la sogs pa yis// bla ma mnyes par ma byas na// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// bod du 'khrungs pa'i lo tsā ba// rje btsun mar pa lho brag pas// yab yum rang yul longs spyod dang*// lus srog bde skyid thams cad la// ltos pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis// bgrod par dka' ba'i rgya gar du// dpal chen nā ro'i drung du phyin// rgyud sde bzhi yi man ngag gis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par mdzad// snying stobs med pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la des// zwa tshwa med gsol ba'i spyod 'gros kyis// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// ras rkyang pa gcig gi na bza' gsol// nyal ba med pa'i 'dug lugs kyis// lo bzhi bcu lon pa'i bgres po des// dus rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// rlung srog rtsol gnad du bsnun pa yis// gtum mo ye shes me 'bar nas// mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes// sgrub pa snying por mi byed pa'i// bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras kyang*// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// mtshungs pa med pa'i rje btsun pa// 'gran zla med pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon// mnyam med bla ma rnam gnyis kyis// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan thogs nas// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// spros med lhan cig skyes pa yis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par mdzad// rang sems chos skur ma rtogs na// gong ma'i rjes su snyogs par dka'// gong ma'i rjes su ma snyogs na// bdag lta shi dang ci ma 'dra// yang grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma la// rang snying dpang du btsugs pa yi// gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// brgyud pa gong ma'i rjes 'brangs nas// brgyud pa gong ma'i mdzad spyod kyis// dus rgyun chad med par gnas par smon// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// che thabs zang zing ma mchis kyang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa der// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bas// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bde skyid la// rtsol sgrub med par shugs kyis spyod// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// nye du gnyen 'brel thams cad kyis// sems sdug bsngal drag po mi bskyed kyang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro rnams// dus rgyud chad med par byin gyis rlob// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// 'jig rten spros pas mi g.yeng ste// byar med kyi ngang du sos dal skyong*// rje gong ma'i rjes su ma bslabs na// thugs la btags pa don re chung*// byin gyis brlabs pa chud re zos// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// rje gong ma rnams kyi spyod 'gros kyis// gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// dus rgyun chad med par gnas par shog/

// 363) ༄// nyon mongs che 'bring chung gsum spong sems drag po dgos pa sdom pa rin chen// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang*/ lam bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la gtor mas mnyes par byas pa dang*/ bla mar bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ rdo rje spun la tshogs kyi 'khor lo drangs pa dang*/ mdor na dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dang gang bgyis pa des/ lus kyis sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig ces pa nas/ de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig /ces pa'i bar du'o// lus sems gnyis kyis ma myong ba'i// gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag che ba kun// chos rgyal bla ma'i zhal snga nas// chos mkhyid gang ma zhes bka' stsal gsung*// mkhyid gang ma yi dam chos kyis// rang la phan nam gzhan la phan// 'khor 'das kun gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i// 'byung gnas khams gsum kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu spong ba'i sems// sdom pa rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa don du gnyer ba'i rten gyi gang zag sgrub pa pos/ yon tan rin po che rgyud la ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa gong nas gong du bogs 'don dgos pa/ de gang 'dod kyang gong du yon tan ma skyes pa'am/ bogs ma byung ba'i rgyu la bltas te/ de ngos zin nam mgo 'am gos la me shor ba'am/ pang du sbrul 'ongs pa ltar/ shin tu myur ba'i brtson 'grus kyis spang bar bya ste/ ma spangs na ni bskal pa grangs med pa gsum bas/ grangs med pa bye ba phrag mang por yang lha dang mi'i go 'phang tsam yang mi thob na/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu ni mi srid pa nyid do// de la yon tan ma skyes na mi skye ba'i rgyu ngo shes par bya ste/ yon tan gang yin yang mi skye ba'i rgyu ni/

de rang du ltas pas rang gzhan bas lhag pa/ mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa gang yin pa de la yon tan zer la/ yon tan de rgyud la skye ba rang gi snga ma'i lus ngag yid gsum de spong dgos/ spangs pa'i tshul lugs khyim pa'i rtags spangs pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags yang dag par blangs nas khyim dang 'dre ba med par/ zas bsod snyoms gos phyag dar khrod/ gnas shing drung du bcas nas klog pa'i 'khor los de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung*/ phung po lngas bsdus pa sdug bsngal ba dang*/ de 'byung bar byed pa'i rgyu kun 'byung*/ de 'gag pas 'gog pa'i rgyur 'gro ba'i thabs/ lam gyi bden pa la nges pa'i shes pa bskyed pa ni/ tha mal pa'i ngag spang pa'o// de skad du 'phags pa ba glang bdag gis/ tshul khrims rin po che bre mo'i gtam gyi bar chad ma zhugs sam zhes dris pa lta bu'o// tha mal pa'i yid spangs pa ni/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa la// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa brjod// ces slob dpon shanta de ba la sogs pas gsungs pa'i don/ ltung ba sde lnga nyon mongs pa dug gsum po che 'bring chung gsum spong bar gsungs pa/ mi gtsang spyod dang rku ba ni 'dod chags rags pa/ mi gsod pa ni zhe sdang rags pa/ mi chos bla ma ni gti mug chen po lhag ma'i sde dang ltung ba byed dang*/ spang ba'i ltung byed ni 'bring*/ bslab par bya ba'i chos ni tha ma ste/ de ltar nyon mongs pa che 'bring gsum spong ba'i bsam pa drag pos/ srog la bab kyang tshul khrims mi gtong ba zhig dgos la/ de yang kā ri kā nas/ gdug pa sbrul gyi khar bcug bla// lus la dka' thub mi bshig ces// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bka' bstsal to// zhes pas srog la bab kyang mi gtong ba zhig dgos/ de yang sdom pa len pa'i dus su ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du khas blangs pa las dus 'di dang 'dir gnang ba'i skabs yod pas ci bder yang bya'o zhes dam bcas pa med pa dang*/

de bzhin gshegs pas mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung bar mkhyen pas de gnang ste mi mchi/ lar gnang ba'i gnas skabs bstan pa mar 'grib pa dang*/ yul mtha' 'khob tu gyur pas gang zag gi blo bcos pa'i 'dul ba yul chos su song bas gnang ba mang yang*/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu lta ci yang ma tshang ste/ lha dang mi'i 'bras bu tsam mi thob pas/ srog la bab kyang sems brtan pos bsrung ba ni/ yon tan ma skyes pa'i rgyu spong ba bstan pa'i/ spyir srung sems med pa'i gang zag dang*// bsod nams bsags pa chung ba dang*// dad med bdud kyi dbang song dang*// shes rab gsum gyi mig med pas// thub pa'i bstan pa 'jig par byed// lhag pa'i tshul khrims sun 'byin cing*// rgyu dang 'bras bu khyad du gsod// rje rin po che yi zhal snga nas// rgyu 'bras la nges shes ma skyes na// sdig pa che yang rgyan du mthong*// gsungs/ lar rgyu sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu la// lang kar gshegs pa la sogs pa// theg pa chen po'i mdo rnams su// de bzhin gshegs pas bkag pa dang*// dge slong phyi rkon 'dug lugs dang*// sha yi nyes pa mthong tsam na// za bar 'dod pa skyi sha tsha// dngos su za ba 'jigs kyang 'jigs// chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas rnams// bza' bar 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang*// khas blangs dam tshig nyams pa yis// ngan song gsum du mi 'gro ba// dus gsum rgyal bas ma gsungs pa'i// gdams ngag zab mo su las rnyed// bu rang la snying brtse yod gyur na// dran pa'i mel tshe 'bad par gyis// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pa// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba zhes// thub pa'i dbang pos gang gsungs pa// dran pa tsam du gcig na yang*// dran pa gzung yul tha dad do// spyir 'gog pa'i bden pa gzhir bzhag nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye ba dam pa'i chos padma dkar po la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab mang po dang*/

slob dpon 'phags pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i bzhed pa yang rnal 'byor pa'i blo'i dus tshod so sor thar pa zhes bya'o// 'gog pa de rang gi yon tan ma chags pa/ zhe sdang med pa gti mug med pa'o// de stobs 'phel ba zhe sdang med pa stobs 'phel ba la byams pa dang snying rje dang*/ yang na byang chub kyi sems so// //

364) ༄// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i snying gtam tshig gsum dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal seng la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa rnams// gnyis med byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// sangs rgyas sku gsum bde ba chen por bsgyur mdzad pa// mnyam med bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// ku sā li yi gsang tshig 'di// nyams dang yon tan bskyed pa la// nor bu rin chen 'dra bar 'gyur// mi bzad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di// rang nyid yin par ma shes na// tha snyad tshig la chags pa rnams// spang bya gnyen por ma shes pas// 'bad pa byas kyang 'bras bu med// spang bya 'khor ba ngos zin na// gnyen po de dang dbyer med gnas// gnyis ka rang gi bsam pa yin// bdag med bdag tu 'dzin pa de// gti mug ma rig chen po yin// bdag 'dzin nam mkha'i padmo la// chags sdang rtog pa'i mo sham bus// chos brgyad me tog kha dog bltas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer du// dug gsum sdug bsngal lo 'bras de// 'khrul pa'i byis pas rgyan du thogs// mdzes su re yang phung nas mchi// skyid du re ste sdug nas mchi// skyabs dang bral ba de dag gis// skyabs mgon dkon mchog gsum po btsal// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog de// gzhan du rnyed pa ma yin te// mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa la// snying gtam 'dun gros dris pa'i blo// rtsa ba bdag 'dzin ma rig pa// skye ba med par rtogs pa'i tshe// spang blang med pas rang sar grol// rang gi gshis la 'pho 'gyur med// 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// spangs thob bzang ngan phyogs ris med// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// spros dang bral ba'i chos skur 'gyur// sangs rgyas dkon mchog 'di nyid yin// 'di la mos shing bsten pa rnams// skyabs 'gro dang po thob pa yin// skyabs su song ba'i phan yon la// nged rang da lta spyod pa la// mi chos mdun mar mi brtsi zhing*// thar pa'i srog rtsa mi gcod 'tshal// gnyis med 'od gsal chen po de// rtogs pas sems bskyed thob pa yin// dri med byang sems rin po che// gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje des// bag chags rtog pa'i sgrib pa rnams// bcom zhing spangs pa'i bye brag la// sa dang lam zhes mkhas pas gsungs// mig med rmongs pa'i byis pa rnams// sa lam mi 'dod ji ltar lags// goms pa mthar phyin sangs rgyas la// spang bya gnyen po gnyis med na// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog ga la yod// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba ni// sems dang sems las byung ba yi// 'jug pa nye bar zhi ba ste// rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas// sems med sems las byung ba med// zab mo bka' bstsal gsungs pas so// skyabs chen sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*// bu skad cig tsam yang ma bral dang*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs nas mchi// 'di spang bya gnyen po gnyis med kyang*// gti mug dag pa'i lag rjes yin// yang gang la zhen pa skye ba'i yul// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*// mtho dman bzang ngan thams cad kun// thugs gnyis 'dres pa'i gong ma la// 'gro ba'i don du gtong na yang*// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa yis// chags pa gsum dang bral gyur la// sems can khams dang gong ma'i thugs// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa des// 'khor ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho rnams// sems can rnams la ma smin na// sems can rnams kyi don ched du// bsngos pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// sems can rnams la ma smin pas// rgyu 'bras phyin ci log tu nges// sems can kun la smin gyur kyang*// byas pas mi rtag nges pas na// skye zhing 'gag par 'gyur zhe na// dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kun// sems can don du bsngos pas na// sems can khams rnams zad pa dang*// dge ba zad pa nyid du gyur// zad med sems can khams rnams dang*// 'gro ldog gcig tu nges pa 'o// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// stong pa nyid du gnas pas na// bsngos kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba des// phan dang gnod par mi 'gyur ro// snyam pa'i rtog pa skye na yang*// 'khor gsum dag pa'i rnam gzhag kyang*// khyad par myong bas ma phye bas// stong ngo snyam pa'i rnam rtog la// don dam bden par byas pa yin// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa ni// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yi// dge ba'i rtsa ba gang byed rnams// gnyis su med par gnas pas na// byed pa thabs dang ma bral zhing*// byed pa byed med rab rtogs pas// gnyis su yang ni mi 'gyur te// byed pa med pa'i byed pa 'dis// 'khrul par gyur pa'i sems can la// 'khrul pa'i rnam pa byung gyur na// 'khrul pa med pa nyid la 'god// sgyu ma'i rten 'brel zab mo 'di// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis// blo yi yul du ma gyur pas// mi ldog sems dpa' chen po la// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba zhes// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa yin// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi// yon tan dpag tu med pa yang*// 'khor bar 'jigs pa'i blo gros kyis// thar pa 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis// bsod nams bsags pa'i mthu med na// nyan thos rang rgyal gang nas byung*// thub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho rnams// bsod nams tshogs las byung ba ste// sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// dpe byad 'od zer rab 'bar zhing*// zhing rnams kun tu skus khyab pa// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes can// rgyu med 'bras bu las skye'am// yon tan med par gyur ba med// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su zhig zer// des na rgyu lam 'bras bur yang*// rten 'brel zab mo nyid du gnas// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi srog gcig pu// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsung gi gces pa gsang ba'i mdzod// dam chos dkon mchog rin po che// 'di la mos shing bsten pas kyang*// chos la skyabs su song ba ste// rtag chad lta ba spangs nas kyang*// sangs rgyas sras su gyur ba yin// dam chos 'di ni gang rtogs pa// sems bskyed dam pa thob 'gyur te// 'khor 'das rang gzhan thams cad kun// gnyis med rgya mtsho cher bzhugs nas// sa lam yon tan rdzogs par byed// mthar thug rgyal ba'i yon tan sku// mi zad gter chen 'di nyid dang*// bu skad cig tsam yang ma bral cig

/yang dge dang mi dge ngos zin na// zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med// sdug bsngal phung khrol bskyed pa'i gzhi// snying rus chen por mtshan gsol ba// zhe sdang rus shing chen po 'di// byams dang snying rje'i stobs su bsgyur// byams dang snying rje'i stobs 'phel na// byang chub sems la ngang gis 'jug /byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// byang chub mchog la 'god par byed// bem po sra ba'i dngos po rnams// 'og min gnas mchog dam par 'gyur// gtong ba'i shugs dang stong nyid la// bskal pa bye ba grangs med par// rgyun chad med par rtag gnas kyang*// byang chub sems kyi rgyu med na// 'bras bu sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba// khyed mkhyen pa can gyis dgongs kyang dgongs// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsung rab 'o ma krogs pa'i bcud// byang chub sems 'di yod med las// dam chos yod med ma mchis te// rna bas thos pa tsam gyis kyang*// 'khor ba'i bag chags zad par byed// gus pas bsten nas skyabs su song*// rgyud la skyes pa'i sems bskyed de// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du// rang nyid gyur pas sa la gnas// stong nyid bsod nams tshogs kyis kyang*// bsam pa 'di yi stobs 'phel bas// sangs rgyas sku gsung thams cad kyis// 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun// bde chen sa la 'god par byed// byang chub sems 'di dge ba ste// 'di la 'dun par gang byed pa// de ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ste// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gdung rgyud 'dzin pa sras kyi mchog /dge 'dun dkon mchog 'di nyid dang*// bral bar ma byed rnal 'byor pa// de ltar dus gsum rgyu la gnas pas sems can khams yin pas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bzlog pa'i dam chos sde snod gsum// bslab pa gsum la bslab pas sku gsum 'bras bur 'grub// rdo rje theg pa gsang sngags mchog tu gang gis rab bshad pa// de yang 'di las gzhan zhig yod pa ma yin pas// skyabs mchog dam pa 'di dang khyed cag bral bar ma byed cig

/thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab kyis// spyod dang rang gi mtshan nyid la// chags dang thogs pa mi mnga' yang*// ku sā li yi gzhung lugs la// nyams len don thag chod bzhed pa// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal seng bar// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// snying gtam tshig gsum bshad pa 'di// snying dang 'dra bas thugs la zhog /'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// 'gro rnams sku gsum thob par shog/ // 365) ༄// phyag rgya chen po gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyong stangs// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// nang par dang por sems bskyed/ de nas yi dam bsgom/ de nas bla ma bsgom/ de'i rjes la phyag rgya chen po nyid pril le bsgom gsungs/ rin po ches ni thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor byas gsungs/ dkon mchog gsum sngon byung ba de yin na ji ltar du bsgrubs dgongs pa la rje phag mo gru pa dang mjal nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang 'khor ba de gnyis ka yang bsam par go gsung*/ 'khor ba bsam pa yin te/ rnam par rtog pa 'khor ba'i rgyu yin te/ de yang bzang rtog bskyed rim bsgom pa la sogs pa dge ba'i las 'dus byas pas lha dang mir skye/ ngan rtog nyon mongs pa'i kun slong byas nas mi dge ba 'dus byas pas ngan song du skye ste/ ji skad du/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// zhes gsungs so// dkon mchog gsum yang bsam pa yin te/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa thog ma nas yod pa rnam par mi rtog pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs pa/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de dkon mchog gsum yin te/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// zhes gsungs so// de ltar 'khor 'das gnyis ka sems su go zhing*/ sems de yang rtog pa med pa mya ngan las 'das pa chen po dang*/ ro gcig dang ro mnyam chen po'i rnal 'byor zhes ming gi rnam grangs yin te/

ji skad du/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa nyid// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod par bya// zhes gsungs so// rnam par mi rtog pa de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ zhi gnas kyi bde gsal mi rtog pa dang*/ lhag mthong gi bde gsal mi rtog pa'o// zhi gnas kyi mi rtog pa ni/ ci yang mi tshor ba gnyid log pa lta bu ste/ phyi ba dang khams gong ma'i lha 'ba' zhig bzhin no// de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin de'i rgyu ni rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel gyis 'byung ste/ rtsa gnyid log pa la sogs pa'o// gsal ba ni mig phye ba dang btsums pa khyad med pa zla ba shar ba lta bu dang*/ gnyid 'od gsal du song bas nye ba dang ring ba la sogs pa'i yul mthong ba yin/ de'i rgyu rlung dbu mar tshud pa la sogs pa yin te/ bde ba ni shin tu bde ba ste/ de yi rgyu ni phyag rgya bsten pa dang*/ gtum mo tsand+ra li bsgom pa la sogs pa yin no// de ltar gsum po de 'tshogs sam re re yang rung ste/ gzugs med pa dang 'dod khams su skye ba'i rgyu yin pa dang*/ lha tshe ring po bzhin du log lta dang skur 'debs kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis smad pas spang zhing dor bar bya/ de lta bu de yang bsgom 'dod 'dod po de rnam rtog mang ba la gnas skabs kyi drang don tsam yin/ rje rin po che mtha' rtsa bas ni zhag gsum phyin chad mi 'jog gsungs/ lhag mthong gi mi rtog pa ni thog ma nas yod pa gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngo bo bde ba/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam par mi rtog de yang nyams sgrib thams cad dang bral ba yin gsungs/ de lta bu skye ba'i rgyu yang bla ma byin rlabs dang gdams ngag ldan pa gcig dang*/ slob ma mos gus dang ldan pa zhig gis 'khrul 'khor gsum la brten nas skye ste/ re shig lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni rkang pa dkyil dkrung che chung ran par bya/

thur sel gyi rlung dbang du byed pa yin/ rkang pa g.yas phyir bton na bde ba yin/ sgal tshigs bsrang*/ lag pa spu mtshams su mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bkan te bya/ g.yas steng du bde ba yin/ rked pa dgye dgu ran pa drang por bzhag mig gnya' shing gang tsam du dbab ste/ drang por bzhag go// ngag gi 'khrul 'khor smra brjod dang bral bar bya/ sems kyi 'khrul 'khor bya byed dang bral bar bya/ de rnams kyi rten 'brel 'dzom pa las skye gsungs/ yang phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i dus su/ bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ yi dam sgom pa dang*/ snying rje dang dad gus la sogs pa drag po sgom pa'i bya byed dang bral bar bya'o// de rnams bsgom pa'i dus su phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i bya byed dang bral bar bya ste/ cig car ba yi sman chen la// rim gyis pa yi dug tu 'gyur// rim gyis pa yi sman chen la// cig car ba yi dug tu 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// spyir gnas dben par bsgom pa yin/ dben par bsgom pa'i dus su/ yid mi dga' ba dang*/ snying 'phar ba la sogs pa dang*/ tshig pa za na shes pa ha cang bsgrims drags pa yin pas/ tshogs su cha la mnyam du bsgom/ tshogs su de bzhin byung na dben par bsgom/ gang du byung ba'i dus de bzhin du gzhan du yang bsgom gsungs/ yang sgom pa'i dus su rnam rtog drag po dang*/ nyon mongs pa 'phel na/ bar du gcod pa 'jug pas thabs gang gi sgo nas kyang spang bar bya gsungs/ yang dus ma yin pa dang*/ nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la gnyid spangs te/ gdon dang nad la sogs pa thams cad gnyid la 'khra brten pa ba yin pas gnyid spang gsungs// // 366) ༄// kun la sman pa'i rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo'i bdud rtsi gtung bar gdams pa// kye ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'di las 'di 'byung nges pa yi// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs la// lugs 'byung lugs las ldog pa'i chos// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo 'di// bde gshegs bla ma'i gsung las rnyed// 'brel med tshig gi be'u bum la// zab pa'i gdams ngag re ba kun// nga bzang gi gsung skad 'brug ltar sgrogs// shi na pham por mi mchi 'am// rang rgyud pa spo'i sa gzhi la// byams snying rje'i sa bon ma btab par// 'bras bu sangs rgyas re ba kun// tug gis thug na bslu bar nges// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yi// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma go bar// bzang po khyad du gsod pa rnams// rang la 'khor nas mi mchi 'am// soms dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// 'di ni bla ma'i gdams ngag ste// rang gzhan kun la sman pa yi// bdud rtsi 'di ni btung bar bya//

367) ༄// skal ldan sems thag chod pa'i zhal gdams nyams len sgron me// rang sems bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams pa zab mo zhig btsal dgos snyam na/ chos thams cad la mi zab pa med/ sems gtan la 'bebs par gcig bla ma'i byin rlabs khyad che/ bla ma gdam la mos gus bya ba dang*/ des blo sna bsgyur ba gdams ngag zab pa yin no// bgegs la sogs pa mang bas srung 'khor dgos snyam na/ nyon mongs pa'i dug tu rnam rtog rgyun bcad dang*/ 'gal rkyen thams cad mthu rdugs par nges so// thos pa yang dgos par 'dug snyam na/ sems phyag rgya chen po gnyis med kyi ngang du sdod dang*/ chos thams cad de'i steng du gzhol zhing 'bab/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang bsgoms pas go ba yin no// las rgyu 'bras bshad pa ltar bden nam mi bden snyam na/ zhing bla ma dam pa dang yi dam yang rang sems/ chags sdang gi yul yang rang sems yin pas/ dge sdig ci byas rang sems la smin nges pas bden no// gdams ngag gi rgyus mang po yang dgos snyam na/ spyir 'dus byas mi rtag pa rang gi sems thog tu 'bros 'ded go na de yin no// nā ro chos drug la sogs pa'i thabs lam yang ma bsgoms snyam na/ tha mal pa'i sems dang bral bas phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas snang srid yi dam lha las ldang 'jug med na/ thabs lam thams cad bsgoms pa yin no// 'gal rkyen sel ba dang mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i las tshogs bsgrub dgos snyam na/ phyag rgya chen po gnyis su med pa'i ngang nas byams snying rje rgyun ma chad par bsgoms na/ las thams cad 'grub pa bdo ba yin no// 'dag sbyar ram dben par bsgom dgos snyam na/ rnam shes tshogs drug yul rkyen gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par dran pa yengs pa med pas 'phong dang gri skor mkhan 'thab pa lta bur ma yengs pa gnad du che'o// bla ma bzhud pa'am rang 'gro bas bsten du ma byung snyam na/

spyir thams cad sems yin/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas bla ma ma brjed na bla ma dang ma bral bar bsten pa yin/ byin rlabs 'jug nges so// lta spyod sgom gsum thag ji ltar gcad snyam na/ sems gdod ma nas ma skyes shing gnyis med blo las 'das pa lta ba/ de las ma yengs pa sgom pa/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa spyod pa yin te/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis nyon mongs kyi las mi bsgrubs pa so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ ci byed thams cad sems can gyi don du byed pa byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa/ de'i ched du lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems phyag rgya chen po dang ma bral ba rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig gsum gcig pa ni bstan pa spyi'i babs/ nyams len thams cad 'dus pa/ chos kun dang mthun pa rin po che'i lugs kyang lta sgom spyod gsum gcig par bzhed pas thag de ltar bcad do// 'bras bu mthar thug pa gang yin snyam na/ snang srid thams cad sems/ sems gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su rgyas pas sku gsum mi zad pa'i gter ro// grangs kyi gnas gzhan dang po yi// nyams len gsal ba'i sgron ma 'dis// skal ldan sems thag chod par gyis// 'dis ni kun la phan par shog/ // 368) ༄// phyag rgya chen po snying po don gyi gdams ngag lnga ldan dang dam tshig brgyad ldan// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas// phyag rgya chen po snying po don gyi gdams ngag 'di la don lnga yin gsungs/ de yi gdams ngag brgyud pa dang ldan pa/ lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa/ sgom pa nyams myong dang ldan pa/ spyod pa ro snyoms dang ldan pa/ nges shes kyis skyon bsal ba dang ldan pa'o// dang por phyag rgya chen po don brgyud kyi gdams ngag tshig rgyud tha snyad du ma shor ba/ mi bar khyis ma chod pa zhig dgos te/ de yang dpal rdo rje 'chang nas bla ma rin po che yan chad do// gnyis pa lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa ni/

don spyi tsam 'jal ba de ma yin te/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis rang sems skye med rtogs na rnal 'byor pas/ sems nyid skye ba med pa dang*// snang grags 'di gnyis dbyer med par rtogs pa ste/ chu dang 'khyag rom mam/ til dang til gyi mar bzhin no// gsum pa sgom pa nyams myong dang ldan pa ni/ rang sems spros pa mtha' dag dang bral bar rtogs pa'o// bzhi pa spyod pa ro snyoms dang ldan pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje ro snyoms/ snang ba stong pa ro snyoms/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ro snyoms/ nad 'byung ba bzhi ro snyoms dang ldan pa'o// lnga pa nges shes skyon bsal dang ldan pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig brgyad yin te/ de yang rang sems skye med du rtogs kyang bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mi spang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa nas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba yan chad la zab mi zab dang*/ grogs po la sogs pa'i skyon mi brjod/ yar sangs rgyas la re ba med kyang chos spyod rgyun mi bcad/ mar 'khor ba la dogs pa med kyang kha na ma tho ba phra rags la 'dzem par blta/ ting nge 'dzin chur mi bying ba la sogs pa yod kyang rang che ba'i nga rgyal mi bya/ 'khor 'das gnyis su med par shes kyang lta spyod gzhan dang bstun/ sangs rgyas dang sems can rgyud gcig tu rtogs kyang snying rje rang shugs la skye ba/ sgom pa mnyam rjes med kyang dgon pa bsten par bya'o// phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig brgyud pa snying po don gyi gdams ngag bsdus pa rdzogs so// // 369) ༄// yul la ma blta sems la ma blta zhes pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen jo sras kyi zhu chos// na mo ratna gu ru/ skyabs chen bla ma dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// sngon sbyang tshogs chen dpag med kyis// da lta thub pa'i bstan pa la// skye ba mi lus rin chen thob// dpag med yon tan gter gyur pa// dge ba'i bshes gnyen jo sras kyis// zhus pa'i gdams ngag rin po che// skur gcig gsung ba'i gdams ngag 'di// tshul bzhin nyams su blang bar zhu// khams gsum sems can thams cad kun// mi rtag srin po'i khar chud pas// yun ring zhig tu sdod dbang med// glog dang chu bur ji bzhin du// rtag pa med par thugs la zhog

/byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// yi dam lha la nan tan bsgom// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// bla mar mos gus tshad du bskyal// bsags pa can gyi gang zag gis// bla mar mos gus skyes pa'i tshe// rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo 'di// tshig dang yi ges ma bslad cing*// snyam tsam rtog pas ma bkab pa'i// rang byung sems nyid ngo bo mthong*// ngo bo gzugs med mthong ba po// sgra med thos pa po yang med// dri med snom pa po yang med// ro med myong ba po yang med// reg med reg pa po yang med// sems med sems las byung ba'ang med// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i don// tshig dang yi ges ma bslad pa// don gyi snying po rang gi sems// mtha' bral gnyug ma'i ngo bo de// sems la bya byed med pa mthong*// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// yul la ma blta sems la ma blta gsungs// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal dang*// mi mthun rkyen rnams thams cad la// gong du smos pa'i sbyor ba byas// de nas de nyid btsir gyis bzung*// de yi ngang la bzhag gyur cing*// rgyun chad med par bskyangs gyur na// sprin tshogs mkha' la yal ba bzhin// mi mthun rkyen rnams rang sar grol// des na dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis// rgyun chad med par bskyang bar zhu// // 370) ༄// 'phags pa sangs rgyas phal po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba dam pa// 'phags pa sangs rgyas phal po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba las// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /ces gsungs so// bdag dang sems can ma lus thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba 'dis// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kun// bde ba mchog thob sdug bsngal bral nas kyang*// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog

/bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig de bzhin dbyer med rtogs gyur cing*/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa'ang nga*// 'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga*// de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bsngo ba 'di dang mthun par 'jug /bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du// 'di 'dra ston pa'i bla ma dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing*// 'di 'dra skyob pa'i dam chos kyis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par smon// slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas// zung 'jug go 'phang la gnas pa'i// slob bzhin pa yi rnal 'byor che// zung du 'jug pa bsgoms gyur pas// spyod pa'ang de dang gnyis su med// zhes pa'i don dang mthun pa 'o// lus ngag yid gsum ma go na// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /nyams rtogs nang nas ma skyes na// sgom kha slob byas pa'i kha na med// phar la smras pa tshur la bzlo// dper na brag cha lha mo 'dra// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /mos gus sems la ma skyes pa// dben par bsdad pa'i kha na med// bskungs pas nyams rtogs skye mi srid// nam phyed nyi ma 'tshol ba 'dra// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /bsod nams rang gis ma bsags par// 'gro 'dug mang po'i kha na med// gang du phyin yang rnyed par dka'// yi dwags grong khyer chen po la// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /nyon mongs nang du ma zhi na// gdams ngag mang po'i kha na med// phan pa bas kyang gnod pa che// dug sbrul 'o ma blud pa 'dra// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug /bla ma spyi bor ma bkur na// che thabs yod pa'i kha na med// dgos pa'i nang par phung nas 'ong*// klu mchog nor bu bzhag pa 'dra// bu ba glang rkang gnyis yi re mug

/byams snying rje nang nas ma skyes par// khe grags bsgrub pa'i kha na med// zas nor god kha shor ba bas// gshed ma'i grong du phyin pa 'dra// bu da rung khyod kyis ma go 'am// dran pa rgyun chad ma shes na// lus ngag tab tab kha na med// byas pas 'grub par 'gyur mi srid// spun pa brdungs pa'i 'bras bu 'dra// bu da rung khyod kyis ma go 'am// 'di stong nyid bdud rtsi dam pa mchog /lha chos dam pa ma yin yang*// mi chos 'dun ma zab mo yin// nyams rtogs skye ba'i thabs yin yang*// rtogs pa skye ba'i rgyun yang yin// gzhan la smras pa ma lags te// yid mug rang la skyes pa yin// // 371) ༄// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len u rgyan rgyal po ind+ra bho dhi zhes pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ badzra dharma ka ya ni// u rgyan rgyal po 'dul ba 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// u rgyan rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon// dug gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags rnams// bde chen lhan cig skyes par sbyong*// 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod khrid// ces pa'i don ni bus nyon dang*// zab pa'i gdams ngag bshad rgyu yod// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag ni// theg pa chen po gsang sngags yin// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// nyams len ind+ra bho dhis byas// shi gtam tshig tu brjod pa ni// nyon mongs lam du byed pa yin// de yang rten 'brel gsum gyis 'grub// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o// de kho na nyid kyi rten 'brel ni// gnyis med bde chen lhan skyes su// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bag chags sbyong*// gsang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di// 'dod yon lam du 'khyer ba yin// phyi yi rten 'brel zab mo ni// 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod khrid// nyon mongs ma spangs rnal 'byor pa// dbyings su grol ba ngo mtshar che// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus kyis// rtogs pa skyes pa ma lags sam// lar gyi 'dug tshul ma shes na// ci byed 'khor ba'i gzhung lam yin// sems skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// spang bya gcig dang gnyen po gcig

/nam mkhar byas pa'i mdud pa rnams// ji srid nam mkha' ma zad par// rtog pa'i mdud pa ga la zad// nam mkhar go ba rnams kyis kyang*// bzang ngan stong len mdud pa rnams// 'ching grol stong len med pa 'di// khyed mos gus can gyi ma go na// da rung mos gus bya ba'i yul// bla ma dam pa ma go bas// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten par gces// lar lta ba'i mthar thug tog tse ba// mig gi rnam shes rtog pa yis// gnyis med ye shes ngo mtshar che// ngo mtshar can gyi rnam pa drug /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyis bsten// med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// nged ni 'dul ba 'dzin pa yin// khyed rang gsang sngags ci dgar spyod// 'du shes 'dod chags bral la sdom min ga la yod// gang la sdom dang sdom pa ma yin rlom sems med// 'di ni tshul khrims sdom pa rnam par 'dren pas gsungs// // 372) ༄// 'gro mgon bla ma'i dam chos sems bskyed dang bsngo ba mthil yin pa// oṃ swasti/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// ma lus gcig gyur 'gro ba'i mgon// mnyam med bla ma la btud nas// rang la brtse ba'i grogs po la// kha gsag g.yo sgyu ma yin par// snying gtam tshig gcig gdams ngag 'di// ma brjed thugs la bzhag par zhu// 'gro mgon bla ma'i dam chos rnams// sems bskyed bsngo ba mthil yin pas// yang yang dpag med byed pa de// lag len yin pas khyod rang mkhas// ma 'ongs dus na bdag nyid kyis// bla ma'i zhabs tog byed gyur zhes// smon lam tsam du 'debs pa la// dngos su grub pa
