ngo mtshar che// theg chen gsang sngags dam tshig ni// dam pa bla ma dam pa ste// tshig ni de yi gsung yin pas// ci gsung sgrub pa dam tshig mchog /dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// ji ltar byas kyang tshe gcig gis// sangs rgyas thob par bshad pa de// grogs khyod rang yin no logs na med// bya dang byed pa gang la yang*// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bkag pa gnang ba'i skabs yod pa// khyed rnal 'byor pa yi sems la dris// nyon mongs dug gsum rnam rtog rnams// dpag med skyes par gyur na yang*// spong sems mi dgos ngang du glod// chu dang chu rlabs tha dad min// rang la bde skyid byung ba rnams// bla ma'i bka' drin yin pas na// pho rgod mi bsam phud kyis mchod// 'di yis bde skyid 'phel ba yin// sdug bsngal dpag med byung na yang*// lam du btang zhing gsol ba gdab// lnga ldan grub na rab tu bshad// 'di la mdzad pa'i rgyu ru bzhed// bde dang sdug bsngal gang snang yang*// sems su go bar byas nas ni// chags sdang rtog pa rab spang la// gcig shos grags pa'i man ngag mdzod// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// sgom dang ma sgom spros pa yi// mtha' bral rang sems rdo rje dang*// grogs khyed la rtag tu mi 'bral zhu// dman la rngan chen mi byed cing*// bzang la chags pa mi mdzad pa'i// mnyam nyid byams pa'i chu bo de// grogs khyed kyi rgyud la shugs kyis 'bab// sbyangs ldan mkhas pa ma yin pas// nor 'khrul gong mar bzod par bzhes// dge bas lus can ma lus kun// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog/

373) ༄// gnyis med bde ba chen po'i mchod pa dam pa mdor bsdus su bkod pa// ltas ngan thams cad kyi yang rtse/ mi sdug pa bco brgyad kyi snying po/ legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ bde legs thams cad kyi gzhi rten/ chos thams cad kyi de nyid/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i srog snying*/ sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams 'byung ba'i gnas/ mchod pa kun gyi mchog gyur dam pa des// dus gsum 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kun/ gnyis med bde ba chen po gcig tu mchod par bgyi'o// // 374) ༄// bstan bcos kyi rgyal po thabs snang ba'i me long zhes pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// 'gro kun thugs rje chen po'i lcags kyus 'dzin// bde chen go 'phang mchog la 'god pa yi// thabs mkhas bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// phrag dog zhe sdang bsam pa yis// gzhan pas rang mtho 'dod pa ni// zhe sdang mnar sems chen po yin// de yis sgrub pa byed pa ni// phrag dog zhe sdang bsam sbyor byed// ci tsam sgrub pa byas pa ltar// phan dang bde ba'i 'bras bu bcom// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*// ring du gyur ba ma yin nam// yang khyed kyi bla ma dam des// zhe sdang bsam sbyor drag po yis// rang gzhan phung bar gyis dang zhes// rang la gdams par gyur tam ci// khe grags bsnyen bkur 'dod pa yi// ri dang thang dang thag ring du// phyin nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi// yon tan bsgrub par byed pa yang*// 'dod chags bsam sbyor mthar phyin pas// thar pa'i 'bras bu brlag par byed// yang nged kyi slob dpon gong ma rnams// 'dod chags bsam sbyor drag po yis// rang gzhan phung bar gyis shig ces// nged la gdams par gyur pa de// nyams su len par gyur tam ci// thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab spangs// sgom pa'i shes rab skye ba'i thabs// dben pa shing drung tsog bu sogs// sbyangs pa'i yon tan mi bsten cing*// snyes

rgyab snyes pa shing nyal la sogs pa yi// gnyid rmugs sgrub pa byed pa yi// thabs rnams ston cing grub na yang*// gnyid dang rmugs pa thams cad kyis// bsam gtan bar du gcod nas kyang*// gong ma'i lhag mthong shes rab ni// nam yang skye ba mi srid na/ khyed kyi bla ma dam pa des// gnyid dang rmugs pa la sogs pa// bsam gtan sgrib pa 'di dag gis// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong gi// ting 'dzin zung du 'brel ba ni// cis kyang skye bar 'gyur ro zhes// gdams shing bstan par gyur tam ci// bdag gi bla ma dam pas kyang*// bdag la de ltar ma gdams shing*// skyob pa shākya seng ge dang*// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// mdo rgyud rnams su ma gsungs shing*// grub thob brgyud pa gong mas kyang*// de ltar bshad pa ma mthong na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// rang gi rgyud la skyes pa dang*// skyes pa spel zhing smin pa'i thabs// ri khrod dgon pa bsten bya zhing*// nyon mongs spyod pa'i 'gol sa dben pa na// ri dwags rmas ma ltar bsnyags shing*// nyon mongs gsum gyi dmigs yul la// bskyed rdzogs log par dmigs nas kyang*// nyal zhing snyes pa la sogs pa// gnyid du ci 'gro'i 'khrul 'khor dang*// lus ngag spyod pa thams cad kyis// nyon mongs 'phel ba'i thabs bsten pa// rgyu las dang nyon mongs bsten pa las// tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar dor yang*// sdug bsngal phung po 'byung ba de// bu bdag cag rnams kyis ma shes pas// tshe 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du// phan zhing bde ba'i thabs la 'bad// tshe 'di rnyed bkur grags snyan la// rtag gam mi rtag bsam mno btang*// rtag pa med na mi rtag pa'i// rang gi lus dang grags snyan gyis// dgos pa ci yang med pa de// blo yi phugs su bzhag nas kyang*// khe grags spros pa'i ltos thag re thag bcad// 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa na// ngan song gsum la sogs pa yi// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bsams nas kyang*// rgyu las 'bras bu byung ba rnams// dam chos mngon pa la sogs pa// sde snod 'dzin pa'i skyes bu la// btud nas shes par bya ba 'am// nyon mongs gsum las ngan song gsum// dge ba bcu las lha rnams dang*// dge ba bcu dang byams pa dang*// snying rje bsam gtan snyoms 'jug gis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'bras bu smin// 'khor ba sdug bsngal nyid yin zhes// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa dang*// de yang lha gnas gong ma rnams// gong mar skyes pa'i tshul lugs ni// byams pa rgyud la skyes nas kyang*// byams pa 'dod cing chags pa dang*// byams pa bdag gir byas pa yin// ji ltar srin bu'i kha chus ni// rang las skyes pa bcings pa ltar// byams pa skyes pa'i lha gnas la// snying rje'i bsam gtan la sogs pa'i// skye ba'i rgyu dang bral ba la// 'bras bu gong mar skye mi srid// de bzhin bsam gtan bzhi po dang*// bsam gtan snyoms 'jug gong ma'i lha// gong mar skye bar 'gyur pa ni// snying rje bsam gtan snyoms 'jug rnams// rgyud la skyes shing thob pa la// 'dod cing chags pa bral ba bas// gong nas gong du 'pho ba yin// 'khor bar skye bar byed pa'i rgyu// shes nas rgyu las ma log par// 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi 'gog pas// 'gog pa'i bden pa mngon du bya// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras sus 'gog pa'i// 'gog pa mngon du byed pa la// sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam// mngon du bya ba bslab pa gsum// so so skye bo'i khams rgyud la// ji ltar skyes pa'i rim pa bzhin// phyi dang nang la 'dod chags dang*// bral bar gyur pa'i dge sbyor ni// 'dod pa'i khams su mi skye zhing*// de bzhin dga' dang bde ba dang*// btang snyoms rgyud la skyes pa la// 'dod cing chags pa dang bral bas// rdzu 'phrul la sogs mngon shes lnga// rim gyis rgyud la skyes nas kyang*// zag pa zad pa'i shes pa ni// bdag med rtogs par 'gyur ba yin// bdag med rtogs par gyur pa yis// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i// sems dang shes rab rnam grol zhing*// dgra bcom chen po zag pa zad// las dang nyon mongs rang rgyud kyis// khams gsum 'khor bar mi skye ba// nyan thos 'bras bu thob pa yin// 'di yang gnas skabs 'bras bu zhes// slob dpon 'phags pas gsungs pa dang*// 'bras bu nyan thos rang rgyal la// rgyal sras rnams kyis smad pa dang*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rgan rnams// snying brtse med pas spangs pa la// ha cang glo ba ma rangs pa'i// rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po rnams// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// theg chen pha rol phyin drug gis// sems can thams cad smin par mdzad// de yang snying rje chen po yis// sems can smin par byed pa ni// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi// rgyu dang lam la gnas pa yi// 'bras bu mngon du byed pa yin// 'di yang lus ngag yid gsum gyi// 'khrul 'khor gnad la brten pa yis// nyams gsum sprin gyi tshogs 'dus nas// dga' skyid spro ba'i char bab ste// nyon mongs rtog pa'i rdul 'tshub kyang*// ngam ngam shugs kyis zhi ba dang*// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa yis// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyang*// rim pa bzhin du skye bar 'gyur// de ltar nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyang*// brtson 'grus can gyis 'grub pa yin// rtsa ba med pa'i mi rnams la// lo 'dab tshig gi sdeb sbyor tshogs// mang po smras kyang mi phan pas// yengs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// sgrub pa snying por byed pa gces// bstan bcos kyi rgyal po thabs snang ba'i me long zhes bya ba rdzogs so//

// 375) ༄// phyag rgya chen po'i sgom chen la don gnyis ngam ngam shugs kyis grub pa// nyes pa kun las rnam grol zhing*// yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa po// rang gzhan don grub rin po che// bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad mor 'dud// lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir// 'gro don mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor pa// phyag rgya chen po'i sgom chen la// rnam pa gnyis su 'byung ba yin// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen ltar// rang gzhan don rnams 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa yang*// rtsub cing gdul dka' thams cad kyang*// la las bya byed mi dgos par// ngam ngam shugs kyis dul ba dang*// shin tu gdug pa'i sa phyogs su// ngang gis yun ring bzhugs pa dang*// gdul bya dag pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// ngam ngam shugs kyis byung gyur nas// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// bslab gsum rgyas par mdzad pa ni// byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa 'am// yang na sangs rgyas sprul pa sta// deng sang dus na byung ba yi// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yin// gcig shos dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// sngon sbyang dad pa'i shugs rgyas pas// dpal ldan bla ma'i mos gus kyis// phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skyes// rtogs pa'i phyag rgya chen po yis// bag chags rnam rtog mtshan ma rnams// rtsa ba chad cing brtag mi bzod// rnam pa sna tshogs cir yang 'gyur// des na rnal 'byor chen po de// gza' gtad spyod pa nges pa med// 'di byas 'di byed 'dun ma yis// rtsis dang go rar mi chud pa// gza' gtad med pa'i rnal 'byor 'di// skyes thob sprul pa ma yin te// rang rgyud bsgrub pa'i sgom chen yin// kha tsho sna tsho ci 'dra yang*// slob pa lam la gnas pa yin// yang na dge 'dun tshogs la brten// yang na gcig pur dben par bsdad// de 'dra'i thabs dang bral ba na// rgya la gal te rnal 'byor pa// yang na gnas brtan chen por 'gyur// bar dang sdums dang gnas brtan mdzad// 'khrug dpon bud smad can du 'gyur// zang zing spros pa'i dbang song bas// rang gzhan thams cad cir 'ong yang*// da rung ma nges pa la gnas// a la la dang a dzi dzi// lar gyi spros pa'i bya byed 'dis// chos rje bla ma rin chen gyis// mthar thug sangs rgyas mi thob gsungs// skyob pa shākya seng ge dang*// stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mchog

/rin chen bdun dang ldan nas kyang*// gling bzhi 'khor los bsgyur ba yi// bde skyid spros pa spangs nas kyang*// rab tu gshegs shing bsod snyoms mdzad// bcud len la sogs chen po'i sman// spangs nas brkus te bor ba yi// sman rnams bsten par mdzad pa las// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// bdud tshogs thams cad btul nas kyang*// sems nyid zhi ba'i gshis nyid du// nam gyi tho rangs rdzogs sangs rgyas// lar soms dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i rnam rtog gis// rang gzhan don rnams grub gyur pa// thos sam gzigs pa yod dam kye// // 376) ༄// rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i skor dge slong rgyal ba se ston la gnang ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// byin gyi brlabs pa 'gro ba'i mgon// rgyal sras rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*// phyag 'os kun la phyag 'tshal lo// gang 'di dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung*// rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo 'di// byas dang yod par gyur pa nyid// byas pa lugs las 'byung ba ste// yod pa lugs las ldog pa 'o// de yi nyams len 'di lta ste// lhan cig skyes pa yod pa yi// dge ba'i rtsa ba rtogs pa la// yang dag shes rab zhes bya ba// khams dang gnas lugs de nyid la// log par rtogs pa'i bye brag ni// mu stegs pa dang sangs rgyas pa'i// lta ba grub pa'i mtha' rnams kyi// rtog pa thams cad spangs pa dang*// de nyid rtogs par gyur pa'i thabs// rtogs ldan bla ma dam pa la// ji ltar bsten par bya ba dang*// rtogs pa mtho dman bye brag gis// sa dang lam gyi rim pa la// ji ltar nyams su blang ba la// phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga// ji ltar nyams su blangs pa yis// mthar thug chos sku thob 'gyur na// chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin// dag pa rnams kyis dag pa yi// yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yi// rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad kyi// tshul lugs ston pas bstan pa 'o// byas pa byas la mi rtag nyid// dge dang mi dge gang yang rung*// skar ma rab rib mar me dang*// sgyu ma zil pa chu bur 'dra// lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis// byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cig

/dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba yis// byang chub thob pa'i lam du 'gyur// mthar thug 'bras bu gzugs sku gnyis// thob pa'i rgyu lam 'bras bu yin// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// gnas lugs bzhi dang glo bur gyi// rkyen las byung bar nges pas na// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bstan pa dam chos thams cad kyang*// 'di las gzhan med nges pa 'o// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// thams cad sems su ma rtogs shing*// sems nyid dgongs pas ma skyes pa// nyams rtogs gcig tu ma grub pas// byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba kun// byang chub mchog tu bsngo ba las// yod pa bsngo ba'i mig med pa// e ma yid mug skyug re bro// yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yang*// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gdod nas dag cing skye med la// bsngo ba bsngo byed gang mthong ba// dug can kha zas za zhes pa// 'khor gsum nyes par mthong ba dang*// cis stong mi shes rmongs pa rnams// dge med sdig med ma bsngo zhes// 'khor gsum yongs dag mi dmigs pa// dmigs pa'i yul du byed pa yi// blos byas dmigs pa med pa zhes// med par smra ba snying re rje// thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab dang*// shes rab bral ba'i thabs rnams kyis// nam yang byang chub mi thob ces// ston pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// rgya cher gsungs pa ma tshor ram// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing*// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song ba// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos// bden gnyis ngo bo dbyer med dam// bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa 'am// bden gnyis ro gcig khas len pa// tshur spyon chos kyi spyan can rnams// rgyal sras rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi// yongs su bsngo bar gang gsungs pa// rang dang sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba'i bsngo ba rin po che// 'di yi rjes su zhugs nas kyang*// rtag tu bsngo ba 'di yis bsngo// nam mkha'i khams dang chos kyi dbyings// sems can khams kyi mtha' med pa// mnyam nyid rgya mtsho chen po 'dir// bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di dang ni// mthun par 'jug pa gang yin pa// de dang mthun pa'i rlung gis ni// sku gsum rin chen gling mchog tu// myur du phyin pa ngo mtshar che// dad ldan brtson 'grus che ba dang*// nyon mongs g.yo sgyu chung ba dang*// chos 'dis rang rgyud sbyangs pa yi// dge slong rgyal ba se ston gyis// bsngo ba 'di la bstod pa yi// dam chos gzhung dang mthun gyur pa// dge slong rin chen dpal la zhus// 'di byas dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// bdag dang sems cad thams cad kun// rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba yis// kun bzang go 'phang thob par shog/
// 377) ༄// chos dang chos min 'byed pa sems kyi gros 'debs//

ji ltar ma rig nyes pa'i gzhi// tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed las// 'byung bar gyur na tshul bzhin du// yid la byed pa ci yi phyir// rig pa ye shes rgyur mi 'gro// des na chags sdang bral ba'i sems// mkhas pa su zhig goms mi byed// ji ltar gzung dang 'dzin pa las// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung rnams su// srid pa gsum du 'khor gyur na// gzung 'dzin gnyis med rang sems la// mkhas pa su zhig goms mi byed// dang po'i rnam rtog bdag 'dzin las// bdag gis 'di dang 'di zhes pa'i// 'du byed rnams la 'dus byas na// byas pa mi rtag rten 'brel zhes// ston pas gsungs na ci yi phyir// mi rtog pa la goms mi byed/ rang sems rtog pa la/ sangs rgyas thob pa la/ skye med du rtogs dgos sam mi dgos/ sems la rtog dpyod thongs/ chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba sems kyi gros 'debs 'di/ skal ldan rnams kyi thugs la zhog /skal med rnams la 'di ltar zhu// yar 'gag dang nya gar ma phyin na// dam par bzhugs kyang khral 'jal tsam// rang sems chos su ma song ba'i// lta ba mtho yang thos bsam yin// rang sems chos su song gyur na// ci byas don du 'gro bar mchi// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi khyad par de// rang sems skye ba med pa 'di// rtogs ma rtogs gnyis kyi khyad par las// logs na yod pa ma yin te// bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal snga nas// rang sems ye shes yin pa'i phyir// sangs rgyas gzhan du ma tshol gsung*// dngos 'dzin 'ching ba ma log par// theg pa chen por khas blangs kyang*// 'khor ba'i me dpung bzlog par dka'// gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba ru// rnam rtog chu srin gyi khar chud nas// skye rga na 'chi'i nad kyis gzir// nad gso 'am mi gso rang dbang che// 'dod pa'i lcags kyu 'di sna re gzer// chos brgyad kyi 'ja' tshon 'di bkrag re gsal// tshe 'di yi srad bu e re dam// de gcod dam mi gcod rang dbang che// bsags pa rab gyur gyi skyes bu kun// mi lus rin chen khyad par 'di// rnyed par dka' la 'jig par sla// de chud gson nam mi gson rang dbang che// snying nas byang chub bsgrub pa na// 'khor ba me yi phung po la// dga' ba spangs la thar pa sgrub// de sdug bsngal du mthong ngam mi mthong rang dbang che// bla ma dam pa'i drin thob nas// snying rje byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor can// smin lam rin chen dbang bzhi bskur// de smin nam mi smin rang dbang che// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di// snga nas ma byung da mi 'byung*// don brgyud bla ma rje la mnga'// de bsten nam mi bsten rang dbang che// tshe 'di'i ltos thag rab bcad de// mos gus brtson 'grus rab bskyed nas// ltos pa med pa'i skyes bu yis// bsgrub na tshe 'dir 'bras bu thob// bsgrub bam mi bsgrub rang dbang che// tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgya ba// thabs chen he ru ka la mnga'// don gyis lhan cig skyes pa yin// rtogs sam mi rtogs rang dbang che// khams dgu 'dus pa'i ri bo la// gsang ba sman gcig zhes bya ba// nad kun 'joms pa'i sman gcig gda'// de brko 'am mi brko rang dbang che// rang rig shel sgong dag pa la// rigs drug dri ma mdangs re gsal// 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nyid la// de phyi 'am mi phyi rang dbang che// rang rig me long g.ya' bral bar// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi gzugs brnyan gsal// gzugs brnyan chos kyis stong pa de// de blta 'am mi blta rang dbang che// bde gsal mi rtog rgya mtsho de// rnam rtog rlung gi rba rlabs 'khrugs// ngang la gnas na zhi lags te// de slob bam mi slob rang dbang che// rang sems nam mkha' dag pa la// snying rje zhen med kyi chu 'dzin 'khrigs// byang chub sems kyi char rgyun 'bab// de 'bras bu smin nam mi smin rang dbang che// ma bcos lhug pa'i sa gzhi la// mos gus dad pa'i ljon shing skyes// snang med shel gyi me tog 'bus// byin rlabs nyi ma'i 'od zer shar// de kha 'byed dam mi 'byed rang dbang che// rin chen ri bo'i bla ma la// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu mig yod// mos gus 'gyur ba med pa yis// de 'thung ngam mi 'thung rang dbang che// mos gus bla ma'i rkyen dag gis// ma bcos lhug pa'i lam la 'gro// re dogs med pa'i grogs dang 'grogs// de 'grogs sam mi 'grogs rang dbang che// snang stong gnyis med zung dang bcas// dran pa yengs med kyi bdud rtsi 'thungs// rtsol sgrub bral bar ngal cig bsos// snyems byed kyi shes pa sgyu ma yin// de blo thag bcod dam mi gcod rang dbang che// khyed kyis gsol btab yi ge yis// bsod nams thob pa gang yin pa// thos dang bsam pa tsam gyis kyang*// tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog thob shog/

// 378) ༄// snang ba sems su shes na 'khor 'das kyi lta ba'i gnas lugs go ba// dpa' bo 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// mnyam med dpal ldan rin po che// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// snang ba sems su shes pa 'di// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// lta ba'i gnas lugs go ba yin// bde dang sdug bsngal gang snang kun// rang nyid snang bar ma go na// bstan pa 'di las phyi rol ba// des na phan dang bde 'dod pa// rang sems dag la nan tan bskyed// rang sems dag pa gang zhe na// stong nyid snying rje zhes bya ba// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres la bya// bsam pa dag par ma byas na// snang ba dag par mi 'gyur ba// dad pa can gyis ma go 'am// bsam pa dag pa'i rten 'brel gyis// snang ba'i 'char lugs rnam pa lnga// thub pa rnams kyis gsungs pa'i bka'// mdo rgyud rnams kyi brjod bya rnams// phun sum tshogs pa lnga yin gsung*// dang por rang nyid bstan pa 'di// stong pa nyid dang snying rje 'o// de yi gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs las// legs par grub pa legs bkod pa// ar mo li ka'i rdo leb ltar// mnyen zhing 'jam pa yid 'ong ba// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba la// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po las// legs par grub pa'i dpag bsam shing*// yal ga lo 'bras me tog la// ci 'dod thams cad 'byung ba des// sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las ltar// bde ba skyid pa rgyas byed cing*// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rnams// sel bar byed pa sman gyi mchog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa des// byang chub mchog la 'god pa yi// snod kyi 'jig rten nyams dga' ba// rang sems stong nyid snying rje yi// rang snang de ltar byung ba yin// yul ngan la ma zhen rang sems sbyongs// tshe 'di 'am yang na bar do 'am// skye ba phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe// 'og min chos kyi pho brang ngam// yongs su bzung pa med pa yi// zhing khams bla med de dag tu// rang nyid skyid pa rang snang yin// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa'i// grogs kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni// theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnam grags pa// sa dang lam la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// sngon gyi thugs rje smon lam gyis// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// lha min nam mkha' lding rnams su// 'gro ba'i don du cir yang snang*// de dag rnal 'byor dbang phyug la// mthun rkyen sgrub cing 'gal rkyen spong*// de yang 'phags pa thogs med kyis// mgon po byams pa bsgrubs pa dang*// mnga' bdag chen po mai tri pas// dpal ri khrod dbang phyug bsten pa dang*// rgyal sras nor bzang rnam thar las// shin tu rgyas par shes par bya// de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams// rab 'byams phyogs bcu zhing rnams su// bkra shis bde legs thams cad kyis// rab tu rgyas par yongs bkang nas// sems can thams cad smin pa dang*// nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas// ji srid nam mkha' ma zad tshe// ji ltar 'dod pa mi zad pas// sems can thams cad smin byed cing*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du// dbang che che bar grags pa'i lus// brgya byin dbang phyug tshangs pa dang*// stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba yis// rang dbang med pa'i mthu stobs kyis// thams cad byang chub mchog la 'god// phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams rnams su// shin tu gdug pa bdud kyi dpung*// mi bzad bgeg dang log 'dren rnams// dkon mchog gsum gyi dgrar gyur nas// rang gzhan thams cad brlags pa rnams// thugs rje che zhing thabs mkhas pas// gdug pa de yi gtsor gyur cig

/de dang mthun pa'i spyod pa yis// chags sdang rgyas pa'i gzung 'dzin cing*// tshad med snying rje'i byin rlabs kyis// thams cad 'dun cing rjes gyur na// byang chub mchog la nges bkod pa// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di// gdul bya'i dbang gis snang ba ste// ji ltar las dang nyon mongs rnams// shin tu rgyas par gyur pa des// 'jig rten mgon po nges par 'byung*// ji ltar phrin las sna tshogs kyis// rdzu 'phrul ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*// mi 'bral bsnyen bkur byed pa de// rang sems stong nyid snying rje yi// rang snang de ltar 'byung ba yin// 'khor g.yog ngan la ma zhen par// rang sems sbyongs dang rnal 'byor pa// 'di ltar skyo dub med pa'i grogs// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong tshe// phan dang bde ba skyid byed pa// 'bral med gtan du 'grogs 'dod na// rtsa ba rang gi bsam pa sbyongs// byang chub gzhon nur 'dzin pa ni// nam mkha'i mdud pa dang po yin// de la 'dod dang mi 'dod gnyis// 'dod pa'i 'du byed gnyis pa yin// 'dod pas bod par 'gyur ba ste// de nas zhe 'dod bya byed rnams// 'khor ba'i 'khor lor bla mas gsungs// 'khor ba'i gnad dang 'dug lugs 'di// shes pa tsam gyis yon tan du// bkra shis sgo mang dran pa ste// chu bur rba rlabs bya byed rnams// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ma shes na// yon tan skyon gyi yang rtser 'gyur// dngos grub bar chad chen por mchi// yon tan so sor gang byung rnams// yon tan de 'byung rtsa ba ni// de dang bral ba'i yon tan de// mi 'dzin pa dang bral ba la// mi dbang de la skyabs su mchi// gong ma'i rnam thar min phyir dang*// gzung 'dzin spros dang bcas phyir dang*// sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs phyir dang*// bla ma mnyes pa min phyir dang*// bya ba ma yin byed phyir dang*// yon tan gong ma'i bar chad phyir// thub pa'i dbang pos spangs pa'i gnas// khyim bdag rnams kyi bya ba spangs// mi bzad gdug pa'i dug rnams kun// rma bya gser du snang ba zos// spu mdog kha dog mdzes par gyur// ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// 'di dag gsang sngags man ngag yin// sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos// lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa rnams// gcig shos grags pa'i rten 'brel gyis// gser du bsgyur zhing gyur pa 'di// ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// drang srong chen po nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa'i 'bras bu 'jig rten bya byed sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab gzigs nas// thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don la mnyam par bzhag cing mnyam gzhag chen pos sems dpa' che sogs 'gro kun smin par mdzad// mnyam rjes shin tu rnam par dag pas bya byed mi mnga' dag pa gnyis ldan dri med chos kyi sku// sku dang gsung dang thugs nyid lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' 'gro ba ma lus smin par mdzad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo//

// 379) ༄// gzhan don phun tshogs kyi rgyu nges pa byang chub kyi sems yin pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir mthar thug pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che rang don dang*/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu nges pa byang chub kyi sems yin/ byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes pa'i rgyu byams pa yin pas/ dang po byams pa ni/ sems can thams cad a mar bsgoms pas shes pa 'dres shing gdung ba'i blo skyes pa de la byams pa zer/ 'di brtan por song na byams pa thob ces zer ba ste 'dus byas yin pas rtag tu brtan par dka' ba dang*/ byams pa brtan pas kyang lha'i go 'phang las gzhan mi thob pas/ a mar bsgoms pas sems 'dres shing gdung ba skyes pa'i dus su/ rigs drug na gnas pa'i ma 'di rnams kyi sdug bsngal la blta/ bsams shing bltas pas sdug bsngal ba la snying rje skye ba chos nyid yin/ snying rje skyes pa'i dus su nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i bsam pa brtan po zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyed cing dam bcas te/ bsam pa des kun nas bslang nas/ de'i ched dus sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol snyam du sems bskyed cing dam bcas nas/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba'i rtsa ba la 'jug par bya ste/ skabs skabs su dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// de ltar byas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la// tha mal btang snyoms nam yang mi srid de// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba thams cad kyis// 'bras bu sku gsum cis kyang thob par nges// rgyu lam 'bras bu byang chub sems su gcig /'di dang phyi ma grangs med gsum la sogs// byang chub ji tsam gcig na thob pa yang*/ brtan nam mi brtan bsam pa rang la 'dri// ji tsam dus kyi byang chub thob bo zhes// dus tshod gtso bor smra ba'i gang zag rnams// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa las// de sngon phan chad grangs med ma song ngam// da yang bsam pa brtan po ma mchis na// grangs med gsum gyi byang chub mi thob snyam// des na byang chub sems la goms par bya/

rigs kyi bu don dam pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams skyes kyang rung*/ ma skyes kyang rung mi 'jig pa ste/ rigs kyi bu de'i phyir na byang chub sems dpa' rnams skra dang kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig gyon pa la yang dag par dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo*// rab tu byung nas kyang chos 'di kho na thob par bya ba'i phyir/ mgo'am gos la me 'bar ba bzhin du brtson 'grus brtsams shing gnas so// rigs kyi bu gal te don dam pa med du zin na/ tshangs par spyod pa don med par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'byung ba yang don med par 'gyur ro// gang gi phyir don dam pa yod pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams don dam pa la mkhas zhes bya'o// dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo 'di las// tshangs par spyod pa'i dgos pa ni// don dam bden pa yin zhes gsungs// des na rab tu byung ba rnams// rtogs pa don dam rtogs par mdzod// // 380) ༄// grong khyer nyug na wa mo yin zhes pa ri la 'gro ba'i bstan bcos// na mo ratna gu ru/ tshad med snying rje ma skyes na// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs mi zad pas// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// phan sems gyis dang rang gzhan skyid// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// mos gus tshad du ma bskyal na// yon tan skye ba mi srid ces// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gsung*// nyon mongs sdig pa'i dbang song ba// nyon mongs spyad pa'i 'gol sa la// dben gnas ri khrod dgon pa zhes// rmongs pa khyed la su zhig zer// lhun grub rang byung phyag rgya che// blo yis bcos su med pa la// nyon mongs rtogs pa'i bsam pa yis// chags sdang skye na rdzun po yin// seng chen lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// gangs ri'i khrod du mi gnas par// bsam pa 'dod pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// grong khyer nyug na wa mo yin// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// bla ma mnyes mdzad mos gus can// sgrub pa snying por mdzad bzhed nas// ri la 'gro ba'i bstan bcos 'di// kun la phan pa'i don du zhus//

381) ༄// nyams rtogs rgyud la skyes pas zang zing spros pas mi gnod pa// chos sku sems nyid gdod ma nyid nas rnam par dag /gnyis med zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// 'gro ba smin mdzad skyob pa thugs rje can// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam med dam pa rin po che// u rgyan rgyal po 'gro mgon gyis// 'dod yon 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras kyis// tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub bsgrubs// ku res mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// rje btsun dpal ldan 'bri gung pa// brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rin po che// nyams rtogs rgyud la skyes pa yis// 'jig rten chos brgyad zang zing btsal// zang zing zas dang longs spyod kyis// slob ris nye du gnyen 'brel rnams// nyon mongs dug gsum nyes skyon sel// pha rje btsun khyod kyi spyod 'gros 'di// zang zing spros pas mi gnod pas// yang na gong ma rnams pas lhag /yang na zhabs 'dren chen po song*// 'di de gang yin ngas ma shes// 'on kyang bla ma rje btsun pa'i// rnam thar sangs rgyas yin nas mchi// sus kyang 'di las ma gleng zhig /lar sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i sras// don grub skyes bu dam pa des// stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba yi// rgyal srid 'dod yon kun spangs nas// rab tu byung zhing dka' thub spyad// sbyangs pa'i yon tan brtul zhugs kyis// byang chub snying por mngon sangs rgyas// lar nged kyi rje btsun ma gtogs pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun la yang*// 'di 'dra ba yi bcos shig gda'// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// rgyal sras bdag nyid che rnams la// rnam thar tshul lugs 'di 'dra gda'// lar dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras mchog la// rang gzhan smin pa'i gnyer kha yod// rang gzhan smin pa'i thabs mchog de// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos// spros pa med dang mthun pa'i rkyen// sbyangs pa'i yon tan yin par 'dug

/yang sbyangs pa'i yon tan yin par 'dug /kwa sbyangs pa'i yon tan yin par 'dug/ // 382) ༄// rang bas gzhan gces par 'dzin dgos pa'i bslab bya dgra skyong*// oṃ swasti/ na mo ratna gu ru/ khyed spyir 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la sku gces/ khyad par du nga 'bu 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sku shin tu gces pa lags pas/ rang nyid srung ba la gces par mdzad par zhu/ de ji ltar byed snyam na rang bas gzhan gces par byas na/ gzhan thams cad kyis kyang rang bas khyed nyid gces par byed pa lags pas/ rang bas gzhan gces pa la nan tan shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu/ de yang yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jig rten 'di dang ma 'dres pa'i rten gyi gang zag stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du chud nas/ bya rgyu sems can gyi don ma gtogs pa med pa zhig la/ smon 'jug gnyis kyi sdom pa blangs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la nan tan bya ste/ 'gro ba thams cad bu gcig pa bzhin du bskyang bar bya'o// de la nged sde pa chen po'i dpon du ni song*/ mtho dman mang po'i las la ni 'jug dgos/ byang chub sems dpa' de 'dra ba'i mi 'ong snyam na/ pha mas bu la brid pa dang*/ bkol ba dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ brdeg pa dang*/ tshar bcad pa dang*/ rjes su bzung ba bzhin du byams pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems kyis rjes su bzung bar bya ste/ de yang mdo sde skyes rabs las/ mchod sbyin byed pa'i skyes rabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ dgra ji ltar gdul bar bya ba'i thabs/ mkhas pas rang nyid rgyal bar 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan thams cad kyang gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad du/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'god pa'i thabs la mkhas pa la 'bad par bya ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mdo sde zab pa dang rgya che ba rnams las 'byung bas/ dge slong ngam dge tshul chos dang ldan zhing klog mkhas pa dag snyan pa klog tu 'jug cing*/

de la mnyan nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du nyams su blang bar zhu/ gzhan yang chos kyi rgyal po'i mdzad pa/ rang gi yul ris dang rgyal khams su chos dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa thos bsam sgom gsum gyi nor gyis phyug pa rnams chos dang mthun par bya ba dang*/ phyogs ris kyi mi bsod nams dang yon tan che ba dpag tu med pa rab tu byung ba dang*/ gza' mi dad pa dang shes rab che ba rnams/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi grwa sar khral dmag las gsum las phyung nas/ yon tan rin po che slob tu btang bas nga'i pha dang ma bas lhag pa'i dpon chen po de bdag la shin tu bka' drin che zhes/ sde dang gnyen 'brel thams cad kyis skyong ba chos nyid yin pas/ 'di yang thugs la bzhag par zhu/ mdor na dkar po phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas tshogs ma yin pa'i phyogs dang ris su bcas pa thams cad ldog pa chos nyid yin pas/ khyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che bskyang ba la 'bad par zhu/ dgra bo nyes par byed pa phung bar 'dod pa rnams dang*/ yun ring du 'thab cing srog chags mang po shi ba dang*/ rmeg med par byas kyang*/ mtha' mar mdza' ba dang mthun pa ma gtogs par bya ba'i thabs mi 'dug pas/ dgra rnams la nged mdza' bar bya'o zhes dbugs dbyung nas dgra rnams rang gi gnyen du 'gyur ba mtshan nyid yin pas/ dgra rnams kyang khyed kyis dgra sar mi bzhag par zhu/ de ltar mdzad na thog mar dge// bar dang mtha' mar kun tu dge// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// dge zhing bde dang skyid pa'i thabs// skyes chen khyed kyis nyams su blang*// bstan pa 'di yi bcom ldan dang*// de rjes zhugs pa'i dam pa dang*// yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// bdag cag ring na gnas pa dang*// dgra dang gnyen rnams thams cad kun// khyed la re ba che bar mchis// kun gyi bsam pa rdzogs mdzad gsol// // 383)

༄// bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i bu gcig mi thub zla ba la gdams pa// bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi sras// bsgrub pa gtsor mdzad dad pa can// bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi// bu gcig mi thub zla ba la// ku re kyal ka zur tsam zhu// bde gsal mi rtog zhe 'dod kyis// bla ma dam pa ma spangs sam// lus ngag yid gsum bye brag gis// 'dus ma byas dang ma bral lam// bslab gsum gces pa'i tsab tsub kyis// rang byung gshis las ma g.yos sam// bla ma'i 'dug lugs ma go bas// ngo srung sdug la ma bskyal lam// grogs dang 'byar la ma reg pas// kha nyen dbang chung ma bsgrubs sam// rang sems rnam dag nam mkha' 'dra// yon tan mu mtha' med pa yi// bla ma mchog dang ma bral na// yon tan sprin tshogs 'ubs kyis mchi// rang gzhan gnyis med lhun gyis grub// 'dus ma byas dang ma bral bas// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// rang don gzhan don lhun gyis grub// gshis nyid don dang ma bral na// nyon mongs rnam dag rang sar dag /zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims la// dus gsum 'phags pa kun gyis bsngags// bla ma stong nyid snying rje'i bdag /ri rab gser gyi ngos dang 'dra// mtho dman bya ba gang byas kyang*// thugs dgongs rdzogs shing gces par mchi// pha ma gnyen 'dun grogs bshes kyis// khur 'khur brtse sems yod gyur na// mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam po yis// gdan thog gcig nas bod khams bskyangs// bu gcig gces se dam pa khyed// gong ma'i go 'phang thob bzhed na// gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar 'di// lta bas khong du chud tsa na// bla mar shes pas sangs rgyas mthong*// dam chos 'di yi nyams len gyis// dge ba gsum po mngon du 'gyur// lhan gcig gnas pa'i grogs mched la// drin bzhag drin brtsi ma byas shing*// yon tan brjod na grags snyan 'phel// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gsung*// 'di ltar nyams su blang bar zhu// ma 'thad na yang bzod par gsol// ri khrod la 'gro thabs lam ji ltar nyams su len/

zhus pas 'di mdzad pa'o// // 384) ༄// gnyis snang gi bag chags sbyong ba blo 'das thugs kyi rdo rje ma// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// a la la ste dpe las 'das// snying rje snying rje kun gyi bdag /gnyis su med pa'i snying rje mchog /snying rje can gyi gang rtogs pa// blo las 'das pa'i snying rje ni// gnyis med snying rje can rnams kyis// gnyis snang med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// rgyun chad med par gnas par bya// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// khams gsum srid gsum 'khor 'das kun// rig pa'i ngang la ma g.yos pa// rgyu 'bras gdod nas stong nyid 'di// gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa yis// gnyis su med par gyur pa yi// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bag chags sbyangs// de ltar gnyis med thugs rje dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral 'tshal// blo 'das thugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya'o// // 385) ༄// sku gsum lhun gyis grub par rang sems dang mi 'bral ba mdzod ces pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ dbyer med 'od gsal chos kyi sku// gnyug ma spros dang bral ba la// ngos gzung med par blo 'das te// 'dzin pa'i spros pa sna tshogs kyis// sems nam mkha' chen po bkab gyur na// mkhyen pa'i yon tan nyi zla de// sgrib par gyur pa gdon mi za// bu sku gsum gyi yon tan 'dod pa na// nyams myong gi rtsi la ma 'byar bar// bde chen rgyal po rang sems bsgoms// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog kyang*// ri bong rwa dang mo gsham bu// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// gnyis su grub pa mi srid pas// bu 'dzin pa thongs la rang sems sgoms// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*// sgom dang sgom mkhan thams cad kun// gnyis med rang sar dag gyur na// thabs lam gyi dgos pa rdzogs pa yin// mnyam nyid kyi ngang la mi 'gro na// gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan don kun ga la rdzogs// bu sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa la// rang gi sems dang ma 'bral mdzod//

// 386) ༄// gong ma'i rnam thar mi 'dzin re zhes nam ra ri zom gyi mgur ma// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag phyogs med 'du 'dzi g.yeng bas dub// nam ra ri bo'i zom la phyin// bsags pa can gyi rnal 'byor pas// gong ma'i rnam thar yi ge de// snyan pa'i ngag gis tshig tu brjod// rje gong ma'i rnam thar thos tsam na// pha la bu skyes don re chung*// byin gyis rlabs pa 'di chud re zos// 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba 'di yi re mug /rang gi spyod pa 'dis bdag re bslus// rje gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// sems la bsam mno bag tsam byung*// rje gong ma'i rnam thar mi 'dzin re// sgrub pa nyams su mi len re// 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba mi skyung re// bya byed spros pa 'di mi gcod re// nor gyi byin len 'di mi 'jog re// rnal 'byor ri khrod mi 'grim re// // 387) ༄// 'khrul pa 'thad pa'i sbyor ba rgyu lam 'bras bu zhes pa// chos kun gdod nas ma skyes spros dang bral// rang byung lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa'i sku// skyon dag yon tan ma lus thams cad rdzogs// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// 'khor 'das chos 'di thams cad kun// ma lus rang gi sems yin te// sems nyid 'gyur med chos kyi sku// rgyu gcig lam gcig 'bras bu gcig /tha dad 'dzin pas 'khor bar 'khrul// 'dzin pas 'khrul ba'i 'khrul lugs ni// rang gi rig pa 'di nyid la// 'di dang 'di zhes so sor bzung*// nga bdag yod na dgra gnyen du// ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar snang*// bdag tu 'dzin pa gzhir byas nas// nga ni mi yin snyam pa yi// mir 'dzin shes pa drag po yis// mi nyid du ni nges pa 'di// lta ba zhes ni bya ba yin// mi las gzhan pa gang du yang*// rang nyid mi sems ma mthong ba// bag chags goms pa sgom pa yin// mi chos bcu drug ji bzhin du// legs par spyod pa spyod pa yin// lta sgom spyod pa 'di gsum gyis// mi yi skye gnas thob par 'gyur// phyi dang nang gi yul rnams la// 'dod chags drag pos yi dwags dang*// zhe sdang gti mug byams pa dang*// snying rje bsam gtan snyoms 'jug dang*// 'di ltar yin zhes thag chod cing*// nges shes gting nas skyes pa yi// lta ba nges pa de nyid kyi// ro myong goms pa'i bag chags kyi// sgom pa nyid du gnas pa yin// de dang mthun par spyod pa ni// spyod pa zhes ni bya ba yin// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa des// sgrub pa'i 'bras bu gang yin pa// 'bras bu so sor 'grub 'gyur te// rgyu 'bras gzhan du 'gyur ba min// lta sgom spyod 'bras de dag ni// rim gyis skye bar dgongs nas ni// rgyu lam 'bras bu zhes kyang gsung*// rten 'brel tshogs pas byung ba na// rten 'brel zhes kyang bya ba yin// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// 'jig rten rgyu 'bras de dag ni// 'khor gsum zhes kyang bya ba yin// 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa ni// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// dmigs pa med pa nyid yin zhes// ston pa shākya seng ges gsungs// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// shes nas ldog par byed pa 'o// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang*// gnas lugs tshul lugs ji bzhin du// nyams su blangs par gyur pa yis// gnas lugs 'dug lugs ji bzhin la// 'khrul pa mtha' dag dag gyur la// 'bras bu chos sku bde chen ma lags sam// spyir tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// gus ldan gyi slob ma dam pa des// mos gus gcig tshad du skyol lags na// gnyis 'dzin dang nyon mongs rnam rtog rnams// mthar thug gi 'bras bu chos sku de// dus skad cig gcig las 'gyur ba de// mi kha cig gi blo la ma bde yang*// kho mos gus can la bde nas mchi// lar chags sdang kho re chung ba zhig

/sems zhe sdang drag pos rbad tsa na// mi gzhan la gnod du re ba yis// rang gis rang nyid gsod pa de// mi gzhan la 'thad par mi 'dug ste// kho rang gi blo ngor 'thad pa yin// nang sems can la chags pa'i gang zag kun// gcin dang phyi sa klad pa dang*// mi gtsang rul bsungs kyi rkyal pa la// rin smar po mang pos nyos nas kyang*// yul de dang bral na mya ngan skye// bsam shes kyi mi la mi 'thad kyang*// kho rang gi blo ngor shin tu 'thad// yang las 'phro can gyi gang zag la// rin chen dbang gi rten 'brel gyis// bskyed rim goms par gyur pa las// phyi snod kun lha yi gzhal yas khang*// snod bcud kun lha dang lha mor snang*// grags tshad kun sngags su thos pa dang*// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// byin gyis brlabs nas kyang skye med ston// gdod nas sangs rgyas kyi nges shes skye// sus kyang byas pa med par go// lam dman la zhugs pa'i gang zag la// yi 'thad ces bya ba dka' lags te// khyed dang 'thad pa bsdur ba'ang min// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'ang yin// grub thob brgyud pa'i gdams ngag kyang yin// yang dad pa can gyi gang zag la// spong pa'i bsam pa gzhir bzhag nas// pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel dang*// bde dang skyid pa kun spangs nas// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyis// brtul zhugs dka' thub drag po yis// byang chub rnam gsum bsgrub pa yis// 'ching bas bcings pa'i gang zag la// ha cang 'thad pa dka' na yang*// kho rang gi blo ngor 'thad pa yin// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yis// rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad du// bde bas bde chen bsgrub pa dang*// nyon mongs lam du 'khyer ba yang*// dka' thub mchog tu 'dzin pa yis// mngon shes can la mi 'thad kyang*// ind+ra bo dhi la sogs pa// gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor rnams la 'thad// chos kun gdod nas ma skyes shing*// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba la// 'di yin gyi grub mtha' sna tshogs su// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// 'dzin pa'i mtha' la 'chel

zhen pa ba de// khyed rtogs ldan rnams la mi 'thad de// tshu rol mthong ba rnams la 'thad// spyir phyogs 'dzin gyi 'thad pa thams cad kyis// 'dzin pa med pa'i tshul lugs 'di// rtogs shing myong bar dka' bas na// tshad ldan gyi bla ma dam pa la// mos gus skyed la rang sems bsgom// gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// rang sems 'khrul pas bskul ba bas// 'khrul ba 'thad pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 388) ༄// nged rang pha spad kyi shi gtam dge sbyong bya ba'i rim pa bstan pa// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla med dkon mchog gsum po la// gus pas rab tu btud byas te// bya ba'i rim pa cung zad bri// snying gtam tshig gcig gi man ngag nged rang pha spad kyi shi gtam gyi dbang du byas na/ de ltar dal ba dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i lus 'di thob par dka'/ 'jig par ni sla/ skye shi la ni rang dbang ni ma thob pas/ nam 'chi yang cha med/ shi nas 'khor ba gting mtha' med par sdug cing bsngal ba 'di yi mug cing mi nus pas/ rang gzhan 'khor ba las ci thar byed dgos/ de la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog dgos/ ye shes kyi tshogs zab pa stong pa nyid yin/ de la shes rab zer/ bsod nams kyi tshogs zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum la brten nas gsog pa la thabs mkhas pa zer/ thabs mkhas pa de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dgag par bya ba'i bslab pa dang*/ bsgrub par bya ba'i bslab pa byang chub sems dpa'i skyes pa'i rabs lnga brgya la sogs pa 'dul ba'i tshul khrims dpag tu med pa rnams kyis nyes pa spangs pa dang legs pa bsgrub pa thabs mkhas pa la bslab par gsungs so// legs par bsgrub pa'i thabs yang*/ zhing dkon mchog rin po che gsum dang*/ de gcig tu gyur pa bla ma dam pa la brten nas/

bsam pa chags sdang rmongs gsum med pa dang*/ de'i gnyen po 'phel bar byed pa'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gsum dang*/ gtong ba gsum dang*/ shes rab gsum po de nyid kyi lus ngag yid kyi las kyis/ tshe 'di nyid kyi sangs rgyas thob pa mi dka' na/ gzhan zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'am/ 'khor ba'i bde 'bras lta smos kyang ci dgos pas 'di la nan tan tu bya'o// de la shin tu phra bar ji ltar bslab na/ zhing bzhi po de la dad pa dang gus pa'i sems gcad du med pa phul du byung bas/ dper na 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi rang nyid kyis ro myong bas/ bu smad dran nas ster 'dod pa ltar/ dge 'dun rnams rang gi 'khor la sbran zhing*/ dga' ba dang*/ 'thad pa dang*/ yid du 'ong ba dang*/ tshogs chen por 'gyur bas bskul bar bya ba ni/ kye gson zhig dge 'dun btsun pa rnams// sang ngam da ste zhag bdun na// nged kyi ston pa bla ma de// ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas kyang*// chos kyi khri la bzhugs gyur te// chos char rgyun tu 'beb pas na// de yi bar chad spang pa'i phyir// rtswa shing lo ma la sogs pa// dge 'dun phrin las mdzad par zhu// yang gcig zhu ba'i rim pa ni// kye gson zhig dge 'dun btsun pa rnams// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nam// dam chos dkon mchog rin po che// gser 'bum la sogs byon pa la// dge 'dun bsrung ba mdzad par zhu// de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// sa bdag rgyal po byon pa la// gong mas mdzad pa'i rnam thar bzhin// khyed kyis legs par bskul gyur na// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa yis// don chen 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs// yang gcig dge 'dun btsun pa rnams// kho bo'i bla ma rin chen de// rdzas dang yo byad sbyin pa'i tshogs// dngos po bzang bzang sngon la sbyin// bzang po 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa// ngan pa gcig kyang mi srid pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// dkon mchog mchod pa'i sbyor ba yang*// spos dang mar me la sogs pa// kun la de ltar mdzad par 'dug

/'gro drug sems can thams cad la// 'di ni lhag pa'i lha yin zhes// grib ma'ang 'gom par mi mdzad na// snying nas 'thab cing gshe ba dang*// thugs kyis spong bar mi mdzad pa'i// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'dir// deng sang 'jig rten mgon po yi// sku gsung thugs kyang lha bzhin blta// dge 'dun mnyam par bzhag pa dang*// mdo dang gtor ma la sogs dang*// phyag skor mdo skor mdo dbyangs dang*// chos spyod mdzad pa'i phrin las la// gnag rdzi dga' bo ji bzhin du// bar chad med par brnag pa bskyed// mtha' khob yul du skyes pa yi// da rung skye dri ma yal zhing*// mthon po'i rigs su ma skyes shing*// sprang po gcig tu sku 'khrungs pas// gang la cis 'dul ma mkhas pas// tshig ngan rgya gad gcud rgyangs dang*// shākya'i sras kyi dge 'dun dang*// rdo kha thengs gsum byed pa la/ khyed kyis tshad mar ma 'dzin par// bla ma rin chen rjes su slob// nga yang khyed la mthun 'jug byed// phra bas don chen 'grub pa yi// bya ba'i rim pa zur smos nas// zab mo stong pa ye shes tshogs// gong du smos pa de dag kun// skye med stong pa ma lags sam// skye med stong pa ma yin na// stong pa'i lung dang 'gal gyur cing*// 'thad pa dang yang bral ba yi// stong pa 'di la mkhas pa rnams// dga' ba med cing 'dor bas na// gong du smos par gyur pa yi// bya dang byed pa'i bya ba rnams// bya byed kun dang bral ba yi// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po zhes// rtogs ldan rnal 'byor rnams kyis go// rdzogs so// // 389) ༄// lta sgom spyod gsum ya ma bral bar rtag tu gnas par bya ba// 'di ltar thub pa chen po'i chos// nyon mongs gsum la chags pa dang*// sdang bar byed pa gang yin pas// lha mi la sogs gong ma yi// 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba la// nyon mongs gdug pas dkrugs pa'i yid// 'di yis thar pa mi thob ces// so sor thar pa'i me long la// bltas la nyes pa spang bar bya// 'di ni 'phags pa char ka las// spong mgu spyod pa nyid las gsungs// chos thams gdod nas ma skyes pa/

smra bsam brjod med kyi ngo bor gnas pa la/ smra ba dang bsam pa dang brjod pa rnam pa gsum gyis ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rtogs par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rtogs pa rnams kyis kyang rtogs pa de'i don goms par bya zhing*/ smra ba dang bsam pa dang brjod pa med pa'i spyod pas slob dpon shanta de ba ltar dus 'da' bar byas nas/ bla ma rin po che'i dgongs pa lta ba'i mthar thug blta bya lta byed thams cad dang bral ba/ sgom pa'i mthar thug nyams myong thams cad dang bral ba/ chags sdang med pa'i lus ngag dang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhes pa/ lta sgom spyod pa gcig tu gyur pa la tshegs med pas/ lta sgom spyod pa gsum ya ma bral bar dus rtag tu gnas par bya'o// 'di yang 'di 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad lta ba dang sgom pa spyod pa rnam pa gsum mam/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba mthar thug pa rnam pa gsum mam/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po rnam pa gsum la sogs pa 'grub par byed pa'i tshul lugs dpag tu med pa zhig bshad pa dang*/ rten 'brel ma 'dzoms pas myur du mi 'gro ba dang*/ yun ring du 'gro ba dang*/ gtan du mi 'grub par bar chad du 'gyur bar shes par bya'o// 'di la blun po nga rgyal can// skyu ra sgom pas 'di skad ces// grib la rnam pa gsum gsung ste// bzang ngan grib kyis mi gnod pa// de ni mi pho khyo ga yin// bzang po sangs rgyas byin rlabs dang*// ngan pa sdig pa'i grogs po yi// rgyu zad rkyen zad gang yin pa// dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// chos sku ye shes gnyis med par// gsung ba'i bla ma rnams la 'dud// // 390) ༄// spang blang gi rten 'brel ma shes na rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel log par 'gyur ba// na mo ratna gu ru/ bram ze'i rigs su skyes nas kyang*// ston pa drang srong chen po'i bka'// dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod la// nges pa'i shes pa skyes gyur cing*// yan lag rtsis la mkhas pa rnams// bsam sbyor mthar thug gyur pa yis// pham par gyur pa'i ltung ba bzhi// ci nus phyogs med spyad pa yis// mthar thug byang chub thob smra yang*// ston pa'i gsung dang ma mthun pas// nges pa'i shes pa ga la skye// bu kun tshul khrims rin chen srungs// yang gnyis med don rtogs kyi rnal 'byor la// spang blang gi gdams ngag zab mo dgos// spang blang gi gegs sel ma shes na// rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel log par 'grig

/tshig rtsub kyi mtshon cha rnon po yis// gnyis su med pa'i phrag dog skye// rang gzhan gnyis kyi mgo bo 'breg /lhan skyes he ru ka dpal gyis// rgyan du byas pa a re 'jigs// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di// bred cing dngangs pa a la la// gnyis med don rtogs ma gtogs pa// sangs rgyas yin par yid ches dka'// ru tra chen po'i 'du shes skye// gdul bya snod ldan phal cher yang*// smin cing grol bar mi 'gyur bas// gnyis med don rtogs rnal 'byor pas// spang blang gnyis kyi gegs sel bstan// spang blang gi gegs sel ma go na// yul yul can gnyis su 'dzin pa'i yid// gnyis med 'od gsal ngang du bsad// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// byams dang snying rje rgyun du bskyed// rang bas gzhan gces ci bzang blta// gnyis med don rtogs rnal 'byor pas// zab mo'i rten 'brel 'di ma shes na// mnyam nyid stug po'i zhing khams na// gnyis med kun tu bzang po la// rtogs ldan byang chub sems dpas bskor// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi longs spyod rnams// ma lus rdzogs pa'i sku gyur pa// sangs rgyas yin par 'dren pa yang*// skyob mdzad mgon po rin po che// rten rab tu byung bar gyur ba la// phyi ma ngo mtshar che 'o zhes// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// bu rang dang 'dra ba'i grogs se kun// rgyud tshod mthon por song tsa na// thabs la mkhas pa'i grogs po gces// gnyis med don rtogs rnal 'byor pa// thabs kyis ci bya snyam na yang*// ring du song ba'i sems dpa' rnams// shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs nas// thabs mkhas bstan pa ma mkhyen na// dag pa'i sa la gnas pa yi// mgon po bdag nyid chen po rnams// gnyis med tsam du 'dzin pa'i blo// shin tu phra ba shes bya yi// sgrib pa sbyong bar nges pas na// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// rtog pa'i ri bo bsnyil te thal// chos rnams thams cad gnyis med de// gnyis med de yang rang sar dag

/bdag nyid chen pos bka' bstsal gsungs// de ltar mdzad na rnal 'byor pas// gnyis med gsha' mar rtogs nas mchi// shes rab thabs su 'gyur ba yin// rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mngon du 'gyur// sangs rgyas kyi mnyam rjes mi brtsi bar// mkhyen pa gnyis po gcig tu go// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi// mdzod 'dzin rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur// 'di la mnyam nyid rgyud rgyal du// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po mchog /phyag na rdo rje des kyang gsungs// ༈ //yang mi nga ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po 'dra// bu sprang po lta bur gyis shig ces// 'khor la zhe 'dod byed pa 'di// snying nas yin nam ku re lags// de las de byung cang srid dam// yang mi nga ni grong 'dab kyi khyi rgan 'dra// bu seng ge lta bur gyis shig ces// 'khor la zhe 'dod byed pa 'di// snying nas yin nam ku re lags// de las de 'byung cang srid dam// yang mi nga ni 'dod yon gyis ngoms pa med// bu 'dod yon zhen pa thongs shig ces// 'khor la zhe 'dod byed pa 'di// snying nas yin nam ku re lags// de las de 'byung cang srid dam// yang mi nga ni tshong dus kyis tshong pa 'dra// bu ri dwags lta bur sdod cig ces// 'khor la zhe 'dod smra ba 'di// snying nas yin nam ku re lags// de las de 'byung cang srid dam// // 391) ༄// rgyu las byung ba'i 'bras bu ni sangs rgyas mthus kyang 'gyur mi srid pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ bdud rtsi sa zhag lta bu yi// mchog thun mong gi 'bras bu smin pa'i gzhi// gsum ldan gyi bla ma rin po che// bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing mchog ste// mos gus byed pa'i gang zag gis// mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnams// 'di dang bar do gnyis su smin// zhing phun sum tshogs pa blo las 'das// theg mchog gi gsang sngags ma gtogs par// thabs khyad par du 'phags pa ma gsungs lags// dngos po phun sum tshogs pa ni// shes rab rgyal po ma da na// thabs kyi rgyal po maṃ sa ste// bdud rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin mchog

/mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'du bar byed// zos na nyams myong ting 'dzin skye// thabs shes gnyis po mnyes pa'i rdzas// dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa lags// sa gzhi de las me tog skye// de yis 'gro ba smin par byed// bla ma'i bka' stsal mtho dman la// lan bdun bar du gsol ba gdab// bsams shing rtag dang rang byung bsgoms// ༈ //gshe bar mi 'os rnam pa bcu// ngo mtshar med dang klan ka tshol// byis pa blun po mi gsal ba// mi mkhas mtshams kyi pha rol gnas// mkhas la las dang spyod lam las// ldang bar tshig ma bsdams dang bcu// nyes pa thams cad chos kyi sku// phyag rgya chen por spungs se spung*// rang byin gyis rlob pa 'di ngo mtshar che// spang blang med pa nyams re dga'// ji ltar dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo la// da lta'i mkhos ka dgos don che chung zhes// chags sdang gti mug drag po yis// mi mgu mi rangs mi bzod kyang*// rgyu las byung ba'i 'bras bu ni// sangs rgyas mthus kyang 'gyur mi srid// 'di ltar drang srong chen po'i sras// zang zing spros pa'i mtshan ma dang*// 'dres sam yang na ma 'dres zhes// sems la blta ba goms pa dang*// zab mo sems nyid rdo rje 'di// nyon mongs rtog pa'i 'dam rdzab tu// bying ngam yang na ma bying zhes// sems la blta ba goms par gyis// 'khor ba res su 'dre byed na// sa thob pa la ring zhes pa// mkhas pa rnams kyi gdams ngag nyon// thub pa bdag nyid chen po'i chos// zhi ba 'dod chags bral ba ste// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kun// zhi ba 'dod chags bral bar gcig /bden don bstan pa'i bye brag rnams// bram ze rtogs pa can rnams la// rnam par mi rtog pa zhes mtshon// rgyal po zhe gdug can rnams la// yid la mi byed pa zhes bstan// // 392) ༄// rang sems phyag rgya chen po 'di 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rgyal po yin zhes pa//

na mo ratna gu ru/ rang sems phyag rgya chen po 'di// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rgyal po yin// dngos med rnam rtog sna tshogs 'di// rgyal po de yi blon po yin// rgyal blon gnyis su med pa de// rgyal po de yi rgyal chas yin// mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// bde chen mchog la 'god pa de// rgyal po de yi rgyal khrims yin// ji ltar nam mkha'i bya yi rjes// btsal zhing brtag tu med pa ltar// de bzhin rnal 'byor pa yi sems// btsal zhing rtag tu med pa la// khyad par btsal zhing gdung pa'i sems// bya rjes 'dra bar gnas pa la// skye dang 'gag dang gnas pa rnams// gzhan gyi snang ba ma yin nam// zhe 'dod che la ngoms pa med// mthong thos 'dod pa'i mi rnams ni// smyon pa yin phyir bltas shing srid// chos shes khrel yod ngo mtshar can// ji ltar byas kyang btub pa de// rang gi snying dang 'dra ba'i phyir// de yi gnad du gces dgu bzhag/ //

393) ༄// thub dbang sras dang bcas par gsol 'debs 'gro ba'i dpal gyur// 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje// bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa'i bstan 'dzin brtul zhugs can// 'od srung chen por phyag 'tshal lo// mang du thos pa gsang sngags mchog /kun dga' bo la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bdag gi ston pa klu dang 'dra// bdag ni char sdod bya dang 'dra// klu yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*// bya yi gre bar song ba nyung*// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi zhabs drung du// 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog /nye bar 'khor du 'ong du re// mdo sde 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog /gnas brtan chen po 'ong du re// ma mo 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog /'od srung go 'phang thob tu re// yang 'od srung go 'phang thob tu re// kha tshong kha dor kha na med// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi zhabs drung du// gtan gyi skyes bur 'gyur ba nges// rgyal ba mnyes par byed pa nges// 'byung ba dus su g.yos pa 'di// zhe 'dod phra mos mi bzlog gda'// birwa chen po la gsol 'debs// yang birwa chen po la gsol ba 'debs// ji ltar khams kyi ri khrod du// sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i tshe// 'chi ba dran pa'i blo gros kyis// sems sdug chen po skyes pa bzhin// dus 'dir dbye ba'i gnas skabs min// pha 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' bstsal pa// 'gro ba'i don la dpal 'gyur gsol// // 394) ༄// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra chen rang sems rtogs pa gcig pur gda' zhes pa// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// sngar yang bka' drin mi chung che// da rung byin rlabs thugs la thogs// char pa ha cang ma ches sam// bya las pa rnams mig kyang phyid// dge 'dun 'dam rdzab nang du bzhugs// char pa cung zad gcad par zhu// lo thog skye 'khrungs smin mdzad gsol// bdag med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// bla ma mnyes mdzad mos gus can// bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi sras// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad pa// phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pa// goms pa klong du gyur pa la// nyon mongs khong khro ga la rigs// bla ma'i drung du byon pa legs// zhag gsum mnyes mdzad ngo mtshar che// slar yang rang gi gnas su gshegs// yang dang yang du byon par zhu// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra bo che// rang sems rtogs pa gcig pur gda'// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang por bzhugs// rnam par rol pa'i mdo las shes// snang ba zil gyis gnon pa la// slob dpon padma rgyal po dgos// glu chung so yi bar na len// len ma myong la ci la yod// gdams ngag thub pa'i gsung rab zab// nyams myong med la ci cha yod// bla ma dam pa tshad ldan gyi// gdams ngag zab mo de 'dra bas// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi// gnad kyi sgo rnams 'byed pa yin// de mos gus can gyis go ba yin// myong ba med la ci cha yod// spos sna la gtugs kyang ma tshor ba// phan pa med pa ngo mtshar che// chos rin chen rgyud la ma skyes pa'i// nye gnas de dang e 'dra ang*// bdag gi bla ma bzang ba dang*// bdag kyang mos gus che bar nges// mgon po'i chos thun gcig gcig la// bdag gi dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung*// nam mkha'i me tog mo gsham bu// ri bong rwa dang sbal pa'i spu// mkhan po chen po'i nad dang lnga// gang gi su zhig ji ltar na// bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi// ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas kyang*// don kun grub pa'i phrin las zhu// 'gro ba thams cad smin par mdzod// sangs rgyas byon pa'i dga' ba yang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i sdug bsngal yod// dga' dang mi dga' las 'das pa// rang sems mya ngan 'das pa yin// drang srong chen po sher 'byung gi// khyi gzhug gang la mi gtug 'tshal// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho la// lung khungs thams cad ga la 'ong*// rnal 'byor 'dra bar song ba des// tshogs 'khor 'dra ba bskor snying 'dod// bag pug

brag phug 'dra bar bsdad pa des// glu chung 'dra ba len snying 'dod// bu zer ba bden no shin tu dga'// dang por 'jig rten spros pa bcad// bar du 'jig rten zhen pa log /tha mar 'jig rten gnas las 'phags// pha dang ma dang nye du dang*// gnyen 'brel phyogs ris thams cad dang*// bla ma rdo rje spun grogs kyi// zhabs tog che 'o rgyal ba'i sras// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// sna tshogs mtho dman thams cad kun// rlung gi byed par thugs su chud// gsang sngags mkhyen pa phyag 'tshal lo// dgongs pa lon la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i jo sras phyag 'tshal lo// gzu ba dpang po chen pos mi khyogs pa// de yi dus su dpon rgan yin// lto ba sgal tshigs 'byar dus su// de yi dus su drang srong yin// me ghe me ghe zer ba'i tshe// khams kyi klog mkhan chen po yis// rtsed mo sna tshogs byed pa'i tshe// pha bzang bu gces yin nam snyam// kun yin gang yang ma yin pa// rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba yin// // 395) ༄// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gnad ston pa sprin chen mdo'i snying po// oṃ ku ri ku ri/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// rang bzhin gcig gyur chos kyi rje// mgon po phag mo gru yi// zhabs la rtag tu spyi bos 'dud// skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs// mgon po de yi zhal snga nas// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// dam chos bla med rin po che// gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad du// legs par gsungs pa thams cad kun// lta dang sgom pa spyod pa zhes// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal to// zhe 'dod lta ba'i lta ba can// de rjes 'brangs pa'i spyod pa yis// de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob pa 'di// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyi// rgyu dang 'bras bu 'byung ba'i tshul// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yang*// lta dang spyod pa ji snyed pa// thams cad de dang 'dra ba las// dgongs pa rnal 'byor bzhi yang ang*// zab mo bstan pa'i ting 'dzin gyi// lta ba 'gyur med lhun grub las// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyi// spyod pa rgya mtsho bsam yas pa// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa kun// rnal 'byor pa la 'byung ba 'di// ngo mtshar bas kyang ngo mtshar te// rmad du byung zhing rmad po che// 'gyur med lhun grub ting 'dzin dang*// dbyer med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*// de dang rjes mthun spyod pa 'di// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis// tshad du gzung bar ga la nus// mdor na rgyal ba nyag gcig las// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// chen po rnams kyi spyod yul min// tshad ldan bla mas ma bzung zhing*// zab dang rgya che'i gsung rab la// blo yi snang ba ma skyes shing*// lta spyod gcig tu ma gyur pas// 'bad pas sug drug bskyod na yang*// sbur pa bal du 'thums pa bzhin// grol bar 'dod kyang dam por 'ching*// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos// stobs bcu 'dul ba dri med la// spyod pa'i brtul zhugs spyad nas kyang*// dpag med 'gro ba thams cad kun// smin par byed pa dam pa'i chos// 'gro ba'i mgon po'i zhal snga nas// spyod pa blang dor bral ba de// chags sdang med pa'i lus ngag yid// tho co sna tshogs ma yin pa// dgongs pa bla na med pas shes// chos rje bla ma rin chen gyi// sras kyi thu bo rje btsun pa// stag lung thang pa ngo mtshar che// skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs// zab cing rgya che dam pa'i chos// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gnad// sprin chen mdo yi snying po 'di'i// bdag po shes rab 'byung gnas lags// chu yi rgya mtsho'i dus tshod kyi ting nge 'dzin no//

// 396) ༄// 'gro mgon rin po che'i bzhed pa gal che zhes pa dwangs gsal blo yi mun sel// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa la springs pa/ bzhugs sa de/ bla ma rje btsun pa gong mas btab pa dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pas kyang gnyan pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang shugs kyis zhi bar gyur pa yin pa dang*/ gnyis pa snang ba rang gi sems yin pa'i phyir sa gzhi dang gzhi de'i bdag po thams cad zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom zhing*/ de las byung ba'i rje btsun spyan ras gzigs su sa gzhi dang yul khams thams cad bsgoms pas yul dang yul can rnam pa gnyis ka la phan pa dang bde bas bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i bzhed pa 'di gal che/ gsum pa byin gyis rlob par byed pa de yang*/ bu slob chos rten sgrub pa byed pa thams cad kyis gnas byin gyis brlabs zin la/ da rung yang byin gyis rlob par byed pa'i rang bzhin can du mchis pa lags/ khyed kyi dgon pa de dpe med par shin tu legs pa gcig yod par gda' bas/ der yun ring du bzhugs nas/ 'gro ba gzhan la phan pa dang bde ba rgya chen po ci 'byung la dgongs par zhu 'tshal/ de yang gtso bor gyur pa ni/ bdag nyid dge sbyor la nan tan che bar ma byas na/ gzhan gyi rgyud byin gyis rlob par mi 'ong bar/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa yin pas/ rje rin po che'i mdzad pa zla stod smad dang*/ snga dro phyi 'bred kyi rnam par thar pa de bzung na rang gzhan gyi don mi 'grub cing rgyud byin gyis mi rlob mi srid pas/ de ltar thugs la bzhag par zhu/ bkra shis par gyur cig/ // 397) ༄// gnad kyi nyams len shes dgos pa snying po don bsdus ri khrod dbang phyug la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// ston pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// 'di ltar sems kyi ting nge 'dzin// lus kyi mngon du byas pa yis// snang ba dbang du gyur ba dang*// de yi mthun pa'i rkyen rnams dag

/bsam gyis mi khyab dpag med du// 'phel bas mthong chos mngon du 'byung*// thub pa rgyal ba man chad nas// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// snang ba sna tshogs bsgyur ba dang*// yon tan bkod pa dpag med pa// nyams su myong bar gyur pa rnams// tshu rol mthong ba'i gang zag dang*// zhu thug byed du ga la btub// byas na dpal dro'i sdud pa yin/ khams pa lung pa'i bskol phor dang*// spyan snga chen po'i gser tshums dang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug nag po yi// skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dug lugs rnams// bdag cag su dang zhu thug bya// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// gnad kyi nyams len ma shes na// yar lung dge bshes chen po zhes// 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rje// dpal ldan phag mo gru pas gsungs// don gyi snying po bsdus pa 'di// ri khrod dbang phyug bu la gdams// // 398) ༄// dge sbyor sgrub pa'i mchod pas gong ma rnams mnyes par byed dgos pa// bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum la/ lus gus pas phyag 'tshal/ sems dang bas skyabs su mchi'o// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i 'das mchod/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod pa chen po 'di la/ chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod chen pos rang gzhan gyi rgyud tshim par byed pa yin pa la/ do gcig gi gnas skabs su/ rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gis/ thugs dam dang dge sbyor la nan tan chen pos nyams su blang ba'i bsgrub pa'i mchod pa chen pos/ gong ma rnams mnyes par byed dgos par gda' bas gzhi la bzhugs pa rnams 'dag sbyar dang*/ smra bcad dang*/ dran pa ma yengs pa'i 'bad pas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu mdzad par zhu/ phan tshun du bzhud pa rnams kyang*/ spyod lam rnam bzhir dge sbyor la 'bad pa chen pos 'bad par zhu/ song nas tshur la 'ong bar bzhed pa rnams kyang*/ tshol gsog dang rtsol sgrub mdzod la rgyags bsnoms la chos bzhed pa rnams 'byon par zhu/

gsar pa chos ma tshar ba 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa/ rnying pa rgyags med pa 'bul ba la re ba rnams rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gis zhabs tog bya rgyu med pas/ phan tshun ri khrod du sgrub pa la bzhud par zhu/ sang nas chos zab mo sha stag byed pa dang*/ sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byed pa la sogs pa chos dang mthun pa mtha' dag ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dus mchod/ bla ma rin po che'i 'das mchod lags pas/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams kyi bzod pa mdzad cing*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bskyang bar mdzad du gsol/ bkra shis par gyur cig/ // 399) ༄// mkhas pa'i man ngag rgya che chung gsum gyi rim pa zhes pa// ston pa thub mgon chos kyi rje// rnga bo che la sogs pa'i mdor// slob dpon 'phags pa lung bstan pa// zhing srung thabs la mkhas pa'i dpes// rgyal sras bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams// pha rol phyin drug sbyor ba yis// ston pa'i gsung bzhin nan tan bsgrub// slob dpon 'phags pa'i rjes 'brang bya// bho dhi tsitta byang sems kyis// zhe 'dod med pa sbyin pa'i stobs// bden drang bsgrub pa tshul khrims stobs// snying stobs bsgrub pa bzod pa'i stobs// myur bar bsgrub pa brtson 'grus stobs// sems rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa bsam gtan gyi stobs// phyogs ma nor bsgrub pa shes rab kyi stobs// mgon po rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis// bsgrub pa 'di yi stobs shugs kyis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bzung nas kyang*// 'gro ba sman pa'i mthu ldan mod// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nyon mongs pa gsum dang*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ bya ba dang*/ bya ba ma yin pa mi shes pa dang bzhi spang zhing*/ nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyi dbang du mi 'gro ba dang*/ 'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang*/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa shes pas/ zhal ta dang bya ba thams cad bsgrub par bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ mkhas pa'i man ngag rgya che 'bring chung gsum gyi rim pa/

bram ze chen po gnag las skyes dang*/ sman chen po dang*/ sa ga ma'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ste/ las dang bya ba mtshams tshod kyis byed pas bsgrub par byed pa ni rin chen po chung ngun gyis mi 'grub pas/ chen pos bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ 'bring po 'bring gis bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ chung ngu chung ngun gyis bsgrub par byed pa gal che ba ste/ de yang 'dir bla ma thugs rje che zhing phyogs ris med par skyong 'dod pa'i bsam pas bzang ngan thams cad 'ur rgyag tu byas pas/ dngos po 'tsho ba bza' rgyu dang btung rgyu ni zad/ bya ba dang byed pa ni mi 'grub pas da phyin chad nyung ba nyung bas bsgrub/ 'bring po 'bring pos bsgrub/ rgya chen po mang pos bsgrub pa la tshod dang rim pa ma shes na/ lag skud dam chu gcig pu rang gis kyang lang mi srid pas/ ci tsam dgos pa las lhag pa/ nyal nyil bya ba la mi phan pa mi gzhag pa dang*/ nang na yod pa rnams kyang so so'i las dang bya ba gru bzhi logs brgyad du bcol zhing*/ de ma nus na gang 'dod kyang sar btang ba dang*/ logs su 'jog pa gal che bar 'dug/ //

400) ༄// sems kyi rgyal po goms na yon tan thams cad 'byung bar bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ zab cing rgya che rgya mtsho lta bu'i sku// smon lam mthar phyin 'gro ba ma lus la// theg chen chos kyi char 'beb rin po che// mnyam med bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phung byed mi chos chags sdang kun gyi gzhi// g.yog 'khor nye du sdug bsngal kun gyi rkyen// rang la sems pa'i gang zag gi 'gal rkyen// 'di dag spangs nas bden pa bstan par gces// sems kyi rgyal po goms na yon tan thams cad 'byung*// nyams len brtson 'grus che na sangs rgyas sku gsum thob// 'dod chags bral bar gyur na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// zhe sdang spang la brtson na byams pa rgyun chad med// gti mug bral na 'od gsal rgyun par gnas// rnam rtog drwa ba chod na gzhan don lhun gyis grub// dman pa'i byis pa nyams su len pa'i thabs// // 401) ༄// gser g.ya' dang bral ba ltar rang sems spros med rdo rje sgom pa// kye rgyal ba'i sras/ de la blo gros chung zhing shes rab dman pa kha cig sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rgyu mi dge ba mi spong bar bde ba dang skyid pa 'bras bu la spyod pa'i gdams ngag cig zhu zer ba byung na/ de ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang mkhyen mi srid na/ rmongs pa gzhan gyis lta shes pa ga la yang srid pas/ de lta bu khas len pa byung na bdud kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'am/ shes rab 'chal pa zhes bya ba bsam mi shes pa'am smyo ba kho nar zad do// 'o na gang zhe na/ thos dang bsam dang sgom pa yi// shes rab zab mos gang rtogs pa// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal rnams// de yi gnyen pos spong shes na// mkhas pa'i gdams ngag bsam mi khyab// nam mkha' mdzod la spyod par nges// yang kha cig nad dang sdug bsngal/ gdon dang gnod pa las dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams ting nge 'dzin ma yin pas sel ba'i gdams ngag cig zhu zer na/

bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun// sems gzhan g.yengs pas byas gyur na// de nyid rig pas don med gsungs// zhes pas de nyid rig pa ni/ 'phags pa rnams dang slob dpon bram ze chen po dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yin la/ don med pa ni gnas skabs su nad dang gnod pa la sogs pa dang*/ sgrib pa gsum 'dag pa ni sems g.yengs pas mi srid pas/ de lta bu la 'dod pa ma skyed cig 'o na mu stegs byed kyi sngags kyis phan par 'dug snyam na/ de la yang sems kyi dmigs pa gcig gam/ yang na lus ngag gi gnad cig bcings pas/ bcings pa rang grol ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye/ des nad dang gnod pa 'tsho ba kho na'o// de'i gnad ka yang sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad kyang sems las byung ba kho na yin la/ de so so re re la sems gnas pa'i dus su/ gnas dus kyis bskal pa'i gnad kas rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgrub shes na ni/ mkhas pa rnams kyi rtsal kha la/ bsam gyis mi khyab cir yang 'gyur// de la dam chos bsam mi khyab// ting nge 'dzin yang bsam mi khyab// mkhas pa rang gi sems la 'dri// lar sems kyi gnas lugs ma go na// kun rdzob bde skyid kyi thabs rnams kun// me yi nang du bsil ba tshol// bu snying gtam tshig gcig 'chad pa de// tshe la long med kyi dus tshod 'dir// log sred tshig gi gdams ngag la// 'dod pa'i bsam pa rab bcad de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog /bde dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas gtso// gser g.ya' dang bral ba lta bu yi// rang sems spros med rdo rje bsgom// bu log sred can gyi gdams ngag dang*// rang gi lta spyod mi bstun zhing*// mtho dman gyi gdams ngag sna tshogs kun// rtog pa'i sna kha yin pas na// mthar thug gi 'bras bur ma bsam par// 'gyur med lhun grub 'dus ma byas// bde chen rdo rje rang sems sgoms// // 402)

༄// tshe 'di'i bsam pa ma btang ba'i ting 'dzin ni khras byi'i bcum pa'i nyams rtsal dang 'dra ba// na mo ratna gu ru/ spyir 'o cag gi mi'i lus rin po che 'di rnyed par ni dka'/ 'jig par ni sla/ 'jig rten 'dir yun ring por ni mi sdod/ sdig dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyis 'jig rten chos brgyad bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub kyi/ pha rol tu grags pa nyams pa la sogs pa'i rgyur 'gro/ grags kyang yun ring por mi sdod/ 'gro dgos pas dgos pa med/ tshe 'di'i bsam pa ma btang ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar yang dka' bar slob dpon shan ta de ba'i zhal nas gsungs/ spyir zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin rlung dbu ma'i nang du tshud pas bde ba dang gsal ba dang mi rtog pa stobs 'phel bas/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang*/ chu la mi bying ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul mang po ston nus kyang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang ma bral bas/ khras byi'u bcum pa'i nyams rtsal dang khyad med/ de 'dra gcig la gtan gyi bde ba tshol na smyon pa dngos yin/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar byed pa la/ zhing bla ma dam pa rtogs pa dang ldan zhing snying rje zhe 'dod du ma song ba zhig la/ slob ma 'khor ba dang tshe 'di la blo log pa zhig gis ku re dang kyal ka med par/ zhe thag pa rus pa'i gting nas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i blos gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu byas la gsol ba gdab// bar chad gsum dang bral gyur na// gang 'dod 'bras bu myur du thob// 'jig rten blo gros sna tshogs kyis// kha dang bsam pa 'dzol gyur na// g.yo can rang gis rang bslus pas// 'phags pa rnams kyis khrel bar zad// // 403) ༄// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyed pa bla ma'i gsol 'debs// rje rin po che yi byin rlabs kyis/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba dang*/

shin tu gang ba dang*/ smin pa dang*/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa ni rje rin po che'o// rje rin po che'i sku gsung thugs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid lhun grub rgyun chad med pa'i gter du gyur pas/ bdag dang bdud kyi dkyil 'khor/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag cing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid lhun grub rgyud chad med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa rgyud la skye bar 'dod pa rnams kyi zhe 'dod kyi tshig go// // 404) ༄// rtsa bzhi nyams pa'i dge slong dge 'dun rnams dang lhan cig tu gnas par mi bya ba// mi gnas pa dang mi bya'o// chos ni rnam pa bcu yod de// rnal 'byor can dang mi dga' ba'i// nan tan 'di la 'ga' tsam gyi// rjes su zhugs par gyur na yang*// khams gsum ting 'dzin mi skye na// byang chub rnam gsum smos ci dgos// 'tsho ba'i yo byad med pa dang*// tshul khrims nyams pa sdig byed dang*// log par lta bas 'jig rten gyi// bzang ngan ltas la chags pa dang*// sems 'phyor ba dang rgod pa dang*// phra ma dga' bas dbyen byed dang*// rtsub po smra bas 'phags pa smod// tshig kyal pa dang rdzun smra dang*// chags dang phrag dog bsam pa yis// gzhan gyi rnyed la mi dga' dang*// zhe sdang bcas shing gnod sems bskyed// rgyu 'bras med par blta ba 'o// gzhan yang rnam pa bcu yin te// las la dga' zhing chags pa dang*// bre mo'i gtam la dga' zhing chags// gnyid la dga' zhing chags pa dang*// zang zing tshol la dga' zhing chags// gzugs la dga' zhing chags pa dang*// sgra dang dri ro reg bya dang*// rtog dang dpyod la chags dang bcu// mi gnas pa dang mi bya ba'i// bya ba 'di la 'ga' zhig dag /byed na ting 'dzin mi 'grub cing*// grub kyang stong par 'gyur ba ni// lha sbyin la sogs 'dra bar gsungs// pha dang ma dang dgra bcom bsad// dge 'dun dbye dang sku mtshal byung*// lnga po mtshams med las yin te// nye bar rnam pa lnga po la// rang sangs rgyas pa bsad pa dang*// dgra bcom ma la mi tshangs spyod// dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor la spyod// slob dge gsod dang mchod rten bshig

/rtsa ba rnam pa lnga po las// nyes pa shin tu che bar gsungs// dkon mchog gsum la ma dad na// mu stegs can la skyabs song ste// ltas su lta ba 'dzin byed cing*// 'jig rten lha la mchod pa dang*// theg pa gsum gyi dam chos la// skur zhing bar chad byed pa ni// tshigs bcad gcig tsam yin na yang*// 'di ni shin tu lci ba yin// srog gcod pa dang ma byin len// mi tshangs spyod dang rdzun du smra// rtsa ba chad pa'i dge slong ni// dge 'dun rnams dang lhan cig tu// gnas par bya ba ma yin zhing*// dge 'dun las rnams mi bya ste// dad pas byin pa'i dge 'dun gyi// dkor la 'di ni mi dbang bas// dge slong dge sbyong ma yin par// ston pas bcas pa yin par gsungs// des na ston pa kun mkhyen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// // 405) ༄// nyams len gnad kyi man ngag bdag 'dzin rtog pa'i khrud shing skyu ra pan mo la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ skyu ra pan mo la springs pa// 'das pa'i dus gsum sngon byung ba// mgon po me tog zla mdzes de// thub dbang 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur pa// padma'i bla mar rdzogs sangs rgyas// rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs bskyed phyir// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong tshe// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa// rgyan gyi 'khor lor gyur pa'i phyir// bstan pa'i bdag po sras kyi gtso// mgon po zla 'od gzhon nur gyur// bdag cag kun gyi don gyi phyir// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// dwags kyi yul du rdzogs pa lags// dwags po yul gyi sde dgon dang*// de na yod pa'i sems can dang*// dwags por yongs grags bu slob rnams// mtho dman 'bring gsum gang la yang*// lha sa srong ska byur mda' gsum// rang gi gnas su 'dra ba la// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs thams cad dang*// dwags po'i bu slob thams cad la// phyogs cha phyogs ris med dam snyam// spyi dang bye brag thams cad dang*// dwags po'i bu slob thams cad kyi// bsam sa lha sa gcig pu yin// rin po che yi gdan sa de// lag pa g.yas g.yon ma spos pa'i// nga yi bu chen rnam gnyis kyis// ku re rtsed mo byas pa la// byed mkhan nga yin gzhan na med// bdag kyang dkyil na yod pa la// khyed dang gzhan lta smos ci dgos// 'on kyang gdod mtha' bar gsum du// bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa mchog
