/lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mgon skyabs zhig par gyur pa la// sbyor dngos rjes gsum gang la yang*// dga' zhing gtogs pa med mod kyang*// ston pa de yi bstan pa la// dag dang ma dag thams cad kun// mi gtsang skyon gyis bskud bskus pa'am byug pa pa 'di// 'das pa'i rgyal bas lung bstan pas// mi dga' byas pas ci zhig phan// nam mkha'i btson rar tshud pa'i mi// nam mkha' nyid la bros na yang*// nam mkha' nyid las mi thar bar// da rung khyed kyis ma go 'am// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing ri bo rnams// bcu chos nyi ma bdun shar bas// bsregs pa de yi 'od zer gyis// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kyi// sgrib gsum lhag ma ma lus shing*// 'od gsal bskal pa'i me chen gyis// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// zab pa'i gdams ngag rin po che// nyams su blang ngam bris la bzhag /legs par dgongs la 'bad pa yis// nyams su blangs na mngon du 'gyur// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen ni// nged rang spad bu las ma mchis pas// 'bad pas thugs dam nyams su blang*// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pas// nyes tshogs 'khrugs pa zhi ba yis// lha sa dar cing rgyas par 'ong*// bu slob phyogs ris thams cad kun// dga' zhing skyid pas glu snyan len// nga yi bu chen rnam gnyis kyang*// nga yi drung du e mi 'ong*// grub mtha' 'di las med dam snyam// bdud dpung nyes tshogs bcom pa la// dge sbyor gcig pu ma gtogs pa// rgyal ba la yang thabs gzhan med// de phyir 'bad pas dam chos bsgom// snying gtam tshig gcig gi man ngag /mngon mtshan med pa'i thabs sdums// bdag 'dzin rtog pa'i khrud shing*// nyams len gnad kyi man ngag rdzogs so// // 406) ༄// chos kyi stan bshams ma thag phun sum tshogs pa'i phan yon bcu thob par bstan pa//

de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos gang*// zhi ba bshad pa lung bstan pa// chos kyi stan ni bshams ma thag /phun sum tshogs pa bcu thob pa// 'khor los bsgyur ba brgya byin dang*// tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag po dang*// ston pa'i bstan la stan thob dang*// dbang bskur ba dang byang chub kyi// snying por sangs rgyas thob pa'i bstan// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i khri// cho 'phrul chen po ston pa dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i khri stan bcu// de dag thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs// byang chub sems dpa' dmigs med la// thal mo sbyar ba byas pa yi// rnam par smin pa gang yin pa// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa la// thams cad 'dud dang 'drar 'gyur gsung*// chos pa bzang po yin snyam na// da rung nyon mongs kha ma bri// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// bka' bkyon bas lta bsod re thang*// lung 'di kun tu brtags las byung*// kun tu rtog pa'ang yod ma yin// bzhad gad rtsed mo'i bar du yang*// dus ma yin pa'i tshig mi smra// dus la bab par smra ba ni// mi g.yo'i zhing der skye bar 'gyur// gces pa'i bu gsum tshad du chug /a tha ling tha ling tha ling lang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyi// rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab la// gdung rgyud so so 'dzin pa rnams// skyabs gsum bslab pa byang sems kyis// thams cad legs par 'ong du 'dra// thar pas sangs rgyas thob pa la// dga' zhing rjes su yi rang 'bul// so so rang gi pha phogs la// spyod cing rnam thar skyong ba 'di// legs shing mi 'thad med pa la// rang la gtad pa'i pha yi phogs// bla ma'i rnam thar mi 'dzin nam// myos pa yin nam chang 'thung ngam// gdon gyis brlabs sam ji ltar gyur// 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// thugs rje dgongs nas byin gyis rlobs// sprang po nags khrod dgon par skyol//

// 407) ༄// dran dang shes bzhin 'di nyid chos kyi rtsa bar thub pas gsungs pa// oṃ swasti/ sprang po sro shig mi bzhar phyug po rab tu dbyung*/ /mi chos 'dun gros mi 'dri khrid la nan tan zhu/ /ka ca nga la ma zhu yod pa'i mi la slong*// kun gyi so nam bsgrub pa 'ba' zhig ma yin nam// skye dang rga dang na ba dang*// 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// skyob par byed pa'i skyabs gcig pu// dam pa'i chos las gzhan med par// skyes chen khyed la gdams par bgyi// 'khor ba skye ba'i rgyu bzhi ni// tshogs ma bsags dang sdig byas dang*// gzhan gyi dge ba'i bar bcad dang*// dge ba byang chub ma bsngos pa'o// dgra gnyen du chod pa'i dpa' bo dang*// gnyen stong par rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro gnyis// sems 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la// dus rgyun chad med par ko ro ro// dran dang shes bzhin 'di nyid ni// chos kyi rtsa bar thub par gsungs// ma yengs pa dang mi 'da' ba// gnyis pos lam dang dam tshig rdzogs// //

408) ༄// rang la rang bskul nyams len zhes pa tshig rkang drug pa// sems nyid gnad du skyel ba la// gtum mo a thung gi man ngag gces// gsang sngags phrin las sgrub pa la// bskyed rim sgyu lus man ngag gces// zung du chud pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rang la rang mkho nyams su len// // 409) ༄// rgya gar byed lugs a tsarya'i sgrub stangs zhes pa tshig rkang bcu pa// yon tan 'byung gnas rgya gar du// byed lugs mkhas pa'i a tsarya// las 'phro gang mthun brtag brtag nas// yi dam gcig la sa the dam bca' btsugs// de la rtags mtshan thon pa dang*// skyon dag yon tan kun rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas gcig la thams cad 'byung*// thams cad sangs rgyas gcig yin pas// a tsarya yi bsgrub lugs yin// bus kyang de ltar nyams su longs// // 410) ༄// sgom zhes bya ba rnam rtog zhes pa tshig rkang brgyad pa// sgom zhes bya ba rnam rtog ste// sgom du med par rang grol nyid// gnyis snang med pa chos nyid dang*// mi 'bral rgyun chad med pa yin// 'khor ba dang ni myang ngan 'das// gnyis med sems su gcig pa la// 'khrul pas gnyis su snang ba ni// don du yod pa ma yin no// // 411) ༄// sgom pa byang chub yon tan la gnang ba'i gdams pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rje// 'gran zla med pa'i dam pa rje btsun pa// 'dun ma sbyar dogs yod do dge ba'i bshes// rjes 'jug sdug tu ma 'jug rin po che// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// dpal ldan drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// gsang sngags bdag po bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs rnams// mngon du gyur cing sdom mdzad pa// rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya mtsho chen po'i mchis 'gram ltar// sgom pa byang chub yon tan khyod// khyod la rnam rtog yod mi mnga'// mnga' na ye shes pha rol phyin// gnas brtan chen po phyag 'tshal bstod// khyed kyi bla ma rin chen ni// la kha'i bya sgro ji bzhin du// rkyen gyis phar sgyur tshur sgyur byed// shing lo rlung khyer zhes kyang grags// ji ltar sngon gyi jo bo rje// dge bshes ston pas bskyangs pa ltar// skyes chen bdag nyid gong ma rnams// nye gnas mchog gis bskyangs pa yin// de phyir shin tu 'bad par zhu// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i sku// 'gro ba'i mgon po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rab phab nas// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus zhi mdzad gsol// dus gsum rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum// rje btsun 'phags mas de skad gsung*// shes rab can gyi rdor 'byung gi// dam chos 'jam rkyang phag mo gru// 'phan yul rgan mo'i ser sngags bzhin// pha ri pha ri pha gir song*// dam chos 'di yi gleng lang ni// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'grig tshul yin// bu gces se nor bu rin po che// dang por dam chos ma bzung ngo*// bar du dam chos ma bcangs so// mtha' mar shor rgyu ma mchis so// dga' 'o skyid do nye gnas rnams// rul pa mchod pa gcig pus chog/

༈ //chos rje bla ma rin po che// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pas// thabs dang shes rab zung 'brel phul// de dben na yon tan mi skye re// gzhan du chu las bsrubs pa'i mar// rkyal pa bdun bcu tham pa de// 'bri gung pa yi longs spyod mdzod// mkhas pa la mkhas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi zhing khams 'dra// skyi shod kyi grwa sa ma lags sam// btsun po la btsun po'i 'khor gyis bskor// shākya seng ge'i zhing khams 'dra// dbu ru stod pa ma lags sam// gtum po la gtum po'i 'khor gyis bskor// phyag na rdo rje'i zhing khams 'dra// bla ma rin chen ma lags sam// gdod nas skye ba med pa yi// lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid de// rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal yin// gsum po tshogs pa'i rten 'brel gyis// sems su spros pa chod pa de// bsgom pa yi ni 'od gsal yin// gnyis po dbye ba med pa de// rmi lam dag tu drangs gyur na// de ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal yin// spangs thob bral ba'i blo 'das de// tshe gcig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin// sems khral chen pos thum 'phras dgos// nyal na dgon pa'i ri dwags gsung*// des na 'chi dang mi rtag dang*// rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang*// khyad par gnyid sogs sgrib pa lnga// mgo la me shor lta bur spang*// gsal ba'i rgyu ni byang sems yin// rkyen ni dran dang 'dun pa yin// gcig shos rgyun chad med pa 'o// rtag tu mnyam gzhag rgyu 'bras blta// bla ma'i gsung bzhin tshogs gnyis bsags// nags khrod gcig du gnas bcas nas// rnal 'byor dbang phyug smra bcad mdzod// bsod snyoms zas la brten nas ni// sgrub pa snying por 'gyur zhig gu// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// rang byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag gis// snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus kun// gnyis med gcig tu 'gyur zhig gu// rje btsun bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// rang byung phyag rgya chen po yis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde chen chos skur 'gyur zhig gu// gnad du phog pa'i rma tshabs la// chen po'i kha na mi 'tshal te// chung yang 'chi ba'i bya ba byed// gnad du phog pa gtsigs su che// mkhas pa'i man ngag zab mo la// mang po'i sna mthud mi 'tshal te// gnad du phog pa gtsigs su che// nyams su blangs pas yon tan skye// bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad du// 'di la bla ma dgos so zhes// nan tan chen pos yang dang yang*// bla ma rnams kyis bka' bstsal gsungs// rdo rje lus kyi gnad gcig gis// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa yi// nyams dang rtogs pa skyes pa 'di// bu gcig ngo mtshar mi che 'am// na mo so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyis// sdom pas legs par bsdams pa yi// rnal 'byor pa yis ri khrod du// byams pa snying rje gzhir byas nas// rang gi dge sbyor gang yin la// ma yengs brtson pas nyams blangs pas// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// 'bral ba'i dus su shi 'bras 'byung*// 'di yi dus su snying rus kyis// goms pa gang che'i gdams ngag la// bcu chos sum chos nyams su blangs// bskal par rnyed par dka' ba yi// yon tan bye ba mang po yang*// bu yis tshe gcig nyid la thob// snying gtam yin pas nyams su blang*// gsang sngags yin pas zhe la zhog

/bde ba'i 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che// skyid pa'i bdag nyid bla ma rin po che// dga' ba'i rang bzhin bla ma rin po che// mkhas pa bla ma rin po che la bdud// sems 'dzin pa btang na bde ba yin// blo bya byed bral na skyid pa yin// gnas lugs mthong na dga' ba yin// sems nyid 'dres na mkhas pa yin// 'dzin pa btang na bde ba de// yul sna tshogs bdag tu mi 'dzin pas// dang po rtsol sgrub bral bas bde// bar du chags sdang zhi bas bde// tha mar ngan song spangs pas bde// gtan du thar pa thob pas bde// de bas 'dzin pa gtang na bde// bde bar 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams// khyi rgan gter srungs ma byed par// 'dzin pa gtang na bde bar gda'o// blo bya byed bral na skyid pa de// sems spros pa'i bya byed spangs pa yis// dang po 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spangs// bar du thar pa'i sa la gnas// gsum du theg chen gyi don mthong bas// bde skyid mthar thug gi sangs rgyas thob// de bas bya byed bral na skyid// skyid par 'dod pa'i dam pa rnams// bya byed rgya stag gi tshang nang du// rang dbang med par ma 'jug par// sems bya byed bral na skyid par gda'o// gnas lugs mthong na dga' ba de// sems nyid gnyug ma'i ye shes de// dang po mthong bas skyon rnams dag /bar du mthong bas yon tan rdzogs// mtha' mar mthong bas lhun gyis grub// de bas gnas lugs mthong bas dga'// dga' bar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// mtha' gnyis kyi g.yang sar ma 'tshol bar// gnyis med ye shes kyi thang la rgyug /sems gnyis 'dres na mkhas pa de// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa des// zhi ba phyogs gcig sa spangs nas// dang po rgyal ba'i gdan sa thob// bar du sku gsum lhun gyis grub// tha mar sku gsum rgyun chad med// de bas sems gnyis 'dres na mkhas// kwa mkhas par 'dod pa'i kha sbyang can// nga rang rgyal 'dod kyi sbrul dong du// rang gzhan gnyis ka ma mchong bar// sems gnyis 'dres pa'i 'dun ma des// 'og min rgyal ba'i khang bzang du// rang gzhan gnyis ka bde bas rol// 'di ku re kyal ka ma lags te// bde skyid dga' dang mkhas pa yi// gdams ngag rmad du byung ba yin//

// 412 ༄// mos gus rgyal mtshan thogs la sgrub pa dang du len pa phyag chen man ngag lnga pa// oṃ swasti/ thog mtha' dus rnams kun tu bde dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas gtso// gdod nas gnas pa lhun grub sems kyi de bzhin nyid// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa he ru ka dpal bla ma dam pa la// dus rnams rtag tu phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar 'chi// gting mtha' med pa sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'khor ba 'di// stes dbang rang dgar ldog pa nam yang mi srid pas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms la sgrub pa dang du longs// shin tu gces par byas pa'i sha rus phung po 'di// 'jig cing 'gyes pas rtag tu dbang byar med pas na// brtson 'grus drag po'i shugs kyis sgrub pa dang du longs// mdza' shing dga' ba snying du sdug pa'i bshes rnams dang*// snyan grags khe bkur phan phan lta bu 'chos pa rnams// bde dang thar pa 'phrog pa'i chom rkun bdud yin pas// ngo srung ltos 'jog med par sgrub pa dang du longs// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi nor bu rin po che// rtag tu phan zhing bde bar byed pa grogs kyi mchog /nges 'byung tshul khrims skyon dag yon tan bskyed// rang snying dpang por tshugs la sdom pa srog bzhin srungs// bsam pa bzang yang sbyor ba rjes ngan gang yin dang*// ngan par 'dug pa'i bsam sbyor khu 'phrig za ba rnams// rtsa ba drungs phyung 'bad pas spongs la sgrub pa dang du longs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba ni// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi 'byung gnas dbang phyug gtso// rdo rje 'dzin chen bla ma rin chen la// mos gus rgyal mtshan thogs la sgrub pa dang du longs// byang chub sems dang gnyug ma bsod nams tshogs// mkha' la 'phur ba rnams kyi 'dab ma ji bzhin du// gnyis med zung du 'jug pas skyon dag yon tan rdzogs// man ngag gnad dang ma bral rnal 'byor pa// 'gag dang nya ga ma spong rang 'dod can// snying rus chos su thon dang pho rus can// bla ma'i gsung mchog rdo rje rin po che// dus gsum rgyal ba gshegs pa'i gzhung lam ste// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi srog gi snying po mchog

/sgrib pa'i bud shing thams cad bsreg pa'i me// sde snod kun gyi rtsi thog snying po ste// rgyud sde kun gyi gnad kyi bcud phyung ba// sngags dang mtshan nyid kun gyi man ngag ni// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa la sogs pa'i// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams las legs byung ba// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag lnga po 'dir// chos rnams ma lus thams cad 'dus pas na// yon tan skye bar 'dod pas goms par gyis// goms shing nges pas yon tan gang skyes kyang*// nga yi sgom du song bas nga yi nyams rtogs dang*// nga yi yon tan slob na lhag pa'i nga rgyal des// dug sdong lo 'dab rgyas pa'i me tog 'bras bu yis// rang gzhan phung bar byas na shin tu ma rung bas// brtse ba chen pos ci byed lam tu gtong zhing bsngo ba dang*// rang bzhin shes pas chags pa thams cad yongs spangs te// rang gi sems dang bla ma rnams la the tshom gang skyes kyang*// bsags pa chung bas bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pas na// gsol ba gdab cing dbang bskur bskyar ba dang*// maṇḍal yi ge brgya pa'i bsnyen pa dang*// dad gus drag pos bstim pa la sogs kyis// dam tshig dri ma ma lus dag byas pas// 'bras bu tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob// // 413) ༄// kun rdzob 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gti mug che zhes pa tshig rkang dgu pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ badzra dharma ka ya ni/ don dam rang sems 'gyur med lhun gyis grub// kun rdzob 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gti mug che// rtog pa'i bye brag gzung ba'i yul rnams la// chags sdang rmongs gsum nyon mongs gsum po yi// rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag bya byed las// las de rnam par smin pas rnam smin no// lugs ldog lugs las byung ba'i rten 'brel 'di// rgyal ba rnams kyang gsung mdzod zab mor gsungs// dam chos 'di las gzhan med go bar gyis// // 414) ༄// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis bags chags thams cad kha bsgyur ba'i gdams pa//

sems dang dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs pa skyes// rtogs pa skyes pa'i skyes bu yis// bsam pa'i sa bon bag chags la// sa bon snang ba zhing yin te// dngos po lus ngag yid nyid do// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// bag chags thams cad kha bsgyur bas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor bsgyur// bu bsgoms pas go ba rnyed pa yin// spros pa chod la rang sems bsgom// mthong chos skyes gnas myong 'gyur dang*// lan grangs gzhan la myong ba rnams// spang bya gnyen po'i rim pa des// mkhas pas sa dang gser phye ste// gser gyis lcags rnams gser du bsgyur// de tshe gser las ma gtogs pa// lcags rnams btsal yang mi rnyed do// de la sku dang rgyan sogs kyis// rang gzhan don grub dga' bar byed// sred pas len pa'i phyag 'tshal lo// srog gsum gtogs pa'i mchod pas mchod// skyug nad log pa'i sdig pa bshags// yon tan mthong bas rjes yi rang*// rin po che la zhe 'dod byed// nad kyis gdung pas 'on gsol 'debs// kun gyi zad med gter chen bsgrub// // 415) ༄// lha bdud du mi 'bebs pa'i gdams pa tshig rkang nyer gnyis// na mo ratna gu ru/ rtse gcig nyams su blangs pa yis// nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i dus tshod du// bla ma dam pa dran pa 'am// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal tshogs// rang la byung ba'i dus tshod du// rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de// gzhan du lus pa ma yin te// snang ba rang sems yin pa'i phyir// rang gi lte ba'i 'og tu bsgom// de la gus 'dud ma yengs dang*// de yis de yi 'dug lugs smra// bu smras pa go na nyams rtogs can// dgra bo'i yul du dpa' bo yin// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// bar du gcod pa'i rkyen ngan dang*// sdug bsngal phung po grangs med la// bu gcig rnam dag 'gres su mdzod// 'di gzhan la smras pa ma yin te// ri khrod dgon pa rnal 'byor pa// bla ma gzhan du lus pa la// mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis// lha bdud du mi 'bebs gdams pa yin//

// 416) ༄// rlung lnga sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i ngo bor bstan pa'i tshul tshig rkang dgu pa// rlung ni lnga po 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas lnga yi ngo bo ru// gnas nas las kun byed pa'i ming*// srog 'dzin snying khar mi bskyod pa// thur sel rin 'byung 'doms na ste// gyen rgyu lkog mar 'od dpag med/ */me mnyam lte bar don grub ste/ */khyab byed tshigs rnams thams cad la// rnam par snang mdzad tshul du bzhugs// //

417) ༄// thag chod drug gi gdams pa zab mo// oṃ swasti/ tha lam pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dang ma bral na sgom ma sgom med par thag chod/ nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa dang ma bral na 'khor ba las mi 'da' bar thag chod/ stong pa dang snying rje'i ngang du ma song na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi thob par thag chod/ ci byed tshe 'dir bslangs na phung 'dre snying la zhugs par thag chod/ dug gsum gyi rtog pa byung na sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bur smin par thag chod/ bla ma la mos gus bskyed na skyon dag cing yon tan rdzogs par thag chod/ thag chod drug pa// // 418) ༄// ri khrod dben pa bsten par gdams pa tshig rkang nyer bzhi// tshul khrims phung por gnas bcas shing*// 'grus skyong dran pas rtse gcig tu// yengs pa med par bsgom pa yi// mi yi seng ge dben pa bsten// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan ni// rmi lam du yang mi 'dod pa// dben pa'i dgon pa nags khrod du// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gnas par byed// chags sdang mtha' la mi gnas shing*// rtag tu mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig gis// bsam gtan sgrib pa spong byed pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dben pa bsten// rul pa'i lus dang zas gos la// mi rtag don med shes nas kyang*// rtag par sems nyid sgom byed pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dben pa bsten// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs shing*// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// sems kyi de nyid bsgom pa yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dben pa bsten// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum 'di/// sangs rgyas sku gsum lhun grub tu// rtogs pas 'khrul pa spong ba yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod bsten// // 419) ༄// gsang sngags kyi gnad ma longs pa bstan pa tshig rkang bcu bzhi// bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de// grangs med bskal bas bsgrub snyam na// gsang sngags gnad kyis ma longs so// wa la za ma snying re na// bla ma rin chen gdan sa de// phag mo gru 'dir bya snyam na// gdug pa'i 'dre la ma longs so// wa la za ma snying re na// sdug chung bkra shis rin chen de// lung mdo gcig tu 'chi snyam na// mos gus gnad kyis ma longs so// wa la za ma snying re na// bkra shis rin chen dkon gnyer spro// de yang nam mkha'i me tog 'dra//

// 420) ༄// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bstod pa chos nyid 'khor lo// ri bo ta la'i gnas mchog dam pa na// sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po spyan ras gzigs// ji srid 'khor ba stong par ma gyur tshe// 'gro ba sgrol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gangs ri'i mdog can zla ba nya 'dra'i zhal// zhi ba'i spyan dang 'dzum pa'i mdangs mnga' zhing*// ral ba'i thor tshugs 'od dpag med kyis mdzes// skyon med brjid pa'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i sku la phyag bzhi rin chen brgyan// gnyis ni thal sbyar lhag ma pad phreng 'dzin// zhabs gnyis dkyil krung pad ma'i gdan bzhugs shing*// dri med 'od zer 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo// 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i rang lus ri bo la// dbang phyug rab ldan rang sems snying rje ni// ji srid bdag 'dzin zad par ma gyur tshe// mi zad thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba'i sku mdog byang sems rgyas pa'i zhal// bde ba'i spyan dang phan pa'i 'dzum mnga' zhing*// 'gro ba 'dren 'dod bla ma spyi gtsug mdzes// rnam dag ye shes zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// kun mkhyen tshad med bzhi ldan dgos 'dod rgyan// byams dang brtser 'brel dga' ba btang snyoms 'dzin// bden gnyis zung 'jug tshogs gnyis gdan bzhugs pa'i// phrin las lnga yi 'od ldan phyag 'tshal lo// gshis nyid 'gyur med chos sku'i ri bo la// ye shes pha rol phyin rdzogs bde chen nyid// ji srid kun gzhi zad par ma gyur tshe// 'khor 'das mi zad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas dag pa kun tu bzang po'i zhal// chos nyid spyan ras spros med 'dzum mnga' zhing*// yon tan rab rdzogs mnyam nyid thog mar mdzes// rang byung lhan skyes zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag med bzhi ldan mi zad 'khor los brgyan// dngos dang dngos med ro gcig 'dus ma byas// re dogs mtha' bral bden gnyis gdan la bzhugs// ye shes lnga yi 'od ldan phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsum dbyer med byang chub sems kyi sku// lus dang snang ba bskyed pa'i lhar bsgoms na// tha mal lus 'di bde gshegs skur grub pa'i// dri med rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba'i dngos po thams cad la// skye med tshangs pa'i rang sgra 'gro drug grags// de nyid thos sam 'dzin tam klog pa rnams// skyon med tshangs pa'i gsung grub phyag 'tshal lo// snang ba'i sems dang stong pa'i chos nyid la// skye 'gag gnas pa'i spros pa nyer zhi ba// sgrim glod med par gang rnams bsgom byed pa// mi rtag 'od gsal thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten gsum mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang gi// sku gsung thugs la phyi nang gsang gsum gyis// bstod pa 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba rnams// lus ngag yid gsum gnod pa dag gyur cig

/dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du// sdug dang mi sdug tha mal la brten pa'i// chags sdang gti mug rnam rtog zhi gyur nas// byams dang snying rjes rang sems rtogs par shog /rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi bstod pa chos nyid kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba rje rin po che 'bri gung pas g.yo ru dang dbye chung phug tu ri khrod mdzad pa'i tshe na dang po zhal gzigs pa'i dus su mdzad pa'o// // 421) ༄// chos 'dod na kha sang ngas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin gyi bca' khrims nyan dgos gsungs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum gyis 'gro ba thams cad rgyal bar gyur cig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ slob dpon tilli pa chen po'i gsang tshig dpal ldan nā ro pa chen po'i thugs kyi yang snying*/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gsang gtam/ rgyud sde rin po che bzhi'i thugs bcud/ sde snod rin po che gsum gyi lde mig gtsigs dang rgya mdud kyi bka' rgya can gyi chos 'di/ mod pa kho na min/ dkon pa zhig yin/ yun ring por ma byas pa yin pa la/ slob ma mos gus can gyis gsol ba drag tu btab pas bya snyam pa yin pa la/ khyed rnams kyis bya dbang mi ster bar 'dug kha sang bca' khrims ji ltar byas pa bzhin du mi nyan na/ khyed kyi chos mi byed pa yin/ khyed rnams bla ma'i bka' gcog/ ci dran dran byed pa la chos gal che rgyu med/ da chos 'dod na kha sang ngas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du bca' khrims 'di yin pas/ chang khung rtsad bcu chos ma ran pa mi 'dzud pa dang*/ bla dbye'i dkyil du gsar pa 'jog pa dang*/ rnying pa bla dbye'i gong 'og tu bzhugs pa dang*/ mkhan slob dang jo bo dang bzhugs par zhus pa min par khri khug pa de la mi sdod pa dang*/ skad ma btang gi bar du mi 'byon pa dang*/ gsar pa la skad byung ba'i dus su/

thang la byon nas ser srungs su byed na ga ler byon nas mal mal du bzhugs pa dang*/ phibs 'og tu mchod pa bshams pas bskos pa ma gtogs pa mi 'ong ba dang*/ 'di rnams kyi bkod pa legs par ma byung gi bar du chos byar ma btub pa yin/ ha bzhad gad dang gang snga la rgyug pa'i chos zab mo 'di 'dra ba de sngon gar byung*/ da gar 'byung*/ zan rdog re re la gang spang byed pa yin snyam mam/ dge 'dun gyis legs par bshams pa 'di kho na bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ chos skad ma byung gi bar du spyil bor bzhugs nas thugs dam la nan tan dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa la nan tan dang*/ mos gus la nan tan mdzad par zhu/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig/ // 422) ༄// bdag med rtogs pa'i chos rnams rgyun du med par dgongs pa dge bshes gung par springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gung pa la springs pa/ khyed kyi 'bul ba yon bdag zhang dpal la skur ba de dag phyag tu legs par thengs/ da rung yang 'bul ba rgya chen por bsgrub pa la phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'ong bar byin gyis rlabs dang*/ bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar thugs la gdags par zhu/ gsung ba de'i ngos nas/ byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// rang rgyud smin cing gzhan rgyud dang*// snang srid byin gyis brlabs gyur na// bkra shis bde legs thams cad 'byung*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// bdag med rtogs pa'i chos rnams la// rgyun chad med par dgongs lags na// phun sum tshogs pa'i gter dang 'phrad// 'bul ba rgya chen bsgrub pa la// kha sbyang mkhan dang snying sdug dang*// ser po tso rjes byi po la// glo gtad snying bzhag spang nas kyang*// khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa yi// yon bdag dra ma ngo che can// dad dang dran dang shes ldan la// blo gtad byas na 'grub par 'dug

/de las gzhan pa swā hā zhes// nam mkha'i padmo 'dzin par bas// legs par thugs la dgongs la mdzad// sman mchog rgyal po a ru ra// rdog ma gsum zhig 'bul zhing mchis// // 423) ༄// dad gus kyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa reb ston rgyal mtshan 'bum la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// rang gi chos las skyes pa'i bu// reb ston rgyal mtshan 'bum la springs// khyed kyi 'bul ba zhabs tog dang*// bsnyen bkur bgyis pa thams cad kun// skye sa mtho zhing rigs rgyud bzang*// dad dang gus pa'i rgyal mtshan thogs// dkon mchog gsum la mos gus che// bsod nams tshogs la nges pa skyes// tshong dpon yon chen zhang la dpal// bdag nyid che la bskur ba rnams// thams cad legs par phyag tu thengs// yi ge mi 'khyams pa yi rten// bdag gi dbu zhu gsol 'phro cig /khyed la 'bul gyis dbu la gsol// 'di lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// rgyan gyur dpal ldan rin chen gyis// dbu la gsol ba'i rgyal mtshan lags// 'phags pa klu sgrub a ti sha// bla ma gong ma'i dbu zhu lags// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// btsun por bzhugs pa'i btsun zhu lags// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis// mchod cing bkur ba'i rin chen lags// gang gi dbu la thogs pa la// gnyer kha go cha chen po mchis// thugs kyi dgongs nas bzhes par zhu// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med cing*// zung du 'jug pa'i rdor dril 'di// lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag mtshan mdzod// khyed kyi pha jo bla ma de// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pas// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad la// khyab cing 'gro 'ong ma mchis na// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// gang nas 'ongs nas gang du bsdad// thugs dam sa phyogs de nyid 'phel// da rung rdzas dang yo byad dang*// 'bul ba rgya chen sngar bzhin zhu//

// 424) ༄// yon bdag dbang rtse la ched bstod dang phyag gnang bcas bskur ba'i springs yig/ oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ yon bdag dbang rtse rgyal la springs pa/ khyed tshe snga ma bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas/ skye ba mi'i lus rin po che ni thob/ skyes bu dam pa gong ma rnams la dad pa dang gus 'dud rlabs po che byas pas/ rigs rgyud khyad par can du ni sku 'khrungs/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud byin gyis rlabs pas/ bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag tu ni gyur/ zhing rnam par dag pa dkon mchog gsum la 'bul ba rgya chen po byas pas/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa mi zad pa'i gter chen po dang ldan par bzhugs pa thams cad la sku drin che/ sgos bye brag gi dbang du byas na/ khyed yab sras gnyis/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ yon bdag gi rtsa ba dkon mchog rin po che gsum gyi bdag por gyur pas/ gong slad du yang 'bul ba rgya chen po bkur ba de dag kyang phyag tu legs par thengs/ da res kyi gnas skabs su yang*/ na bza' rin po che bkur ba ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin du phyag tu legs par thengs/ yi ge mi 'khyams pa'i rten byin rlabs legs par byas pa'i rung dar kha gsum bskur nas mchis// // 425) ༄// gnang bkag gi don bkrol ba shākya'i dge sbyong shes rab 'byung gnas la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// 'gro ba'i bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i zhal snga nas/ nga'i bcas pa rgyal po'i khrims dang 'dra'o// zhes gsungs pas/ rjes su 'brang ba'i bslab pa blangs pa ma gtogs pa/ sems can thams cad la bcas pa yang med/ bcas pa las 'gal ba'i nyes pa yang mi 'byung ngo zhe na/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can thams can kyi don du thugs bskyed cing*/

tshogs rnam pa gnyis bsags nas khams gsum gyi mgon por gyur pas/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni rgyal po'i khrims yin te/ de yang ston pa'i gsung dang du mi len pa log par lta ba can thams cad dang*/ rlabs po che'i nyes par song ba mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas pa la sogs pa ni/ skyabs su song ba'am bslab pa'i gzhi phran tshegs yang gnas par mi nus pas/ phrin las rnam pa bzhis tshar bcad pa dang*/ dus la bab na rjes su gzung ba ni rgyal po'i khrims kyi bya ba dang po/ bsags pa chung ba shan pa dang*/ mi gsod pa'i khrims thob pa/ nyi ma tha dad pa'i bsnyen gnas sam sna gcig bsrung ba ni rigs ngan gdol pa'i bcas pa khrims gnyis pa/ bya ba sna tshogs byed pa'i rgya mtshor ltung ba la/ sna 'ga'am/ yongs rdzogs sam/ tshangs spyod srung ba'i dge bsnyen ni rgyal po'i khrims gsum pa/ dge tshul la nyes byas so// zhes ming tha dad par btags kyang*/ pham pa byung na dge slong dang khyad par med par/ dge sbyong du mi rung zhes pas/ gzhan yang de dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ tshig na smad kyang don na smad pa med pa dbugs dbyung ba'i gsung*/ bsgrub par ma nus pa la gsung ba bcas pa bzhi pa/ bcas pa lnga pa dge slong yin te/ rgyal po'i bu'am/ blon po chen po'am/ dmag dpon la nyes pa 'di byas na khyod la nyes par 'di ltar 'gyur zhes tha dad par bcas pa thams cad ni/ rang bzhin gyis sgrub par nus pa'am nus pa la thabs mkhas pa 'ba' zhig gis gsungs pa las/ gzhan ma yin par shes par bya'o// yang bcas pa ni dge ba yin la/ rang bzhin ni mi dge ba yin pas/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin gcig na/ mun pas mun pa bsal bar mi nus pa bzhin du/ bcas pa dgag bya 'gegs byed ma yin par 'gyur ro zhe na/ rang bzhin gshis kyis mi dge ba de thams cad mkhyen pas mkhyen nas bca' ba ni/ thugs rje chen pos sems can rjes su bzung ba dang gcig

chos la slob dpon gyi dpe mkhyud med pa dang gnyis/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi brnyes pas 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba gsum gyis/ dgag bya nyon mongs pa dang de dag rjes su 'brel ba'i las spong ba bcas pa las/ ston pas nyes pa bsgrub pa'am/ mun pas mun pa sel ba'i dpe ni/ rang bzhin gyi thog tu bcas pa yod ces pa de'i don spyi ma go ba kho na'o// yang bcas pa dang rang bzhin tha dad par 'dod pa ni/ bcas pa'i gzhi lung ma bstan yin/ sa brko me reg chu la rtse ba gos dang zas dang snod spyad las gyur pa thams cad rang bzhin bsrung ba'i ched du gsungs te/ de yang mi na ba'i dus na/ dgag bya dang ldan pas dgag bcas/ na ba'i rkyen dang ldan na dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sgrub bcas/ dgag dgos gang yang mi dmigs pa'i dus na gnang bcas yin pas/ gnas skabs gsum du bcas pa gsum byung ba yin zhes pa yang*/ 'dir gzhi med cing 'thad pa ma yin te/ thams cad mkhyen pas nyon mongs pa gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i las ni gtan du gnang ba med cing bkag pa yin pa dang*/ gnang ba ni ltung ba gnang ba ma yin te/ gzhi dang bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug bzhi dang ma 'brel bas/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad du 'gro ba dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad las/ mya ngan las 'das pa sgrub pa dang mi sgrub pa bsod bzhag ste/ dgag bcas las log tsam gnang ba dang*/ sgrub bcas ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyis/ sgrub pa mya ngan las 'das pa sgrub par nges pa/ sgrub par bcas pas nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du bya ste/ smyug tshal bregs pas a mra'i tshal zhes pas go bar bya'o// yang lus ngag yid gsum gyi las/ gshis kyis dge ba dang ni mi dge ba dang lung du ma bstan pa gsum du gsungs pa las/ mi dge ba mtha' dag dgag bcas/ dge ba mtha' dag lung du ma bstan pa gnang bcas su 'dod pa kha cig yod de/ spyir sdom pas bsrung tshad dge ba rgyun chags su 'dod pas/

lung du ma bstan pa khas blang du med pa dang*/ byang chub sems kyi dbang byas pas lung ma bstan dge ba'i rtsa bar 'gyur pa dang*/ bden pa mthong bas bden pa 'ba' zhig tu nges te/ lung du ma bstan pa mi 'grub par/ 'gyur ba'i phyir mi dge ba ltung ba a cang yang che ste/ lung ma bstan du gyur pa yang ltung bar nges so// yang rang bzhin gar yod kyi thog tu bcas pa yod na/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa la ni dgag bya med de 'on kyang bcas pa yod do zhe na/ dgag bya bzhi po las dang lam ma sgrib pa dang*/ ngan song gsum du skye ba dang*/ bya ba dang byed pa mang ba dang*/ gzhan ma dad par 'gyur ba bzhi kha yod pas/ ston pas 'geg par 'gyur te/ gnas skabs kyi dgag bya las brgya rtsa gcig la dgra bcom pa thob nas ltuung ba byung ba gnang ba yin no zhes ston pas gnang ba med cing rten de nyid las ldang bar gsungs pa dang*/ mthar thug gi dgag bya sangs rgyas kyi phrin las dang*/ yon tan dang 'bras bu thob pa la sgrib ste/ lam gong du 'gro rgyu yod par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung pas/ lam la yang sgrib/ sa bon bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa ma spangs pas/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las dang 'brel pas 'bras bu ngan song du yang 'gro ba nges par/ bka' lung sman gyi gzhir ston pa'i phrin las bstan pa las gsungs/ gzhan ma dad par 'gyur ba yang yod do// dge slong sde snod gsum pa dgra bcom pa la/ klu gdug pa dang 'dra/ khyi zugs pa dang 'dra zhes smras pas/ nyes pa de nyid la 'chags pa byas kyang skye ba lnga brgyar klu gdug pa dang khyir skyes nas dgra bcom pa thob kyang*/ las kyi lhag mas 'di ltar gyur zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ ston pa'i sras 'phags pa bdag nyid chen po rnams rang gi don thob kyang*/ gzhan srung ba ni gong ma dang 'dra ste dgag bya shin tu lci ba dang*/ bya ba dang byed pa mang ba'i dgag bya yang rang gi ngor byas pas lam gong du 'gro rgyu yod na tshogs rnam pa gnyis rgyun chad med par gsog dgos la/

de yang don med pa'i bya bas mi 'grub cing klog pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ bya ba phrin las kyi 'khor los rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par byed dgos pa la/ gzhan gyi rjes su 'jug pa'i 'khor ram/ gang zag mang po bya ba dang byed pas g.yengs pas/ 'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin gyis don bsgrub par ma nus pa shākya las gyur pa lnga brgya lta bu dang*/ gnas brtan dgra bcom pa rgyal po lta bu 'khor rgya chen po smin par byed pa yang*/ rang gi lam du gzhan 'dzud dgos pa ma lags sam zhes go bar bya'o// de la spyir rgol ba 'di lta bu thams cad ni rgyu nyon mongs pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brang pa'i las kyis 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi 'byung ngo zhes pa dang*/ dgag pa'i bslab pa lung ma bstan nam don med pa yin no zhes ston pa la skur ba 'debs la yang bsgrub pa'i bslab pa 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad las yang dag pa'i lta bas dgag sgrub gnyis kyi bslab pa shes par bya ste/ de yang dgag bya las dang nyon mongs pa dgag pa/ dgag par bya ba'i thabs 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden par 'gro bar shes pa ni yang dag pa'i lta ba de'i rtog pa rtogs pa/ de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi bya ba dang byed pa spangs shing mthun pa'i rkyen sgrub pa ni yang dag pa'i rtsol ba/ 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa la gdams pa'i skabs ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ de la sogs pa 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad tshul khrims rin po che/ 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa byang chub rnam pa gsum thob par mi 'gyur zhes log par lta bas skur pa 'debs pa kho nar zad do// yang dam pa'i chos 'dul bar/ dgag bya las dang nyon mongs pa bkag na byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bsdus pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ de bsdus pa sdoms pa nyi shu pa la sogs par mi dge bar gnang ba'i skabs yod par gsungs pa de ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas te bsdus pa'i sdom pa/

snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes pa med// ces gsungs pas/ snying brtse ba'i phyir na go bar zad la/ sems dge zhes pa ni/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug rnam pa gsum dang bral bas/ ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med pa ni dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum po de la nyes pa med par thub pa'i gsung rab spyi dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mtha' dag la bsgrub pa'i sgrub par gsungs te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che phal cher ni/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po sa chen po la rab tu gnas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pas sems can smin pa dang grol bar byed pa 'ba' zhig tu 'dug pas/ de'i spyod par gsungs pa las des kyang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis med cing*/ gnyis med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rang nyid nyes pa'i skyon dang bral bar 'gyur zhing gzhan de dang gnyis su med par gyur pas rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pas/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par 'gyur te/ 'dir phyogs gcig la nyes par mtshon na/ 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung ba nas/ drang srong chen po mes rgyal po sde mi pham pa la/ ngas bdag nyid kyang ma mthong na chom rkun pa ga la mthong zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal po khros nas rkang lag bcad pa las/ rgyal po chen po khyod nyid kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad du/ rgyal po sde mi pham pa tshol cig ces btsal bas ma rnyed pas/ drang srong chen pos smras pa go bas/ drang srong nyes pa med pa'i rkang lag bcad pa la 'gyod pa skyes pa la/ yang rgyal po chen po nga'i rkang lag bcad pa yang de ltar shes par gyis shig ces gsungs pas/ rgyal pos mi skye chos la bzod pa thob/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan par gsungs pas/ nyes pa chen po thams cad las rang nyid ldang ba dang*/

spyod pa rgya chen po thams cad ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs la mkhas pa/ gti mug pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kho na gsungs par mthong ste/ bdag blo shin tu dman par gyur pas bdag ni byang chub sems dpa'o zhes/ byang chub sems dpar khas blangs pa tsam gyis/ nyes pa rlabs po che'am phung khams chen po la bkag pa med par spyod pa 'di dag rang nyid kyi blo la ma shong zhing*/ shin tu 'jigs pa/ rab tu 'jigs/ kun tu rab tu 'jigs par byung bas/ bdag la dga' ba zhig yod na/ sems bskyed pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing*/ ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med par lta spyod rnam pa gnyis las don dam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug gi rang bzhin du nyams su blang bar bya ba dang*/ dus tshod gcig la sems can ni mi mdzad/ phung khams rlabs po che chos yin na nyams su blang long yod pas/ dang por rang nyid rkang bu tshugs pa gal che bar bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa yin par tshor ro// yang dge ba dang mi dge ba gshis yin pas/ mi dge ba bar du gcod pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pas gnang ba med na/ gsang sngags su 'dod pa la spyod pas 'grub par gsungs pas/ rnam pa thams cad du bar chad du 'gyur ba ni ma yin no zhe na/ 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gsungs pa la/ gsang sngags kyi sangs rgyas de la yon tan de dag med pa yin nam yang na de bzhin gshegs pa gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi stobs dang*/ mi 'jigs pa rnam pa bzhi brnyes pas/ ngas bar du gcod par gsungs pa'i chos kyis bar du gcod par mi 'gyur ro zhes lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi rgol bar mi nus so zhes gsungs pa de rdzun pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pas ni gnyis su mi gsungs pas 'dul bar ni gzhi dang bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug gi yan lag rnam pa bzhi tshang ba dang ma tshang ba'i bye brag gis ltung ba che 'bring du bzhag ste/

gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa la ni yan lag rnam pa bzhi po de mi snang ba dang*/ gal te yan lag rnam pa bzhi las gang yang rung ba gcig snang na yang de ni gsang sngags su mi 'gyur te/ tshe 'di nyid du 'jigs par byed pa thams cad kyis gtses nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsad cing ngan song du khrid par gsungs pa dang*/ bdud ma traṃ ru ṭa dang*/ bram ze tsa nag kya la sogs pa mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal bar ltung bar dpag tu med pa gsungs pas mi dge ba gnang ba ni med do// 'o na 'dod pa la spyod pas 'grub par gsungs pa de ci yin snyam na/ de ni bcom ldan 'das gyi thabs de nyid la brten nas/ don rtogs par khong su chud par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi sgo tha dad par gsungs pas/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya bsten pa ni dug lnga rnam par dag pa/ srog bcod pa ni rnam par rtog pa 'od gsal gyi ngang du gsod pa/ chang 'thung ba ni kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gsol bar gsungs pa yin pas/ de lta bur gyur pa ni 'dul bar 'ang bkag pa med pas so// 'o na grub thob pa la 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnam pa sna tshogs la spyod/ de rnams kyis 'dod pa de lta bur spyad pa ma yin pa cis shes zhe na/ de ni 'bras bus rgyu dpog pas/ slob dpon rgyal pos 'dod chags ma spyad/ slob dpon lwa ba pas/ phyi dro'i kha zas ma zos/ sor phreng can gyis mi ma bsad pa'i bden pa'i byin rlabs byas pas grub par gsungs nas bden pa nyid kyis 'grub kyi/ rdzun pas ni ma yin pas/ ston pas babs mkhyen pa nyid yin zhing dam bcas pa brtan par khong du chud par bya'o// yang bdag med pa gnyis ma rtogs na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi thob ces gsungs pas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa dang ldan na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang mi thob na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub lta smros kyang ci dgos pa la/

mchod pa dang 'bul ba thams cad ched du bdag tu bzung nas 'bul ba de ci yin zhe na/ de shin tu yang mad de/ 'on kyang 'khor gsum du rtogs pa bdag dang bdag gi yul nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad smin pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad mchod pa ni yul/ de smin par bya ba'i thabs pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bcu/ bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhis sems can gyi don byed pa dang*/ tshogs gnyis kyi 'phags pa mchod par byed pa bdag dang*/ 'khor 'das dang mchod cing smin pa'i thabs rnam pa gsum gyis khams gsum gyi 'khor ba las mi 'da' zhing*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi zhi ba phyogs gcig tu mi ltung ba ni/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas/ bdag dang sems cad thams cad bde ba dang ldan pa dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba 'di ni mya ngan las 'dar mi ster ba/ 'khor ba 'ba' zhig sgrub pa/ gzugs sku gnyis rgyun chad med par 'byung ba'i rgyu/ mya ngan las 'da' bar mi gnas par bzhed par gda'/ 'khor bar mi gnas pa ni bdag dang 'khor 'das dang*/ mchod cing smin par khyad par gyi chos/ 'khor gsum gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par khong du chud cing dmigs pa med pa ni 'khor bar mi gnas pa ste/ de ltar yang bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas// 'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa nas/ mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa zhes pa dang*/ theg pa chen po mtha' dag thabs shes rab zung du 'jug pa 'dis ma bsdus pa med par thugs su chud par mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ de ltar spyir sems can thams cad bdag tu 'dzin pas 'khor bar 'khyams kyang*/ bdag tu bzung nas mchod pa phul ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa bsngo ba byas pas shing las me byung bas de nyid sreg par byed pas kyang 'gal ba med/

byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag nyid la bsten te tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir yang 'gal ba med/ rtogs pa thob nas kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas nga dang nga 'dra ba zhes pa'am/ ngas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs zhes btags pa tsam du gsungs pas kyang 'gal ba med/ yang gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid dang*// yon tan pha rol phyin pa 'bras// zhes pas bdag med pa de nyid dam pa'i bdag 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gshis de la bdag ces btags pas kyang 'gal ba med pas/ gang du bsngo ba dang*/ bsngo bar byed pa po dang*/ bsngo ba rnams de dang 'brel ba 'thad pa nyid lags so// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po'i bka' stsal don gyi gnad bkrol shākya'i dge sbyong shes rab 'byung gnas la gnang ba'o// rdzogs so// //

426) ༄// rje phag mo gru pa'i nye gnas 'gran gyis do med sgom gzhon la gnang ba// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rje brtse ba can// 'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje rin po che// rang sems lus su rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// lus sems gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun pa// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa// sku gsung thugs kyi bya dang byed pa yis// tshar gcod rjes gzung mdzad pa'i mkhyen rab can// 'gro ba'i bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// rje phag mo gru pa'i nye gnas mchog /'gran gyis do med sgom gzhon pa// chos rje rin chen mi bcom zhu// bcom na ngo tsha skyugs kyang ldog /mi gzhan gyis thos na ji skad smra// sang drung du 'gro ba'i dus tshod na// ngo so bzang po ji ltar gsol// skyes mchog bla ma rin chen gyi// lan gcig sras su gyur yang myong*// de nas bu de bu mor song*// bu mo bran gyi bran mor song*// deng sang bran mo bzang mor song*// gsol ba 'debs so gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba 'debs so rin po che// 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// 'gran gyi don med rje btsun pa// mi la chen por gsol ba 'debs// bla ma de yi byin rlabs kyis// zab pa'i gdams ngag ma lus pa// ngas shes pa'i nges shes gting nas yod// de ltar lags na byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul par gyur na bzod par gsol// dpon po yin pas nyams re dga'// khams nas byon pas 'o re brgyal// nye gnas yin pas snying du sdug /dgos pa dam pa'i chos 'di dgos// rgyal ba'i sras po shākya ye shes kyis// gong ma bstod pa'i dbyangs kyi rim pa 'di// rang byung phyag rgya chen po de nyid dang*// dbyer med gcig tu grub pa'i spyod pa yin// slob dpon chen po dpal ldan nā ro pas// 'dod chags 'od gsal bde chen zung du 'jug

/zhe sdang 'od gsal skye med zung du 'jug /gti mug 'od gsal rtog med zung du 'jug /byang chub sems las byung gyur cing*// tshad med snying rje chen pos dam pa'i chos// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun la bstan pa yi// bsod nams dri med mtshungs pa med pa des// phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i zhing du rnam par grags// dpag med gdul bya smin par mdzad pa la// rjes su yi rang byang chub chen por bsngo// rgyal bas gang 'dod dris nas mdzad// nyams myong gsang ba mi bshad gsung*// gnod pa bzod pas don rnams 'grub// ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed// rigs shes sems can dbang don shes// rigs gsum sdud pa'i thabs la mkhas// chos dang zang zing phan gnod drod// shes na 'gro ba smin par 'gyur// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// mthong dang thos dang dran pa dang*// reg par gyur pa tsam gyis kyang*// rnam par grol bar nges gyur na// ci phyir yi mug bskyed par byed// nyi ma nub nas shar na dga' ba la// gzho chu gyen la log na dga' ba la// 'tshal pas 'khrug pa thengs nas dga' ba la// gces sems dam chos go na dga' ba la// // 427) ༄// skyo bsangs su gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad thor bu phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// gnyen gyur dpal ldan rin po che// nyes pa'i skyon rnams dag mdzad cing*// 'phags pa'i nor rnams ma lus pas// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa yi// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi// rje rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// dam chos 'di yi gleng slangs ni// stod lung jag pa'i shar mo yin// snang ba sems su rtogs pa yi// ting nge 'dzin la bsam mi khyab// 'bri gung dpal gyi dgon pa 'dir// chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// chos dang tha mal bka' stsal la// bor rgyu med par go lags na// dam pa'i chos shig 'di na gda'// 'dzam gling nor gyis bkang gyur kyang*// bud med kyi a pha rabs chad yin// sa steng chos kyis gang gyur kyang*// dge 'dun med pa'i bdag po ci// gnad ka rgyu mtshan gang gis kyang*// pha la bu 'di dgos par gda'// bu go 'am shes sam ti se ba// 'di gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// yab sras lnga yi gsang gtam yin// gal po che la ngo dga' med// dgos pa'i tshig 'di snying la zhog

/nged kyis bla ma rin po che// khong 'jig rten mgon pos de skad gsung*// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang ma bral na// lnga brgyar bsgoms kyang a chu ta// bla ma'i grub mtha' ma shes par// nye gnas byas pa'i yus po che// rang rgyud smra ba'i mkhas pa de// gzung 'dzin sgrog tu ma chud dam// lta ba mthon po'i thal 'gyur te// blos byas stong par ma shor ram// ku sā li yi sgom chen la// de na med de de na yod// bu bse ru dpal la klad pa med// klad pa med de phog gsol yod// 'di de na med de 'di na yod// pha yi rin chen dkor mdzod de// gces se bu yis ma shes na// gces se med kyang btags pa tsam// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa 'di// las kyi rjes su 'jug pa las// bya thabs gzhan na med pa 'di// rgyal ba'i sras kyi dgongs lags sam// chen po rnams kyis dgongs lags sam// rna brgya ba yis dgongs lags sam// bu rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras gcig pu// dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyud 'dzin// thub pa chen po'i gsung bzhin du// sbyangs pa'i yon tan spyad pa yis// bsgrub pa mdzad pa'i dam pa khyed// sku khams ci bder bzhud par zhu// 'bral ba med pa thugs la zhog /jo bo chen po rje lha cig /bod kyi yul du bzhugs pa la// mnga' ris yul du lo gsum ste// dbus su lo bcu tham pa gsung*// mkhas pa chen po lo tsā ba// dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga nas// lnga bcu rtsa lnga'i bar du ni// dpag med tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bskyangs// ku tra spos su mi rung bas// dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga nas// bdun cu tham pa'i bar du 'o// thub pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// nor bzang zhes bya'i skyes mchog de// da lta dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs// nor gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rnam par grol bas smin mdzad gsol// brjod bya rjod byed brjod pa la// rmongs pa med pa'i dam pa khyed// don gyi snying po go lags na// tha snyad tshig gis ci zhig bya// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho la// na bza' rin chen drubs la stsol// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*// cis kyang thob par nges pa yin// khyi sngags rma sngags 'gug sngags gsum// sngags gsum gyi phu rtser bzhugs bzhugs nas// yon tan rnams sad la ma shor ram// mi chos skyong ngam lha dam skyong*// dge 'dun skyong ngam sdig pa skyong*// sangs rgyas skyong ngam bud smad skyong*// pha chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa po// rgya gar yul du byung ba yi// grub thob rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// snying khrag zhal du skyugs pa yi// gnad kyi rgyu mtshan zab mo rnams// dge 'dun tshogs su gsungs na yang*// sus kyang go ba ma rnyed pas// rabs chad rgad po zhal tshabs che// mang po'i dge 'dun yi re mug

/de go 'am rtogs sam sher 'byung dbon// sngon gyi rgyal ba bsnyen bkur bas// da lta mchog gi rigs su skyes// 'jig rten mgon gyi sras gyur pa// mos gus padmor rab phye ste// gnyis med ye shes bdud rtsi yis// thugs kyi dpal be'u rab bkang zhing*// mtha' yas 'gro ba smin mdzad pa// skyes bu chen po khyod la 'dud// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// dbang bskur mchog thob gdung 'dzin cing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i bdag /ji srid 'khor ba ma stong tshe// 'gro kun smin par mdzad la 'dud// rgas kyang dam chos mi byed pa// wa la za ma snying re na// gzhon yang de dang 'dra ste mchi// glang rgan 'dam du tshud pa bzhin// rang nyid brgal bar ma nus shing*// grol bar yang ni ma nus pas// gzhan phan mdzad pa a la la// chag legs par gzab pa'i gdong pa 'dra// rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs la// go ba med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// grub pa thob kyang 'o re brgyal// ci tsam nyams su blangs pas phung*// skyon med yon tan rdzogs 'dod na// 'bri gung dpal gyi dgon pa der// smra gcad skyu ra nga la gtug /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// rdzas dang zang zing yod yod pa// dka' ba mang po bsgrub pa kun// chud zos stong par ma btang ngam// ngur smrig rgyal mtshan rin thang che// na bza' phul dang bsod nams che// da rung phul dang dad can rnams// mi rgod rgyal ba'i snying yang 'khrul// gcig shos rung ba'i man ngag la// tshwa las dwangs snyigs 'byed par byed// sha tshas shin tu nye bar byed// 'dod chags rtog pas bdag re bslus// zhen pa'i shes pas bskyangs gyur cig /gser gyi bu chung bdar na yang*// sol ba nag po gcig tu nges// 'di nas dpag tshad lnga brgya'i pha rol na// 'dre yungs zhing khal bdun gyi grangs rnyed 'dug /thub pa chen po rgyal ba'i bka'// dbang phyug chen po'i dkyil 'khor na// gdug pa'i lha 'dre bsam mi khyab// bcom ldan rje btsun dkyil 'khor na// gdug pa'i lha 'dre bsam mi khyab// dur khrod chen po gnas brgyad na// gdug pa'i lha 'dre de dang 'dra// so gcig pa yi rigs dang yang*// de bzhin ne le'i rigs la sogs// bsam gyis mi khyab gnas pa de// lha 'am mi 'am sangs rgyas yin// 'di lha 'am mi 'am sangs rgyas yin// bdag tshad med snying rje chen po yis// gces pa'i nye gnas rnams la ni// snying dang 'dra bar gdams pa yin// gnod pa mthong dang thos pa dang*// 'ong zhing gsod par byed pa yang*// thabs kyi mthun par 'gyur ba'i phyir// khe mtshams bya zhing dga' ba sgrub// dgos pa'i dus su med pa de// mi rabs chad pa'i snga rtags yin// mi dgos dus su yod pa de// 'dul khrims 'jig pa'i snga rtags yin// khyod dang 'dra ba mang po yod// lar khyod dang 'dra ba mang po yod// khyad par dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams// byis pas gnam sa ma mthong bas// ltad mo gar lta ci cha yod// dam chos rin chen klog pa la// seng ge'i khri yang chung ba la// 'bol stan gcig la 'dzems ci dgos// sang kha chags sna ral sprang mo yis// co do

skra nas bzung 'drud tsam na// de yang bskur sti chen po yin// 'di gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te/ khyed 'bri gung pa la bzlas pa yin// rang byung phyag rgya chen po de// rtogs pa'i mi la skul ma 'debs// rnal 'byor nyin mtshan med par gnyid// don 'di yang rgya shug tshig gu tsam// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa nam mkha' mtha' med la// bu slob rnams kyis ri dbang rtse tsam mthong*// 'bri gung pas kyang khab kyi mig tsam ste// khab mig tsam yang ngo mtshar shin tu che// ji ltar me tog 'gyur ba ltar// 'dus byas thams cad de dang 'dra// ji ltar shing thog 'brul lhung ba ltar// mi rtag 'chi ba de dang 'dra// byis pa 'ja' tshon bda' ba bzhin// mdza' bshes 'grogs pa'ang de dang 'dra// mi lus rin chen thob dka' na// rab tu 'byung ba rnyed par dka'// khyed la 'chi ba mi 'ong ngam// cis kyang rab tu 'byung bar zhu// gsad pa rang gshed 'khor lo 'di// mngon par byang chub mchod pa la// bla ma dam pa'i drin gyis go// byang chub snying por bzhugs pa yi// ston pa shākya'i rgyal po yis// byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// srod la bdud kyi sde rnams bcom// chos 'di'i nyams myong rtogs pa cig /gzhan la ma lus rang la yod// 'di yi brtul zhugs spyod pa gcig /snying nas bsgrub par mi byed re// legs par dgongs dang rin po che// 'khrul na 'khrul tshabs mi che 'am// mi chen po 'khrul ba'i dus tshod du// rang phung gzhan phung gnyis ka mchi// chos dang po ti brtsigs pa 'di// gang du bzhugs kyang 'gro don mdzad// mchod gnas bla na med mod kyi// skyel 'dren gong ma'i rnam thar min// sa dang gzhi dang lha khang 'di// btsan po'i rdog rten yin na yang*// nang 'khrug rtsod pa 'phel ba'i rgyu// 'di yang gong ma'i rnam thar min// rta dang gnag dang lug khyu rnams// gdan sa'i zhabs tog yin na yang*// gzhi med nam mkha'i me tog 'di// bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar min// kha smras kha mchu'i gleng gzhi yang*// za tshol phongs pas byed mod kyi// sgyu gsum rang la 'du bas na// 'di yang gong ma'i rnam thar min// 'khrug pa 'thab mo rtsod pa yang*// snying rjes gzhan don mthong ba dang*// bstan pa'i ched du byed mod kyi// bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar min// ri khrod dgon pa'i spyil gseb tu// sgom ma ban mo'i chas bab pas// 'dod ldan dga' ba skye na yang*// 'di yang gong ma'i rnam thar min// legs par dgongs dang rin po che// 'khrul na 'khrul tshabs mi che 'am// 'khrul pas rang nyid tshad mar mthong*// smyon pa'i nang nas smyon par song*// dge 'dun g.yog mdzad nye gnas rnams// sbyin bsreg thal ba 'pho ba la// khrel shor byi pos 'phrang tshas bcad// dbus sa rtsub zer ba 'di re bden// ngan la chad pa mi gcod pa// 'di 'jigs po yin nam thugs rje yin// 'di na mi med nags tshangs su// thams cad kun gyis go bar zad// tha gang ne'u gyi snye ba gluu// thams cad de 'drar shes gyur na// ji ltar dga' ba skyes par 'gyur// snying rje chen po cis mi skye// rgad po tshul 'bum thugs rgyal ang*// lha na mo bcom ldan 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po yis// gsung dbyangs tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas pa'i// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus thams cad rnams// ston pa sangs rgyas de dang 'dra bar shog

/rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas skyo bsangs su gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa thor bu phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa rdzogs so// // 428) ༄// ran pa'i sa la bzhag pa gces zhes pa tshig rkang bcu drug/ nga yi nye gnas 'khor dang yon bdag rnams// 'phan yul gyi a ce khye'u ma skyid// de tshod tsam zhig yin pa 'dra// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// mi bzang po la po skyid med// 'khor dang 'bangs dang rigs ngan brin// ran pa'i sar ni bzhag pa gces// rkang rgyan mgo la btags pa bzhin// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa la// rigs rus lang tsho go chas brgyan// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu// de la khyod kyi rgyal srid gtod// mgon pos pha 'babs byin pa'i rdzas// ngan log gso ba'i bag chags can// de la re ba ma che spongs// // 429) ༄// bya ba gtang bar bskul ba blang bar mi bya khyad du mi bsad zhes pa// lar skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi bya ba btang*/ spros pa bcad/ ri khrod kyi dgon par sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byas pa'i dus su/ kye e ma ho/ ngo mtshar che/ rmad du byung*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ thub pa'i bka' bzhin du byed pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa/ ri khrod kyi dgon pa bsten pa/ 'di lta bu zhe nas thams cad dga' ba dang*/ dad pa dang*/ gus par gyur pas ci yod tshad thams cad 'bul/ dgos dgon pa 'bul/ de la ltogs sdug 'phongs pa ma khyags pas dgon pa blangs/ dgon pa gnas dang 'brel/ gnas gzhi kha smras dang bral/ kha smras rtsod pa byed pa'i khral dmag las dang gos rang la 'bab/ 'jigs su rung ba'i g.yang sar ma tshor bar rang dbang med par 'gro ba yin pas/ blang bar ni mi bya/ gus par ni mi bya/ khyad du mi bsad/ bstod pa byas la bzhag ces gsungs so// //

430) ༄// dge slong tshul khrims grags la springs pa dum bu gnyis// oṃ swasti/ na mo ratna gu ru/ bu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po yis// 'jig rten gyi bya ba rgyab tu bskyur// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la btugs/ bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su blangs// zab mo dam chos nyams len gyi// sdig dang sgrib pa'i bud shing tshogs// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes kyis// bcom dang shin tu bcom par byas// dga' bo skyid do rgyal ba'i sras// bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu byung ba yin// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal tshogs// brjod kyis lang bar ga la 'gyur// ji ltar bstan pa'i gdams ngag gi// gnad kyis nyams su blang bar bya// de las gzhan pa yod mi srid// ༈ //oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ mos gus kyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa/ mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par mdzad pa/ dge slong tshul khrims grags la springs pa/ khyed sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas/ skye ba mi'i lus rin po che thob nas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa la zhabs 'bring dang*/ zhabs tog mnyes pa thams cad kyis mnyes par mdzad pa dang*/ nga 'bu yang*/ bu'i dam par mdzad nas/ zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog rgya chen po yang du mdzad cing bsnyen bkur ba shin tu phyag yang bzang*/ thugs la btags/ slad kyis don zhu ba/ gong du yang yang gdams ngag cig skur gsung ba yin pa la/ bskur ba'i yi ge bas kyang*/ khyed rang gi thugs dam bsgom pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che la mos gus byas pas dge sbyor thugs rgyud la skye snyam pas yi ge ma bskur ba lags/ nga'i ngos nas kyang bskur ba'i yi ge yang dad pa dang gus pa'i grogs su tsam ma gtogs pa/ khyed rang gi snga ma'i thugs dam bla mas legs par bstan pa/ rin po che'i gsung*/ byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// mgon po rin chen bsgom pa dang*// rang byung lhan skyes phyag rgya che// rgyun chad med pa'i sems nyid de// rgyun chad med par goms pa dang*// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// chos lnga 'di dag ma gtogs pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// ma rnyed rnyed par mi 'gyur zhing*// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyang*// 'di las gzhan pa med pa'i phyir// rgyun chad med par goms par bya// bu gcig khyed la gdams pa'i don// tshe 'di mi rtag glo bur ba// myur du 'jig cing 'chi ba dang*// 'dus byas dngos po gang la yang*// blo gtad med par dgongs nas kyang*// chos lnga 'di la nan tan bya// dge slong tshul khrims grags la gdams pa// rdzogs so//

// 431) ༄// chos sku phyag chen rang nyid lags zhes khang gsar mkhan chen la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i mda' bdag mkhan po chen po khang sar pa'i spyan sngar springs pa/ khyed tshe snga ma phan chad la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas mi'i lus rin po che thob/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams bkur bas rigs rgyud khyad par can du sku 'khrungs/ sngon sbyangs ye shes kyi tshogs sad pas/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la rab tu byung nas/ yul dbus bstan pa'i bdag po/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la shar ba lta bu'am/ rin po che gter sbas pa lta bu bla ma yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi spyan sngar/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i spros pa thams cad ni bcad/ bdag nyid chen po de rnams mnyes pa rnam pa gsum rab kyi mthar phyin pas ni mnyes par mdzad/ khyad par du nga 'bu la yang mnyes pa rnam pa gsum mtha' dag thams cad kyis/ mnyes pa'i rab gong na med pa thams cad kyis mnyes par mdzad cing*/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa/ spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba thugs su chud pas/ tshe gcig gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzhed pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa lags te/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis// skye 'dir sangs rgyas mchog nyid du// sems bsgom pas ni sangs rgya 'o// rin chen sems las phyir gyur ba'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas/ sa dang lam dang sangs rgyas thams cad ro gcig pa/ gnyug ma'i yid ni yid la dris/ zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ don dam pa'i bden pa/ sems nyid kyi gshis mthar thug phyag rgya chen po de nyid thugs su chud pa las/

gzhan bya rgyu ci yang ma mchis/ 'on kyang chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po rang nyid lags mod kyang*/ chos kyi sku yi phrin las kyis// rang gzhan smin par mdzad pa'i tshul// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad par zhu// rang gzhan gnyis su med pa'i phyir// gzhan don mdzad pa thams cad kun// rang don yin par thub pas gsungs// dper na ston pa bcom ldan gyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa la// rang nyid byang chub sangs rgyas nas// 'gro kun bde la 'god pa de// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// bu gcig dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa'i tshul// sngar bzhin thugs la gdags par zhu// // 432) ༄// gnyis med ting 'dzin la rgyun chad med par skyong ba tshig rkang nyi shu pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin chen gyis// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis 'dud// mgon po de yi thugs kyi sras// skyes bu chen po khyed la zhu// skye rga na 'chi chu bo bzhi// sdug bsngal gting mtha' med pa de// rang las skyes pa'i rnam rtog yin// thar pa mya ngan 'das pa de// lhun gyis grub pa'i mi rtog pa// rang la yod pa 'di nyid yin// rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i rgya mtsho de// lhun gyis grub pa'i mi rtog dang*// gnyis su med par rtogs pa de// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs yin// gnyis su med pa'i ting 'dzin la// rgyun chad med par bskyang bar zhu// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang*// ji bzhin tshul khrims rin chen dang*// rang gzhan 'khor 'das thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// // 433) ༄// byams snying rje'i sgom khrid dang mdo sngags nyams len gyi skor// 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rje/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs btud nas/ chos kyi rgyal po rin chen gyi/

gsung sgros cung zad yi ger 'bri/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ byams pa ni rnam pa gsum ste/ sems can la dmigs pa dang chos la dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i byams pa dang gsum du gsungs/ de nas dang po sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa ni/ pha'am ma'am rang la phan btags pa de las skye yi/ gzhan la mi skye bas dang po kho nar/ rang la drin che ba gcig gi drin dran par byas pa la brten nas de la gdung ba'i bsam pa skyes pa de la byams pa zhes ngos 'dzin pa yin pas/ de ngos bzung nas yang nas yang du gdung ba'i bsam pa ci skye bya/ de la nan tan shin tu che bar zhag bdun tsam du bsgoms pas gdung sems de tshad du 'khyol nas 'ong*/ de nas rang gi rtsa ba'i a ma'i drin dran par byas nas/ a ma la de kho na bzhin du zhag bco lnga bsgom/ de la gdung ba'i shugs chen po skyes pa dang*/ snying rje 'phar mdog yod pas 'gro ba gcig gam gnyis nas mang po bar du ched du gzhug la bsgom/ de yang 'dzam bu gling pa tsam la zhag bco lnga bsgom/ de nas stong gsum tsam dang*/ de nas rim gyis phyogs bcu khor yug tu sems can thams cad la bsgom/ de nas sems can ma lus pa la de ltar bsgom pas mthar thug cing*/ byams pa tshad med par gyur pa'i dus su yang rtsa ba'i ma nas/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dran pa'i sgo nas snying rje bsgom ste/ de tshegs mi che bar skye bar 'ong*/ de nam skyes pa dang*/ bdag gi ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du sems bskyed/ de la byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems zhes zer/ byang chub kyi sems des kun nas blangs nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ sngags kyi lugs kyis bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom zhing rjes la bsngo ba 'dir/

theg pa chen po ma 'dus pa med pa lags so// khrid kyi rim pa 'di ni shin tu zab pas yi ger ma bris pa lags te/ gsung bzhin du bgyis pa lags pas nan tan chen por nyams su blang bar zhu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon nas/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig/ // 434) ༄// sa thob pa'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis kyi lung khungs dang bcas pa// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ngo ngo mtshar ci yang mthong*// mi yi gnas su lha rdzas dkon yang ngas 'dir mthong*// dpal chen bla ma de yis bdag la gnang ba yi// dngos po 'di la khyed cag thams cad ltad mo ltos// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la rab gsal bas// ngar snabs 'tsher ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ji bzhin du// bdag kyang de 'dra 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i drin// rjes su dran par gyur pas 'dir ni rnam par g.yo// chos 'di byed lo tsam yang ngo mtshar 'di dran na// snying nas byas na snying nas ngo mtshar ci 'dra ang*// chos rje bla ma mchog des bdag cag rgyal gyur cig /'phags pa'i sa thob pa'i yon tan 'byung tshul ni/ rim gyis pa/ cig car ba/ 'ga' zhig yod 'ga' zhig med pa/ re re 'byung la gzhan mi 'byung ba/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi snang ba/ yod kyang gzhan gyis mi mthong ba/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis kyi lung khungs dang rnam pa drug las/ de la dang po rim gyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshul khrims las ting nge 'dzin/ ting nge 'dzin las shes rab skye bar gsungs la/ de yang rgyal po chen po ma skyes dgras tha dad pa rab tu byung ba las mthong ba'i chos la myong bar 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu ji lta bu thob pa zhus pa las tshul khrims kyi phung po sbyangs pa las ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po zhi gnas 'byung la de la rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas/

zag pa zad pa/ zad pa shes pa dang mi skye ba shes pa/ shes pas shes rab dgra bcom pa gsungs pa lta bu'o// cig car ba ni mdo nas/ sa dang po thob nas rab tu byung ste bsgoms na gzod yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung ba dang*/ yum rgyas pa nas/ sa thob nas sa sbyang ba ston pa/ spang bya spangs nas da gzod yon tan skye ba 'thad pa dang*/ grangs med gsum gyi khas len yod na/ gsum gyi bcu cha re re sbyangs pas brgya phrag bcu gnyis po thob par rigs pa'o// 'ga' zhig yod la 'ga' zhig med pa ni/ sangs rgyas bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pas thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan ma lus pa thob pa yin la/ sa bcu man chad gtsor tshogs mi 'dra ba gtso bor sbyangs pa re re las/ re re'i yon tan 'byung la/ gzhan mi 'byung ba ni/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu chen po dang*/ nor bzang gi bla ma brgya rtsa bcu lta bu'o// rnal 'byor pa rang gi snang ba ni/ mngon par rtogs pa skyes nas/ nyon mongs pa gsum bsal gzhag med pa/ chos kyi sku 'ba' zhig tu mthong zhing*/ sku gsum du bum pa la ngo sprad pa lta bu'o// yod kyang gzhan gyis mi mthong ba ni/ ārya na gardzu na sa thob pa'i yon tan dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma pham pa slob dpon 'phags pas bstan pa dang*/ 'dus pa chen por bdud kyi bu mo lnga brgyas sems bskyed pa dang bzod pa chen po thob pa las sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi me tog gi gdugs rgyal ba rnams kyi dbu la snang ba mthong ba lta bu'o// // 435) ༄// 'bad rtsol drag po ma yin par lhun grub chen po'i ngang du sdod pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pas/ 'jig rten gyi bsam pa/ log pa'i rtog pa/ nga'am bdag ces nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i shes pa/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad/

tshe 'di'i rnam par rtog pa mtha' dag spangs nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis 'phangs pa'i bsam pas/ bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis nyams su blang bar bya ste/ nyams su len lugs de yang bskyed rdzogs gnyis rang gi 'dug lugs su rtogs par byas nas bsgom par bya ste/ med pa btsal btsal po/ bsgoms pas 'ong 'ong po/ bsgrubs pas 'grub 'grub po cig re nas 'bad pa dang rtsol ba drag pos/ rtsa rlung thig les 'bad pa ci tsam zhig byas kyang rtsa a ba dhu tī yang sha'i ltar ltar po/ rlung bum pa sha sha shu shu yang 'gro 'ong rtsab rtsub can/ thig le dwangs snyigs kyang chu khams mer mer po/ dhu tir chud na rgyu ma la g.yos pa 'dra kha g.yos rkyang pa las cang srid dam ste/ byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// ji ltar bsgoms kyang rgyal ba'i gsung dang 'gal// byar med lhun gyis grub pa don dam chos sku yin// de dang ma bral rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi// mi bya mi bya rtsol ba'i las mi bya// byas na ci tsam byas pa 'dus byas yin// lhun grub chen po'i ngang la sdod cig gu// bsngo ba la 'bad// // 436) ༄// bstan pa'i gnas tshad gsungs kyang nges don du mya ngan mi 'da' chos kyang mi nub zhes pa// thub pa chen po chos kyi rje// bskal pa bzang por gsungs pa ni// lnga stong lnga brgya phrag bcur gsungs// slob dpon 'bum ṭig mkhan po yis// lnga brgya tha ma dus kyi tshe// bstan pa gnas par ma gyur kyang*// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi// 'dul ba'i snying po gsar pa thob// nyams len byed pa mang bar gsungs// zla ba'i snying por nyis stong gsungs// 'dul ba phran tshegs nyid du stong*// sprin chen nas ni lnga brgya gsung*// chos nyid rang gi ngo bo las// ma g.yos tha dad snang ba'i mdor// bdun stong brgyad brgyar gnas par gsungs// thub pa chen po nyid kyi sras// sang ga par pa ta zhes pas// bstan pa nub par 'gyur ba'i tshul// zla ba'i snying po'i rjes 'brangs nas// rgyal po chen po dpung dmar can// dgra bcom pa dang mang du thos// rnam pa gnyis la brten nas kyang*// thub pa'i bstan pa nub par gsung*// dgra bcom chen po dge ba'i bshes// bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyis// ston pa mya ngan 'das nas kyang*// ston pa bdag nyid chen po yis// gnas brtan chen po bcu drug nyid// sum cu rtsa gsum man chad dang*// gling bzhi 'jig rten khams nyid dang*// khyad par 'dzam bu gling nyid du// skyes chen de dag bzhugs nas kyang*// mar la 'grib pa zad pa dang*// yar la 'phel bar gyur pa yi// lo grangs drug brgya'i bar du yang*// bstan pa rin chen gnas 'gyur zhing*// de nas thub pa'i gsung rab rnams// thams cad bsdus par gyur pa kun// mchod rten chen po byas gyur nas// thams cad mya ngan 'da' zhes gsungs// de rjes 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams// lo ni nyis khri bar dag tu// 'byung bar 'gyur bas 'gro ba yi// tshogs gnyis rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang*// de nas rje btsun byams pa byon// byams mgon byon pa'i bstan pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// gang gis bya ba byas pa rnams// 'dus pa gsum du 'gyur zhes gsungs// thub pa chen po rgyal ba'i bka'// nges pa'i don ston gsung rab tu// sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// dam pa'i chos kyang mi nub ste// dge 'dun rgyun chad med par gsungs// de yang mya ngan 'das pa nas// 'di ltar sbrang bu mchu snyung mchus// rgya mtsho'i gting du thug ces dang*// rlung dmar zhags pas bcing du rung*// kha yis dbugs kyis ri rab sgyel// zer bar gyur pa de sla yi// ston pa mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// rtag par gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos// nub par gyur ba ga la srid// dam pa'i chos kyang mi nub na// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgyun chad cing*// thub pa chen po rgyal ba yis// ji ltar gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'i gzhi// dgongs pa dgongs gzhi dgongs pa'i gsung*// ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam chos kyi// don dang mi 'gal ma shes na// glen pa mgo bo 'khor nas mchi// ban rgan 'chol pa kha sla ba// de la dad pa'i nye gnas kyis// yi ger bris par gyur pa la// 'thad dang 'gal ba byung ba yang*// sgro skur bral ba'i blo gros kyis// btang snyoms chen por bzhag la btang*// dam pa'i chos la rgyus chung zhing*// dad pas gang zag rjes 'brang ba// kye ma nga yi dam chos zhes// 'dzin par byed pa'i ban rgan bzhin// khyed kyi bla ma dam pa de// thub pa'i gsung las gzhan pa yi// dam pa'i chos gcig yod na ko// de la su zhig dad cing gus// ston pa'i gsung las mi gzhan pa'i// zab pa bla med dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog gsum po rtag gyur na// de la ngo mtshar che rgyu ci// ji ltar byis pa'i rmi lam la// pha ma dga' ba skye na yang*// rmis pa'i 'khrul pa rdzun du bas//

437) ༄// jo sras la snying khong nas byung ba'i gdams pa bstan pa// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// pha bdag las skyes pa'i jo sras la// snying khong nas byung ba'i gdams ngag bstan// sdig nyon mongs rnam rtog nyes tshogs kun// chos sems nyid stong par rtogs pa des// skyon 'khor ba'i nyes tshogs bcom par nges// a dzi/ rgyal po chen po ma skyes dgras// mtshams med lnga sogs nyes tshogs kun// stong par rtogs pa'i skad cig la// skyon rnams dag cing yon tan rdzogs// sgyu lus phung po 'di nyid la// mi gtsang rdzas gyur sum cu gnyis// rtag tu yod pa ma shes sam// gang ni bzang la gang ni ngan// khyad par khyed kyi gcig shos te// spang bya gnyen po gnyis med par// khyed kyi nyams su blang bar zhu// a ti sa ma pa ṭa'o// // 438) ༄// phag gru'i gdan sar bzhugs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gdan sa na bzhugs pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po la gdams pa/ spyir gnyid mi 'ong ba'i rgyu ngal dub med pa dang*/ nyin par gnyid pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa mangs pa dang*/ rdo rjes 'og gi rnal 'byor la ma gnas pa dang*/ rnam pa bzhis 'byung ba yin gyi/ grib kyis kyang cung zad 'byung ste/ nyes pa'i dri ma de gang yin ngo shes par byas nas/ de las bzlog pa'i gnyen po mang du thos pa gdams ngag gzhan la rag ma lus phan yon che ba/ dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las rnyed pa mtha' dag thugs su chud par bya ba dang*/ rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// nyes tshogs ltas ngan sna tshogs pa// bzlog par byed pa'i gdams ngag ni// skyon yon tan du 'gyur ba/ bar chad dngos grub tu 'gyur ba/ bdud chos skyong du 'gyur ba/ skyon dag cing yon tan rdzogs pa'i gnad/ bcu chos dang sum chos ma gtogs pa la bdag po med pa ni khyed rang gi khums/

dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas pa la yang med dam snyam pa'i bsam pa yod pa lags pas 'bad pa chen pos nan tan che bar mdzad par zhu/ phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mtha' dag thams cad kyang*/ snang ba rang gi sems las gzhan med pa'i phyir gong ma gcig pus skyon 'dag pa dang*/ yon tan rdzogs pa dang phun sum tshogs pa khong du chud par bya'o// 'gro bas byang chub mchog thob shog/ // 439) ༄// dam chos dpal gyi chos drug 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi tshul bstan pa// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla med jo bo dkon mchog la// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// skyabs su mchi 'o byin gyis rlobs// mgon po bcom ldan rin po ches// chos dang dus dang tshod dang yang*// bdag nyid 'khor dang gang zag rigs// shes pas nyams par mi 'gyur zhes// legs par gsungs pa 'di yi don// dam chos dpal gyi chos drug thabs// rab 'byams stong nyid rgya mtsho yin// de don nyams myong rtog pa yin// rgas 'khogs nus pa zad pa'i dus// dus dang bdag nyid shes pa yin// 'khor dang tshod dang gang zag gsum// deng sang phan chad bsgrub nus shing*// phun sum tshogs pa ma glas gnas spos pa te// thar pa'i sa bon gzhag pa'i phyir// thams cad rab tu byung ba dang*// 'bad pa byas par gyur pa la// dga' zhing rjes su yi rang ngo*// 'das pa'i dus tshod bstan pa yin// da ltar dus tshod bstan pa la// dam chos nyams su len pa ni// dad ldan g.yo sgyu kha bsag med// na so gzhon zhing brtson 'grus che// nyams su len pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// ri bo 'bugs shing rgya mtsho skems// de yang dad ldan gtong phod che// sham thabs khral la ltos pa med// bco lnga bcu drug yan chad nas// bzhi bcu lo grangs man chad la// dam chos ston pa'i dus tshod yin// yab kyis ngo sras khrid pa dang*// a pos sras po khrid pa dang*// rgas pa la sogs nyes tshogs kyis// grwa pa skyong ba'i dus tshod min// 'khor dang gang zag tshod rigs pa// gdams pa bla ma gong ma'i bka'// da lta'i dus su bstan pa 'o// ma 'ongs dus tshod bstan pa ni// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs dug rgyas pas// a po shi ba'i rjes shul du// gdan sa bya byed shom ra yis// sde 'khrugs nyes tshogs bsam mi khyab// thub pa'i bstan pa zad du nye// lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir// ston pa'i sku gdung rgyas pa dang*// mchod cing bkur sti mi byed pa// gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa kun// bden nam rdzun pa'i tshul lugs kyi// gong ma'i gdan sa rnams la ltos// dang po 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi// lto gos nar dang kha bsags kyis// mgo skor brid pa'i sdug bsngal rnams// til phung bzhin du bsdus nas kyang*// mnar med rdo rje dmyal ba dang*// ngan song gsum du lhung ba 'di// de sngon mgo bo 'khor na yang*// a dzi snying yang ma rje 'am// rang rang gnas su ci dgar sgur// bag kyang 'dug na cis ma legs// rjes kyi bya ba bstan pa 'o//

// 440) ༄// rang gi rig pa 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed po tshangs pa yin zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa dkor rje drang dkar zhes bya ba de/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed pa po tshangs pa/ gdul bar shin tu dka' bar 'dod pa yin/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed pa po de/ bcom pa dang*/ brlag pa dang*/ tshar gcad par ci tsam du 'bad kyang*/ rang nyid la de ltar byas par 'gyur ba yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang rang gi rig pa 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed pa po tshangs pa yin/ de skye ba med cing rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag par rtogs pa'i dus su/ tshangs pa chos kyi sku phan pa dang bde ba thams cad kyi byed pa po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yin pas de spong dgos/ de spang ba la thabs mkhas pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa ku sā li'i tshogs gsog gis bdag 'dzin spong ba/ rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad spangs nas sangs rgyas su byed pa 'di/ lan gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig byas pa'i 'og tu lus bdud rtsir zhu bas/ rang gzhan snod bcud nyes pa'i dri ma sbyangs nas/ sangs rgyas su gyur pas kyang blo bde/ rang yi dam gyi lha gcig tu bsgrubs pas sangs rgyas su gyur pas kyang blo bde/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa smra bsam brjod 'das lhun gyis grub cing 'gyur ba med pas kyang blo bde/ phyir lus pa ni khab tsam yang med/ ma nyan pa ni spu tsam yang mi 'dug rgyun chad med par ri bo'i khrod du rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid dang ma 'bral ba 'di las/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la yang gzhan mi mnga' na/ nged rjes su 'jug pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ 'di kho na nyams su blang*/ ang ang ang*/ de yang dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// 'jig rten gsum mgon rin chen gyis// gnyug ma byams chen ting 'dzin gyis// srod la bdud kyi dkyil 'khor btul// zhes pas mngon no// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig/
