// 441) ༄// srung 'khor zhal gdams gtum po sum brtsegs// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol snyam du dam bca'/ bsam pa de yi ngang las jo bo thugs rje chen po bsgom/ de'i thugs kar khro bo mi g.yo ba bsgom/ de'i thugs kar yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ gza' mi rnams bsrung bar 'dod na/ gza' mi gang bsrung ba rnams bsgom la bzlas pa ci nus tshad du bya/ skabs skabs su/ bdag dang 'khor dang 'das thams cad kyis/ dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces yang dang yang du bsngo ba 'bad la bya// // 442) ༄// gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nor bu bzang po'i gtor chog kha zas phud gtor byed thabs pha ma gnyis kyi gdams ngag ma ṇi bha dra// pha ma gnyis kyi gdams ngag ni/ dang por sems bskyed nas/ yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ kha zas ci za ba'i phud la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la cung zad phul ba'i rjes la gtor ma'i rgyu dum zhig phud la sder ma'i grwar bzhag nas za 'thung nam tshar ba'i dus su/ gtor gzhong zhig gi nang du zan dum de bcug nas/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po byang chub sems dpa' nor bu bzang po la/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dgos 'dod kyi dngos po mtha' dag tu bsams nas/ sngags 'dis dbul bar bya ste// oṃ ma ṇi bha dra hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun brjod/ se gol bdun gtogs nas de'i rjes la mdo gdon/ gtor ma gtsang sar dbul/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/

dkon mchog la mchod pa/ long sprang la yon/ skyes bu dam pa la bla'i mchod gnas su byed pa ni dam tshig go// // 443) ༄// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bdag 'dzin spong ba gcig pur 'da' ba// skyabs bla na med pa'i bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che/ lhag pa tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab dang gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur cing*/ de bdag dang*/ bdag gi 'khor dang*/ rdzas dang*/ yo byad dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ grags snyan du 'dzin pa thams cad/ tshul khrims kyis tshar bcad cing spangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyis mi 'ong ba'i sgo gtan pa dam por bcug nas/ shes rab kyis gzung 'dzin rnam par dag pa/ rten med pa nam mkha' dang 'dra bar gyur pa/ ston pa'i bstan pa yin pa la/ ming bzang po ni de gsum rgyan du thogs nas/ ming bzang po'i bdag 'dzin dang*/ khe dang grags pa dang*/ rnyed bkur mang po dang*/ bzang po yin no bsgrub par 'dug ste/ ston pa'i gsung bstan pa de dang*/ khyod kyang mthun par 'dug gam/ ston pa'i bstan pa rin po che// bdag dang bdag gi gzung 'dzin gnyis// spangs shing spong bar gsungs pa dang*// spangs shing rnam par spangs pa yis// bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rnams// spangs shing spangs par gyur pa yis// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' ma de// spangs par mdzad pa'i ston pa dang*// spang thabs bslab pa rnam gsum dang*// nyams len 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las// med cing rnam par dag pa dang*// lta dang sgom dang spyod pa dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba// nam mkha' lta bur rab gnas pa// don dam ngo bo nyid kyi sku// mnyam pa nyid la gnas pa dang*// rtag tu 'di dang mi 'bral shog /'di 'dra 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dang*// dus rnams kun tu 'grogs pa dang*// thub pa'i dgongs pa gnyis med pa// mkha' ltar dag pa rdzogs par shog

/sdig pa'i grogs po ming bzang po// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa dang*// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa dang*// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bdag dang 'dra ba med do zhes// ji ltar byas pa thams cad kyis// ming bzang 'khor dang bcas pa yi// bdag 'dzin mnga' thang rgyas pa'i thabs// res 'ga' ri bo'i rtse la bsgom// ri bo'i rtse la gnas pa'i tshe// shal ma ri yi rtse mor gnas// res 'ga' chu bo'i 'gram du bsgom// thal tshan chu bo rab med ang*// res 'ga' nags kyi nang na zhugs// ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal 'jigs// res 'ga' thang la spyod lam gzob// lhar bcas 'jig rten rkun po 'dis// thar pa'i nor rnams 'phrog 'phrog 'dra// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// rang la snying brtse yod pa'i mis// chom rkun 'di la blo ma gtod// chom rkun 'jigs su rung pa la// blo gtod snying bzhag ma mdzad cig /stong nyid nyi zla 'phrogs nas kyang*// bdag 'dzin gzung 'dzin mun khrod du// dmyal ba ngan song mtha' med du// bdud kyi rgyal pos skyur skyur 'dra// byang chub sems kyi yon tan brjod// khong gzhan don mdzad pa yin no mchi// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rtog pa thams cad spang pa'i sems// 'gro 'ong spros pa bcad pa dang*// da rung phrad mjal ma thub pas// khyod kyi 'khor dang gnyen 'dun dang*// khyod la dad cing gus pa dang*// btud par gyur pa'i slob ma kun// khyod ci 'dra ba de yis shes// rgyal po'i bsam pa 'bangs kyis ston// mang po'i bshad bshud ci zhig 'tshal// 'khor gyis spyod pa gsal bar bstan// rje yi mdzad pa 'bangs kyis byed// de sngon phan chad dad rdzas kyis// dpag med 'khor dang gnyen 'dun rnams// khrod nas skyes chen gang du bzhud// skyob mdzad skyob pa chen po yi// bstan pa nub khar byung ba yi// dpon chen bzhi dang khyad ci gda'// legs par bsams nas dpon chen bzhis// ston pa'i zhal mthong gsung yang thos// rgyal po'i gsung rab rgya chen du// tshogs kyi lam par gsungs pa lags// kye ma rje btsun ming bzang po'i// bu smad da lta ga na yod// thub pa'i bstan pa 'jig pa yi// bcom ldan 'das kyis nyes ci byas// mkhan slob bla ma gong ma la// 'di tsam gnod pa skyel ba yi// de tsam khyod la ci zhig bya// kye ma kye hud ming bzang po'i// 'khor gyi tshogs dang lhan gcig tu// bzhud par gyur pa re ma dga'// byang chub sems dpa' 'di 'dra na// 'jig rten chom rkun ci 'dra ang*// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// bdag ni bdag la bdag cag gis// rnyed mang bkur sti mang po byas// bdag la mang po dga' bo zhes// de 'dra'i snyems pa 'chang gyur na// shi ba'i 'og tu 'jigs pa skye// skyob mdzad mgon po'i gsung re mad// skyabs su mchi 'o bla ma rnams// skyob mdzad mgon pos bskyab tu gsol// bskal pa dpag med sngon rol na// dus rnams rtag tu skyob mdzad cing*// skyob par mdzad pa'i mgon po mchog

/bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// skyob mdzad yi dam lha la skyabs// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// skyob bar byed pa'i dam chos la// skyabs su mchi 'o bskyab tu gsol// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong na// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// phyi yi rdzas dang yo byad dang*// slob ma nye du 'khor 'bangs kun// spangs pas 'bral bar mi 'gyur te// lta ngan bdag dang bdag gi dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa spang pa la// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten mgon po gong ma dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// da ni rjes su mi slob re// bdag 'dzin bzung dang 'dzin pa rnams// spong bar byed pa'i gnyen po rnams// spang bya gnyen pos gang spong ba// 'bad pa'i brtul zhugs ci spyad kyang*// mu stegs byed kyi brtul zhugs kyis// dka' thub drag po ci spyad kyang*// dka' thub nas ze gang za ba// ma bkab gos gyis 'tsho byed pa// ston pa rdzogs byed 'khor bcas lags// bdag dang bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di// rang gi sems su mi gda' 'am// rang gi sems su gda' lags na// rang sems rtogs pa ma gtogs pa// thabs gzhan gda' 'am dgongs par zhu// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med pa// bdag 'dzin spong pa ma lags sam// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyang*// bla med byang chub rin po che// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rnam rtog spangs pa rang gi sems// rnam dag nam mkha' lta bu de// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med mgon pos bstan pa de// lhag pa tshul khrims rin po che// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul mchog /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems pa'i me// nyon mongs dug chen 'joms pa'i sman// sems rta kha blan dka' ba la// mthun pa'i gzer chen brgyab pa'i srab// rang sems thar pa'i grong khyer du// 'gro bar byed pa'i cang shes la// legs par bsrab cing kha lo bsgyur// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// tshad med snying rje chen po las// nges par byung ba'i byang chub sems// nye bar zhi ba'i grong khyer du// phyin par gyur pa'i dus kyi tshe// 'dir yang gnod byed chom rkun mang*// bsam gtan sgo 'phar dam po yis// ma yengs dran pa'i stobs kyis bcad// lhag pa ting 'dzin bslab pa yin// ting 'dzin 'di la gang gnas pa// rnam grol ye shes phung po nyid// chu bo rgyun phyogs 'bab pa 'am// nyi mas mun pa gsal ba ltar// rtsol sgrub med par ngang gis 'char// 'ching ba'i thag pa gcod par zhu// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen 'di// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen la// rgyal ba'i yon tan dpag med pa// 'byung bar thugs kyis dgongs par zhu// bdag 'dzin spong ba gcig pur 'da'o//

444) ༄// the tshom gcod pa'i zhus len snying po spyan snga sher 'byung gis bsgrigs pa// 'khor 'das bdag po bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /mnyam med bla ma mchog dang rnal 'byor ma// spros med mkha' ltar gzigs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin chen la// rtse gcig sgrub pas mnyes byed ri khrod pas// the tshom gcod phyir khrid du zhus pa'i chos// brtse bas tshogs la gsungs pa bri bar bya// spyir thabs dang shes rab sgom pa de tshig dang don mtshon pa yin/ de chos yin rgyu med/ mos gus kyis bla ma de'i tshig des mtshon pa'i don nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa skye/ de don yin pas skyong ba yin/ dus rtag tu lnga ldan la ldab rkyang byed pa yin/ dang po kho nar nang par gyi dus su lam du gtang*/ sems bskyed yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ 'di dang po'i sngon 'gro yin/ de nas byams pa'am/ snying rje'am/ yi dam gyi lha'am/ bla ma'am gang yin pa nyin mtshan kha sbyar la 'bad/ bsngo ba de yid la dran pa tsam yin no// rnam rtog dang dge sbyor dbye ba med pa chos kyi skur rtogs pa las/ gong du 'gro rgyu'i bogs med/ bu chung rkang bu tshugs pa yin/ de gzod dben par bsgom dgos/ yon tan dpag tu med pa skye/ phyag rgya chen po gsha' ma yod pa la/ phyag rgya chen por mi 'gro ba 'ga' zhig byung na/ mi 'gro ba de rgyun bsrings pas phyag rgya chen por 'gro ba de la bsgom zer/ snga ma lta ba zer ro// nyon mongs dang rnam rtog phyag rgya chen por go yang*/ rang rgyud du 'chor bar 'dug dran pas zin na de nyid phyag rgya chen por 'ong bar 'dug pa de nas bcu chos dang gsum chos lags mod/ bcu chos dang gsum chos kyi rtog pa/ rags pa dang*/ 'bring ba dang*/ phra ba lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum mo// ngas lo gnyis bsgom shes pa de gang yin na/

mi rtag pa dang*/ byams snying rje shes pas so// thabs lam la sogs pa gong mas kyang de rang du 'gro bas/ chu la chu bzhag rab/ 'bring thabs lam/ tha ma 'khrul 'khor ro// phyogs gcig tu sdod yun ring na/ dge sbyor gyi shugs chad pas rnam par rtog pa 'ba' zhig tu 'ong*/ de la maṇḍal dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur dang gtum mo dang*/ thabs lam tshos bogs 'don/ glang bu rgyab chad la sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang dge rtsar bsngo/ gsos par bya/ rgyu 'bras la nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ sgyu ma dang dngos por 'dzin pa gsum mo// shes pa rtse gcig tu dmigs drag na/ nad du 'gro ste/ rtsol drag pa'i skyon/ sgom ma shes pa'i skyon/ yul la ma blta sems la ma blta shig dang*/ gang la'ang mi brtson de ni byang chub sems dpas brtson/ ri khrod kyi dgon par rtsol sgrub mi byed par lhug pa gal che'o/ bla ma sna tshogs su 'gyur ba de rang gi bsam pa sna tshogs su 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma yin/ nyin par dge sbyor la rtsol sgrub mi dgos/ mtshan mo gnyid khug tu mi 'ong bas rmi lam 'od gsal 'dzin pa gal che gsung*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyan thos srod dang tho rangs la mi nyal bar sbyor ba la brtson pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di yin/ gzhan gyi grib de mngon par shes pa dang 'dra bar 'ong*/ gsang sngags rnying ma tshe ring ba sman mchod kyis yin/ ci tsam du dge sbyor 'phel ba de tsam du mi mthun pa'i phyogs skyon de bas che ba 'ong*/ kwa kha gcig dge sbyor 'dre rtags yin/ nad 'dre yin/ drag sngags kyis 'dre gcun pa la drag sngags su byed de/ spang bya dang gnyen po phyin ci log tu song bas gtan mi phan te/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig go// rtsa ba'i byams pa dang chags pa gcig mod kyi/ a ma la bsgom pas chags pa dang bral bar byed/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ma 'dres pas tshangs pa'i gnas su skye/ rgya chen po la byams pas de'i bdag por 'gyur/

byas pa la mi rtag pa 'khor ba'i chos yin/ ma hā mu dra dang bo dhi swa twas dbang byas pas rtags dang 'gyur ba med pa'o// grang ba'i dus su gtum mo bsgom/ de dang 'dra bar mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad la'o// spyir skyon la bros pas mi phan/ gtum mo'i rlung sems gnyis las/ rlung sems nyams su blang ba'i thabs spyan sngar bstan pa de yin/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor nyams su len pa'i dus su/ rje btsun chen po'i 'khrul 'khor gnad drug bcing ba'i man ngag byas la nyin mtshan kha sbyar la bsgom/ 'gro ba dang*/ 'chags pa'i dus su dmigs pa 'ba' zhig la ma yengs par bya/ skabs skabs su snga ma de ltar nyams su blangs/ phyag rgya chen por rang shugs kyis gnad du 'gro/ gtum mo'i bogs 'don zhag bcu bdun la de kho na bsgom/ sgyu lus kyi bogs 'don la nyin mtshan kha sbyar nas nyams su blangs pas ting nge 'dzin rab mchog bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' byon pa'i dus su/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mi thob pa rang dbang med/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khrul 'khor gsum gyi man ngag gis nyams su blang*/ slob ma gcig pu byung yang des chog /sham thabs khral len khri tsho bas// nyams su len pa gcig gcig dga'// rnying pa kha cig ri khrod du// bla ma dam pa mnyes pa'i phyir// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don bsgrub pa// rnal 'byor seng ge 'dir mchod do// rnying pa kha cig nor gsog cing*// lha dang yi ge kha smras tshol// phung ba'i 'dre 'di dgos med pas// so so rang rang gnas su dengs// shan shun ma phyed gsar pa 'ga'// bskyang bar bya phyir gong ma yi// rnam par thar pa'i rjes 'jug pa'i// brtas par gyur pa'i thabs 'di brtsam// rgas pa shi dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bla ma byang chub kyi sems yin pas so// ri la 'gro ba khe grags re sa med pas dur khrod dang 'dra ste mi sgom kha med/

khrid byas pa tshig gi phreng bas mi phan nyams myong dgos/ sgrub pa ma byas pa'i ri khrod bla ma dpal dang ra bye lo tsā ba dang 'dra ba yin no// dge sbyor mang po thams cad rmi lam lam gyi tshod 'dzin yin/ gtum mo lam gyi dngos gzhi yin gsung*/ des na gzhan la rtsol sgrub med do// thams cad ma grub pa gzhi de la rtog pa chu las chu bur 'byung*/ gnad du gang 'gro nyams su len pa las nu ma gdams ngag mang po ra dang gzhug ma dang 'dra'o// yid gdung bas ma tshugs pa'i dus su bstim/ nyon mongs dang rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya/ rigs 'dzin no ba glang skyong ba ltar ste/ thabs dang shes rab kyi bogs 'don pa gal che/ thams cad kyi sngon du bsod nams kyi tshogs 'gro bas don 'grub/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa ste/ sangs rgyas thob pa 'dzin pa yin/ gnyid drag po/ 'dod pa spyod pa drag po/ rdeg pa la zhugs pa drag po gsum dharma drag po la grub thob zer ro// phan btags par drin du mi gzo ba mtshams med kyi las yin/ skyon byung ba la rdzu zer ba de ma zhus par ma zer ba bsam gtan pa dga' bo lta bu'o// ri la dge sbyor 'phel bas sa g.yo ba yi ge drug pa'i dpe dang 'dra'o// ri drin che ba ri bo dang drang srong dang 'dra/ rtsa rlung lnga la rtog pa lnga la ro gcig gces so// cho 'phrul bag la nyal rkyen gyis slongs pas gos dang nor la sems zhugs na thams cad la 'dra'o// bdag med rtogs shing byams snying rje skyes nas don bya/ nad dang bdud lhar bsgom pa dran pa ma yengs par brtson 'grus bskyed/ lnga ldan gyis nyams su blang rgyu'i rtog pa 'dzin pa chen po la zer ro// lus dngos po'i gnas lugs ci la zer na/ da ltar 'dzin pa'i shes pas lus der nyon mongs dang rtog pa thams cad do// byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems skyes pa'i dus gnad 'brel ba can du bsgom/

za rgyu ma rnyed na tshogs bsag yan lag bdun pa mang po bya/ gzhan mi srung bar rang bsgom/ bsrung na dang por rang bsrung ba gal che'o// dge sbyor gnad du ma song na 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor bas gcun/ nan tan chen por bsgrub na rtsa'i mdud pa dral/ gnad du ma phog pa'i sems 'dzin/ dus la ma bab pa'i brtul zhugs goms pa med pa'i ri khrod/ pho tshod med pa'i bya byed byas pa'i rjes la ngan nas mchi'o// rtsa zug rlung zug mdze/ rnam par rtog pa dang mi rtog pa'i khrid do// sgom ma shes na zhe 'dod/ sgom shes na zhe 'dod med pa'o// yul la chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis bar do'i lus gsum/ bla ma bya ba rang gi sems kyi de nyid la zer ba yin/ slob ma gces par byas pas tshar la sdang bar byung ba na/ de la chags pa dang*/ gsol ba gsum ma btab pa'i skyon yin/ phra men lha ma yin phyin kha log/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba la zer ba yin/ rmi lam du dge ba dang mi dge ba byas pa dang*/ ma gnyid pa'i dus su byas pa phan gnod mi bcu 'gyur ram/ brgya 'gyur gyis che ste/ mthong chos mngon sum du 'byung ngo*// sum chos bsgoms pas rmi lam du bde ba rgyas nas sad na de rang gis bya/ rmi lam res zin res mi zin pa'i rgyu bzhi dang*/ de las gnad du song ba de las ldog pa'o// rlung log 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ tung tung dang tsab tsub tu song bas lan no// bla dwags mi dwags pa dang ban dhe chos med yon bdag pas tshar bcad pa'i gtam rgyud dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba byas pas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mi thub/ phyag rgya chen po bla ma yin/ de dang ma bral bas bla ma dang ma bral/ ri khrod du bsgoms pas zhal bzhugs na sku'i rim gror 'gro/ rang shi yang bla ma dang gcig tu 'dres nas 'gro bas drung du 'ong bas gtso che ba ma yin nyon mongs pa spyod pa'i grogs dang rten rnyed nas bla ma mi dran pa skyon yin/

bde ba dang skyid pa'i dus su mkhar lan dang rtsed 'dzings dang ri ltad la sogs pa ye mi bya/ bde skyid des bde skyid dge sbyor 'ba' zhig tu bsgrub/ sdug pa'i dus su dge sbyor byed dgos te 'ong ba dka'/ byung na bogs che/ des na ston pas bde bas bde ba bsgrub par gsungs pa yin/ skyon dang nyes pa gang byung yang byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ bla ma dang phyag rgya chen po gang bsgom pa/ skyon de sos de nyid du shes par bya/ sna 'gebs pa dang lto za ba phyi'i srung ba/ gsang ba'i srung ba khu ba ma nyams pa/ bdud rtsi lnga lus la gnas pa/ nang gi bsrung ba dpa' mo'i go cha'o// bogs ni blo ldog rnam bzhi ci skye yin/ bhe ra ba dang 'dre gnyis sems gcig la gnyis su byas pas 'khrul lo// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i chos/ thub pa chen po'i gsung rab rgyal po'i dkor mdzod lta bu/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis sdud ma shes pas ni 'thor du bcug brgyud pa gong ma'i gdams ngag gsang sngags thams cad kyi yang snying*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi srog rtsa ni kha zags su btang*/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa'i chos dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa lta bu ni/ mi chos kyi 'dam rdzab du rul du bcug bla ma sangs rgyas kyi gsung tshu rol mthong bas/ dpag par dka' ba/ dbang gi rgyal po lta bu ni/ ste'u dang zer dang*/ lo la sogs pas khyi khung du phyung ba'i slob ma slob ma yin snyam pa'am/ ngo re tsha skyug re bro/ gnod pa thos dang mthong ba dang*// 'ong zhing gsod par byed na yang*// thabs kyis mthun par 'gyur ba'i phyir// kha mtshams bya zhing dga' ba sgrub// phyogs ris med pa'i 'gro don gyis// phyogs ris zhe 'dod spros pa chad// zhe 'dod med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rig pa ngar ldan rang mthong skye// srog chags phra mo ban ban 'di// rgyu gang las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin// ston pa snang mdzad chen po de// rgyu gang las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin// kwa a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// yul dman dang phra ba'i nyes skyon spongs// zab dang rgya che'i chos la 'bad// dam chos 'di yi gleng langs ni// yog pa mthong ba'i chags sdang yin// lho bal gyi 'bul ba bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gro bar gcig kyang*/

sbed pa dang*/ 'phyar ba dang*/ tshogs su 'bul ba dang*/ de la sna khrid 'tshol ba zab/ byin rlabs kyi rkyen gcig gis gzhan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs nas sangs rgya/ byin rlabs kyi rkyen zhig gis bstan pa'i dgrar gyur na rdo rje dmyal ba 'gro ste/ mar khrid kyi ded dpon du gyur pa'i skyon no// lus ngag yid gsum dum khrigs kyi bsngo ba/ bla ma dam pas yon tan skyed/ yi dam lhas bar chad sel/ bla ma gong ma la bkur sti bya ba'i thabs so// blos btang ba dang*/ blos bzung nas grol ba'o// rnam par shes pa gar yod pa'i sar 'du/ lus ngag yid gsum gnas dang longs spyod du bcas pa'o// gtam la nyan na 'bri/ chu bo gaṅga dang rten 'brel lo// snyigs ma'i zhing 'dzin pa'i dang po sems bskyed pa bde ba bdag gir mi bya/ bstan pa'i gdams ngag bdag gir bya/ bstan pa'i gdams ngag bdag gir ma byas par/ bde ba bdag gir byas na/ bcu chos dang sum chos ma go/ ma go bas nyams len ma shes/ des khu ba nyams/ 'dod pa'i don ma grub pa yin/ sgrib pa lnga mngon du rgyu glo bur du spong*/ rtse gcig bsgom btab pas 'ong ba min/ spros bral byin rlabs kyis go/ ma bcos pa bzhag thabs yin/ rtogs pa'i gnad kas tha mal du mi 'ong*/ dge sbyor gsha' ma zhig bya snyam pa'i dus der/ bar du gcod pa 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan rang nyid gcig pus gtso bor rang nyid kyi don du dge sbyor byas pa'i skyon yin/ de la byang chub kyi snying po'i rdo rje'i gdan sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin rlabs pa'i dpe/ don dam byang chub kyi sems su bstan/ bar chad dang po byung ba yul shor/ rting du byung ba nyes skyon slongs pas de nyid bsgom/ byams snying rje dang mos gus dang gsol ba gdab/ maṇḍal dbul/ rab gnas rten 'brel rgyu rkyen 'dzom/ tshogs pa bsgrub pa tshogs pa'i skad cig la las sbyor bya/ mu dra skyong pa la shes pa bkug pas skyo/

btang ba 'byams pas re dga'/ mtha' bral byang chub kyi sems kyis ma bslang na nad mi sol/ sol yang ldog lar spang gnyen gnyis su song na dug gsum yin/ des na byang sems bla ma yi dam sku bzhi gang du bsgoms kyang sos/ spyod lam cha mnyam thabs shes rab bogs 'don/ nad dang rlung log gi rgyu byas pa yin/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas/ tshogs skyong ba dka' ste/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la mi blta ba 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga la ma chags pa/ lus dang srog la mi blta ba/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyud 'dzin pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la gces spras su byed pa/ sems can gyi khams smin pa dang grol ba'i go cha bgos pa/ brtson 'grus kyi shugs me ltar 'bar ba/ bzod pa'i go cha rdo rje lta bu bgos pa/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyal mtshan bzung ba/ rgyu sems can la 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i nges shes brtan pa'o// a ma a la la dge 'dun gyi tshogs skyong zhing bskyangs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par 'dod na/ rdzas dang yo byad kha rje dang dbang thang*/ bsod nams dang bsags pa la mi brten cing mi gnas na chos 'ba' zhig gis 'tsho zhing de rnams la mi gnas pas/ 'khor dag cing bzang po sha stag tu 'gyur la/ chos ma gtogs pa gzhan la re ba med pas/ chos 'ba' zhig so nam du byas pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba ngo mtshar che ste/ bla ma slob ma la mi mgu/ slob ma bla ma la mi mgu ba ni 'di dag thob par 'dod pas/ de ma byung ba'i dus su 'khon pa kho nar snang ngo zhes de dag mi 'dzin pa'i dam bca' can dag de skad zer ro// chos bya snyam pa'i dus su bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten gyi gang zag 'ga' zhig gis/ dge 'dun ci 'khrugs/ dge sbyor ci tshogs yon bdag pa la kha ze ci tshod blta bar 'dug pas/ nga la slob dpon re na rgyun 'di tsam gcig mi mdzad par zhu/

sprang long yang 'khyar/ tshe ma phyid nam ma langs/ mi chos dang lha dam gang yang med pa/ nga 'dra ba'i grwa ba/ so nams su nor mi gsog gtan srid du chos gsog pa dang gcig spyi'i nye gnas bla ma'i gsung bzhin dgos pa mtha' dag bsgrub pa dang gnyis/ drung gi nye gnas rang gi zhe 'dod kyi rjes mi 'brang zhing*/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin du byed pa gsum po 'di dang mi ldan na/ nga gsum ga mi 'chang*/ khyed kyang drung du ma gnas/ gdug pa'i me sbar bas thar pa'i sa bon 'tshig nyon mongs kyi sprin gtibs pas dkar po'i lo tog bcom/ 'dod chags kyi dug khol bas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi 'joms/ a la la re 'jigs/ a la la re 'jigs/ a la la re 'jigs/ 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de// skyabs 'gro thun mong nas bzung nas// gsang 'dus phyag rgya chen po'i bar// thub pa'i bka' rnams ma lus pa// sdom pa gsum gyis bsdams pa rnams// gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa yi// sdom pa bla ma rin chen gsung*// de la gnas par gyur pa ni// phyag rgya bzhi po bstan pa yang*// gsang sngags dam tshig nyid du nges// bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi nyams len 'dir// gtso bo dpal ldan nā ro pas// lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs su// gsungs pa nyams len rim pa dang*// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa rnams// slob dpon chen po tilli pas// dpal ldan nā ro pa la gdams// de yi nyams len zab mo 'di// brgyud pa rin chen bcud phyung nas// slob ma rnams la gdams pa yin// 'gro ba'i bla ma nyid kyi phyag bsam la// snying po snying po'i gsung tshig 'ba' zhig dag /dus tshod gcig tu btab pa 'di dag kun// ban dhe shes rab 'byung gnas bdag gis bris// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig/

445) ༄// mnga' bdag rgyal po jo sing la 'bangs rnams byams pas skyong bar gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ se ba byang chub gling gong nas// chos kyi rgyal po chen po yis// bla ma dam par bkur gyur pa// shākya'i dge slong ldom bu bas// mi rje lha yi dpon dang sras// byang chub sems dpa'i gdung rgyud mchog /mgo nag yongs kyi spyi rje ste// rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa mchog /chos kyi rgyal po jo sing la// gdams shing zhu don gsol ba'i mdo// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon gyur pa// dpal ldan stag lung thang pa dang*// kho bo sprang po ldom bu gnyis// khyed kyis bla ma dam par bzung*// rgyal po'i khrims kyi bya ba dang*// 'bangs kyi so tshis mdzad pa yang*// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs tog tu// chos kyi rgyal po'i lugs su mdzad// da yang sngar bzhin thugs la thogs// rgya gar rgya nag bgrod byed cing*// zam pa bzhi la rten bcas nas// rab byung khrims kyis 'tsho ba yi// 'gron po phan tshun rgyu ba rnams// rgyal po rnams kyis skyong ba las// gnod pa bskyal ba ma mchis pas// gong ma rnams kyi tshul bzung zhu// rdo rje gdan dang dpal gyi ri// u rgyan la sogs rgya gar na// sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs byed// thams cad kun gyi rnal 'byor pa// mthu dang nus pas dgos pa yi// 'di tsho yon bdag rtsa ba yin// bal yul gtsang dang dbus kyi dang*// rten dang dge bshes rnal 'byor pa// thams cad kun gyi ma ma yin// nga dang stag lung thang pa sogs// 'di la shin tu byams pa zhes// rgyal khams thams cad phung ba'i 'dre// sprang po nor shor sum brgya la// gya la ba zhes grags pa 'dis// mtho dman thams cad phung tshod 'dis// de bas mang na de bas phung*// mgo nag mtho dman thams cad kyi// spyi rje gung khab mi yi dbang*// 'phrul gyi rgyal po chen po yis// gya la ba dang 'gron po rnams// nyid kyi sras dang khyad med par// byams pas bskyang bar mdzod cig dang*// thams cad sras dang 'dra bar mchi// zhe 'dod phra mo'i rjes 'brangs nas// byi la 'bar ba nag po ltar// dal gyis skam pa'i mchus bzung nas// tho bas drag tu brdung snyam nas// zab tu re bas gsang na yang*// dar gyi nang du bre gtums pa// thams cad kun gyis shes so zhes// 'jig rten mgon po bla mas gsung*// des na chos kyi rgyal po yis// dgra gnyen thams cad mnyam par mdzod// bzang ngan thams cad rang du 'ong*// phyogs med sprang po ldom bu yis// sa chen 'di yi bdag po la// zhu don gsol bar mi rigs kyang*// sngon gyi rgyal po mkhas pa rnams// byis pa bud med sprang po yi// bden tshig gtsug gis len pa la// srog snying nyid du gyur pa dang*// skyid sdug gcig tu gyur pa yi// bla ma'i gdams ngag gang yin pa// mi dbang khyed kyis bkur bar rigs// sras dang gdung rgyud kun la yang*// thugs kyi gter du gtad par zhu'o//

// 446) ༄// tshad ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub dgos par rje btsun gyi spyan sngar zhu ba// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ yon bdag gi rtsa ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bla ma mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyi spyan sngar zhu ba/ spyir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang bla ma dam pas lung bstan pa las yon tan thob pa ni 'gro ldog nges pa yin pas/ khyed kyi bsam pa de ni shin tu bzang*/ spobs pa de ni shin tu dge ba lags so// de yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas// ye shes cung zad dbang ba dang*// snang ba sems su shes pa dang*// gzhan phan rtag tu bsgom pa yi// bla ma tshad ldan gar bzhugs sar// bsgrubs na tshe 'dir dngos grub thob// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsung*// gsung bas sgrub pa byed pa'i gnas// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi drung du// ci byas thams cad tshogs gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'grub par the tshom med/ bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs na/ de las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub rgyu med pa lags pas khyed bla ma dam pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen de'i drung du bzhugs pa rang gis dge sbyor lhun gyis 'grub/ tshogs gnyis zung du rdzogs/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par 'grub pa the tshom dang som nyi med pa lags pa de thugs su chud par mdzad nas de kho na bzhin du mdzad par zhu 'tshal// // 447) ༄// gsal la mi g.yo ma yengs bzhag ces pa gces pa'i snying po rin chen mdzod// oṃ swasti/ zhal snga nas kyi man ngag bden pa'i byin rlabs rnam pa lnga dang ldan par byas nas/ yi dam lha gcig pu/ mar me rlung gis mi bskyod pa ltar// gsal la mi g.yo ma yengs bzhag /bying dang rmugs dang gnyid byung na// 'phags pa bye ba nyi shu pa'i// rnam par thar pa'i rjes su bslab// rgod dang rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs shing*// rang gi rang nyid ma chun na// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bhu su kus// nyes pa'i skyon rnams tshar gcad bya// lus sems cha mnyam gnas gyur na// ston pa byang chub shing drung du// bzhugs nas byang chub brnyes pa yi// 'khrul 'khor de ltar goms par bya// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rjes// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag gsungs// mi rtag rtag par 'dod pa yis// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dbang song bas// ngas 'di byas zhes 'dag sbyar dang*// chur 'jug med 'jug g.yang sa yi// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i mu stegs pa// ston pa'i thabs dang bral ba rnams// shes rab ting 'dzin ji ltar skye// thabs dang shes rab ga la rnyed// mkhas pa rnam gsum shes byas nas// ting 'dzin dbye ba sna tshogs kyis// gnas skabs mthar thug yon tan bskyed// skyon rnams sel bar thugs la zhog

/gces pa'i snying po rin chen mdzod// bstan chos 'di'i ming yin no// // 448) ༄// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag thugs la zhog ces shes rab rgyal mtshan la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi padmor rab btud nas// 'gro ba'i mgon po rje btsun pa// mnyam med mi yi seṅge mchog /thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// don gyi snying po bdud rtsi'i bcud// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// don gyi snying po rgya mtsho yis// thugs kyi dpal be'u rab bkang nas// 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rje// dpal ldan drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa bla med pa// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa mchog /lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// sems nyid chos sku bde chen gyis// snang srid dbang du bsgyur mdzad cing*// gdul bya skal ldan padma'i tshogs// byin rlabs nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// kha 'byed mdzad pa'i rje btsun la// bla ma dam pas zhus lags na// thub pa chen po chos kyi rje// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po yis// gdul bya smin par mdzad pa'i tshul// zab dang zhi dang spros dang bral// 'od gsal 'dus byas ma yin pas// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad dang*// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa rnams// 'di las gzhan med gong mas gsungs// tshig dang yi ge bsam mi khyab// thag rul sna yi 'breng rul dang*// yin lo byas lo byed lo yi// tshig tshogs sprin phung 'khrigs na yang*// mi rtag glo gtad snying gzhag med// chos kyi rgyal po'i zhing khams su// sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu yi// skyes bu dam pa khyed bzhugs pas// sangs rgyas nyid kyi dam pa'i chos// sems nyid 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med// rang byung phyag rgya chen po yis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad par zhu// snying po so nam 'di lags pas// 'gro ba smin par mdzad par zhu// mi rtag tshe la glo gtad med// snying rje'i dbang gyur ma rgan rnams// khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa la// skyob par byed pa'i skyabs gnas mchog

/bu las gzhan med thugs kyi dgongs// nor bzang bla ma bsten pa ltar// khyed kyi mos gus zhabs tog kun// rgyun chad med par mdzad pa rnams// bla ma rnams kyi phyag tu thengs// dbul zhing 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal bsal// mkha' las char pa bab pa yis// sa gzhi lo tog smin pa ltar// gdul bya rgya mtsho mang po kun// bsdu dngos bzhi yis smin pa kun// skyes bu dam pa khyed kyi drin// bu slob rnams kyi zhabs 'bring dang*// zhabs tog rgya chen byung ba yang*// bdag gis sha chang bud med dang*// 'dod yon log pa'i chos rnams kyis// rang gzhan mang po ma bslus pa// khyed kyi zhabs tog yin nam snyam// byis pas a tho me tog 'thu ba ltar// mdzes dgu 'tshol gsog ma khom zhing*// dbus gtsang pre ta'i grong khyer du// bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'dug cing*// khyed kyang phongs par mi bzhugs pas// thebs len yig rten ma mchis pa// tshogs shing 'dus pa'i grwa pa la// bzod pa dam pa gsol ba lags// dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kun// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu// bsngo ba chen pos bsngo bar zhu// phyag bum ril ba spyi blugs dang*// kha che gur kum phul gang dang*// dbu zhu to pi gsol 'phro gcig /bskur nas mchis pa yig rten lags// bu gcig shes rab rgyal mtshan la// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag mchog /snying po bla na med pa yis// nges par gdams kyi thugs la zhog /thugs la brtse ba'i a pa yang*// 'od gsal ngang du mya ngan 'das// rtsa ba'i bla ma rin chen yang*// rang gi sems las gzhan pa med// phun sum tshogs shing 'gal rkyen spangs// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// spun dang 'brel par mi blta zhing*// mtho dman gtogs 'dod ma che bar// zhabs kyi drung du bsgom pa de// shin tu ngo mtshar che 'am snyam// snying gtam yin gyi thugs la zhog /dbu zhu to pi gsol 'phro gcig

/bskur nas mchis pas gsol bar zhu// ༈ //'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa yis// gang gis shing sdong 'khyer gzigs nas// nyid kyi sras la bka' bstsal pa// shing 'di tshu rol pha rol dang*// dbus su chags par ma gyur cing*// skam la ma phyin mi dang yang*// mi ma yin pas ma bzung nas// klong du ma nub khong ma rul// nyes skyon 'di dang bral gyur na// rgya mtsho chen por phyin 'gyur gsungs// de la dge slong tshu rol gyi 'gram zhes bya ba ni nang gi skye mched drug gi tshig bla dwags yin no// pha rol gyi 'gram zhes bya ba de ni phyi'i skye mched drug gi tshig bla dwags yin no// dbus su thogs pa zhes bya ba de dga' ba'i 'dod chags kyi tshig bla dwags yin no// skam la phyung ba zhes bya ba de ni nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi tshig bla dwags yin no// mis gzung ba zhes bya ba ni/ 'di ltar 'di na la la rab tu byung ba dang khyim pa 'dres par gnas te/ dga' ba mtshungs pa dang*/ bde ba mtshungs pa dang*/ bde na bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal na de sdug bsngal zhing 'phral gyi bya ba byung zhing 'byung ba rnams yang dag par blangs te/ mthar 'byin par byed pa lta bu yin no// mi ma yin pas bzung ba zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar 'di na la la tshul khrims sam/ brtul zhugs sam/ dka' thub bam tshangs par spyod pa bsten pa 'dis bdag lha 'am/ lha gang yang rung ba gcig tu gyur cig ces smon lam btab nas tshangs par spyod pa lta bu'o// klong du nub ces bya ba ni/ ji ltar 'di na la la bslab pa phul nas babs pa lta bu yin no// khong rul pa zhes bya ba ni/ ji ltar 'di na la la tshul khrims 'chal ba/ sdig pa'i chos can khong myags shing 'dzags pa/ shing rul pa lta bur gyur pa/ lug bong ltar spyod pa dge sbyong ma yin la dge sbyong du khas 'che ba/ tshangs par spyod pa ma yin par tshangs par spyod par khas 'che ba yod pa lta bu yin te/

dge slong khyod kyis gal te de bzhin du/ tshu rol gyi 'gram du ma thogs zhes bya ba nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa las bab par gyur ro// zhes bya ba'i bar du gsungs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa de dgra bcom pa sems shin tu rnam par grol bar gyur to// thub pa chen po chos rje yi// sras kyi thu bo nye sde la// bka' bstsal legs par gsungs pa'i don// khyod kyi 'khor 'di mdzes pa dang*// shin tu mdzes pa'i rgyu mtshan smros// bdag drung rab tu 'byung 'dod la// sbyangs pa'i yon tan nus sam dris// nus zhes mchi na rab tu phyin// des na shin tu mdzes pa yin// ston pa nyid la zhus pa las// su yis sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi// bsngags pa gsung ba de dag kun// thub chen rgyal ba'i yon tan smra// sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dzin pa la// ston pa blta ba'i dus rnams la// bkag pa med ces bka' bstsal gsungs// thub chen rgyal ba yab sras kyi// rjes su slob par byed pa rnams// sbyangs pa'i yon tan gtsigs bzung nas// rab tu byung dang chos ston pas// thub pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs par nges// // 449) ༄// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med zhes pa'i zhal gdams kyi gsung mgur// oṃ swasti/ phyogs bcu mi chen thams cad kyis// thugs la btags nas byon na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dad can 'bul ba'i char bab kyang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// tshogs pa rnam grangs mang na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dung pad de pud de mang na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dbyangs tsa re tsi re len na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// yon bdag mos gus che na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dge 'dun mdun skol mang na yang*// dus deng sang nga la sgom chen med// dge 'dun rnams kyang mos gus che// 'bad pa brtson 'grus che ste mchi// bla ma'i byin rlabs zad pa 'dra// lo gsum sgrub pa byed par zhu// dus deng sang sgrub pa ma byas na// rgad po 'chi ba btang du thug

/bu go 'am shes sam dgos se kun// // 450) ༄// sngags bla med kyi gdams zab gnad bsdus ri khrod dbang phyug rnams la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyis// bla med theg chen gsang sngags kyi// gnad bsdus gdams ngag zab mo 'di// ri khrod dbang phyug rnams la gdams// de yang ston pa bcom ldan gyis// phyi rol ji bzhin nang ji bzhin// legs par gsungs pa 'di yi don// ro snyoms thabs lam zab mo yi// ro snyoms gnyis med phyag rgya che// thabs kyi gdams ngag zab mo 'dis// shes rab mnyam nyid bogs 'don byed// mnyam nyid phyag rgya chen po yi// thabs mkhas gnad rnams go bar byed// de gang zhe na/ gangs kyi chu shin tu bsil ba des grang rlung shas che ba rnams rkang lag 'khums pa dang*/ nad rnam pa sna tshogs byung ba yi khrag dang mkhris pa shas shin tu che ba rnams la gangs kyi chu shin tu bsil bas phan pa yin/ de nyid la sgom bzang ngan med/ 'byung ba bzhi las grub pa'i lus/ phyi rol gyi tsha grang rnam pa gnyis kyi cha snyom ma shes na/ khe grags kyi snying rus kyis gri rnon pos rked pa bcad na 'tsho ba mi nus pa 'dra/ ba tshwa'i chu 'am bal yul lta bu'i tshad pa'i yul du bsdad na tshad pa'i nad kyis na ba la sogs pa'i nyes pa byung ste/ gangs kyi chu bsil bas phan te de yang snga ma dang 'dra/ sgom bzang ngan med/ mtsho ma dros pa ni chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa bsil drod snyom pa nad thams cad la phan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas ti se la nad byung na ma pham gyis phan pa yin/ ri dang gnas tha dad pa thams cad la tshad pa dang bsil ba dang*/ mnyam pa thams cad de ltar shes par bya/ nad kyi 'byung ba ro snyoms 'di// yi ger bkod las byung ba yi// 'gro ba'i dge ba ma lus kun// bla med byang chub mchog thob shog/ //

451) ༄// gangs ti se u rgyan me nyag khyi than gsum na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la sprengs pa/ oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ mgon po phag mo gru pa rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sras dam par gyur cing*/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa gangs ti se dang*/ u rgyan/ rgya mi nyag khyi than gsum gyi rgyal khams yan chad na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun sgrub pa rtse gcig tu nyams su len pa rnams la/ skyabs bla ma dang dkon mchog grogs chos byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa/ byang chub kyi snying po ma thob kyi bar du/ mi 'bral ba/ rdo rje spun grogs ma gtogs pa/ mi chos dang phyogs ris dang*/ dbus gtsang khams gsum dang*/ nga dang*/ kho dang*/ khyod dang phyogs dang ris med pa lags/ rgya la'am gal te/ nga khyod phyogs ris byung na/ phyogs ris des mi stongs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyis spong bar gyur nas mtha' ngan lam du 'gro bar 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na skyu ra smra bcad pa la skyu ra khri tsho bco brgyad kyis ma stongs/ yul dbus gtsang gi bla ma dang*/ grogs po dang*/ bu slob rnams kyis stongs pa lta bu yin/ kye kye kye/ pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel dang*// nga bdag phyogs ris spangs pa yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// ma ma tshan tshan ma mdzad pa// sgrub pa snying po byed pa yis// skyes bu dam par bkur bar zhu// dper na khyed kyi bla ma des// bla ma bu slob ma bsam shing*// dbon po pha rgyud bu spun skyu ra gcig gcig gis// so chas 'bad pa byas na yang*// bla ma bu slob gnyen 'brel rnams// khyod la gcig pus chog par gyis// snyam par bsams nas 'brel ba gcod// gzhan gyis gnod pa sna tshogs sgrub// de dang 'dra bar shes par mdzod// ma ma tshan tshan phyogs ris rnams// nga bdag 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog gis// bcings pa'i rtog pa spongs mdzod la// sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad pa yang*// yar lam mar lam ma gtogs pa// ji srid lo lnga'i bar nyid du// sgrub pa snying por mdzad par zhu// khyed rnams mthun par bzhugs pa dang*// sgrub par mdzad pa'i gtang rag tu// chab tsha zho gsum 'bul zhing mchis// khog gang mdzad nas gsol bar zhu// gnas dang dus dang ting 'dzin dang*// yi dam grogs kyi thabs rnams kyis// ting 'dzin rgyal po bskyed pa yi// ro snyoms gnad kyi man ngag gcig

/bskur bas de yang nyams len mdzod// chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal khams su 'tshe ba med pa tsam ma gtogs/ gdod mtha' bar gsum 'dzam gling gang na yang rgyal po rnams la rdzas dang yo byad kyi dngos po med pas ming btsad ltogs su thogs pa yin/ jo bos khyed rnams la dngos po ster rgyu mi rnyed/ rnyed na yang rgyal po rnams ni bya ba mang ba/ byed pa mang bas nga mi 'dod ces/ shākya'i sras kyi dge 'dun gyis mi len pa yin/ de sngon phan chad jo bos phyogs thams cad du bskyangs/ da phyin chad jo bos khyod la 'bul ba byed pa thams cad ma len cig jo bo la slong 'phro ma byed cig nga'i jo bo mnga' ris su bzhugs su chug cig nga'i bka' ma bcag cig yon bdag jo dge dang yon bdag pa rnams kyang*/ sgom chen pa la mos gus ran tshod tsam gyis chog pa yin/ shugs kyis rgyab nas skyong ba yin/ khyed kyis yod tshad gcig la byin yang chos su 'gro ba'i ngang phan pa shin tu dka' ba yin pas/ bdag nyid dang ni gzhan la'ang rung*// sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan dang*// phan dang bde ba rnams bya ste// bde yang mi phan mi bya 'o// zhes gsungs pas de'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// sgom chen pa rnams kyang rang la rgyu rkyen ci 'os tsam yod kyi bar du ti se la sgrub pa byas na legs/ rgyu rkyen med par bsod snyoms dang*/ slong phro mang pos thams cad sun phyung ba yin te/ de bcom ldan 'das kyis bkag pa yin/ de nas 'tsho ba ma 'dang na ni ti ser ma bsdad par/ 'tsho ba sla ba/ dge sbyor 'phel ba/ lho bal gyi mthar sdom pa 'chor ba yin pas/ skad rigs mi gcig pa lho bal gyi mtha' ma yin pa/ bod kyi rgyal khams gang yang rung bar bsdad nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad par zhu/ de yang ma ga dha yi byang chub shing drung du// thub pa chen pos rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes// slob dpon tillis rgya gar shar phyogs su// dpal ldan nā ro bla ma'i zhabs drung du// rje btsun lo tsās de dang 'dra ba nyid// rje btsun mi la rang gi yul nyid du// dwags po bla mas dmyal gyi se ba lung*// phag mo gru pas dwags lha sgam po ste// bla ma rnams kyang yul phyogs tha dad du// sgrub pa'i gnas der grub pa thob pa las// ti se 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba ni// nang pa sangs rgyas pa la gtan med de// tha dad dgon pa rnams su thugs dam mdzod// bu la snying gtam snying por gdams// rdzogs so//

// 452) ༄// dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi bu slob skyes bu rnams la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi nga'i bu yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mgon po phag mo gru pa'i rjes su slob pa/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum la gces spras su 'dzin pa/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che/ rang gi srog pas kyang phangs par 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar zhu ba/ bdag yon tan shin tu chung bar gyur pa/ gcig pu gnyis su med par ri khrod kyi dgon par sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byed pa yin pa la/ khyed phyogs ris kyi bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis/ nga la sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba lta bu gcig tu bkur zhing zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog ni byas/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi sgro 'dogs kyi spros pa ni bcad/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pas rang rgyud ni tshims/ gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa go bas chos mthong zhing mngon du ni gyur/ bdag nyid chen po rnams la gdams pa/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar/ thub pa chen po de nyid kyi gdung rigs lha sbyin dang*/ ko ka li ka la sogs pa rjes su phyogs pa dang*/ 'phags pa drug sde cho ma cho dgu mdzad pa rnams la thub pa chen po de nyid kyi sras dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang*/ ston pa dang bstan pa la snying nye zhing gtong mi phod pa'i khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang*/ dge bsnyen ma sa ga ma la sogs pas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'dod pa'i mdzad pa dang*/ rgyal po shag gi rigs ma yin pa/ bram ze grong nya gro ta can du sku 'khrungs shing bram ze chen po'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i 'od srung chen po dang*/ shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gi bu chen po dang*/ rje'u rigs su sku 'khrungs pa 'phags pa rab 'byor dang*/

rna ba bye ba ri dang*/ 'breg mkhan las rab tu gshegs pa nye bar 'khor ba dang*/ gzhan yang yul tha dad pa nas 'dus shing rigs tha dad pa las rab tu byung ba/ thub pa chen po'i sras bsten pa ni yun thung*/ rigs rus ni tha dad/ brtul zhugs ni mi 'dra ba las rab tu byung ba rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par byas shing*/ legs pa'i skar ma dang*/ lha sbyin dang rjes su phyogs pa la sogs pa yun ring por bsten pa/ bstan pa la gnod cing sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba de rnams rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis chad pa ston pa'i bstan pa sngon byung ba dang*/ deng sang rjes su zhugs pa rnams kyi nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/ nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i chos rnam pa bdun yin par gsungs pa las kyang yang dang yang du 'du ba las nyams par mi 'gyur gsungs pas/ khyed kyi yul phyogs tha dad pa rnams su yang dang yang du 'du ba dang*/ bsten yun ring bar khas 'che zhing chang dang bud med dang nyes spyod la 'jug pa tshar gcod pa dang*/ dpung pa snyems na bcom ldan 'das kyis tshul shing mang po'i sbyor ba ngan byed kyi rjes su phyogs pa ci 'dug pa dang*/ bzang po'i rjes su phyogs pa ci 'dug pa dang*/ gang mang ba bltas nas de'i phyogs dang bcas pa gzhom par bya ba'i tshul lugs 'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu chen pos lha sbyin phyogs dang bcas pa pham par byas pa ltar bcom pa dang*/ phyogs log bya ba dang*/ ser mo bshu ba dang*/ bla ma dge 'dun dang bcas pa la 'dis 'di byas yi ge bskur ba la sogs pa tshar bcad par bya ba dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lor snyad btags nas sha chang gi za rgyan byed pa tshar gcad pa dang*/ mi chos kyi gnod pa byed pa la ji ltar 'os pa'i chad pa bgyid pa dang*/ sgrub pa snying por byed cing chos dang mthun pa thams cad bkur bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur bas de ltar du 'bad par zhu 'tshal//

// 453) ༄// ston ma sgom btsun ma dang dge bsnyen ma sgom chen ma la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ thub pa chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gyi sras rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'khor rnam pa bzhi/ dge slong ma dang*/ dge bsnyen ma bcom ldan 'das kyi yum skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo go'u ta ma dang*/ dge bsnyen ma sa ga ma'i rjes su slob pa/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la gces spras su mdzad cing*/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrungs ba/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyis rang gi rgyud smin cing dag par byas nas/ gzhan rgyud smin cing dag par byed pa'i rab tu byung ba/ brtul zhugs kyi khur khur nas sgrub pa tshul bzhin du mdzad pa'i ston ma sgom btsun ma rnams dang*/ dge bsnyen ma bsgom chen ma rnams la gdams pa/ de sngon phan chad bdag na so gzhon pa dang*/ chos dang bya byed kyi brtson 'grus slob ma smin par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la yang 'khor rnam pa bzhi 'dug sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byed pa la ni/ jo mo rje btsun ma lha rje ma dang mang po gcig gis bstan pa'i so ga bzung nas gda' snyam nas/ chos zab pa dang rgya che ba thams cad tshogs dang dpag tu bstan pa lags/ de phyin chad 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du'ang grwa pa bzang 'bring ngan gsum yod pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i dug gi stobs chen po 'phel bas/ rang nyid bsregs cing gzhan bsreg par byed pa mang bar gyur ba dang*/ rang nyid kyi kha dang zhal ta 'bad pa byas kyang byas pa bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag nyung ba dang*/ skyes bu dam pa dbang chen po 'dzin pa phan pa dang bde ba la dga' bas/ gzung ba'i yul med na 'dzin pa'i shes pa nye bar zhi bar gong ma rnams kyis bca' khrims shin tu dam par byas pas/ btsun ma dang sgom ma nga'i drung du yar la mi 'byon par zhu/

de ltar gyur na bla ma ni khyod yin/ nyams su ji ltar blang snyam na/ gdams ngag gzhan med sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad kyi snying po lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrungs pas/ ting nge 'dzin rang dbang med par skye/ sems rang shugs kyis dul/ de la ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang*/ sems kyi bslab pa zhes zer/ sems dul ba las rang gi sems kyi gshis nyid spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba yod med dam gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa/ sems kyi 'dug lugs/ lus kyi 'dug lugs/ snang ba'i 'dug lugs 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'dug tshul mngon du mi 'gyur kha med pas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i babs/ gsum po 'di las mi 'da'/ bdag la dad pa dang gus pa yod pa thams cad kyang*/ tshe snga ma phan chad dam/ 'di yi slob mar gyur pa yin pas nga la yang sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes kyi mos gus tshad du bskyal/ bsngo ba dang sems bskyed gnyis po legs par khong du chud par byas nas yid kyang bsam/ ngag tu yang brjod/ lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pa chen pos nyams su blang bar bya/ 'dir phyin yang de bas med/ 'di bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gar phyin yang nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di las med pas nan tan chen pos nyams su blang bar zhu/ thub pa'i sras 'khor rnam pa bzhi rab tu byung ba dang*/ dge bsnyen ma rnams la gdams pa'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa lags pas nyams su blang bar zhu'o// // 454) ༄// 'phags pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u nas gsungs pa bzhin mi 'bral bar gdams pa// 'phags pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u nas/ de la ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra bar shes zhe na/ lha'i bu khams gsum pa ni sems tsam du zad la/ sems de yang gzugs med pa/ bstan du med pa/ thogs pa med pa rnam par rig byed ma yin pa sgyu ma lta bu ste/

sems de yang sems kyi chos nyid kyis btsal yang mi rnyed do// sems gang gis sems yongs su btsal ba'i sems de yang mi rnyed do// sems de mi dmigs pas chos thams cad mi dmigs so// chos thams cad mi dmigs pas chos gang yang mtshan ma rdzas su yang dag par mi mthong ste/ chos thams cad la chags par mi 'gyur ro// chos thams cad yongs su ma grub pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar shes so// yang srid gsum thams cad sems las 'grub par 'gyur/ sems de yang ni rang bzhin mthong ba med/ yang bka' bstsal pa/ bdag nyid dang ni gzhan dag gi// gnyis ka'i sdug bsngal rab shes nas// bdag gi sdug bsngal zhi byed cing*// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun zhi byed// sems can thams cad byang chub sems// sems de la ni 'dogs par byed// sems la chos rnams thams cad kyang*// don gcig tu ni 'dogs par byed// sems can kun gyi bsod nams gang*// dus gsum gyis ni bsdus pa dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi bsod nams gang*// de dag kun gyis rjes yi rang*// dge ba de dag thams cad kyang*// sems can kun la sbyin par byed// sangs rgyas kyi ni ye shes phyir// lhag pa'i bsam pas 'jug par byed// sems ni skyes pa thams cad kyang*// byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo// chos nyid ma gtogs sems can nam// byang chub kyang ni mthong ba med// de ni sems dang byang chub kyang*// rnam pa gnyis su mi mthong ste// byang chub de yi mtshan nyid dag /sems kyang de yi mtshan nyid yin// mnyam pa nyid kyi chos rnams mnyam// de ni gnas pa yod min te// mdzangs pa thabs la mkhas pa ni// dkar po'i chos kyis rgyal bar 'gyur// dbyings de la ni 'phel ba med// chos kyi dbyings ni bsam mi khyab// sangs rgyas chos rnams tshol ba la// rtag tu chog par 'dzin pa med// bdag ni dkar pos rgyas so snyam// de ni sems kyis bsam mi byed// de ni gang du bsngo ba yi// byang chub de yang mchog mi 'dzin// sbyin pa mi rtog sbyin par byed// rlom sems med par tshul khrims bsrung*// rtag tu bzod pa sgom byed la// sems can la yang gnas pa med// sems dang lus ni dben pa yis// rtag tu brtson 'grus rtsom par byung*// rtog med bsam gtan phun sum tshogs// shes rab kyi ni pha rol son// sems can rnams kyang smin byed la// de ni dmigs pas gnas pa med// zhing yang yongs su sbyong byed la// lhag par 'dzin pa'ang yod ma yin// de ni sangs rgyas ye shes tshol// yi ge rnams la'ang chags pa med// de ltar spyod pa de la ni// byang chub rnyed par dka' ba med// tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang*// smon pa med la mos na ni// de la tshad kyang med par 'gyur// yang de nyid nas/

byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na/ re shig skye ba ngan pa len par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'/ byang chub sems dpa'i ming gi rnyed pas 'tsho bar 'gyur byed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la mi slob pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spong ba yal bar 'dor zhing zlog par mi byed pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag gi rnyed pa'i bar chad byed cing bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod pa dang*/ lus kyi las dang*/ ngag gi las dang*/ yid kyi las sam bsrungs pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni 'gro ba ngan par 'gro bar 'gyur ro// yang de nyid nas/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid na/ gling chen po bzhi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na/ tshangs pa'i gzugs kyis chos ston te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu 'byung ba dang*/ gos ngur smrig mi ston pa yang yod do// de bzhin du brgya byin dang*/ de bzhin du skye ba thams cad kyis kyang chos ston to// stong gsum 'di na ji ltar mos pa'i sems can la mos pa bzhin du chos ston te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa gzhan dang gzhan dag tu yang chos ston to// de la ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad 'jug par mi nus so// mo'u 'gal gyi bu/ dper na/ zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni// gzhal med khang nas mi g.yo la// grong dang grong khyer grong rdal dang*// rgyal po'i pho brang kun tu snang*// de bzhin thub mchog sangs rgyas ni// rang gi zhing las ma g.yos la// dpag med rgyal ba'i zhing du snang*// sems can ji ltar smin gyur par// de ltar rgyal bas chos ston to// zhus pas rgyal ba mchog gang lags// lan du sgyu ma'i skyes bu la// dman dang mchog gi khyad bzhin du// thams cad khyad par med pa ni// chos kun sprul pa'i ngo bo nyid// chos kun rang bzhin nyid stong pa// kun tu brtags las byung ba ste// de dag ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin// rnam par bsgrub par byed mod kyi// chos kyi dbyings la skye 'jig med// chos dbyings ston pas thugs chud phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan// sgrib med thogs pa med pa yis// rnam par gzigs par gyur pa yi// sangs rgyas zhing khams de dag na// sems can ji snyed yod pa kun// snga phyi med par mir gyur la// rgyal po 'khor los sgyur bar gyur// rgyal po de dag re re la// de snyed dag gi 'khor yod kyang*// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ni// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// rgyal ba'i spu yi khung gcig nas// re re'i mdun du de bzhin gshegs// dge slong dge 'dun bcas pa rnams// yang dag ston par mdzad na yang*// gcig gis gcig kyang mi shes te// rang rang de bzhin gshegs pa mthong*// spu yi khung bu thams cad kyang*// sngar bzhin rdzu 'phrul ston pa yis// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi// brgya 'am stong ngam 'bum gyi cha// grangs sam cha 'am bgrang ba 'am// dpe dang rgyur yang mi 'gyur bar// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal to// 'khor los bsgyur ba de dag gi// bsod nams phung po mang po des// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu yi// khung gcig yongs su 'grub par 'gyur// de ltar ston pa bcom ldan gyis// mo'u 'gal bu la bka' bstsal to// 'di ltar zab dang rgya che ba'i// mdo rgyud mang po mthong ba'i tshe// bdag gi bla ma'i bka' bstsal dran// phar gcig tshur gcig rtsod pa yis// lam gcig drang por bstan pa yang*// rgyal ba yin zhes smra ba la// bla ma'i gsung la nges shes skyes// ma lus 'gro ba thams cad la// sangs rgyas 'du shes bskyed pa yi// gtan tshig zab mo 'di na gda'// rgyal ba'i lung rnams kun gyis shes// sgom chen thol ler dris pa'i lan// a la la zhes lan gsum zer// rgyal ba'i dam chos rin chen dang*// dus rnams rtag tu mi 'bral shog
/'di 'dra ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes// mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*// skad gcig tsam yang mi 'bral shog /dus rnams rtag tu mnyes pa dang*// mnyes shing ci mnyes byed par shog/ //

455) ༄// theg chen gnad kyi snying bsdus rgyal ba'i gsung rab dus gsum gsal byed// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rje phag mo gru pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ khyod kyi bla ma la khyad chos thun mong min pa mang po yod zer yang*/ rtsa ba bsdus sa med pa thar thor rnam par 'thor ba yin/ yun ring por dbang po rab dang ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag cig nye gnas su byas/ yun ring du bsten nas gzod go ba srid snyam na/ bsdus pa'i don 'di lta ste/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas rgya ba'i rgyu/ byang chub kyi sems ma gtogs pa yod dam med/ de med par thams cad zhal mthun pa yin la/ de yang smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin/ de yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi lugs kyis/ byang chub kyi sems sdom pa rten can du bzhed pa yin te/ gang gi phyir zhe na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa pha rol tu phyin pa lnga dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas/ de yod na byang chub kyi sems skye/ med na mi skye ste/ de ltar yang bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas sems bskyed do zhes pas sngon la tshad med pa rnam pa bzhis blo sbyangs pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can byas pa dang*/ rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes pa las skye bar/ thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du gsungs shing*/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis nges pas/ sems 'di skyes na 'jug pa skye byed kyi rgyu bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes pa/

smon pa brtan pa rnam pa gnyis gzhir gyur nas 'jug pa blang ba rnam pa gsum ste/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brangs nas mthar rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba dang*/ 'phags pa 'dul ba gtan la dbab pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang*/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas nyin mtshan cha drug tu bya ba dang*/ rje btsun mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gom pa 'degs 'jog gi bar du yang mi brjed par bya ba dang gsum/ gang zag dbang po'i bye brag gis shes par bya zhing nyams su blangs pa ni gzhir gyur pa/ byang chub sems de las sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems/ dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa drug ldan/ rjes 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba dang bcas pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub rgyud/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i nyams len/ blo ldog rnam pa bzhi las sems nges par sbyangs nas theg pa chen por nges pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa sgrub rgyud dang bshad rgyud du bcas pa'i gnad dang man ngag rgyas pa dang bsdus pa thams cad du shes par bya'o// de yang gang zag dbang po rab tu gyur pa byang chub kyi sems kyi mthu rgyas pa/ ltogs pa zas kyis gdung pa ltar myur du sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don bya bar 'dod pas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgor 'jug par bya ste/ de yang rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhir ma 'dus pa med la/ de yang mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ rgyud sde rin chen bzhi po ni// bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud// rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med do// zhes pa nas/ bzhi pa dngos sgrub kun gyi gter// zhes pa'i bar du gsungs la/ zab pa'i man ngag gi gnad nyams len gyi bka' stsal ni/ bya ba'i rgyud kyis bya ba sgrub/ spyod pa'i rgyud ni spyod pa yin// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi thabs gnas nas// bla med rgyud nyid bsgom pa yi// rgyu mtshan gnad rnams bka' bstsal pas// mgon po de yi gsung bzhin bsgrub// de la theg chen gsang sngags dang*// pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa yi// khyad par gang zhes bsam pa kun// dbang nyid khyad par yin no zhes// nges shes gtan tshigs dang bcas par// khong du chud par bya ba 'o// bla med rdo rje theg pa 'di// sgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag dang*// gegs sel bogs 'don thabs rnams dang*// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi// gegs sel yon tan bskyed pa dang*// skyon rnams dag par bya ba dang*// gnas skabs mthar thug 'bras bu kun// ji ltar mig dang ldan pa yis// lag pa'i mthil du bzhag pa yi// skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu bzhin// mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*// dpal ldan 'gro mgon a ti shas// legs par bstan pa'i dam tshig la// nan tan chen por ma gnas na// bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu gang yin pas// gsang sngags yin no byas na yang*// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// thog mar phung ba sna tshogs kyi// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor gnas nas kyang*// bar du phung ba gnas med dang*// rdo rje dmyal ba 'jigs kyang 'jigs// tha mar gting mtha' med pa yi// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bsam las 'das// de phyir gsang sngags dam tshig ni// zab pa'i phyag rgya bzhi yi gnad// mkhas pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// lag mthil skyu ru ra la blta// lha dang bcas pa'i sa lam gyi// gegs dang bar chad sel ba dang*// yon tan rgya mtsho skyed pa yang*// dka' bar gyur pa ma yin na// brgya phrag stong phrag khri phrag dang*// 'bum phrag la sogs 'khor rnams kyi// yon tan skyed pa smos ci dgos// thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das// rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa dang*// mgon po bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// phag mo gru pa'i bka' stsal 'di// nyams su blangs pas nyams su myong*// nyams su myong bas rang rgyud tshims// de bas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid// skyong bar 'dod pa'i brod pa skyes// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// theg chen gnad kyi don bsdus pa// zab cing rgya che nam mkha' 'am// rgya mtsho chen po lta bu 'di// mgon po phag mo gru pa yi// bka' drin dran nas bris pa 'dis// mgon po de yi thugs dgongs mchog

/nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral nas kyang*// bla med byang chub mchog thob shog /rje rin po che mgon po phag mo gru pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ rnal 'byor pa ri khrod kyi dgon par sgrub pa snying por byas shing*/ dka' ba nyams su blangs shing*/ lus srog gdon ltor btang nas nyams su blangs pa'i nyams myong*/ snying dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams la gnad kyi snying po/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dus gsum gsal byed ces bya ba// rdzogs so// // 456) ༄// dam pa'i chos la nan tan gyis shi khar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod ces pa// oṃ swasti/ phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// mgon po dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis// legs gsungs chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mchog /bsam med yid la mi byed pa// rang byung phyag rgya chen po 'di// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin// thog ma bar dang mtha' mar dge// dran pa rgyun chad med pa yis// skyong ba ting 'dzin rgyal po yin// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam zhes// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla mas gsung*// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// nam mkha' yongs su dwangs ba la// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba de// dkar nag khra bo'i sprin tshogs kyis// nyi ma bsgribs na ji ltar gsal// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho tshogs// rnam par rtog pa ma yin nam// rang byung phyag rgya chen po de// de dang bral ba yin na ko// su yis su la ji ltar dri// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can de// rnam par rtog las byung gyur na// de las grol bar byed pa de// rang gis gang la ji ltar 'grol// bu gcig legs par dgongs dang kye/ /gsum po gang gis kyang mi phan/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pas phan// // 457) ༄// rnal 'byor sgom chen dang grwa pa sogs 'byung ba zhes pa//

oṃ swasti/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// sngon yang bka' drin mi chung che// da rung byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rje gong ma rnams kyi bka' drin gyis// yon tan med pa'i sprang po la// phyogs ris med pa thams cad kyis// nga 'bu thugs la shin tu btags// thub pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brangs// mthong tshad thams cad rab tu byung*// rab tu byung ba'i grwa pa la// nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ltar// dgos 'dod thams cad thams cad byung*// gangs khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor byung*// ri khrod 'grim pa'i sgom chen byung*// tshogs dpon che dgu mang po byung*// dge bshes rnams kyi grwa pa byung*// sde pa rnams kyi gnas dpon byung*// gnas gzhi rnams kyi gza' mi byung*// sa bdag rgyal po'i sku rkyen byung*// 'dun gros byed pa'i gtso bo byung*// bu chung gso ba'i mthu chen byung*// tshong lug 'ded pa'i sna khrid byung*// skrad pa rnams kyi dpon po byung*// sgom ma rnams kyi bdag po byung*// yon bdag mo yi bu rdzi byung*// bsha' lug gsod pa'i bshan pa byung*// khyim phugs 'degs pa'i rkun ma byung*// bstan pa'i dgra bo chang 'thung byung*// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// ming la bla ma rin chen zer// bla ma yul gsum phyogs na med// rin chen zer ba 'di re bden// byung lugs 'di 'dra re re la// mang po mang po byung ba des// bzang ngan 'bring gsum bgrang ma lang*// bcas bcos kha ta byas ma lang*// tshar bcad rjes gzung byas mi lang*// gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba 'di// rang log rang dngas mi srid pas// rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams// dam pa'i chos la nan tan mdzod// shi khar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod// rang la snying rje lta rtog mdzod// // 458) ༄// chos kyi rgyal po tsha rong jo bo bla zhang gi sdug sdum byed pa//

oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis 'dud// 'gro ba'i mgon po de nyid dang*// bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad pa// mgon po dpal ldan rin chen gyi// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i skyes chen la// zhu ba 'bul ba'i tshig gi don// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// spyi gtsug nor bu rin po che// bla med mchog gi gdan sa de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mchod rten yin// rgyal ba'i mchod rten bla med par// gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// khyed nyid dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs// nga dang 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad// gong gi phrin las chen po de// kun gyi thugs su ma shong zhing*// ha hu zer brjod mang na yang*// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// mtho dman brjod pa rang sar zhi// bdag gi bla ma dam pa yis// gdan sa brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur du// sngon bas lhag par 'ong ngo zhes// bka' bstsal gsungs pa bden no zhes// nga yang mngon shes can du btang*// ngam shod klung na bzhugs pa yi// che 'bring chung gsum thams cad kyang*// khyed las bsam rgyu mi gda' zhing*// 'di na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun dang*// bod khams yongs kyi 'gro ba kun// dga' zhing blo bde rjes yi rang*// bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs thams cad du// mun pa med cing snang bar gyur// dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad skyes chen khyed// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i zhabs tog tu// g.yor po spyi dang bye brag gis// dad gus mdzad pa'i byed tshul dang*// skye 'gro kun gyi dga' ba dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang*// bdag kyang dbugs byung dga' ba yi// thugs dgongs thugs la bzhag nas kyang*// gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru// dpal gyi rdo rje gdan mchog der// bdag gi bsam pa ma rdzogs tshe// thugs kyi g.yo 'gul mi mdzad par// rgyun chad med par bzhugs par zhu// gong gi mdzad pa kho na ltar// khyed rang dge 'dun skyong ba dang*// mtho dman bya byed btang ba des// phyogs su ma lhung ngo mtshar che// skyes bu dam pa'i nang cha bstan// thams cad kun gyi gting tshod rig

/mkhas dang btsun dang bzang ba dang*// bzang po bzang po thams cad kyang*// ring du ring du bsring tsam na// zha ngon zha ngon chen por thal// de 'dra de 'dra mang po des// ngam shod lung pa skyug nag log /cha la je 'jigs je 'jigs thal// nged rang spad kyi rnam thar la// ha ya hu ya ci zer yang*// 'dam gyis ma gos padma 'dra// dri mas ma gos rin chen 'dra// gsal zhing dag pa shel sgong 'dra// blo bde skyid pas rgyal tshab 'dra// gsol ba 'debs pas sangs rgyas 'dra// 'dra lugs mang ste brjod mi lang*// snga ma bzhin du mdzad par zhu// dam chos rin chen ma gtogs pa// phan nam snyam pa a dzir gda'// thugs la zhog dang rin po che// chos kyi rgyal po tsha rong ba// bla zhang phyogs ris ma mthun yang*// gcig pu khyed nyid bsam pa yis// snying nas nga la snying sdums phul// khyed rang gcig pu ma gtogs pa// gzhan du ma bsams rgyu mtshan des// skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi phod// khong dang bdag cag thams cad kyis// thugs dgongs re ba rdzogs mdzad nas// mtho dman 'di kun gang du yang*// skyo bsang thugs dgongs mi mdzad zhu// khyed cag ngam shod pa rnams kyi// thugs rten skyo ba bsang ba'i phyir// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar 'di// dgongs pa rdzogs phyir bzhugs pa lags// 'di dang mnyam du bzhugs par zhu// 'gro ba'i bla ma gcig pu nyid// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa bla med mchog /bod khams spyi dang de bzhin du// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde zhing sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs// gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo grur// bdag gis zhabs tog ci byas pa'i// dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog thob shog

/rin chen yab sras bdag cag dang*// dus gsum dkon mchog thams cad la// sdang zhing 'tshe ba thams cad kyang*// mgon po phag mo gru pa yi// bla med gdul bya mchog nyid du// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog thob shog /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// mi shes 'khrul pa'i dbang song nas// nyes par gyur pa srid na yang*// bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dkar phyogs kyis// bzod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang*// bu gcig bzhin du bskyang mdzad gsol// bla ma rin chen byin rlabs kyis// bdag la byams sam sdang yang rung*// mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang*// reg pa dang ni dran pas kyang*// 'khor ba'i nyes skyon sdug bsngal dang*// bral nas bde chen mchog thob shog /jo bo bla zhang gi sdums byed pa'i gtsigs su khyed gdan sar bzhugs par chad

kha chad byas pa yin no// khyed ri pa de rnams gdan sa der bzhugs par zhus pa yin/ chos nyams su len pa mtha' dag phag mo grur dge sbyor la btang ba yin pas/ 'dag sbyar dang dge sbyor la 'bad par zhu/ su tshur byung yang nga dang mi mthun pa yin no// gzhan thams cad kyang de rang du bzhugs par zhu// khyed rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa yin no// // 459) ༄// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod thub pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes su gsungs pa// oṃ swasti/ thog ma bar dang mtha' mar dge// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don chen grub// bla ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas// phun sum tshogs pa rnam lnga 'di// lhun gyis grub cing rtsol ba med// rgyun chad med par gyur pa de// ngo mtshar rmad byung rjes yi rang*// thub pa chen po rgyal ba'i sras// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pa// thams cad bsams nas byed pa ni// thub pas mkhyen pa'i ye shes gsungs// // 460) ༄// dpal ldan phag mo grur spyan snga rin po che'i mdun du phul ba'i 'bul tho// oṃ swasti/ dpal ldan phag mo gru'i nags tshal na// legs par bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog /spyan snga rin po che zhes yongs grags pa// dam pa khyed la cung zad zhu ba'i don// pha jo jo jo yon bdag sgom pa yis// dpe med rag sdir kha 'phyang bdun dang yang*// ting kha gnyis dang dgu po 'bul ba 'di// 'di 'dra gong du ma byung mi 'byung bas// sdug pa'i dngos po phul bar gyur pa 'di// zhal du 'du ba'i dngos po 'ga' zhig la// bsgyur nas cis kyang zhal du gsol bar zhu// gzhan yang ja srang rtse mo sum cu tham pa dang*// mar tshud grod ling tsho la stug pa dang*// gan ta gcig dang sha rkyal gcig kyang 'bul// bdag gi bsnams phying gnam ga sngon po dang*// phyag shan rgyal po me nyag 'ga' gri dang*// glong thang ze tse rdo rje sgur chung 'bul// g.yang shun ser po 'di yang bzhugs gdan mdzod// khungs nas byung ba'i chags bu gsol bar zhu// de yi nang tshangs g.yang mo'i na bza' mchis// zhes gdugs khra bo gcig dang rgya nag gi// yul nas byung ba'i chu gdugs ngo mtshar can// chab dang tshad pa skyob par byed pa nyid// nyid kyi dbu la gsol nas mdzad pa mdzod// bdag gi nye gnas rgyal po shag ye yis// bdag gi na bza' ras phyam gsol 'phro dang*// rje btsun ras pa'i char dar yug gcig dang*// yon skyabs grongs pa'i rgun 'gyed bre gsum mo// byang chub yon tan nye gnas rgyal po yis// ja srang stong dang gsum brgya ja phud lags// nye gnas gnyis sogs khams gsum sems can gyi// tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes par mdzad du gsol// slob dpon chen po dge bshes rgya ston la// chab tsha rtse mo zho gang 'bul zhing mchis// ri pa rnams la gser zho sum cu dang*// zab chen kha the'u ma nyams yug gsum dang*// dmar ser srubs gsum dang yug drug dang yang*// mdzo gcig 'bul bas skyes chen rnal 'byor pa// mi yi seng ge ri khrod dbang phyug rnams// thugs dam 'phel zhing dgyes par dgongs par zhu// sangs rgyas dpal gyi shol du mkhan po chen po bzhugs// dkon mchog dpal dang tshul 'bar dbon po la// dar yug dmar po ja zho gcig dang sder gsum 'bul// sder gyi bar na shing tog ku shu gsum gsum mchis//

// 461) ༄// nga yi snying gtam tshig gsum rin chen phyag rgya me tog/ oṃ swasti/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal mi g.yo zhing*// rten 'brel zab mo'i skur gyur rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*// mi pham mgon po thugs rje spyan ras gzigs// chos rje chos kyi rgyal pos rgyal srid skyong*// thub pa mar me mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma ngo mtshar 'di 'dra ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa de// nga dang 'dzin pa zad pa'i ming*// ngar 'dzin gyi rtsod pa ma zhi na// chen por gyur kyang bzang po min// nga med bdag dang bral ba la// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin par bzhed// bod yul dbus kyi rnal 'byor pa// chen po bzang por grags pa yi// mnga' bdag rgyal bu thub pa dang*// dge bshes grwa pa'i mngon shes bzhin// nga rgyal ches na smad pa'i rgyu// nga rgyal zad pa'i bdag med de// srid pa'i nang na chen po mchog /med kyang ku re zhus pa lags// kun la med pa'i chos gcig pu// rang gi sems nyid kho na yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// gzhi la bye brag tha dad med// ma rig 'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog dang*// rang byung ye shes chen po gnyis// gzhi la bye brag tha dad med// khams gsum 'gro drug sdug bsngal dang*// sangs rgyas sku gsung phrin las gnyis// gzhi la bye brag tha dad med// 'khor 'das gnyis med ro mnyam la// tha dad ma byed rnal 'byor pa// nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas nga yin pas// nga dang dus gsum sangs rgyas la// 'phrin las gcig tu bzhugs pa la// mos gus rgyun chad ma mchis na// yon tan mi zad gter dang 'jal// rang sems yid bzhin nor bu la// gsol ba thob cig rnal 'byor pa// slob dpon bram ze chen po dang*// dpal ldan tilli nā ro la// zab mor grags pa'i chos zhus te// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa dang*// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa gnyis// ming gcig tha dad ma mchis pas// gsum po'i gdams ngag gcig tu go// gcig zhu rang la ngos gzung med// ma bcos bzhag pas bde ba che// bsgom rgyu rdul tsam ngas ma mthong*// yengs su med do rnal 'byor pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// nga ni nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs// 'khor 'das thams cad nga la shong*// nga ni bar snang khams na bzhugs// thabs dang shes rab dbyer mi phyed// nga ni ri rab rtse na bzhugs// gsang skad chen pos 'o dod 'bod// nga ni dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs// rnam par rtog pa zas su za// nga ni 'og min gnas na bzhugs// rtog med ye shes gos su gon// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// kye kye rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// thabs kyi lha sku sgom gyur nas// de yi bya ba rdzogs gyur na// de nyid brtan par gyur pa na// sa bdun non te mchog mi thob// rtsa rlung bsgom pa'i sgom chen rnams// skyon med dmigs pa mthar phyin yang*// rang sangs rgyas dang khyad par med// blos byas stong pa bsgoms gyur kyang*// sa brgyad thob pa'i rgyu rkyen med// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// dang po las kyi sbyor ba yis// sa brgyad thob par bzhed na yang*// nga dang dus gsum sangs rgyas gnyis// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa yis// sa lam brtsi rgyu ma mthong bas// rang sems bsgom zhig rnal 'byor pa// e ma ngo mtshar 'di 'dra ba// bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen ni// mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing*// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// sems nyid rdo rje 'chang chen de// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor gyis bskor// rgyun chad med pa'i chos gsung zhing*// 'bral ba med pa'i grogs dang bcas// mchod pa chen pos mchod gyur cing*// re ba med pa'i rgyan dang bcas// dogs pa med pa'i gdan la bzhugs// 'phel 'grib med pa'i zhabs tog mdzad// rang sems bla ma yin no rnal 'byor pa// na ning dus kyi ding sang na// nga yi bu yi dam pa ni// zhabs tog can gyi rnal 'byor pa// nyis stong bdun brgya ri la song*// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du// khri tsho gsum dang stong tsho brgyad// bdun brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug la// zab mo bcu chos gsum chos bshad// khyed zhabs tog mkhan gyi bu slob la// chos la nye ring mi byas shing*// 'khor la bzang ngan ma byas te// mos gus rten cing 'brel 'byung gis// rim pa tha dad gyur kyang ni// chos la phyi nang med do rnal 'byor pa// do gcig dus kyi de ring la// bu zhabs tog can gyi dam pa yis// gser srang brgya dang drug cu phul// lus dang srog la mi blta zhing*// dad gus chen po'i thugs dgongs kyis// 'bras dang chab tsha'i bsnyen bkur mdzad// gnyis su med dang thugs dam las// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa phul// 'bul bar che'o rnal 'byor pa// e ma ngo mtshar 'di lta bu// gzhan don rnams kyi chos gcig pu// byang sems yin no rnal 'byor pa// tshogs chos rnams kyi chos gcig pu// rgyu 'bras yin no rnal 'byor pa// khrid chos rnams kyi chos gcig pu// mi rtog yin no rnal 'byor pa// phyag rgya bzhi yi ye shes kyis// skad cig nyid la rtogs gyur pa// 'bras bu rnams kyi chos gcig yin// dmigs pa rnams kyi chos gcig pu// bla ma yin no rnal 'byor pa// bogs 'don rnams kyi chos gcig pu// mos gus yin no rnal 'byor pa// gegs sel rnams kyi chos gcig pu// stong nyid yin no rnal 'byor pa// phrin las yin pa'i 'gro mgon gyis// sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa de// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mthong chos myong nges zab mo 'byung*// tshe gcig lus gcig 'di nyid la// rdo rje'i skur gyur rdo rje 'chang*// yin pa'i rgyu mtshan zab mo de// bu khyod dang nga gnyis gcig pa bzhin// tha dad ma byed rnal 'byor pa// nga yis bshad pa'i chos rnams la// khyod kyis ma go gang yang med// khyod kyis go ba'i chos rnams la// nga yis ma bshad gang yang med// nged kyi rgyu mtshan zab mo de// ngas kyang gzhan la bstan pa med// khyod kyang nga la mi zhu ste// ku re bag tsam bya ba ni// nga yi ming 'di shes par mdzod// nus ldan blo gros u rgyan yul// nag po dge ba bsil ba'i tshal// gtum byed bden smra ha ha rgod// nyi 'od sgron ma so sa gling*// 'dzi na byang chub dpal gyi ri// bde byed dga' ba srin mo'i gling*// nyi zla i mi rtsi ka li// dbyangs ldan lkugs pa na ga ra// rin chen dpal nyid kha ba can// res 'ga' sbyin bdag chen po yin// res 'ga' mu stegs byed 'dul cing*// res 'ga' bstan bcos chen po byas// de ltar rnal 'byor dbang phyug la// ku re kyal ka zhus pa yin// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// rgyal po me dbon rnam gsum yang*// tha dad ma byed rnal 'byor pa// chen po gsum gyi 'phrin las kyang*// rlung sems gnyis kyi byed pa yin// nga yi snying gtam tshig gsum yin// kun la med pa'i chos gcig pu// rin chen phyag rgya me tog yin/

/'di khyod rang byed dam gzhan la ster// ngas kyang bya ra byed pa yin// bsngo ba bsngo byed bsngo mkhan gsum// dmigs pa med par thim par shog /rdzogs so// // 462) ༄// mi chos kyi 'dun ma sa re si re zhes pa dge slong chos kyi ye shes la gdams pa// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dad ldan g.yo sgyu chung ba dang*// bsod nams bsags pa che ba dang*// sgrub pa snying por byed pa yi// dge slong chos kyi ye shes kyis// rang gi bla ma dam pa la// 'jig rten mi chos kyi 'dun ma yi// rnam bzhag ji ltar byas lags na// phan par 'gyur ba zhus lags pas// bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung*/ spyir mi chos kyi 'dun ma rnam par bzhag pa 'di la/ shin tu mkhas shing rab tu byung ba 'am/ legs par bslabs pa med pas kyang*/ 'di tsug byas na legs par 'ong bar 'dug pa'i nyams myong ni yod pas 'dir cung zad brjod par bya'o// de yang gang zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang byed pa thams cad kyi ni bde ba dang skyid pa sgrub pa yin pas/ bde skyid sgrub pa'i thabs chags pa'i bsam pa gtong ba ma gtogs pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis btsal yang gzhan pa mi rnyed pa nyid du nges te/ des na chags pa'i bsam pa spang bar bya'o// de la gnyis te/ phyi yul la chags pa dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa'o// de gang dang gang la chags kyang*/ nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ phung 'dre thams cad kyi gzhi ma/ yon tan thams cad kyi bar chad/ bde skyid thams cad gtan nas zad par byed pa chags pa yin te/ de yang nang sems can la chags pa'i dbang du byas na shin tu phra zhing chags rin mi chog pa srog chags grog sbur lta bu gcig la yang*/ 'di nga'i yin snyam du bsam nas chags shing zhen na/ rdzas dang yo byad kyi dngos po dpag tu med pa dang*/ rang gi nye du dang gnyen 'brel dang*/ 'khor dang 'bangs rang nyid dang bcas pa'i che na srog gi bar du gcod pa/
