dus de ring nas bzung nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ rang gi lus sam srog gam/ dam pa'i chos kyang btang bar bya'o snyam pa'i dam bcas/ ma chags par gtong ba ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yin pa las/ dam bcas pa yin yang phyi yul dang nang sems can la chags pa che 'bring chung gsum mtho dman rnam pa sna tshogs ci rigs par skye ba/ de'i gnyen po dam pa'i chos 'dul bar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'dul ba'i thabs dpag tu med par gsungs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod chen po rnams su yang mngon gyur byed pa dang bcas pa dang*/ sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa spong ba'i thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis spong bar bstan te/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po rnams la yang*/ shes bya'i sgrib par ming btags pa'i nyon mongs pa yod de/ gnyen po rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin yin zhes pa dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ sgrib pa de spangs nas de gzod thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob ces gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ sgrib pa de dang bral ba'i 'bras bu stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad/ bral ba'i yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun byams pas gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du nyon mongs pa'i bdud de gzod bcom pa yin zhes gsungs pa'i lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du bsrung dgos shing*/ sangs rgyas nas shin tu rnam par dag pa tshul khrims kyi phung por tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin par the tshom dang som nyi med do// de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba byung ba'i nyes dmigs byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi lam la sgrib pa'am/ bar du gcod par 'gyur bar mkhas pa rnams kyis dgongs shing dpag tu med pa bshad pa yin no// nyon mongs pa de dang bral ba'i yon tan gzhan yang sa nas sar 'phar ba dang*/

gtong ba dang yongs su gtong ba chen po la sogs pa bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan gyi skur 'grub tshad mtha' dag lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i 'bras bu lag rjes yin no// lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa ni/ sngar gong du smos pa'i bsam pa de lta bu smon pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas gzod 'jug pa'i sdom pa blang dgos te/ de yang skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gis/ gong du smos pa'i smon pa nyid 'jug pa yin no gsungs pas de'i rjes su 'jug pa yod de/ dper na ngas dge 'dun la khyod la go ba med ces pa'i tshig gnad du/ sum brgya ba'i mchod brjod gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'dul ba yin smras pas der 'dzin pa lta bu yin no// smon pa 'jug pa yin na/ 'jug pa'i cho ga gzhan du 'byung bar mi rigs te/ smon pa gcig pus chog par thal ba'i phyir dang*/ gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa thams cad dang 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// khyad par yang 'di lta bu yod de/ smon pa ni bsam pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ sems de khyad par du byed pa'i bslab bya de bsrungs pas bsam pa de nyid 'grub la/ bsam pa de nyid sgrub pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu btsas ma thag pa ma la sogs pa rnams kyis de nyid chud ma zos pa 'grub pa lta bu/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims rnam pa gsum sems dang sems las byung ba'i tshul du mi len te/ sdom pa'i sems gcig tu bsgrub cing len pa yin te/ dge slong gi sdom pa blangs pas/ dge slong gi bslab pa thams cad blangs pa ro gcig pa dang 'dra bar/ sdom pa thams cad kyang de dang 'dra bas bsod nams rgyun chags kyang 'byung ba yin no// de ltar gyur na byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa gcig pu blangs pas spang bya thams cad spong ba dang*/ yon tan thams cad kyi rdzogs tshul 'di gcig pus chog pa las snga ma smos ci dgos snyam na/

lag rjes rnam pa gsum du gnas pa las gol nas/ la la na re mi dge ba byas pa byang chub kyi lam yin te/ ded dpon thabs la mkhas pa lta bu zer/ la la na re dge ba byas pa byang chub kyi lam yin te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gang la mos mos rdzogs pa'i lung 'dren/ rnam pa sna tshogs su snang zhing grub pa'i mtha' rnam pa sna tshogs su gnas pa/ dad pa ni yod/ thos pa ni chung*/ rang gi rjes su 'jug 'dod pa la gdams pa yin te/ bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan de dang*/ da gzod smra bar 'gyur ba'i nye bar zhi ba bden pa'i don mthar thug chos kyi sku de'i phrin las/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par byed pa'i phrin las lhun gyis grub la rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba ni/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ro gcig cing*/ gnyis su med par gyur pa'i lag rjes yin te/ 'bras bus rgyu dpag pa dang*/ rgyus 'bras bu dpag pa gnyis char la the tshom med par shes par bya ste/ de ni lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa'i lag rjes so// ༈ //lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa 'di la yang*/ shes rab bden don gtan la 'bebs/ zhes te shes rab stong pa nyid kyi mig yod na/ yon tan rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel go bar 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad du gsungs kyang*/ 'dir bdag rgyu dang 'bras bu dang*// gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// stong par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// slob dpon 'phags pa la sogs pa// mkhas pa rnams kyis gtan la phab// 'di la yid ches byar rung ste// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa// 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras yin// phyi ma snod bcud 'khor 'das kun// mig ser ldan pa'i skra shad bzhin// bden med bslu ba'i chos yin pas// dge sdig med par cog ger zhog

/sha bzan gro bo gsod na yang*// bsad sems med par ske ba chod// ces pa'i gdams ngag ston pa kun// slob dpon 'phags pa'i dbu ma dang*// rdzogs chen byar med phyag rgya che// rgyud la skyes pa yin re shig /gal te rgyud la skyes zhe na// nyon mongs spangs pa'i lag rjes su// rim pas skye bar gsungs pa brdzun// de yi lag len 'di ltar bya// de la spyir bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum skye ba'i gnyen po yin pas/ byang chub rnam pa gsum thob par byed pa'i lam du ji ltar byas kyang rung ste/ rang rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa dug gsum 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin pas/ nyon mongs pa gang che che spong bar byed pa'i thabs su bstan pas/ tshul de ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de la rnam pa gnyis/ spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa gtsor bya ste/ lam tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa/ jo bo rje lha cig yab sras kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ lta ba rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba dam pa'i chos dbu ma/ klu sgrub slob ma zla grags yin// de las brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gis// chos nyid bden pa rtogs par 'gyur// zhes pa lta ba'i gdeng de la byed/ tshul khrims rin po che mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du ni bsrung*/ ci dang ci byed pa thams cad la sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems/ dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug /rjes 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba/ byas pa thams cad chud mi zos pa/ skabs skabs su gsang sngags kyi man ngag bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis kyang dam dum bsgom zhing bag chags 'jog pa/ lam tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa/ chos gru bzhi logs brgyad rtse mo dbal dang dgu/ nyams len gnad dang bcas pa/ ngo mtshar la rmad du byung ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu nges pa zhig 'di na gda'o// de yang spyir ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das des/

rgyu dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ tha mar rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs tshad 'di rnams thams cad yin pas/ mos gus dang gdung shugs chen po yang yod/ stong gsum mi mjed 'di na gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ bcom ldan 'das stong gi gdul bya yin pas/ stong gsum 'di la 'khor ba dong sprugs// ༈ //e ma ho/ zhing 'di'i sems can thams cad la yang mos gus byed/ sems can thams cad la yang sangs rgyas kyi snying po yod gsungs pa 'di la yang dga' ba chen po skye bar 'dug sgos bye brag tu byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rab rgyas pa'i gnas su ni gsungs/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i che shos ni lung bstan pa dpag tu med pas ni lung bstan pa 'di'i gdod mtha' bar gsum du bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byed pa po gang yin/ soms dang*/ nged rnams kyi mgo dang*/ rkang pa dang*/ lag pa thams cad dum bu dum bur byas nas bskal pa'am bskal pa bas lhag par mchod kyang bka' drin gyi lan 'khor ba ni mi srid par nges so// sgos bye brag gi dbang du byas na jo bo chen po rje lha cig nged tshu rol mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag rnams dang blo bstun nas rigs dang rus dang mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de la rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas khyod byang phyogs kha ba can du song dang*/ dge bsnyen ston pa gcig la bsten nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la phan thogs par gyur zhes gsungs pa des/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma tshad mar gyur pa dang*/ jo bo tshad mar gyur pa dang*/ u pa si ka tshad mar gyur pa dang*/ de'i rjes su 'jug pa thams cad tshad mar gyur pa yin pas/ nor bu rin po che ltar spyi gtsug gi rgyan du thogs shing rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// bye brag nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa skye ba'i dbang du byas na ni/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan rin po che de'i thugs kyi dgongs pas ni/ sngar ji ltar snyan du gsol ba bzhin du so sor thar pa'i sdom pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i rten du bzhed pa yin te/ de yang kho bo jo bo chen po'i rjes su 'brang gsung*/ jo bo chen po rten can du bzhed par ni grags/ de la jo bo'i dgongs pa skong lugs rjes su 'jug pa rnams la tha dad pa mang po 'dug ste/ nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i las/ las dang nyon mongs pa gang gis spangs pa de thar bar 'gyur gyi/ ma spangs pa ni thar bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir so sor thar pa zhes bya la/ de yang 'phags pa 'dul ba gtan la phab pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ nyan thos kyi so so thar pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i so so thar pa zhes gsungs pas/ dang po gnas skabs kyi nyon mongs pa gsum ma spangs pa las/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa de thob par byed pa la nyon mongs pa che 'bring chung gsum spong ba'i dam bca' dang*/ bdag med rnam pa gnyis rtogs par byed pa'i dam bca' mi skye ba lags sam/ de skyes na skye ba'i rten ma lags sam/ de lags na gnas pa'i rten du gyur pa ma lags sam/ shes bya'i sgrib pa shin tu cha phra ba byang chub kyi shing drung du rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bcom nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i ngo bor gnas par gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ byang chub snying por bzhugs pa na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// dri ma sna tshogs gzhan dag kyang*// khyod kyi ye shes me yis bsregs// zhes pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pas/

nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyis stong pa'i stong nyid de/ nyon mongs pa spangs pas mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyang so so thar pa'i sdom pa la brten cing bzhugs pas/ sangs rgyas kyang rten can du 'dod na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ lam rim gyis bgrod pa'i phyir ro// 'di yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa thams cad las/ skyon shin tu chung ba phra mos kyang yon tan gyi tshogs rgya chen po 'gegs par byed de/ slob dpon 'phags pas rdza'i bum pa chung ngu gcig la chags pas/ gnod sbyin mo grub pa'i bar chad du gyur pa dang*/ mnga' bdag mai tri bas/ bla ma la yin min gyi the tshom skyes pas/ tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i bar chad du gyur pa dang*/ slob dpon chen po tog tse ba tshe rabs gong ma la mchil lham gon nas dri gtsang khang du phyin pas khyi rgod du gyur pa dang*/ slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa bas bla mas za ma tog kha ma 'byed gsungs pa phye bas mkha' 'gro mas bkrongs pa dang*/ dge slong gcig dgra bcom pa thob par 'gyur ba'i nyin par zan spags zos pas/ sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa la yang dgra bcom pa ma thob pa dang*/ ka lan ta ka'i bu bzang sbyin gyis 'jig rten skyon med pa'i dus su skyon phyung bas thub pa'i bstan pa skyon phyung ba la sogs pa nyes pa shin tu phra bas/ lam gong ma yon tan rlabs po che thams cad kyi bar du gcod par 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud nas/ tshul khrims 'chal la sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba ni// yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ mdor bsdus pa'i gsung byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis sam/ sems nyid dri ma med pa la nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi ma gos par byas la/

dben pa'i gnas su snying stobs chen pos sgrub pa yun bsrings na/ skyon dag yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur gsung ngo*// chos 'di rnam pa thams cad kyang gzhi mal mal/ dog cam cam/ sangs rgyas sgam pos ma mdzad/ sems can sgrin pos ma bslad/ gshis sam babs kyis de ltar du gnas pa de/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen nas/ rjes su 'jug pa'i slob ma rnams la gsungs pa las/ chos kyi 'khor lo zhes rnam par grags pa yin pas/ khyed kyis bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa gnyis pa 'di la bslab par bya ste/ 'di yod na ni 'di 'byung la/ 'di med na 'di mi 'byung ba gnas dus kyis bskal pa dang ma bskal ba ni gong ma ltar shes par bya'o// rnam par thar pa gsum pa ni/ sems 'dul sangs rgyas bstan pa gzung*// nyes pa gsum dang bral ba'i yid// gzod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad// dus gsum khams gsum thams cad dang*// dbyer med gcig pa'i rang bzhin sku// nyon mongs gsum dang bral gyur cing*// yon tan gsum gyi lag rjes kyis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// sde snod rin chen gsum po dang*// bslab pa gsum gyi 'khor lo 'di// skuu gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa// rgyan gyi 'khor los 'gro ba rnams// smin cing 'khor lor 'khor ba ni// bla ma sangs rgyas gong ma yi// rnam par thar pa gsum pa ste// khyed kyis 'di la bslab par bya// tshe thung nad mang rkyen ngan gyis// da ltar sems can thams cad slongs// ring po sdod pa'i long med pas// rnam gzhag kha ta rkyang pa yi// rjes su 'brang bar mi bya zhing*// sems nyid rnam dag dri ma med// nyes pa gsum dang bral ba de// byang chub sems kyis goms par bya// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du// skad cig tsam yang ma bral dang*// bla ma sangs rgyas gong ma dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral ba// gnas dang dus kyis ma bskal bas// bu 'bral ba med do thugs la zhog

/'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes su gsungs pa'i gsung sgros 'di// zhabs tog can gyi slob ma yis// bskul nas kun gyi don du zhus// ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni// dpag tshad bzhi khri'i nam mkha' la// rgyu zhing 'khor bar gyur na yang*// 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams kyi// so so'i ri yi rtse nas 'char// de bzhin thub pa chen po'i gsung*// zab cing rgya che mtha' med pa// rang rang blo dang mthun par snang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa mtha' med pa// bdag gis rtogs par ga la nus// 'on kyang bdag gi yi ge 'di// sems can ma lus khams rnams kyi// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i bar// gshis kyis 'gro ba'i tshul bstan pa// nor cing 'khrul pa ma mchis par// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis// gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam du// dgyes shing shin tu dga' bar bstan// 'di ltar nyams su blangs gyur na// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis// byin gyis rlob cing dgyes par nges// kun gyis thugs la bzhag par zhu// dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun// phyin ci log gi lam spangs shing*// rnam grol mchog la reg par shog /tshig gsum gnad kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ dka' ba dang du blangs/ theg pa phrag la khur/ lus srog gdon ltor btang*/ mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas pa'i dpal bkra shis seng ges zhus pa rdzogs so// //

467) ༄// gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi bstan bcos kun phan rin po che rgyal mtshan bya ba// oṃ swasti/ gang zhig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres yon tan kun gyi pha rol phyin// bdud bzhi nyes pa'i tshogs 'joms dpa' bo 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa bla ma rin po che la 'dud// bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros rnams// dpag tu med pa gsan gyur kyang*// mos gus gdung bas ma ngoms pas// da rung bzhed pa'i don du bri// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes ngo bor gyur pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu gsung ba de la/ cung zad cig rgyas par byas na/ spyir 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems ma gtogs pa mi srid de/ de ltar yang*/ 'phags pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las kyang*/ sems las ni las/ las las ni las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa zhes gsungs pas/ sems nges par gyur pa'i rnam par shes pa/ des byas pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las/ de grub pa'am smin pa/ rnam par smin pa 'di 'ba' zhig tu 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ma 'dus pa med pa/ gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu thams cad ma 'dus pa med pa/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dang gnyis kar gyur pa thams cad ma 'dus pa med par/ bde bar gshegs pa'i lung dang*/ mkhas pa rnams kyi rigs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nyams su myong bas dpag tu med pa gsungs shing gtan la phab pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs shing khong du chud pa yin la/ sems de nyid gdod nas skye ba med pa yin te/ gdod nas zhes pa'i sgra don la/ dang po nas zhes bya ba yin te/

sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon rung ma byon rung*/ sems can khams gsum gyi 'khor bar 'khyams rung ma 'khyams rung*/ dang po nas gshis nyid ma skyes pa rtag pa nyid de/ sus kyang ma byas shing grub pa med pa/ nam mkha'i dpe bstan nas/ dkyil zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ phyi rol nam mkha' ma yin zhing*// sems kyi nam mkha'i dbus gnas pa// zhes gsungs pas/ phyi rol gyi nam mkha' ni mtha'/ sems kyi ngo bo ni dbus yin pas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rnams su/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas pa/ zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa'i don yang 'di yin te/ gzhi chos thams cad ma skyes pa/ skye ba med nye bar zhi ba/ smra bsam shes brjod las 'das pa/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa zhig bshad pa thams cad/ shes bya'i yul la kha phyir bltas pa/ tshig dang tha snyad kyi rjes su 'brangs pa/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma'i brgyud pa med pa/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la ma skyes pa'i skyon yin la/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems nyid/ sus kyang byas pa med par gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa ni/ gzhi'i gnas lugs so// gnas lugs de lta bu zhig yin pa/ ma rig pas ma rig pa/ mi shes pas gti mug can/ ma go bas go ba med pa/ ma rtogs pas rtogs pa med pa/ skye zhing 'jig pa la brten pas/ 'jig rten pa zhes bya la/ de ltar yang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas kyang*/ lar gyi 'dug tshul zhig ma shes na// ci byas 'khor ba'i gzhung lam yin// zhes gsungs pas/ sems rtogs pa shin tu gal che/ rtogs pa de la yang bla ma rtogs ldan zhig dgos te/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ bla ma la rtogs pa med na slob ma'i rgyud la rtogs pa skye mi nus/ brkos phor la ri mo med na tsha tsha la ri mo mi 'ong*/

bla ma bzang po gal che gsung*/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje las kyang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las kyang*/ yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*// bla ma med na srid mthar min// skya ba 'dzin pa med pa yi// gru yis pha rol 'gro mi nus// zhes pa dang*/ dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud nas kyang*/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma mchod pa brtsam par bya// de mnyes pa las dngos grub ni// kun mkhyen nyid ni thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma med pa'i rdol bon kha nag la rtogs pa mi skye bar gsungs so// 'o na de tsam du gnad che ba'i bla ma de ji ltar bsten snyam na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu bla ma bsten par bya ba'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab cig gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon bhi bhi lha'i bla ma lnga bcu par ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du nyams su blang zhing*/ 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdo las kyang*/ sa gsum la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems can la snying rje skye ste/ 'di rnams 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal ba cis lan snyam du bsams pas/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ma rtogs pas lan par go// de su la rag las na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las par go bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i phyir mgo dang rkang lag lus dang longs spyod thams cad gtong zhing*/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed cing bla ma mnyes par byed par gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ yon tan rgyas par byed cing skyon dag shes// de 'dra'i bla ma srog gis gzung bar bya// zhes gsungs pas/ 'di yang tshad dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa de las/ tshig dang yi ge'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa yi ge'i ris su bris shing*/

be'u bum du bstar ba/ sbas shing gsang pa/ zab mo zab par grags pa ci la/ 'di gser zho gcig gis thob bam/ srang gcig dang srang brgyas thob bam/ mos gus kyi rnam gzhag phyag phyi dang*/ zhung zhung dang*/ ljab ljib kyi rnam par blo la len cing tshig tu klog pa dang*/ ngom po byed cing gzhan la bshad pas kyang*/ bla ma'i chos zab mo snying nas thugs la gnas pa/ smra ba dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ shes pa dang*/ brjod pa thams cad kyi yul las 'das pa/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de len pa'i mos gus/ rang dang bla ma de gcig tu song ba gcig ma gtogs pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi rtogs par go// rang dang bla ma gcig tu song ba de go'am/ de ma go na snying gcig tu song ba la mi zer/ sku dang gsung dang thugs gcig tu gyur pa/ rgya dang rgya'i 'bur lta bur gyur na/ mos gus yin cing*/ zab mo de lon pa ma lags sam/ zab mo de lon na bcom ldan 'das kyis/ de bzhin nyid gcig shes na chos thams cad kyi mdo dang rgyas pa shes par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu// ngas ni mdo sde gang bshad pa// tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig yin// tshig gcig rnam par bsgom na ni// thams cad bsgom par 'gyur ba yin// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub tu sangs rgyas nas/ brtse ba chen po rje btsun tshangs pa'i rgyal pos/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ma btab pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig khong du chud// ces gsungs pas/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad brjod bya 'di kho na/ rtogs pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu nges pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan pa/ slob dpon dpa' bo'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ chos nyid rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis dang*// chos la skye 'gag med cing spros pa dben// de la dmigs te yon tan kun grub pa// legs bsgyur dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pas/

brjod par bya ba'i don gyi bdag nyid/ rjod par byed pa tshig gi brda sprod pa'am/ rgyu mthun pa tsam du bas pas/ 'di ni mos gus tshad du bskyal ba 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul du gsungs shing nges so// de ltar bla ma tshad dang ldan pa la/ slob ma mos gus dang ldan pas/ sku gsung thugs gcig tu gyur pa'i mos gus kyis/ bla ma'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang gcig tu gyur pas/ rang gi sems rtogs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skye ste/ rtogs pa de yang rje btsun byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med// dri med sangs rgyas yon tan rgyal ba'i mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs kyang*/ slob ma lam gyis bsdus pa'i de bzhin nyid dri ma dang bcas pa yin te/ dri ma de yang gang zhe na/ mthong bas spang ba'am/ sgom pas spang ba rnam pa gnyis su 'dus la/ de gang yin yang sems can thams cad kyi gshis gnyid log par phyin ci log tu 'khrul ba/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug phra ba dang rags par gnas pas mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la sgrib pa yin pas/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las/ byang chub snying por bzhugs pa na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// dri ma gzhan yang rnam mang po// khyod kyi ye shes me yis bsregs// zhes gsungs pas/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi dri ma/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug rnam pa gsum gyi gnyen po/ ma chags pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa rnam pa gsum/ gong nas gong du 'phel zhing yangs pa dang rgya chen por gyur pas/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par bzhed de/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa// de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs// zhes pa 'khor ba lugs 'byung du gsungs pa dang*/

ma rig pa de nyid kyi gnyen po smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i don/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung*// zhes pas/ 'khor ba lugs ldog rgyu mtshan dang*/ gnad ka rtsa ba gti mug gi gnyen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rtogs pa dgos la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mig med na/ lam gyi ye shes dang 'bras bu'i ye shes rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos mngon du mi 'gyur zhing*/ dus gsum la chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i ye shes ma thob pas/ dkon mchog gsum rgyun chad cing sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los sems can gyi don byed pa yang mi 'byung bas/ rtogs pa'i don smra bsam shes brjod las 'das pa'i ji lta ba'i don rtogs kyang*/ dri ma dgag par bya ba'i bslab pa dang*/ dri ma dang bral ba bsgrub par bya ba'i bslab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ stobs bcu'i rang bzhin/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bde skyid/ 'phags pa rnams nges par 'byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba phra ba yin la/ des shin tu phra ba'i nyes pa byung yang*/ ye shes dang*/ ye shes chen po dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi don 'grub pa'i bar du gcod par 'gyur ba/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa nag po la bya rog zhar ma 'dra zhes lkog 'bug byas pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis skye ba lnga brgyar bya rog zhar mar skye bar dbu bsnyung bzhes shing lung bstan pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi zhal ta ba zhig gis/ dgra bcom pa zhig la bran mo'i bu zhes brjod pas/ skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du bran mo'i bur gyur cing*/ dgra bcom pa thob pa'i srid pa tha ma'i bar du yang*/

bran mo'i bur gyur pa la sogs pa sgrib pa myur ba'i chos spang bar bstan pas/ 'di 'dra ba'i chos la sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po rnams kyang rdugs te/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi spyod yul yin pas/ 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' bar mdzad pa dang*/ 'dul ba'i sde snod las thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gtan la phab pa lags pas/ dge slong dang dge tshul lam byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la sogs pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par 'dod pas tshul khrims la bslab par bya ba gal shin tu che ste/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pas/ ltung ba sde lnga rtsa bar gyur pa'i ltung ba byung na/ mgo chad pa la shi gson gyi ming med pa dang 'dra bar dkar po'i chos thams cad mi skye ba'i chos can yin zhing*/ ltung ba gzhan gang yang rung ba zhig byung yang dge 'dun gyi las brgya rtsa gcig gam/ dge 'dun gyi bya ba dang byed pa'i las dkar po'i chos gong nas gong du khyad par gyur pa'i thams cad byar mi btub cing sgrib pa dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la sgrib cing byang chub thob pa'i bar chad du gyur pa dang*/ bla na med pa'i 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam dang*/ 'bras bu'i bar du gcod pa chen por 'gyur bas las dang lam la sgrib pa dang*/ sems can dmyal ba dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su lhung bas ngan song gsum du skye ba dang*/ dkar po'i chos thar pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob pa/ klog pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo mi khom zhing*/ phyin ci log gi bya ba dang byed pas g.yengs par gyur/ bya dang byed pa mang ba dang*/ bla ma dang mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ chos dang mthun pa'i dam pa rnams dang*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad ma dad cing zhabs 'dren par gyur pas/

gzhan ma dad par 'gyur ba'i nyes dmigs dgag pa'am/ spang bar bya ba'i bslab par bcas pa 'di yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon 'das pa'i dus dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dang*/ da ltar gyi dus nye ba'am ring ba thams cad du/ 'gro ba rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can/ ngan par song zhing nyes pa'i tshogs can/ 'di dang 'di ni lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las 'di dang 'di 'dra ba byas pa las gyur pa des na/ dge slong dag khyed kyis spang bar bya'o zhes dgag par bya ba'i bslab par bcas pa dang*/ yang dge slong dag nga sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur ba na/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la tshul 'di ltar spyad cing nyams su blangs pas/ ngas lam gyi yon tan thams cad mngon du byas shing rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bo zhes skyes pa'i rabs lnga brgya gsungs shing de 'dul bar bstan pa dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa dang 'od dpag med// gzhan yang sangs rgyas mang po dang*// sangs rgyas 'di dag smos pa kun// byang chub sems dpar gyur pa dang*// rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos tshogs// legs par spyad pa thams cad la// bdag nyid chen po 'di dag gis// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las// dge bar gyur pa 'di spyad pas// 'bras bu 'di ltar gyur pas na// dge slong de la khyed kyis kyang*// nan tan chen pos bslab bo zhes// sgrub pa'i bslab par bcas pa yin// dgag dang sgrub pa'i bslab pa 'di// rgyal ba rnams kyis bcas pa la// bcas pa dang ni rang bzhin gyi// dbye ba mkhan rnams ji ltar mdzad// legs par dgongs dang dam pa kun// tshe gcig skyes pa'i lus po 'di// sha rus dum bur gyur kyang bla// skyob pa bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung*// de dang 'gal bar su zhig byed// stobs bcu mchog ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan gyis// legs par gsung ba dam pa'i chos// 'khor ba lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi// gzhi yi gnas lugs bstan pa yis// lam dang 'bras bu'i gnas lugs kyang*// rgyu yis 'bras bu dpag pa dang*// 'bras bu yis kyang rgyu dpag pa// gsal bar gyur pa bcom ldan gyis// mya ngan 'das pa chen por gsungs// spyi yi rnam par gzhag pa'o// sgos bye brag tu rten gyi gang zag rnal 'byor pa zhig gis nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/

lam bslab pa rin po che rnam gsum ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de yang med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras/ tshul khrims med na ting nge 'dzin mi 'byung*/ ting nge 'dzin med na yang dag pa'i shes rab rgyud la mi skye ste/ de ma skyes na tshul khrims kyi phung po dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang*/ shes rab kyi phung po dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i mthar thug pa mi thob pas/ gsum po 'di la ji bzhin du bslab par bya'o// de ltar yang lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni gtsor nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi gnyen po/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa ni gtsor nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi gnyen po/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ni gtsor nyon mongs pa gti mug gi gnyen po yin la/ de yang rten gyi gang zag so so'i rig pa tha dad pa dang*/ sngon gyi sbyangs pa tha dad pa dang*/ byang chub gsum gyi 'bras bu tha dad pa'i bye brag gis nyams len tha dad par song ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa rnams kyis ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por ni mthong*/ sdug bsngal de grub par byed pa'i rgyu 'dod chags yin pas khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral nas dgra bcom par 'gyur ba grub ste/ de ltar yang*/ sred dang bral la yang srid med// 'dod pa med pas mya ngan 'das// zhes pas/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor gyur pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ni byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems gtso bo dang*/ gzhir gyur pa mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la 'bras bur sgrub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes med pas// snying rje gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa cig car du 'jug pa sems mngon par rtogs pa'i shes rab skye ba dang*/

lnga sde bzang po ye shes khong du chud pas bsnyen pa rdzogs pa la sogs pa/ de gsum char yang bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab tu gsungs shing*/ de ltar rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur yang 'gal ba med de/ tshul khrims bsrungs pas ting nge 'dzin skye/ ting nge 'dzin de la yang dag pa'i shes rab skyes pa/ 'phags pa dga' bo lta bu dang*/ khams gsum gyi sems can la tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po skyes shing*/ de rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pas/ rang gzhan smin cing grol bar gyur na/ tshul khrims kyis smin cing grol bar 'gyur bar go bas/ de 'ba' zhig nyams su len pas/ gnyis la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ da ltar gyi byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba rnams lta bu dang*/ dang por yang dag pa'i shes rab yang dag pa'i ye shes khong du chud pas bsnyen par rdzogs shing*/ ting nge 'dzin la dbang bsgyur ba lnga sde bzang po lta bu dang*/ slob dpon chen po tog tse ba lta bu ste/ 'di rnams kyang kha cig ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu tshul khrims/ 'bras bu shes rab/ kha cig ni gzhi shes rab/ 'bras bu tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin/ kha cig ni gzhi tshul khrims/ 'bras bu ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab yin par bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ rgyus pa'i sna phag zes mtshon pa dang 'dra bar sbyangs pa dang las 'phro'i stobs kyis dang po kho na gang yang rung bas mtshon nas bslab pa gsum char nyams su len par dgos par nges te/ sangs rgyas zag pa med pa'i phung po lnga'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bslab pa gsum mthar phyin cing de'i lag rjes sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i bzhed pas stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i rgyud tshod mtho yang rung*/ dma' yang rung ste ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi cha stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab yin la/

ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi cha/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang*/ dge ba las bde ba 'byung ba nyams su myong zhing go ba cung zad byung ba des dpags nas/ dpag tu med pa zhig mngon du gyur pas rang gi srog dang yang bsdos nas bslab pa gsum char nyams su blang ba la 'bad par bya'o// 'di yang don bsdu na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ gti mug 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas/ sde snod gsum dang bslab pa gsum/ gsum gsum gyi dbye bas phye na dgu'am/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'gyur te/ rnal 'byor pa lag len du byed na phyi yul lam/ nang sems can nam/ chags pa'i yul gang la chags shing zhen pa skye ba'i gnas/ grogs sam/ dus sam/ yo byad la sogs pa 'di la chags pa skye na nyan thos kyi rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa'i jo sras rnal 'byor pa zhig yin/ yang zhe sdang 'dod cing zhe sdang la chags pas/ zhe sdang skye ba'i yul/ gnas sam dus sam/ grogs sam/ yo byad la sogs pa 'di la zhe sdang skye na/ rnal 'byor pa de bzhi gang yin nam/ yang gti mug skye ba'i gnas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab can mi gnas pa/ 'jig rten 'di la mngon par zhen cing 'dod yon chu bzhin du 'thung ba/ bslab pa nyams pa/ ltung ba pham par gyur pa'i khyus 'tsho ba/ skyes bu dam pa la gshe skur 'debs shing log par lta ba'i gnas sam/ ston pas sngags pa ma yin pa'i nyes pa'am/

ltung ba'am/ shes rab nyams par byed pa'i grogs sam/ gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu legs par spyod kyang*/ dus skabs 'ga' zhig tu nyes par 'gyur ba'i dus sam/ ston pas ma gnang zhing nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa 'ba' zhig bskyed par byed pa'i rdzas yo byad kyi dngos po/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab nyams shing na smad par byed pa de lta bu rnams la/ nyan thos kyi rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa'i jo sras rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ gang yin yang phyar phyor ram/ za zi byas pas mi phan/ sdang ba'i dgra dang thug pa yin/ gtan gyi bde skyid 'chor ba yin/ so nam zhib tig du byed dgos pa yin/ bzhi po gang yang rung ba gcig gis 'dod chags gsum po dang bral bar byas nas/ de gsum gyis ma bcings pa'i sems 'dod chags kyi zhags pas ma bcings pa/ zhe sdang gi zhags pas ma bcings pa/ gti mug gi zhags pas ma bcings pa/ ma bcings pas rnam par grol bar gyur pa/ nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa bral ba/ las su rung ba/ ci byar btub pa zhig 'ong ste/ sems de ni lhag pa'i sems/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhi'am sgor gyur pa/ gzungs dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa yin te/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad par 'dor// rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par sgrub// zhes gsungs pas/ sems rnam par grol ba 'di yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi'am sgo'am/ 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rdo rje'i gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du/ thugs 'di la gnas nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes brnyes pa dang*/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la nyid kyis gdan seṅge'i khri bshams nas/

ting nge 'dzin 'di la mnyam par bzhag nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gsungs pa dang*/ rtswa mchog gi grong khyer shing sā la drung gi tshal du ting nge 'dzin 'di la mnyam par bzhag nas mya ngan las 'das pa yin zhes/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu gsungs shing*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis nges par mdzad na/ kye ci ka sems nyid don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs shing mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa nyon mongs pa gsum gyi zhags pas bcings pa'i 'ching ba las grol zhing*/ gcod par byed pa'i mthu med na/ sems rnam par grol ba'i yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa ji ltar sgrub na ang ge/ 'o na sems nyid don dam pa'i bden pa ni mthong*/ skye ba ni mi len/ shi bas 'khrul pa'i bag chags ni 'dzad snyam na/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni ma thob/ ma thob pas thams cad mkhyen par ma gyur/ thams cad mkhyen pas 'dul ba'i bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' ba'i nus pa med pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis tshul khrims legs par bsrung dgos pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po rdzogs dgos pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thams cad thob par bya dgos na/ nged kyi mngon par rtogs pa 'di tshod tsam gyis phyin ci log tu rlom pa bskyed nas/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang*/ shes rab kyi bslab pa la nan tan mi byed pa ni bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs par zad do// don 'di bla ma rin chen gyis// rtog pa phra ba'i phra ba la// chen po'i chen por gyur pa'i bdud// 'jug par 'gyur bar gsungs pa dang*// ro gcig ngang la 'byams gyur na// rgyu 'bras mngon du 'gyur ro gsung*// 'gro ba'i mgon po klu sgrub kyis// mi rtog ye shes bskyang ba'i phyir// gnod sbyin bu mo bsgrubs pa las// rdza bum chung ngu'i nyes skyon gyis// grub par ma gyur bka' bstsal gsung*// skyob pa shākya'i rgyal po yis// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// nyon mongs la sogs bdud bzhi bcom// de yi phyir na bcom zhes bya// bcom pas ldan dang 'das pa yis// sgra don khyed kyi thugs la gsal// de ltar lhag pa tshul khrims dngos// chags pa gsum dang bral gyur pas// ma bcings dri ma med pa'i sems// ting 'dzin yon tan kun gyi sgo// dpal chen rgyud la skyes gyur nas// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// ma skyes mi skye skye ba med// shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha'// shes rab kyis ni de nyid thob// dang po las can yan chad dang*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug man chad kun// sngon sbyangs goms pa'i bye brag dang*// las 'phro so so dag gis ni// dang po 'jug pa'i bye brag la// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu// tha dad mang po gsungs na yang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// ye shes me yis bsregs zhes pas// sbyang gzhi yod na sbyong byed yod// bslab pa gsum dang bral thabs med// mi 'bral gnad kyi don go rnams// phan tshun 'brel pas go bar zad// de ltar nyams su blangs pa la// gti mug med pa gang yin pa// mthar phyin sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// skye 'gag med pa'i spros las dben// chos sku shes rab pha rol phyin// sdong po bkod par gsungs pa ni// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa 'o// thub pa rnams kyi longs sku ni// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos// bral ba'i yon tan sum cu gnyis// rgyu dang 'bras bur bstan pa ni// dgag sgrub gnyis kyi bslab pa ste// bu mo rin chen mdo las gsungs// rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni// mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyis te// rgyu dang 'bras bu rtags pa'i tshul// rgyal ba'i yum du gsungs pa ste// yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi 'di// chos kyi sku yi yon tan yin// sku gsum so sor dbye ba las// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes grags// 'jig rten ngam gyur padmas kyang*// rnam par snang mdzad ye shes ni// bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs la gnas// theg chen gsung rab dpag med du// dpag med gzhan yang gsungs pas nges// chags pa med pa mthar phyin pas// zhi ba 'dod chags bral ba'i lus// bcom ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku 'o// zhe sdang med pa'i ngo bo nyid// 'gro ba'i don phyir byang chub sems// sems can kun gyi don ched du// bskyed cing sdom pa blangs pa las// sdom pa gsum gyi tshul bzhin du// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo la// sprul pa'i sku zhes yongs su grags// khyad par sku gsum 'bras bu gsum// skyes chen khyed kyi thugs dam mdzod// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel rnams// so so gang gis gang sgrub pa// gsang gtam shub nas bzlas pa yang*// spang bya gnyen po gnyis kyi sems// so so'i sems su gang skyes pa// 'di ni nang gi rten 'brel te// bsam pa de yis byin rlabs pa// sems kyi lus su gyur pa de// gsang ba rten cing 'brel pa yin// lus sems gnyis pos phyi rol gyi// snang ba byin gyis rlabs pa'i tshe// phyi rol rang gzugs shar ba de// phyi yi rten cing 'brel pa ste// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// rgyu dang 'bras bu yin no zhes// sangs rgyas mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'di// gces se rnams la ngo sprod mdzad// rtogs ldan rnams la bka' bstsal gsung*// mos gus can la go ba skyes// snying gtam tshig gcig gsung ba 'di// ngas kyang khyed la bstan pa yin// dus tshod gnyen po re re la// bshes gnyen bzang po re re byung*// grwa tshogs mang po re re 'dus// re re'i gsung sgros re re bris// dam chos mang po mang por song*// tshu rol mthong ba'i dad can rnams// gang mthong bden nam bden nam snyam// pha tsha mang po bkang na yang*// nyams dang rtogs pa ma 'byor na// ma skyes mi 'gag blo las 'das// lta ba nam mkha' lta bu yang*// bcu gsum gung gi ya blar bros// bde dang gsal dang mi rtog pa// lho sprin 'thibs pa lta bu yang*// sad nag byung ba'i nam bzhin dwangs// ma tshor bsags pa'i mi dge ba// 'chi ba'i dus su mngon du gyur// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// sems can kun la skyabs med pa// byang chub sems dpas ma gzigs sam// 'dod yon ro la chags pa spang*// ro snyoms pa la dgos rgyu chung*// man ngag ser sna byed pa yang*// bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung dang 'gal// las dang skal par ldan pa la// nyams rtogs gnyis med 'khrid par zhu// rin po che yi gsung sgros 'di// ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin// bris pa'i dge ba gang yin des// 'gro ba byang chub mchog thob shog
/bstan bcos kun la phan pa rin po che'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //

468) ༄// 'phan yul dpon chen ye shes tshul khrims kyi spyan sngar springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ dpon chen po'i spyan sngar springs pa/ khyed nga'i bu'i dam pa slob ma'i yang rab/ skye ba dpag tu med pa las kyi 'brel ba zab mor gyur pa/ dad pa dang gus pa mi phyed pa'i shugs thob pa/ zab pa dang rgya che ba rin po che'i chos la gser gyi snod lta bur gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab lta bu'i rgyab yod pa/ mos gus skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa'i lag pa g.yas pa lta bu/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyi bcud/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes skad kyis blangs nas/ rang gzhan thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i nus pa yod pa yin pa la/ tshig dang tha snyad kyi yi ge/ byis pa dman pa'i mgo skor/ mi mkhas pa thams cad kyi slu brid/ blun po rnams kyi yang zong*/ mang po zhig khyed dga' re nas/ skur zhing ngas mgo bskor ba ga la phod/ de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ nyams myong la zhen pa ma mchis na// dpe cha la chags pa ga la mchis// zhes pa dang*/ gdams ngag ji ltar zab kyang zhi gnas kyi nyams yang yud cig skyed par yang dka'/ nyams myong mthug po zhig skyes kyang*/ nyams sprin la mtshan ma btsugs gyur kyang*// 'dus byas yin pas bslu nas 'chi// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ bla ma'i mos gus dang sems bsgom pa la nan tan cher mdzad par zhu/ de yang pha mes rigs rgyud can gyi bu tsha ni skyes/ mi rkang grangs ni nyung*/ sa bar khrom tshigs ni 'dzin/ rgyab rten dang skyabs mgon chos ma yin pa ni med/ so nams gdams ngag dang yig sna 'ba' zhig la byed pa'i mi rigs lags pas/

gdams ngag mang po yang yod/ mang po zhig nyams len byas pas kyang ma bslus par ma byung*/ mi bslu nges pa bla ma'i mos gus su byung ba yin pas/ snying tshig gi gdams ngag thugs la bzhag par zhu/ 'jam dbyangs kun tu bzang po 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// nor bzang mos gus rgya mtsho'i khrid mdzad ji bzhin du// 'gro ba kun gyi khrid la rab tu mkhas pa po// mtshungs med bla ma rnams dang rtag tu mi 'bral shog /chos kun gdod nas rnam par dag pa shes rab pha rol phyin// shin tu rnam par zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab tshad las 'das// gzhi dang snying po me tog brgyan pa'i 'jig rten longs sku'i zhing*// shākya'i rgyal po'i zhing khams stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi// gling bzhi bar pa gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa 'dzam bu'i gling*// thub pa'i mchod rten nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas kyi mchog gyur pa// byang phyogs kha ba can zhes rnam par grags par gyur pa yi// dri za'i rgyal po chen po zur phud lnga pa'i gnas kyi drung*// 'phan yul rgyal zhes yongs su grags pa'i gtsug lag khang chen du// bsod nams tshogs las legs par 'khrungs pa shākya'i rgyal po'i sras// gzhon nu rab byung tshul khrims rgyal gyis mdzes pa'i ye tshul gyis// rgyal ba'i yum gyur stong phrag brgya pa gser gyis bzhengs pa 'di// zhing dang lhag pa'i bsam pa dngos po kun gyis khyad par 'phags// rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams ma lus thams cad du// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur cing*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi yul du gyur pa 'di// gang gi lag tu thob par gyur pa de dag thams cad kun// ring por mi thogs 'dren pa rnams kyis byang chub thob ces gsungs// de phyir 'chang dang klog dang mchod dang nyan dang ston dang sgom pa yi// bsod nams dri med mchog tu gyur pa rmad du byung ba des// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyis// mthar thug chos sku shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog thob shog/

༈ //e ma ho/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas// spros med shes rab pha rol phyin// sems nyid 'od gsal stong nyid don// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mchog /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// ston pa shākya seṅge yi// rgyal sras ye shes tshul khrims kyis// thugs dam stong phrag brgya pa ni// mthing shog bai ḍūr glegs bam la// rin chen gser gyis legs bris nas// mchod dang 'chang dang klog pa dang*// nyan dang gzhan la ston pa dang*// tshul bzhin yid la byed pa yi// dpag med bsod nams phung po yis// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i don// skye med 'od gsal rtogs par shog/ // 469) ༄// jo sras la skyes phrin dang phag gru'i gdan 'dzin la bstod pa// oṃ swasti/ stong dang snying rje lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// mi g.yo rdo rje'i ri ltar rab brtan cing*// dbang gi rgyal po nam mkha' mdzod 'dzin pa// brtse chen bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// ji ltar ma ni bu la byams pa yis// bye ba phrag khrig char yang mi phod pa// chos las skyes pa'i bu sdug dam pa la// bla ma rnams ni rgyun chad med par brtse// chags pa'i yid can pha ma bu gcig la// byams kyang gti mug zhe sdang dbang gis nyams// chos kyi rgyal po'i sras kyis dus gsum gyi// rgyal ba rnams kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin phyir dang*// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs yin pas/ |bsam rgyu gzhan med chos kyi bu la sems// 'jam dbyangs dpa' bos 'jig rten khams rnams su// dpag med sems can smin par mdzad pa ltar// khyed kyis 'gro la phan pa rgya che yang*// gdung bas snying la yang yang 'dod par 'byung*// bzang po dpal gyi mchod pa'i bkod pa ltar// bsam yas dpag tu med pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// nam mkha'i khams bkang phul bar gyur na yang*// brtse zhing gdung ba'i sems kyis phrad par smon// mnyes pa gsum gyis dus gsum bla ma rnams// srog la mi lta rtag tu mnyes byed pa// mchog gi rigs 'khrungs jo sras bdag gi bus// khyed dang bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs par byas// bdag kyang 'chi bdag khar chud na ba las// dge 'dun rnams dang khyed kyi 'bul ba dang*// dpon jo la sogs brtse ba'i nye gnas kyis// 'bad pa byas pas deng sang bde bar mchis// rgyud kyi rgyal po mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ni// myur du bris te nyid kyi zhal snga nas// nga yi 'drul

'grul pa gcig byung bar ma gyur tshe// ma bskur gsung bas phyis na bzod par gsol// ༈ //skyes chen gang zhig bsags pa mthar phyin pas// bdag gi bla mas shin tu smin mdzad pas// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang byung shar// skal ldan rang byung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang chen tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// 'gran zla med par phyogs rnams kun tu grags// mi yi seṅge rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// snyan pa'i 'brug sgra can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten mgon pos legs par bsngags pa yi// lhag pa'i tshul khrims rgyan gyis legs par brgyan// skye bo nyes tshogs rgya mtsho las sgrol ba// 'gro ba'i ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe gcig mchog gis byang chub sangs rgya ba// bla med gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// sangs rgyas dngos kyi brgyud pa ma chad pa'i// gdung rgyud 'dzin pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi gter// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal mi g.yo bas// 'khor 'das kun gyi bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas// mi zad mdzod 'dzin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma rin chen gyi// sras kyi thu bo 'gran gyi zla med pa// mchog gi dbang bskur thob la phyag 'tshal lo// skyes chen khyod kyis 'jig rten mgon po yi// bstan pa'i snying po gdan sa rin chen 'dzin// zhabs pad len sogs 'gro ba thams cad bskyangs// bstan pa'i bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa chen po bzhugs sam grongs kyang rung*// khyod kyi mos gus 'dus byas ma yin pas// lhun gyis grub cing rgyun chad mi mnga' ba// mos gus mthar thug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas nyid kyis sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed// rgyal po'i btsun mo rgyal po nyid kyi yin// yab kyi gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru// sras kyi thu bo dam pa khyod nyid kyis// thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir mdzad pa mtha' yas mdzad// khyod kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho la// bdag cag rjes su sgrub po'i bu slob rnams// khyed kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir// ci gsung bka' bzhin bgyid do thugs la btags// gong ma'i zhal mthong gsung thos ma gyur kyang*// sku gsung thugs kyi sras mchog yid 'ong ba// seng ge glang chen yid bzhin nor 'dra ba'i// bu dang tsha bo rnams kyang ci gsung bgyid// dpal gyi ming can ri khrod ldom bu pas// rgya nag rgyal po phyag gi mdzod nas phyung*// mgon po 'jam dbyangs 'phrul bas rnam 'phrul bas// khri gtsug ral pa can gyi na bza' 'di// thugs brtser dgongs nas sku la gsol bar zhu//

// 470) ༄// dge bshes ber ston klag ston sogs rngod pa'i sgom chen rnams la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// gtsug gi nor bu rin po che// 'gran gyis do zla med pa yi// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// dam pa de yi zhabs rdul la// cung zad reg par gyur pa yi// thub mgon shākya seng ge yi// rgyal sras ri khrod ldom bu pas// rang gi rigs las byung ba yi// dge bshes 'ber ston klag ston dang*// seṅge glang chen 'dra ba yi// bu slob rnams la zhu ba'i don// bkra shis sgo mang rag rdo 'di// de sngon khyod kyis thugs la btags// rag rdo snga mas ma 'dang zhing*// da rung mang po dgos par 'dug /gdan khri rin chen lto bo che// khams gsum srid gsum zas nor dang*// zangs dang rag rdo ji snyed cig /gsol yang 'grangs par ma gyur pas// bzang la mang ba thugs la thogs// zhabs tog byas pa'i gtang rag tu// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku gsung thugs dang khyed nyid kyi// lus ngag yid gsum 'dres gyur pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// rngod pa'i sgom chen pa rnams la/ rag rdo'i zhe 'dod zhus pa rdzogs so// // 471) ༄// nyon mongs rnam gsum gyi dbang du mi gtong ba bla med theg pa'i nyams len gyi skor// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig bskal pa grangs med mtha' yas par// thabs dang shes rab tshogs gnyis bsags pa mthar phyin pas// sku gnyis mngon du gyur nas rang gzhan don grub pa// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la rab btud nas// dge ba'i bshes kyi gsung mi gcag phyir bri bar bya// 'dir pha spad drung por gyur pas/ ku re dang kyal ka ni med/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ rang nyid kyi 'dug lugs zur tsam snyan du gsol na/ 'jig rten 'dir ni yun ring po sdod pa'i dbang med/ myur du 'chi dgos par 'dug 'o na shi bas chog mod snyam na shi bas lta mi chog ste/

rang gi bsam pa dge ba dang mi dge ba 'di/ rgya dang rgya'i 'bur bzhin du skye zhing 'byung bas/ bsam pa ngan pa spang zhing bzang po bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya ste/ de la bzang po ni gang*/ ngan pa ni gang zhe na/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// de skyed las ni mi dge ba// ma chags ma sdang gti mug med// des skyed las ni dge ba yin// zhes gsungs pas/ nyon mongs pa rnam gsum gyi dbang du mi btang zhing*/ de'i gnyen po ma chags pa zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa gsum nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'di'i nyams su len lugs shin tu mang yang*/ theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis/ nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i rjes su 'brangs nas bya ba thams cad bsgrub par bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ byams pa'i chu bo mi bcad cing*// snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brlan te// byang sems ljon shing rab rgyas nas// don gnyis 'bras bu smin mdzad gsol// zhes gsungs pas/ dang por sems can thams cad a ma drin can du bsgoms pa las skyes pa'i byams pa bsgom/ ma de 'gro ba rigs drug du sdug bsngal ba bsams pa las skyes pa'i snying rje bsgom/ ma sdug bsngal can 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya bar dam bcas pa'i bsam pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa bslab pa rin po che gsum nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de yang lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub/ stobs bcu thob par byed pa'i rgyu nges pa/ so so thar pa ris bdun gyi sdom pa/ rang gi srog dang bsdo ba/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu 'gro ba'i rkyal pa la rangs pa dang*/

phyed dang sum cha dang*/ lag mthil tsam mam snyung bu'i shul tsam blangs pa las/ de gang med kyang rgya mtsho brgal bar mi nus pa'i dpe bstan pa ltar/ nyes byas shin tu phra ba yan chad rang nyid kyis bsrung ba ni/ tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ bgyis pa dang*/ rang gi nye du dang gnyen 'brel/ phyogs dang ris sems can gyis bsdus pa gang ci yang rung ste/ re rag 'jigs gsum gang yod tshad thams cad/ tha na sna gcig bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen nam/ nyin gcig gam mtshan gcig bsrung ba'am/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yan chad la 'god pa ni bgyid du bstsal ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ dper na rang nyid khyim par gyur nas/ dge slong tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa mthong na/ de la rjes su yi rang zhing dga' ba dang*/ mgu ba dang*/ yon tan dang legs par brjod cing*/ thal mo tsam zhig sbyar ba byas pas kyang tshul khrims kyi bsod nams mnyam por thob pa'am/ de las lhag par 'gyur ba bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ nor bu 'ching bu'i phung po chen por gyur pa yang*// rin chen bai ḍūrya gcig de kun zil gyis gnon// de bzhin 'gro kun sbyin pa'i phung po rgya chen kun// rjes su yi rang byang chub sems dpas zil gyis gnon// zhes pa dang*/ de las bzlog pa ni/ 'phags pa rtogs pa chen po las/ gang zhig dge ba spyod mthong la// 'phya zhing bskur te ma mos na// dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs kyang gcod// ces gsungs pas/ rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gal che bar gsungs pas/ tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du bstsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba zur tsam smos pa des mtshon nas/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa rang nyid bsgoms pa dang*/ sgom du bstsal ba dang*/ sgom pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa/

thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab rang gi rgyud la skyes pa dang*/ bskyed pa dang*/ bskyed du bstsal ba dang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab gang yang rung*/ skyes shing bskyed pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpag tu med par 'jug pa/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi bde ba dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas/ thabs khyad par du 'phags shing bla na med pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po nyid la lhun gyis grub cing rtsol sgrub mi 'tshal bar gyur pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i bdag por gyur pa lags pa la/ bdag cag bla mar gyur pa rnams dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa thams cad la yang bka' drin che zhing rjes su yi rang bar gyur pa lags pas/ de yang bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis rang gzhan thams cad smin pa dang*/ grol ba'i brtul zhugs dang khur chen po snoms par zhu 'tshal lags te/ 'di ni thabs mkhas pa bla na med pa'o// de la shes rab ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ shes rab bden don gtan la 'bebs// zhes pas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni rang gi sems/ sems ni gdod nas ma skyes pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma gzigs pa/ mi gzigs/ gzigs par mi 'gyur ba/ grub pa'i mtha' thams cad dang*/ blos byas pa'i lta ba thams cad dang bral ba yin pas/ 'di ltar rang nyid la nga zhes bya ba'am/ bdag ces bya ba phyin ci log tu 'khrul ba'i blo'i khyad par gyis/ bdag yod pa dang*/ med pa dang*/ stong pa dang*/ mi stong pa dang*/ dben pa dang*/ mi dben pa dang*/ zhi ba dang ma zhi ba zhes bya ba bdag gi khyad par gyi chos log par lta ba mkhas pa thams cad kyis rgyang ring du bsrings pa yin pas/

khyed kyis bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis rtogs par bya'o// de ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes bskyed cing gsol ba gdab/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas/ bla ma dam pa'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ rang gi shes pa gcig tu 'dres nas/ nor bu rin po che chu dang rnyog gseb du bcug pa ltar nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad chu dwangs snyigs phyed pa bzhin du/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dang*/ dwangs snyigs phyed nas mngon du 'gyur te/ de ltar yang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ nyams myong dang rtogs pa gcig tu mchi// rgyun chad med par rtag na yin// zhes gsungs pas/ lhun gyis grub pa'i de kho na nyid/ de nyid la rgyun tu goms par bya ste/ 'di ni dus thams cad kyi nyams len no// bye brag sgom pa'i rim pa ni/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyis/ skyon thams cad ni spangs/ yon tan gyi tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu ni rdzogs pa'i 'khrul 'khor rdo rje'i gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du/ bdud sde dang bcas pa thams cad ni pham par mdzad cing*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i bzhugs lugs/ thub pa chen po nyid kyis dam bca' mdzad pa/ ji srid zag med ma thob pa// de srid skyil dkrung bshig mi bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ dben pa'i gnas su 'bol ba'i stan bting*/ lus skyil mo krung legs par bca'/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnas par byas nas/

dang por byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa thugs kar bsam/ sems ma bcos pa rang sor bzhag yod dang med dang stong dang mi stong dang*// bdag dang bdag med zhi dang ma zhi dang*// mnyam par bzhag dang langs pa'i 'du shes las// rnam par dben pa'i don de khyod kyis goms par mdzod// 'khor ba nyon mongs rnam rtog yin gyur na// de nyid rang sar grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa// 'khor ba chos skur gyur pa ma yin nam// 'jig rten gsum mgon bla ma rin chen gyis// 'khrul pa ye shes yin zhes bka' bstsal gsung*// tho yor skyes bus 'jigs shing skrag pa'i mi// skyes bu med par shes na 'jigs shing skrag pa bral// bdag dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog kyang*// de dang 'dra bar 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs// rnam par rtog pa ma rig chen po ste// rtog pa'i gshis nyid lhun grub mi rtog par// spang blang med par go ba'i rnal 'byor pas// chos kun khong du ma chud ci zhig yod// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ji lta bu zhig spang*// mya ngan 'das pa su yis ji ltar thob// mnyam nyid bde chen 'di dang mi 'bral mdzod// nad dang gnod pa nyes tshogs rgya mtsho kun// nyon mongs rnam rtog nyid las nges 'byung na// de yi gnyen po 'di las gzhan pa'i chos// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis mi rnyed pas// dge ba'i bshes kyis nyams su blang bar zhu// rdzogs so// //

472) ༄// skyes bu dam pa'i thugs dam me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba gces pa'i snying po// oṃ swasti/ ji ltar padmo chu yis ma gos ltar// nyes tshogs skyon gyis ma gos bla ma dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas dam pa'i chos rnams la// gus pas rab btud zhus lan yi ger bri// mi mjed 'jig rten thub pas 'dul ba'i zhing*// nyon mongs stobs 'phel snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gdug pa'i mi rnams nyon mongs dug 'phel ba// khyed spun 'gro ba'i gnyen bshes skyes mchog gis// gdug pa'i me rlabs thams cad zhi bya zhes// phyogs rnams kun tu rgya cher rab grags pa// brtse bar gnas pa bdag cag rjes yi rang*// gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi lus thob pa shin tu dka' ba dang*// dal 'byor thob pa de bas shin tu dkon// thub pa'i bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba// dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyed la 'di nyid rigs// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang ji bzhin du// skyon med dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams btsal zhing*// sde snod rin po che la mkhyen pa sbyangs// bslab gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan can sku mched kyis// bya bar 'os pa'i byed pa shin tu mdzad// sangs rgyas nyid nas da lta phan chad du// don rgyun ma chad tshig tshogs spros pa yi// tshong dus 'o ma spangs pa'i dam pa'i chos// mos gus lces blangs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas// dul ba'i rang bzhin cang shes glang chen gyis// bya bar 'os pa mdzad pa ngo mtshar che// rdo rje 'chang chen dpal ldan chos kyi rjes// dbang bskur byin rlabs mdzad nas shar phyogs kyi// 'gro ba dpag med phan bde la 'god cing*// thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin par gnyer gtad pa'i// bstan pa'i khur bsnams bla ma mnyes mdzad pa// dam pa khyed la bla ma rin chen dgyes// skyes chen de yi bu slob cang shes la// cang shes tshogs kyis bskor ba'i glang po dang*// seng ge gcan gzan tshogs kyis bskor ba ltar// mkhas dang btsun dang rtogs dang grol ba dang*// dul bar gnas pa rgya mtsho lta bu rnams// dga' ba drag pos rangs shing dgyes par mdzad// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kun// byang chub sems kyi dbang gyur khyed nyid la// mig rtsa hrig hrig blta zhing re ba che// 'di yis bdag cag thams cad 'khor ba dang*// ngan song sdug bsngal gnas las skyob mdzad ces// re bar gyur pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kun// sgrol bar dam bcas skyes bu chen po yis// mdzad pa rlabs chen ci yi phyir mi mdzad// smig rgyu'i rgya mtshos khyer ba'i 'gro ba rnams// gzings dang gru zam mnyan pa'i thabs rnams kyis// 'bad pa bye ba khrag khrig mang byas shing*// ji snyed bsgral ces bdag nyid mgu ba dang*// ma brgal sgrol ba'i thabs la 'bad pa dang*// sgrol bzhin pa la skyo ba med pa rnams// smig rgyu chu yis stong par shes tsam gyis// bsgral bya sgrol byed sgrol ba'i rtsol ba la// rnal 'byor dbang phyug su ko dga' ba skye// blo yi bya ba thongs dang rtogs ldan kun// yod ma myong ba bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yid// phung po 'di la bdag tu bzung ba yis// chags dang ldan pa dug gi stobs 'phel bas// rgyal zhing myos par gyur pa'i skye bo la// sman pa'i rgyal po bdud rtsi mchog 'dzin la// rang nyid dug 'thungs nad par gyur nas kyang*// nad kyis gdungs pas gso bar mi byed pa'i// sman pa'i rgyal po rigs pa ma yin zhes// skye dgu kun gyis khong du chud par 'gyur// glang chen dbang pos khur mchog khyer ba ltar// bstan pa'i bdag pos bstan pa'i khur khyer ba// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kun// re ba rang gnas 'di la khyed kyis 'bad// mang du 'di la smos kyang ci 'tshal te// sems can rnyed pa med la smod pa dang*// rnyed pa can la mi snyan smra ba dang*// mos pa tha dad sems can sna tshogs kyi// bsam pa rgyal bas mgu bar mi nus zhes// khyed rang nyid kyis dpag med gsung ba de// thugs la bzhag cing yang yang bsam par rigs// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus kun// nyes tshogs sgrib pa rab spangs te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog thob shog

/skyes bu dam pa'i thugs dam me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba gces pa'i snying po rdzogs so// // 473) ༄// bla ma mnyes par byed pa'i rin chen zhes pa ston pa rgyal ba 'bum gyi zhu chos// 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan chos kyi rje// kun mkhyen brtse ba'i bdag nyid rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa'i bsod snyoms pas// gzhan gyis ci byas tshad mar ma byas shing*// ci gsung bka' la gus pas spyi bos blangs// 'bri la g.yag tu gsung yang nges pa bskyed// bdag 'dzin goms pa'i stobs rgyas 'gyur med pa// mtha' 'khob yul du skyes pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis// shes pa tha rgod mi tshad rdo rjer gyur// dkar po lo tog skye ba'i gnas med kyang*// bla ma bden no ba yi khe grags kyis// gsung bzhin byed lo tsam gyis phyir phyir zhing*// phan zhing bde ba'i nges shes je cher song*// bla ma snying nas mad par deng sang go// ci gsung bka' bzhin byed pa'i mos gus can// srog la mi ltos bla ma mnyes byed pa// rang gi bu la mgon po'i gsung 'di gdams// de dang der gsungs rgyu mtshan 'bras// lha dang sku 'bag yi ge gsum// dug dang ltem rkyang brjod bya gsum// 'khor dang longs spyod gegs sel gsum// bogs 'don gnad dang byang chub che// brid bsdigs tshogs dang dpag gi dam chos dang*// 'brel gtam thugs phebs bka' bstsal gsung gi gnad// bu gcig sems la zhog dang chos kyi bu// sngon yang gsung bzhin byas la de bzhin du// da yang bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin du// nan tan chen pos bsgrub cing dang du blang*// ma 'gyod mi 'gyod 'gyod pa med par 'gyur// mos gus je che nges shes bla med cing*// phul du byung zhing rang la dga' mgu ba'i// rin chen gsung de khyed la ngo sprod bya// bka' bkyon gsung la log lta ma skyes shing*// ci gsung tshad mar byed pa'i mos gus can// kun gyi yid 'ong skyes bu dam pa yi// ston pa shes rab 'bum gyis dam chos 'di// dge 'dun rnams dang 'gro la phan pa'i phyir// dad cing gus pas zhus pa'i yi ge 'di// bla ma rnams dang rgyal ba sras bcas kun// mnyes par byed pa'i rin chen zhes pa'o// rdzogs so//

// 474) ༄// rang sems rang byung 'dus ma byas zhes pa byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rtog pa thams cad spangs pa'i phyir// 'gro 'ong med pa'i rin po che// rtag tu byang chub gling na bzhugs// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// phan dang bde ba'i rang bzhin de// sems can kun gyi khams la bzhugs// sngon gyi thugs rje smon lam gyis// rtag tu phan bde bskyed pa yi// bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs// mos gus can la rtag tu bzhugs// nga 'bu sprang po ri khrod pa// nges pa med pa'i rnal 'byor 'di// spyir ni gangs khrod ri khrod 'grim// nam yang dbu ru'i phyogs su mchi// da res tshur byon mi chen rnams// shi gzir ro gzir ma mdzad par// 'di yi babs la dgongs nas kyang*// da res cung zhig glod par zhu// zhi ba chags bral lha dang mis mchod pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /skyabs gnas mthar thug rin po che// rang sems chos sku 'dus ma byas// 'khor 'das kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// rang sems sangs rgyas skyabs su mchi// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// rang gis rang gi ye shes ni// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// sems spros bral rtogs na chos kyi sku// rang sems rdo rje phyag 'tshal zhes// skyob mdzad 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub gsungs// soms dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// rang sems bzang po ma gtogs pa// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la// skyabs dang dpung gnyen gzhan med pa// glen pa da rung ma go 'am// kwa a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// snying dang 'dra ba'i shag po la// skyabs dang re gnas ma mchis te// rang la yod pa'i dus tshod du// phye gtor byed cing shan shun 'byed// gus pas bsnyen bkur byas na yang*// phye 'gam de la de phed ces// mi mthun phyogs kyi dgra bo la// dgra la thob pa'i snying gtam bshad// kha sbyang mchu sbyang sna tshogs kyis// khong pa'i nang cha 'bru bar byed// zur smras tshig gcig shor ba na// ngan smras brgya tsam btags nas kyang*// kho yi rna bar skyel bar byed// nyin phyed mun ni rub pa bzhin// thams cad dus gcig dgra bor 'gyur// nyon mongs dug gi stobs 'phel nas// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas man chad nas// khams gsum sems can yan chad kyi// skyon bsams ngag tu thon pa yis// sangs rgyas rnams dang sems can la// skyon rnams thams cad blangs pa las// sangs rgyas sems can dag las byung*// dkar po'i sa bon tshig pa na// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong tshe// sangs rgyas sems can gang la yang*// yon tan skye ba'i skal med pa// 'jigs shing ya nga 'di 'dra bar// bzhi bkyigs legs par byas nas kyang*// tsham tshom med par bskyur bar byed// rtog gnyis cig car mi 'jug cing*// sems gnyis 'grogs shing mi 'phrad pas// thos bsam sgom gsum gang gis kyang*// yon tan rgyud la mi skye ba// kyi hud sdig pa'i grogs pos bslus// kyi hud kyi hud ji ltar bya// srin po gshed ma mdza' bo'i gzugs// 'di phyi ma lus thams cad du// phung byed sdig pa'i grogs po la// skyabs gnas ma re rang sems bsgom// rang sems rang byung 'dus ma byas// gtan gyi skyabs gnas min re shi// thar pa'i bar du gcod pa'i bdud// mkhan po slob dpon mched grogs dang*// yon bdag pho mo la sogs pa// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa yis// sdig pa'i grogs por bstan pa yi// spyi yi rnam gzhag zur tsam mo// shag po skyabs gnas ma yin pa'i tshoms so//

༈ //kye ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// gnas 'di 'dra nges par btsal nas kyang*// dus ring por sdod pa'i bsam pa yis// gnas gcig la skyabs gnas mi btsal bar// sems gnyis med ye shes rdo rje gdan// dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs sa 'dir// rgyun chad med par bzhugs lags na// dung phyur sum cu so drug gi// srod la bdud kyi tshogs bcom nas// tho rangs mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas// gnyis med ye shes gnas kyi mchog /gnyug ma'i rang so ma zin na// gnas gang du bsdad kyang sa yi thog /a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// lo phyed dang gsum du sems khral byas// gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i yul dbus su// mkhar zur mang mthon po'i nang shed du// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gnas bcas nas// rang gzhan smin par bzhed na yang*// ngo mtshar can gyi dgon pa la// ha cang thugs rje che drags pas// mos gus can gyi bu slob rnams// lus sems dra sha chad par byed// bsags pa can gyi yon bdag gis// rdzas dang yo byad gang yin rnams// g.yo sgyu thabs kyi bye brag gis// nan tshir byas nas mkhar len byed// dad pa can gyi dad rdzas rnams// dkon mchog gsum po mi mchod cing*// chos ldan drung na yod pa'i yang*// ci yod shan shun phye nas kyang*// dgon par bsdod pa'i so tshis kyis// gtso bo mi chen srid du gcod// nam yang 'khrug pa'i so tshis byed// slob dpon thugs kyi dgongs pa de// bu slob drung na 'dug pas lon// nyin phyed mun ni rub pa bzhin// gtam ngan lung pa khengs pa dang*// gcig kyang 'khor mi med pa dang*// dgon par sdod dbang med pa dang*// gong gi bsam ngan rgyu 'bras kyis// gnas de rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur nas// 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du// rang dang rang la brtse ba rnams// e ma ngan sar bskyur ba 'di// rang la rang snying mi rje 'am// kye ma kyi hud ji ltar bya// gnas dang gzhi dang khang pa dang*// zhen cing chags pa'i dgon pa yi// nyes skyon chen po mthong nas kyang*// skyob pa rgyal ba thams cad kyis// 'du 'dzi chags pas dben pa yi// dgon pa'i bsngags pa gsungs pa dang*// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// gnas gang du sdod kyang gzhal yas khang*// chags pa med pa'i 'bol stan 'ding*// gnas gang dang gang du bsdod na yang*// yun ring por sdod pa'i bsam pa spang*// gsung gi rjes su 'brangs nas kyang*// gnas la skyabs gnas 'tshol ba yi// bsam pa gtad la rang sems bsgom// gnas skyabs gnas ma yin pa'i tshoms so//

༈ //deng sang snyigs ma'i dus la bab// rtsod pa bdo ba'i dus tshod 'dir// rdzas dang yo byad phal cher rnams// bsod nams tshogs su 'gro ba nyung*// dus bzang bskal pa bzang dus na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byung ba rnams// stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba yi// rgyal srid ma lus spangs nas kyang*// thub pa bsod nams spyod pa dang*// 'phags pa gnas brtan 'od srung dang*// skyes chen bye ba nyi shu pa// shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan sogs// thub pa drang srong chen po rnams// rdzas dang yo byad spangs nas kyang*// bdag nyid chen po bsod snyoms spyod// skyes chen gong ma'i rnam thar la// ci phyir bdag cag slob mi byed// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// phung byed rdzas dang yo byad 'di// ji snyed dgra dang chom rkun dang*// gdug pa mtshon dang dug sogs kyis// 'jigs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// gsog 'jog med la 'jigs pa ci// sdig dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis// bsags pa'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams// sbrang mas 'bad de rtsi bsags kyang*// sbrang rtsi gzhan gyis spyod par byed// nor yang sdig pa'i rgyur song zhing*// lus kyang sdig pa'i rgyur song nas// 'jigs su rung ba'i dmyal ba yi// bud shing byed pa a re 'jigs// phyin ci log tu 'khrul pa'i blo// dngos dang brgyud pa thams cad du// phung bar byed pa'i zas nor la// skyabs dang rten sa byed pa 'di// shes pa 'khrul lam gdon gyis brlams// sor bcu brang la bkrams nas kyang*// legs par soms dang bsam gzhig can// nor dang rdzas dang yo byad rnams// skyabs dang rten sa ma yin zhing*// phal cher dngos dang brgyud par yang*// phung bar 'gyur zhes ston pas gsungs// rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams// sems kyi nor bu rin chen ni// dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba ste// rje btsun bram ze chen po yis// nor gyi nor mchog chog shes nor// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod dgu ma lus 'byung ba yi// rin chen sems la phyag 'tshal zhes// sems nyid rdo rje bstod pa dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// byang chub sems 'di gcig pu las// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// 'khor dang yon tan kun 'byung ba// gsung rab rnams su rgya cher bshad// des na rang sems rin chen la/

/gtan gyi nor bu mdzad par zhu// nor rten sa dang skyabs ma yin pas byang chub kyi sems nor chen por bstan pa'i tshoms so// ༈ //e ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// legs par soms dang rje btsun pa// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yus po che// goms pa'i stobs can snying rus can// rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang rnams// khyod kyi nga bdag de yin nam// ha ha ngu bro gad mo thob// phyin ci log gi rten 'brel las// nyes pa mang po'i phung po 'di// dang por skye ba'i sdug bsngal bsgrub// kun tu rlung dang mkhris pa dang*// bad kan 'dus pa nad kyi gzhi// bar du rgas shing 'khogs pa bskyed// mtha' mar 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang*// dgra dang gdon dang sdug bsngal tshogs// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// 'khor ba mtha' med sdug bsngal tshogs// nyes pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// spyi bo gtsug nas rkang mthil bar// mi gtsang rdzas kyis gang ba 'di// phyi sgyur byas na 'jigs kyang 'jigs// e ma a dzi a la la// phung po sdug pa'i dgra chen la// skyabs gnas ma 'tshol mkhas pa rnams// bdag tu ma 'dzin rnal 'byor pa// snying rje ma che thugs rje can// khyu mchog shākya'i rgyal po dang*// sngon gyi drang srong chen po rnams// rnam shes phung po la sogs pa// phung po dgra las rgyal ba'i phyir// 'phags pa dgra bcom ma lags sam// phung po dgra chen 'joms byed pa// mtha' dang bral ba gnyug ma'i sems// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje la// rgyun chad med par skyabs su song*// bdag phung po'i yin/ phung po bdag gi yin zhes pa rul pa la skyabs mi btsal ba'i tshoms so// ༈ //da ni mi rgod rnam rgyal rnams// su dang mi 'dra dbang po che// rgyal po tshogs dpon dge ba'i bshes// khas blangs snying la bsams pa rnams// phyag len mdzad pa'i brtul zhugs can// dgra gnyen 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnams// chu yi chu bur ji bzhin du// rkyen las skye zhing 'byung ba rnams// skye zhing 'gag pa ma go ba// dgra gnyen 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog can// rmongs pa'i byis pa snying rje'i gnas// glen pa yus kyis brnangs pa rnams// shes rab mig dang nam yang bral// bsam pa'i snying yang bud pa yi// ngas byas can gyi dbang po che// rnam rtog mi rtag ma go 'am// don 'di shes rab sna tshogs nas// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// skar ma rab rib mar me dang*// sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang*// rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu// 'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta// gzhan yang 'du byas mi rtag pa// ston pas dpag med gsungs pa rnams// 'khor ba 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i// rgyu mtshan de yis nges pa yin// mi rtag pa nyid sdug bsngal bas// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di// rnam par rtog pa kho na yin// rtog pa thog mtha' med pas na// 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa yin// rnam rtog mu mtha' med pas na// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa yin// ji ltar sgyu ma mkhan po yis// sngags dang rdzas kyi rten 'brel rnams// tshogs pa yod na sgyu ma 'byung*// de la thog ma mtha' ma dang*// mu mtha' yod par mi 'gyur ba// de bzhin 'khor ba'i thog mtha' dang*// mu mtha' yod par mi 'gyur ro// 'khor ba'i dbus dang thog mtha' rnams// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// gang gis ma shes ma rig pa// de la 'du byed nas bzung ste// rga shi'i bar du 'khor gyur na// ci phyir gdod nas ma skyes pa// gnyis med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems mi byed// des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// ma rig las byung 'du byed la// gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma mdzad par// sems nyid rang byung 'dus ma byas// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// rgyal ba sras bcas skyabs su song*// skyabs su song bas don chen grub// rang don chos kyi sku nyid dang*// gzhan don gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis// lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' ba// skyabs rang sems bsgom las byung bas na// skyabs med rnam par rtog pa la// skyabs dang re gnas mi btsal bar// sngon gyi sangs rgyas ji bzhin du// skyabs kyang dam pa rang sems bsgom// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa yi// rnam par rtog pa skyabs gnas ma yin pa'i tshoms so//

༈ //ji ltar mig gi dbang po yis// sna tshogs gzugs rnams mthong na yang*// rang gis rang nyid mi mthong ltar// gzhan gyis bdag ni bkur ba las// chen por rlom pa'i bsam pa yis// gzhan skyon ngan mtshang 'bru ba min// rang la bltas pas rang nyid kyi// re sa skyabs gnas 'di rnams la// re ltos shin tu che bar 'dug /re ltos gcod pa'i yi ge 'di// phag sna gtun bu byas pa yin// mkhas pa'i skye bo ma mnyes na// bzod pa dam pa bzhes par zhu// //

475) ༄// rang thed la btang nas gzhan don byed ces pa ston pa blo gros seng ger gsungs pa// rje bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgos bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' drin gyis// chos zab mo zhig la nges shes skyes// thabs mkhas pa zhig la nyams len byas// ston pa'i bstan la rab tu byung*// shākya'i rgyal po'i rjes su bslab// sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang du blangs// sa phyogs gar sdod gar gnas kyang*// bdag 'dzin nyal sa bla gang med// ji snyed rdzas la longs spyod kyang*// gsog 'jog phul gang byas pa med// 'dod dgu zong du bkram na yang*// khe skyed gang che blta ma myong*// che dgu 'khor du lhags na yang*// rang 'dod zhe 'dod byed ma myong*// zab dgu tshogs su bshad na yang*// nyams su ma myong smras pa med// nga rgyal po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// ston pa shākya seṅge yi// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// rang thed la btang nas gzhan don byas// phyogs ris med par gnyen du gyur// kun gyis bkur bas nga re brod// nga nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// che chung bsod nams gang bsags kyang*// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas na// mkha' la ri mo bris na yang*// mthong chos 'bras bu myur du 'byung*// nga la phul dang bsags pa can// nga skyi bser lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// gzung du med cing bcing du med// gnas la nges pa med pas na// cag cag tig tig med na yang*// gang du bsdad pa'i sa phyogs su// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs// gnas nga la phul dang mnga' thang can// nga seṅge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// rtsa ba sems nyid don rtogs pas// tshig tha snyad gtso bor 'dzin pa la// nyam nga bag tsha mi
